article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola: l'épidémie touche cinq provinces, près de 1.900 cas confirmés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: the outbreak hits five provinces, nearly 1,900 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Five provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are reporting Ebola infections, bringing the national total to 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths as of 12 July 2026, according to a government situation report. Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo are affected; Haut-Uele and Tshopo are newly included, with locally linked cases to Ituri via contacts and population movement. The report covers data through Friday and notes 763 patients in isolation or hospitalized, with a 95.1% bed-occupancy rate in treatment centers. A total of 306 patients have recovered. Authorities also logged 299 suspected cases, including 91 deaths. The outbreak is caused by Ebolavirus Bundibugyo and was declared on May 15. Ongoing monitoring continues across the affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ:流行が5州に拡大、確認症例数は約1,900人に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの5州に拡大し、1,873例確認・672人死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo種）のアウトブレイクが5月15日に宣言されて以降、Ituri・North Kivu・South Kivu・Haut-Uele・Tshopoの5州に拡大。病床占有率95.1%と医療体制の逼迫が見られ、国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: The hunt for hidden TB: How AI is changing India's fight against tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: VMTB and CATB, two AI tools from Wadhwani AI, advance India's TB control. VMTB uses AI-driven geospatial analytics to predict high-TB-risk areas, integrating TB data with over 20 indicators (population density, air quality, proximity to facilities) on a 500×500-metre grid to generate localized vulnerability rankings for villages and urban wards, guiding targeted active case finding and micro-planning. Integrated with the Ni-kshay portal, Haryana and Assam show improved TB detection. CATB, an offline Android app, analyzes cough sounds and symptoms to screen for presumptive pulmonary TB; after consent and registration, three coughs are recorded and analyzed, with presumptive cases referred for confirmatory tests and Ni-kshay updates. Deployed in 17 states and 148 districts, CATB has screened over 175,000 people aged 7–100, with 12–16% of detected TB cases being asymptomatic. As of 13 July 2026, the approach emphasizes proactive identification to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 隠れた結核を追え：AIがインドの結核対策をどう変えているか
triage.triage_reason: AI技術を用いた既存の結核対策プログラムの紹介記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事はAI技術を用いた検出改善策に関する技術紹介記事。新規の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 小虫叮咬竟让阿婆险丧命 发现恙虫病请及时就医 _新闻频道_厦门网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A tiny insect bite nearly cost an elderly woman her life; if you suspect scrub typhus, please seek medical attention promptly.
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi) caused a near-fatal multi-organ failure in a 70-year-old woman in Xiamen, Fujian Province, China. After a chigger bite during outdoor work, she developed a sustained fever up to 41°C and rapidly progressed to respiratory, circulatory, renal, hepatic, and coagulation failure, requiring ICU care at Xiamen University Affiliated Haicang Hospital for about two weeks before recovery and discharge. Chiggers inhabit grasses, shrubs, and forested areas; bites are painless due to anesthetic saliva, often leading to delayed diagnosis. The report urges that after outdoor activity, persistent high fever with a painless eschar, along with body aches, fatigue, or rash, warrants prompt medical attention and disclosure of outdoor exposure. Early diagnosis and treatment can reduce fever within 1–3 days and achieve a high cure rate.

triage.headline_ja: 小さな虫刺されが高齢女性を死の淵に―ツツガムシ病を疑ったら速やかに受診を（厦門網ニュース）

article.articleHeadline: جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل إصابات بالإيبولا في 5 مقاطعات وإجمالي الحالات يقترب من 1900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records Ebola infections in five provinces, with total cases nearing 1,900.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) outbreaks across five provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 12, 2026, with 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths nationwide. Affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and, for the first time, Out-Owili and Chobo provinces, with investigations indicating Out-Owili and Chobo cases are epidemiologically linked to the Ituri outbreak through contacts and population movement. Health facilities report 763 patients in isolation or in treatment, and bed occupancy at treatment centers is 95.1%. So far, 306 people have recovered, while 299 suspected cases have been identified, including 91 deaths. The outbreak was declared on May 15. The report emphasizes ongoing surveillance and cross-border coordination, with no specific index case disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、5州でエボラ感染確認、累計感染者数は1900人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認例1,873人・死亡672人に達するエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが5州に拡大しており、新規2州（Out-OwiliおよびChobo）への拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域リストにAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内の5州（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Out-Owili, Chobo）のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 민주 콩고, 에볼라 확진자 1873명까지 늘어...감염 지역도 확대 - 동행미디어 시대
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola confirmed cases rise to 1,873... infected areas also expand - Donghaeng Media Era
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,873 confirmed cases. A July 12 government report, with data through July 10, shows the outbreak expanding to five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Chopo. Haut-Uele and Chopo are newly included in the national outbreak map; infections in these areas are linked to the Ituri cluster. Transmission is attributed to population movements and refugee displacement from Ituri. Currently, 763 confirmed cases are isolated or receiving hospital care. National hospital bed occupancy stands at 95.1%. Recoveries total 306, while 299 cases are still classified as suspected. The report signals ongoing, multi-province transmission driven by mobility, with the outbreak intensifying in new areas.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ、エボラ確定患者1,873人に増加…感染地域も拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5州に拡大し確定症例1,873例、病床占有率95.1%と医療逼迫が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 北キブ州(North Kivu)は対象国リストの一部としてDRC国内に含まれる。人口移動・難民移動が感染拡大の主要因とされ、国境を越えた拡大リスクも懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 6月新增新冠确诊7.9万例 死亡1例 病例数呈上升趋势
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In June, 79,000 new confirmed COVID-19 cases, 1 death; the number of cases is on the rise.
article.articleSummary: In June 2026, China reported 79,000 new laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 cases, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (involving underlying disease). The data, published by the National CDC on July 8, 2026, show a rising trend in confirmed cases. Sentinel hospitals observed influenza-like illness patients testing positive for SARS-CoV-2 increasing from 2.9% in the first week of June to 6.4% in the last week. The predominant lineage remains Omicron NB.1.8.1 and its sub-branches. Hu Yang, chief physician at Shanghai Pulmonary Hospital, notes a small summer peak in June–August but overall control without a large-scale outbreak. Historical context: 2023 June severe cases 1,968 (July 455), 2024 June 112 (July 203), with rising positivity from 8.9% to 18.7%; 2025 June cases 333,229, July 226,567, showing a slow, fluctuating decline. Summer increases may reflect waning immunity, continued viral evolution, mobility, and indoor transmission, despite higher temperatures.

triage.headline_ja: 6月にCOVID-19新規確定症例7.9万件、死亡1例、症例数は上昇傾向
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の定例サーベイランス報告であり、季節性の小さな増加として説明され重症化率・死亡率は低く、大規模流行や新規異常事象は認められないが、増加傾向自体は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 中国国家疾病予防管理局が定例公表するCOVID-19サーベイランスデータ。専門家は夏季の小規模ピークとしており、大規模流行の兆候はないとされる。過去数年と比較しても重症例・死亡数は低水準。

article.articleHeadline: 夏季新冠感染为何反复出现小高峰？医生解读→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why do summer COVID-19 infections repeatedly show small peaks? Doctors explain.
article.articleSummary: China reports 79,000 new COVID-19 cases in June 2026, with 130 severe cases and 1 death from underlying conditions. Sentinel surveillance shows COVID-19 positivity among influenza-like illness rising from 2.9% in early June to 6.4% in late June; NB.1.8.1 and its sublineages remain dominant. Hu Yang, chief physician of the Respiratory Department at Shanghai Pulmonary Hospital (affiliated Tongji University), notes that summer small peaks are common but do not indicate a large outbreak. Contributing factors include waning post-infection immunity, immune-evasive mutations (NB.1.8.1, XBB family), increased summer mobility and gatherings, and closed indoor air-conditioning environments with limited ventilation and mucosal dryness. The article cites a 2024 pattern (June peak, July acceleration, August peak); 2026 June shows a similar trend at lower levels; July data will clarify. Preventive measures: wear masks in crowded places, hand hygiene, ventilation, adequate rest, and seek medical care if fever or cough appears.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季新型コロナ感染はなぜ繰り返し小さなピークを見せるのか？医師が解説
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の小規模な感染増加であり、重症化率・死亡率も低く、専門家により通常の季節変動と説明されている。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知の変異株（NB.1.8.1、XBB系統）による季節性の小ピークであり、専門家が『大規模流行ではない』と明言。COVID-19は既に監視・管理体制が確立された疾患であり、通常のサーベイランス情報として扱うべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: 인도 남동부서 코로나19로 2명 사망...확산 차단 '비상'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two dead from COVID-19 in Southeastern India... emergency to curb spread.
article.articleSummary: Two people died from COVID-19 in southeastern India, Andhra Pradesh, YSR Kadapa district, triggering emergency measures to curb spread. A 52-year-old man with fever and cough tested positive and died during hospital care; a 43-year-old man with complications also tested positive and died after admission. After the deaths, authorities traced contacts and found 8 additional infections, placing those individuals under home isolation. A rapid-response team was deployed to Kadapa, collecting samples from about 40 people in the outbreak area; 18 samples were negative, with results pending for the rest. The government ordered mask-wearing in crowded places and issued a state-wide COVID-19 alert. Families of cases are urged to test; positive results should be moved to isolation wards. India’s cumulative COVID-19 totals exceed 45 million cases and about 533,000 deaths, with rural undercount concerns noted by WHO and researchers.

triage.headline_ja: インド南東部でコロナ19感染により2人死亡…拡散阻止に「非常事態」
triage.triage_reason: アンドラプラデシュ州で死亡例を含むクラスターが発生し、当局が緊急対応（接触者追跡、隔離、マスク着用命令、州全体への警戒発令）を行っており、WPRO基準の複数項目（重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）と社会的関心（政府対応）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知のエンデミック疾患だが、局地的クラスターで死亡例と拡大対応が報告されているため、続報の有無を確認しつつ地域内対応状況を注視する必要がある。国際的拡大の兆候は現時点で不明。

article.articleHeadline: 夏季新冠感染为何反复出现小高峰 多重因素综合作用
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why Do Summer COVID-19 Infections Repeatedly Exhibit Small Surges? The Combined Effect of Multiple Factors.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, COVID-19 infections in China continue to show small summer surges. In June 2026, China reported 79,000 new confirmed cases, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (with underlying conditions). Sentinel hospitals show SARS-CoV-2 positivity among influenza-like illnesses rising from 2.9% in early June to 6.4% in late June. The dominant lineage remains Omicron NB.1.8.1 and its sublineages. Shanghai Pulmonary Hospital’s Respiratory Dept. chief Dr. Hu Yang says summer peaks are typical and manageable, with prior years showing June peaks and July upticks. Contributing factors include waning immune protection after autumn/winter infections, ongoing viral evolution and immune escape, increased summer travel, and closed indoor environments. Public health advice: wear masks in crowded places and on public transport, wash hands, vaccinate the elderly and chronically ill, and seek medical care for fever or cough.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季の新型コロナ感染がなぜ繰り返し小さなピークを見せるのか 複数要因の複合作用
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19小規模増加であり、重症度・死亡率とも低く、専門家も管理可能と評価しているため、シグナルとしての新規性・緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は例年通りの夏季COVID-19小流行を説明する解説記事であり、専門家が「管理可能」と明言している。新規変異株の報告もなく、既知のOmicron NB.1.8.1系統が主流。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情扩至5省 超1800例确诊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo expands to five provinces, with over 1,800 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has expanded to five provinces. As of July 12, 2026, the country reports 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths. Two new provinces, Qiao-bo (Qiao-bo) and Shang-wei-lai (Shang-wei-lai), are affected, with cases linked to the Nyania region in Ituri Province. Previously affected areas were Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. About 763 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized, and 306 have recovered. Notably, South Kivu has recorded no new confirmed cases since May 26, and by July 7 had 42 consecutive days without new cases—double the Ebola virus’s longest known incubation period. The update underscores ongoing transmission and geographic spread, underscoring the need for sustained surveillance and response in the five-province outbreak. Keywords: outbreak, vaccination, surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、5州に拡大 確認症例1,800例超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が5州に拡大し、1,800例超の確定例と672例の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率は約36%（672/1873）と高く、複数州への拡大が続いている。南キブ州では新規症例なしの期間が伸びているが、全体としては依然拡大傾向にあり、国際的な支援・監視体制の継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ZMB: Epidemic - 07-2026 - Measles outbreak (2026-07-10) - Zambia
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak declared in Zambia (ZMB) with index case: 6-year-old female from Kapengela village, Shangombo District Hospital; fever, maculopapular rash, cough, conjunctivitis, coryza; vaccination history unknown. Measles IgM positive by UTH Virology Laboratory on 16 May 2026, formally declaring the outbreak. On 6 May 2026, an unverified cross-border report of a parallel outbreak in Rivungu Municipality, Angola, involved 6 suspected cases aged 2–6 years. Verification in the eIDSR system prompted activation of the Public Health Emergency Rapid Response Team (PHERRT). The Zambian outbreak has grown substantially, while Angola remains static at 66 cumulative cases and 6 confirmed, with no new cases in the most recent 24 hours. Government requests for international assistance: No; National Society requests international assistance: Yes. Actions include RCCE for health and hygiene promotion; information bulletin has not yet been published. Cross-border transmission risk remains considerations for ongoing response.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：疫学速報 - 2026年7月 - 麻疹（はしか）の発生（2026年7月10日）- ザンビア
triage.triage_reason: ザンビアで麻疹アウトブレイクが正式宣言され、規模が拡大しているうえ、アンゴラとの国境を越えた並行発生（未検証）が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと国内対応体制（PHERRT）の稼働が確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: アンゴラでの並行発生は未検証（unverified cross-border report）であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン接種歴や重症度（入院・死亡）の詳細情報が不足しており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DepEd: Grade 4 student dies of septic shock, several learners felt unwell after Cavite school deworming
article.articleSummary: On July 13, 2026, DepEd Cavite confirmed that a Grade 4 pupil at Hugo Perez Elementary School-Annex in Trece Martires City died from an infection that led to septic shock following a deworming activity conducted on July 2 with the City Health Office. Several learners felt unwell after the event, and the pupil was hospitalized the next day after experiencing vomiting. Initial medical findings link the death to septic shock caused by infection. Authorities are investigating what occurred during the deworming activity and its aftermath, and DepEd says it will review health and safety protocols to safeguard learners. The department extends condolences and provides emotional, psychological, and logistical support to the family, and urges reliance on verified health information. DepEd Cavite pledges full cooperation with authorities should legal processes arise.

triage.headline_ja: DepEd:カビテ州の小学校で駆虫剤投与後、小学4年生の児童が敗血症性ショックで死亡、複数の児童が体調不良を訴える
triage.triage_reason: 学校での駆虫活動後に児童が死亡し複数の体調不良者が出ており、原因不明の感染症疑いで当局が調査中。社会的・行政的関心が高いためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 感染源・病原体は不明。駆虫剤投与との因果関係、汚染や医療過誤の可能性も含め調査中であり、感染症アウトブレイクか単発の医療事故かは現時点で不明。続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 中国6月冠病疫情升温 新增近八万确诊病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's COVID-19 outbreak heats up in June, with nearly 80,000 new confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: China’s June COVID-19 outbreak intensified, with 79,000–80,000 new confirmed cases reported nationwide across 31 provinces/autonomous regions/municipalities and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, including 130 severe cases and 1 death with underlying conditions. Sentinel surveillance for weeks 23–26 (Jun 1–28) showed rising influenza-like illness and SARS-CoV-2 positive rates of 2.9%, 4.1%, 5.3%, and 6.4%. Genomic surveillance captured 3,741 local Omicron sequences, dominated by NB.1.8.1 and sublineages (fractions: 98.5%, 98.1%, 98.8%, 95.9% across weeks 23–26). No evidence of a new variant with increased public-health risk. Week 27 (Jun 29–Jul 5) respiratory pathogens were influenza (11.6%), SARS-CoV-2 (9.6%), and enteroviruses (9.1%). Public health guidance urges masking in medical settings and crowded venues, especially for the elderly and those with chronic conditions, and advocates vaccination for vulnerable groups (pregnant women, young children, seniors, chronic-disease patients).

triage.headline_ja: 中国、6月の新型コロナウイルス感染症流行が拡大、新規確定症例約8万人
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ増加を示す定例サーベイランス報告であり、新規変異株や公衆衛生リスク増加の証拠はなく、重症化率・死亡率も低い。
triage.notes: 既知のOmicron系統(NB.1.8.1)による季節性流行であり、新規リスク増加を示す変異株の証拠はない。中国国内の定例サーベイランスレポートに基づく内容。

article.articleHeadline: ஆந்​தி​ரா​வில் மீண்​டும் கரோனா பரவு​கிறது: 2 பேர் உயி​ரிழப்பு; 8 பேருக்கு வைரஸ் தொற்று
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coronavirus spreading in Andhra: 2 dead; 8 infected.
article.articleSummary: Coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) spreading in Andhra Pradesh, Amaravati reports 2 deaths and 8 confirmed infections as authorities flag a new local transmission. The outbreak sits within the broader COVID-19 history: the virus originated in Wuhan, China in late 2019 and spread worldwide from 2020. India experienced three waves—first 2020–21, second in 2021, and a third early in 2022—during which about 4.50 crore people were infected and around 5.33 lakh died. Since May 2022, global transmission declined and normalcy returned. The article notes ongoing local transmission in Andhra Pradesh but provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation methods, or infection source beyond the general pandemic timeline. No information on travel-related, export, or import cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州で新型コロナウイルス再拡大：2人死亡、8人感染確認
triage.triage_reason: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州で小規模な新規感染・死亡が報告されているが、詳細情報（感染経路、検査手法、症状等）が不足しており、既知のCOVID-19の局地的発生として現時点では重大な国際的懸念に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19の既知の病原体による局地的な小規模再燃を報じており、パンデミック全体の歴史的背景も含むが、新規の異常事態や重大な公衆衛生上のインパクトを示す情報は乏しい。中国（武漢）は歴史的起源の言及のみで、現在の発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو يتوسع إلى 5 مقاطعات والإصابات تتجاوز 1800 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo expands to five provinces, with cases exceeding 1,800.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak has expanded to five provinces, with 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths reported as of July 13, 2026. The affected provinces are Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, with Haut-Uele and Tshopo listed in the national tally for the first time and linked to the Ituri outbreak. Health authorities report 763 patients in isolation or receiving treatment, and treatment-center bed occupancy at 95.1%. Cumulative recoveries stand at 306. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was first declared on May 15. The data illustrate ongoing transmission and an expanding geographic footprint, with new provincial cases traced to the Ituri cluster.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行が5州に拡大、感染者数が1800人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の流行が5州に拡大し、感染者1873例・死亡672例に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 致死率は約35.9%と高く、治療施設の病床占有率も95.1%と逼迫している。5州への拡大は地理的拡散の進行を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Weiterer amerikanischer Ebola-Patient jetzt in Deutschland | Foto: Boris Roessler/dpa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another American Ebola patient now in Germany | Photo: Boris Roessler/dpa.
article.articleSummary: Second American with Ebola, infected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, has been flown to Germany for treatment. He arrived at Frankfurt Airport on the night of 13 July 2026 and was taken to a university hospital in Hesse. The patient tested positive for the Bundibugyo variant; there is no vaccine or specific therapy for this strain. He follows the first U.S. physician, who arrived in Germany on 20 May and was treated at Berlin's Charité, ultimately discharged after about two weeks. His wife and four children, high‑risk contacts, were quarantined separately. German Health Ministry says there is no danger to the public. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and is hard to contain in the Congo, with roughly 650 confirmed deaths and at least 1,830 infections. In late June, the Bundibugyo variant reached Europe again in France, with a humanitarian worker isolated on arrival and discharged in early July after negative tests.

triage.headline_ja: さらに別のアメリカ人エボラ患者がドイツへ搬送 | 写真: Boris Roessler/dpa
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が約650人の死亡・1830人以上の感染を伴い、ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない中、既に複数の欧州国（ドイツ、フランス）へ患者搬送が発生しており、国際的拡大及び公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 感染源はDRCでの継続中のアウトブレイクであり、ドイツ・フランス・米国は治療目的の患者搬送先であるため対象国リストには該当しない。ワクチン・特異的治療のないブンディブギョ株であることが特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Corona Virus पर चौंकाने वाला खुलासा, 3 राज्यों में 10 एक्टिव केस, मशहूर सिंगर के बेटे भी पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shocking disclosure about the coronavirus: 10 active cases in 3 states, the son of a famous singer also tests positive.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, India reports 10 active COVID-19 cases across three states: eight in Andhra Pradesh’s Kadapa district, one in Mumbai, Maharashtra (John Kumar Sanu, son of singer Kumar Sanu), and one at Banaras Hindu University in Uttar Pradesh. Kadapa has recorded two deaths: a 52-year-old man from Rajampet who died at Christian Medical College, Vellore, after fever and cough; and a 43-year-old man from Kadapa city who died during treatment at a government hospital. A 25-year-old medical student at Kadappa Medical College tested positive and is in home isolation. Rapid Response Teams have been deployed, collecting about 40 samples (18 negative; others pending). Samples are being sent to Pune for genome sequencing to study variants. Public health measures include mandatory masks in hospitals and crowded areas, symptom screening, and intensified cleaning and disinfection in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスに関する衝撃の発表：3州で10件の活動性症例、有名歌手の息子も陽性
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の散発的症例（10件、死亡2件）が複数州で報告されているが、既知の病原体であり規模も小さく、現時点でIHR基準の複数該当は認められない。ゲノム解析中であり続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 有名歌手クマール・サヌの息子の感染が話題性を高めているが、疫学的には既知病原体の低規模事例。ゲノム解析結果待ちで変異株の性質が不明なため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Gefährliches Virus: Weiterer amerikanischer Ebola-Patient jetzt in Deutschland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous Virus: Another American Ebola Patient Now in Germany
article.articleSummary: An American doctor arrived in Germany on May 20 and was treated for Ebola at Berlin’s Charité; his condition was life‑threatening during flight from Africa, but he was discharged after about two weeks. His wife and four children, designated high‑risk contacts, were quarantined in a separate Charité unit and remained asymptomatic. German officials say there is no risk to the public. End of June, the Bundibugyo virus—an Ebola strain—was detected in Europe for the first time: in France, a humanitarian‑aid worker who returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo tested positive and was isolated on arrival; he was released in early July after negative tests and no symptoms. In the Congo, roughly 650 deaths and at least 1,830 infections; experts note the current outbreak is rising faster than any previous Ebola outbreak. In 2014–2015 West Africa outbreak, over 11,000 died; three Ebola patients previously treated in Germany: a Ugandan doctor in Frankfurt, a Senegalese man in Hamburg, and a UN worker in Leipzig who did not survive.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なウイルス：新たなアメリカ人エボラ患者、現在ドイツに
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大するエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が欧州（ドイツ・フランス）へ越境搬送された事例であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主な発生源はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行であり、約650人死亡・1830人以上感染、過去最速のペースで拡大中とされる。ドイツ・フランス・米国・ウガンダ・セネガルは輸入症例の搬送先であり対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông suýt chết vì viêm màng não sau khi ăn 1 loại thịt rất quen: Mở tủ lạnh nhà bạn kiểm tra ngay!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man almost died from meningitis after eating a very common type of meat: Open your fridge and check now!
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, a man in Shenzhen, China, nearly died from bacterial meningitis caused by Listeria monocytogenes after consuming long-stored frozen meat and expired dairy. Xu, in his seventies, presented with 40°C fever, seizures, tremors, confusion, and urinary incontinence; lumbar puncture yielded turbid purulent CSF. He recovered after rapid hospital admission and high-dose intravenous antibiotics. The case underscores that freezing does not kill Listeria, which can survive in frozen foods and proliferate upon thawing, especially in individuals with weakened immunity. Dr. Yen Tsung-hai of Chang Gung Memorial Hospital in Taiwan warns that frozen meat can serve as a reservoir for infection that can enter the bloodstream and cross the blood-brain barrier to cause purulent meningitis with rapid progression. Early symptoms mimic gastroenteritis (nausea, diarrhea, fever) before severe headache, neck stiffness, photophobia, delirium, and coma. The article also provides freezer storage guidance: processed meats 1–2 months; ground meat 3–4 months; fatty fish 2–3 months; lean fish and beef 6–8 months and 4–12 months, respectively.

triage.headline_ja: 冷凍肉を食べた男性が髄膜炎で死にかけた:自宅の冷蔵庫を今すぐチェック!
triage.triage_reason: 中国・深圳における単一の高齢者個人症例(リステリア菌性髄膜炎)の啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の重大な影響や異常性、国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にClassical Swine Feverが含まれるが記事内容と無関係(誤タグ付けの可能性)。実際の内容は単一個人のリステリア症例と食品保存に関する啓発記事。台湾の医師コメントは引用元であり発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Tamil Nadu: Wastewater monitoring can offer early warning for typhoid, finds Lancet study in Vellore
article.articleSummary: Wastewater surveillance can accurately track typhoid transmission, identify disease hotspots, and guide targeted vaccination, according to a Lancet Microbe study in Vellore, Tamil Nadu. The prospective study linked Salmonella Typhi detected in sewage with laboratory-confirmed typhoid cases, supporting integration of environmental monitoring into routine public health programs in endemic regions. Conducted by Christian Medical College, Vellore, and Imperial College London with collaborators across 33 urban wards, the study ran Dec 12, 2022 to Jun 30, 2023, preceding the TyphiBEV typhoid conjugate vaccine trial rollout. Researchers collected 1,446 wastewater samples (723 grab and 723 Moore swabs) from 50 surveillance sites serving about 2.25 lakh people. Findings underscore wastewater surveillance as an early warning system and planning tool for typhoid control in high-burden settings.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州:下水モニタリングが腸チフスの早期警告に有効、ヴェロールでのランセット研究が判明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は腸チフスの下水サーベイランス手法に関する学術研究成果の報告であり、実際の感染拡大や急性の公衆衛生事象を報じるものではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 腸チフスはインドの流行地域における既知の風土病であり、本記事は研究手法（下水サーベイランス）の有効性を報告する学術ニュースである。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: वाराणसी में मिला कोरोना का नया मामला, 27 साल का युवक बीएचयू अस्पताल में भर्ती
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 case found in Varanasi; 27-year-old man admitted to BHU Hospital.
article.articleSummary: New COVID-19 case detected in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh: a 27-year-old man from Aashapur tested positive after experiencing breathing difficulties and was admitted to Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Institute of Medical Sciences hospital. Doctors note that although the pace of coronavirus transmission has slowed, infections continue, with about one or two positive cases reported monthly in BHU. Prof. Gopalnath, former head of the Microbiology department, says the virus never fully vanishes; earlier lack of antibodies during 2020-21 led to widespread infections, but vaccination has produced antibodies, reducing the severity of breakthrough infections. High-risk groups include the elderly, pregnant women, and patients with diabetes, heart disease, kidney disease, or cancer; symptomatic individuals with fever, cough, sore throat, shortness of breath, or flu-like symptoms should seek testing promptly. Reinforce mask use and hand hygiene as preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: バラナシで新たなコロナ感染例、27歳男性がBHU病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: 単発の散発的なCOVID-19症例報告であり、月1〜2例程度の通常発生範囲内で重症度・異常性・国際的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の風土病的COVID-19の散発例を報告する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、通常の月次発生数の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: 4년만에 코로나19 사망자 발생" 발칵 뒤집힌 印안드라... 2명 숨지고 8명 감염 확인
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First COVID-19 death in four years shocks Andhra Pradesh, India... 2 dead, 8 infected confirmed
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 death reported in Andhra Pradesh for the first time in four years, centered in Kadapa district, India. Two recent fatalities linked to a small Kadapa cluster: the first, a 52-year-old Kadapa resident who developed fever and cough and died after testing positive on June 28 at Christian Medical College (CMC) Hospital, Vellore; the second, a 43-year-old man with preexisting conditions who died after admission to a state hospital and transfer to ICU. Authorities traced eight confirmed infections in Kadapa, including a 25-year-old student at Kadapa Medical College who remains in home isolation. A rapid response team collected samples from about 40 residents; 18 tested negative, with others pending. Masking was mandated in hospitals and crowded public places, alongside symptom surveillance and isolation when needed. Residents were urged to maintain hygiene and seek immediate medical care for suspected COVID-19, without panic.

triage.headline_ja: 「4年ぶりのコロナ死者発生」で騒然のインド・アンドラプラデシュ州…2人死亡、8人感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 4年ぶりのCOVID-19死亡例とクラスター発生だが、感染者数は限定的で現時点で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、続報を注視すべき事案。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に世界的に流行が確立した疾患であり、4年ぶりの死亡例という地域的な異常性はあるが、規模は小さく（8人感染、2人死亡）、現時点で新規変異株等の情報もないため通常のRRA対象というよりWATCHが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Lebih Canggih, Portable X-Ray Bantu Temukan Kasus TB Tanpa Harus ke Rumah Sakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More Advanced, Portable X-ray Helps Detect Tuberculosis Cases Without Having to Go to the Hospital.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis remains a major global health threat, with the 2025 WHO Global TB Report citing about 1.08 million new TB cases and 126,000 deaths annually; Indonesia ranks second after India in TB burden. The disease primarily attacks the lungs but can affect other organs, and airborne transmission fuels spread in crowded settings. In Sulawesi Selatan, 2025 TB cases reached 29,561 with a target of 45,472, leaving 15,911 undetected and potentially contagious. To speed detection, the Ministry of Health deployed portable X-ray units at community health centers (puskesmas), enabling chest radiography without hospital visits and supporting active case finding. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin launched 25 units donated by the United Arab Emirates, distributed to 15 districts across eight priority provinces: North Sumatra, Banten, DKI Jakarta, West Java, Central Java, East Java, South Sulawesi, and East Nusa Tenggara. Ideally two units per province, with initial focus on high-burden areas to enhance early identification and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: より高性能に、ポータブルX線が病院に行かずに結核症例発見を支援
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は診断機器導入という通常の保健施策に関する内容で、突発的な異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアにおける結核診断強化（UAE寄贈のポータブルX線機器導入）に関する内容。インドやUAEは比較・寄贈国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: تسجيل 1873 إصابة و672 وفاة بفيروس إيبولا بالكونغو الديمقراطية - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Record 1,873 Ebola virus cases and 672 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Ardu Point
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 1,873 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 672 deaths as of 13 July 2026. The affected provinces are Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, with Haut-Uele and Tshopo listed in the national tally for the first time. A total of 763 patients are in isolation or under treatment, and treatment-center bed occupancy stands at 95.1%. The country declared the seventeenth Ebola outbreak wave on 15 May 2026, and the World Health Organization has issued an International Health Emergency alert. No details on symptoms, transmission sources, or exported/imported cases are provided beyond the confirmed-status counts and hospital metrics. Public health measures and laboratory confirmation are implied by the confirmed case counts and treatment data. This update reflects ongoing outbreak activity across multiple eastern provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染1,873例、死亡672例を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17波エボラ流行が拡大し、WHOが国際保健緊急事態(IHR)アラートを発出しており、死亡者数・病床占有率も高く、複数の州に拡大していることからフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOが国際保健緊急事態アラートを発出している点は極めて重要。Haut-UeleおよびTshopo州が新たに集計に加わり、地理的拡大が進行中。症状・感染経路・輸出入症例の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果（金）埃博拉疫情擴至5省 超1800例確診 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo expands to five provinces, with more than 1,800 confirmed cases - Hong Kong Commercial Daily
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo expands to five provinces, with 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths reported as of July 12, 2026. The newly affected provinces are Tshopo and Upper Uele, with cases linked to the Nyania region in Ituri Province, joining previously affected Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Of the total, 763 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized, and 306 have recovered. South Kivu has recorded no new infections since May 26 and, by July 7, reached 42 consecutive days without a new case—twice the longest known Ebola incubation period. A related photo from July 9 in Bunia, Ituri Province shows health workers burying a body per protocol. The outbreak remains ongoing with multiple provinces epidemiologically connected to Ituri’s Nyania area.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、5州に拡大 確定症例1800人超 - 香港商報
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5州に拡大し、1,873例確認・672例死亡という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGhana（Upper East Region等）が含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCの疫学状況のみを扱っており、ガーナでの発生については言及がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai monsoon: NMMC steps up anti-mosquito drive at 270 construction sites
article.articleSummary: Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation (NMMC) has intensified its anti-mosquito spraying at 270 construction sites across Navi Mumbai to curb dengue and malaria during the monsoon. The operation targets under-construction residential and redevelopment projects where stagnant water often becomes a breeding ground for mosquitoes. These sites fall under the jurisdiction of 26 Urban Primary Health Centres, enabling coordinated vector control and monitoring. The campaign illustrates a proactive public health response to the annual monsoon surge, aiming to prevent outbreaks by reducing breeding habitats at densely developed urban sites. By focusing on construction zones, the initiative seeks to limit transmission vectors and protect nearby communities from vector-borne diseases during peak transmission season.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイのモンスーン期:NMMCが270の建設現場で防蚊対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のモンスーンに伴う予防的な蚊対策活動の報道であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクを報告しておらず、通常の予防的な公衆衛生対策の紹介記事である。

article.articleHeadline: ആഗോളതാപനത്തിനിടെ കൊതുകുകൾ വേഗം വളരുന്നു, രോഗവ്യാപനം കൂട്ടും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquitoes multiply rapidly during global warming, increasing disease transmission.
article.articleSummary: On 13 July 2026, in Kochi, Kerala, Dr. K. N. Pannikar, emeritus professor at Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences and Research and former ICMR Deputy Director General, warned that global warming accelerates mosquito life cycles, boosting disease transmission. As temperatures rise, Aedes mosquitoes—two species capable of spreading dengue, chikungunya, and Zika—develop faster; at 25–30°C their life cycle speeds up, reducing the usual 10-day cycle to about 8 days and enabling more generations per season. In Kerala, prolonged monsoon and hot summers create year-round, humid conditions favorable for mosquitoes. This climate shift is likely to intensify the spread of vector-borne diseases, with increased transmission potential from these Aedes species. Pannikar emphasized that these changes expand disease burden in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 地球温暖化で蚊が急速に増殖、病気の伝播が加速
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントではなく、専門家による気候変動と蚊媒介感染症リスクに関する一般的な警告記事であり、具体的な症例数や急増の報告がない。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例報告や発生数の増加を示すデータがなく、専門家の一般的見解記事のため、フルRRAへの移行は不要と判断。今後の症例報告動向を注視する価値はある。

article.articleHeadline: 10 days, 206 cases: Ernakulam district battling to contain dengue spread
article.articleSummary: Ernakulam district (Kochi), Kerala, India, is experiencing a dengue surge amid the monsoon. In the first 10 days of July, 206 lab-confirmed dengue cases were reported, with 463 suspected cases this month; in June, 319 confirmed and 841 suspected. Dr. Rajeev Jayadevan of the IMA Research Cell says Aedes aegypti mosquitoes are highly active during the monsoon, raising transmission risk and complicating prevention, particularly in crowded areas. The dengue virus comprises four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4), and a secondary infection with a different serotype can be more dangerous. The district health department is intensifying vector-control and other preventive measures to curb mosquito breeding as rainfall continues, indicating an ongoing outbreak in Ernakulam.

triage.headline_ja: 10日間で206例:エルナクラム県、デング熱の拡大阻止に苦戦
triage.triage_reason: インドのケララ州で季節性デング熱の増加が報告されているが、既知の風土病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域の対策状況を注視する。
triage.notes: モンスーン期の季節性デング熱流行であり、毎年発生する既知のパターン。地区保健当局が媒介蚊対策を強化中。重症度や死亡者数の情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO cảnh báo bùng phát dịch Ebola tại CHDC Congo năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of an Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 2026.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns many new Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have no identifiable source, complicating containment. In Bunia, Ituri Province, 70–80% of recent patients lack recorded contact with a known case; epidemiology and test positivity indicate the outbreak size could be 2–4 times higher than official counts. WHO and DRC authorities are training 21,000 community health workers to visit households, identify suspected cases, and encourage early treatment. Suspected cases have appeared in areas previously free of the outbreak, with deaths surpassing 600. Haut-Uele Province in NE DRC declared an outbreak after INRB confirmed 7 deaths in Wamba on July 9, prompting a province-wide declaration on July 10. The nation has over 1,800 confirmed cases across four provinces. Trials for a Bundibugyo-strain treatment began last week; volunteers are being recruited. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo, and funding is limited amid eastern Congo conflict.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、2026年コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルス病流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: 感染源不明の症例が70-80%に達し、死者600人超・確定例1800人超と規模が拡大しており、複数州への拡大と治療薬未承認の状況からIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 感染源不明の症例が多数存在し実際の流行規模が公式統計の2〜4倍の可能性、また東部紛争地域での資金不足がWHO・DRC当局の対応を阻害している点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 「食腦變形蟲」：科學家警告對兒童高危的微生物感染可能蔓延全球
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brain-Eating Amoeba: Scientists Warn That a High-Risk Microbial Infection for Children Could Spread Globally.
article.articleSummary: Primary Amoebic Meningoencephalitis (PAM) caused by Naegleria fowleri, the brain-eating amoeba, is contracted when warm freshwater enters the nose during water activities. A Costa Rica family trip ends in tragedy for an 11-year-old, Jordan, who died of PAM after exposure to a natural hot spring; the illness rapidly causes brain swelling and death. Globally (1962–2023), 488 cases have been reported with ~97% mortality, mostly in US Southern states, Pakistan, and Australia, but infections are increasingly identified in Italy, Belgium, and northern regions (e.g., Slovakia). In Kerala, India, an outbreak with over 200 treated patients yielded survival in more than half of cases, suggesting improved outcomes with earlier diagnosis and standardized therapy. Children are at higher risk (most common age around 12). Other risks include nasal-irrigation devices and certain cultural practices. CDC advises sterile, boiled/distilled water for nasal use and avoiding forceful nasal water entry during warm-water activities.

triage.headline_ja: 「脳を食べるアメーバ」：科学者が子どもへの高リスク微生物感染が世界的に広がる可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: 希少な自由生活アメーバによる原発性アメーバ性髄膜脳炎(PAM)に関する啓発的な総説記事であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域拡大傾向や高致死率など一部WPRO基準に該当するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は淡水性アメーバ(Naegleria fowleri)による感染症の世界的傾向を扱う総説であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクではない。インド・ケララ州の200名超の症例は既知の集団発生の言及であり、最新の緊急事態を示すものではない。他国（米国、パキスタン、オーストラリア、イタリア、ベルギー、スロバキア、コスタリカ）は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 食脑变形虫"：科学家警告对儿童高危的微生物感染可能蔓延全球
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Brain-eating amoeba": Scientists warn that a high-risk microbial infection for children could spread worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri, the brain-eating amoeba, causes primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (PAM) after entering the nose from warm freshwater. The article recounts Jordan, an 11-year-old who died in Costa Rica after a single day of swimming; PAM rapidly causes brain edema and death. Globally, 1962–2023 saw 488 reported cases (≈97% fatal), mostly in US South, Pakistan, and Australia, with rising detections in Italy, Belgium, and Minnesota. India recorded over 200 infections last year—the largest outbreak on record—particularly in Kerala; Slovakia reported a case; Taiwan 2023 saw an indoor surfing facility death; a 71-year-old woman in Texas died after using a nasal-irrigation bottle with tap water. Warming waters expand habitats to previously cold areas. Early diagnosis and standardized treatment yielded >50% survival among >200 treated in Kerala, though overall prognosis remains poor. CDC advises sterile or boiled water for nasal irrigation and minimizing nasal water entry.

triage.headline_ja: 「脳を食べるアメーバ」：科学者が子どもに高リスクな微生物感染症が世界的に広がる可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はNaegleria fowleri（原発性アメーバ性髄膜脳炎）に関する世界的な科学的総説記事であり、特定の新規発生イベントというより温暖化に伴う長期的拡大傾向への警鐘。インドのケララ州における過去最大規模の感染例（200例以上）は注目すべきだが、直近の新規急性事案としての情報は限定的であり続報監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は世界各国（米国、パキスタン、オーストラリア、イタリア、ベルギー、スロバキア、台湾、コスタリカ等）の事例を含む総説的内容だが、対象国リストに該当するのはインド（ケララ州）のみ。温暖化による生息域拡大という長期的リスクが強調されているが、直近の新規発生イベントとしての緊急性は不明確。

article.articleHeadline: 인도 남동부서 코로나19로 2명 사망...확산 차단 '비상'(종합)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two dead from COVID-19 in southeastern India... Emergency to curb the spread (Comprehensive)
article.articleSummary: Two people died of COVID-19 in Andhra Pradesh's YSR Kadapa district in southeastern India, triggering emergency measures as authorities expand contact tracing and testing. The 52-year-old man with fever and cough tested positive and died after hospital care; the 43-year-old man with complications died in intensive care. Eight additional infections were identified; samples from about 40 people were collected, 18 were negative, with others still pending. Local authorities deployed rapid-response teams, collected samples from roughly 40 people, and ordered masking in crowded venues plus a statewide COVID-19 alert. Infected families are advised to test and isolate if positive. India’s cumulative totals exceed 45 million cases and about 533,000 deaths, ranking second in cases and third in deaths globally, though rural undercounting is suspected. In China, June new cases total about 79,000 across 31 provinces with 1 death and 130 severe cases; the virus is largely Omicron, with no new variants of concern, and officials say the situation is controllable with small seasonal peaks.

triage.headline_ja: インド南東部でコロナ19により2人死亡…拡散阻止へ「非常事態」（総合）
triage.triage_reason: インド・アンドラプラデーシュ州でCOVID-19による死亡例とICU症例が発生し、当局が緊急対応（接触者追跡・検査拡大・マスク着用命令）を実施しており、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高まりが確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事中で言及される中国の6月症例数（約79,000件、死亡1名）は全国的な統計データであり、インドの局地的アウトブレイクとは別の文脈のため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: 台灣新冠確診連4週升 恐現夏季疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan's confirmed COVID-19 cases rise for four consecutive weeks; summer outbreak feared.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports four straight weeks of rising COVID-19 activity amid a global upturn. Last week’s clinic visits for COVID-19 reached 2,032, with the rise accelerating in the past one to two weeks, prompting models for a potential summer wave. China logged about 79,000 new cases in June, including 130 severe cases, and Week 26 outpatient/ER positivity rose to 7.4% after five weeks of growth. Japan and the Philippines also show higher activity, increasing Taiwan’s vigilance. To counter possible spread, Taiwan extends publicly funded vaccination to July 31; since April 7, second doses are offered to those aged 65+, Indigenous people aged 55+, and high-risk immunocompromised individuals. Moderna’s new vaccine is slated for October 1, and Taiwan’s CDC will consider further extending free vaccination to curb severe disease as activity climbs.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾、新型コロナ確診が4週連続で増加、夏の流行を懸念
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・中国・日本・フィリピンで新型コロナ感染が同時に上昇しており、地域的な流行拡大の兆候があり、当局（台湾CDC）がワクチン接種拡大など対応を強化しているため社会的・行政的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。中国は具体的な症例数・重症例数のデータがあり、フィリピンも活動上昇が明記されているため両国を含めた。季節性のCOVID増加であり、重症度や異常性の明確な報告はないが、複数国での同時的な上昇と当局の対応強化から注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US Embassy Tells Americans to Avoid Congo Over Ebola After Aid Worker Infected
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-13, the US Embassy advised Americans to avoid all travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo due to Ebola after a second American aid worker became infected while responding to the escalating outbreak. The outbreak in the DRC is described as escalating, with the infected aid worker highlighting ongoing transmission among international responders. The advisory notes that travelers exposed to Ebola are required to quarantine outside the country for up to 21 days. The report emphasizes travel restrictions tied to the outbreak and drawn attention to the risk for those deploying to assist, including U.S. personnel in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 米国大使館、援助従事者感染後にコンゴでのエボラ流行を理由に米国人へ渡航回避を勧告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大しており、国際的な援助従事者への感染、米国大使館による渡航禁止勧告・検疫要件などIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCでのエボラ流行拡大が主題。

article.articleHeadline: 养20多只鸡鸭老人感染鹦鹉热 医生：家禽均可携带致病菌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elderly person who keeps more than 20 chickens and ducks contracts psittacosis; doctors say poultry can carry pathogenic bacteria.
article.articleSummary: 66-year-old Li Yibo, a poultry keeper in Fuzhou, China, kept more than 20 chickens and ducks and developed psittacosis caused by Chlamydia psittaci. About ten days before admission, he presented with a high fever reaching 39.5°C, fatigue, and reduced appetite, later developing diabetic ketoacidosis and hypoxemia, leading to ICU care at Fuzhou Second Hospital. Broad-spectrum antibiotics failed to control progression; clinicians suspected psittacosis from poultry exposure and started doxycycline, with fever resolving within 24 hours. Genomic testing confirmed Chlamydia psittaci infection. The report emphasizes that poultry such as chickens, ducks, and pigeons can carry the pathogen, which resides in feces, feathers, and secretions and can aerosolize, surviving for months in dry material. High-risk groups include poultry workers and individuals with diabetes or weakened immunity; preventive measures include ventilation, regular cleaning, PPE, hand hygiene, and avoiding close contact with birds, especially for vulnerable people.

triage.headline_ja: 20羽以上の鶏やアヒルを飼育していた高齢者がオウム病に感染、医師「家禽はすべて病原菌を保菌している可能性」
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の個別報告であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や集団発生の兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: オウム病（Chlamydia psittaci感染症）は家禽飼育者における散発的な人獣共通感染症であり、本記事は個別症例と一般的な予防啓発を目的とした内容。ヒト-ヒト感染性はなく、アウトブレイクの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠疫情又要來了？中國爆病例狂增「萬人中標」在地醫生抖出大實話：3類人要小心了 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the COVID-19 outbreak coming again? China reports a surge in cases—“tens of thousands infected”—local doctors reveal the blunt truth: three groups of people to be careful of.
article.articleSummary: China's CDC reports a renewed COVID-19 wave in June 2026, with about 79,000 new confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infections nationwide and 130 severe cases plus 1 death in a patient with chronic disease. Weekly data show rising COVID-19 positivity among influenza-like illness: 2.9%, 4.1%, 5.3%, and 6.4% in weeks 23–26, signaling an upturn. In June, 3,741 local SARS-CoV-2 genomes were sequenced; all belonged to Omicron NB.1.8.1 and sublineages, with no higher-risk variant detected. Most infections are mild; typical symptoms include low-grade fever, sore throat, cough, nasal congestion, and sometimes diarrhea; pneumonia and severe disease are markedly reduced compared with earlier waves. High-risk groups—elderly, people with chronic diseases, and immunocompromised—remain vulnerable and should seek early antiviral therapy when fever, cough, chest tightness, or shortness of breath appear. Other circulating respiratory viruses—influenza, rhinovirus, enterovirus, parainfluenza, and hMPV—are present, with influenza B dominating in the south and rising in recent weeks; northern regions remain non-epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの流行が再来？中国で感染急増「万人単位で感染」、現地医師が本音を明かす：注意すべき3つのグループとは
triage.triage_reason: 中国全土でCOVID-19感染者数が急増し、季節性の流行拡大が見られる。重症化率は低いものの、持続的な曝露と流行しやすさの基準に該当し、報道による社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 検出された変異株はOmicron NB.1.8.1系統で、より高リスクな変異株は確認されていない。重症化率・死亡率は過去の流行と比べ低下しており、季節性の流行と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Optimalkan Portable X-Ray untuk Percepat Penemuan Kasus TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Optimizes Portable X-Ray to Speed Up TB Case Detection
article.articleSummary: TB remains a leading global infectious threat caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis and transmitted via the air, mainly affecting the lungs but possible in other organs. Indonesia ranks second globally in TB burden after India, with about 1,080,000 new cases and 126,000 deaths annually (Global TB Report 2025). In Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta (DIY), 2025 saw 5,930 TB cases province-wide; the City of Yogyakarta accounted for 1,341 diagnosed cases, around 600 residents and the rest including students and informal workers. To accelerate detection, the Ministry of Health deployed Portable X-Ray units at primary health centers (puskesmas); 25 units donated by the UAE have reached 15 districts across eight priority provinces: North Sumatra, Banten, Jakarta, West Java, Central Java, East Java, South Sulawesi, and East Nusa Tenggara. The national goal is two portable X-ray units per province; initial distribution prioritizes high-burden areas to boost active case finding and early treatment, reducing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、結核症例発見の迅速化のためポータブルX線を最適化
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアの既知の恒常的な公衆衛生課題であり、本記事は診断機器導入という通常の対策活動を報じるもので、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアの結核対策強化（UAE寄贈のポータブルX線配備）に関する通常の保健政策報道であり、Indiaは比較対象として言及されているのみで発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela ahora lucha contra las epidemias | El Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela Now Fights Epidemics | El Dia
article.articleSummary: Two weeks after devastating earthquakes in Venezuela, the emergency has shifted to preventing a public health crisis among thousands in shelters. Medical teams from Mexico, the United States, Brazil, and Spain race to contain the spread of diseases in camps, mainly in La Guaira, the hardest-hit state. Official tallies report about 4,500 dead, 16,740 injured, and nearly 19,000 displaced. Field facilities include a United States emergency hospital in La Guaira with 56 beds, ICUs, operating rooms and a laboratory; Brazil deployed a center offering general medicine, pediatrics, orthopedics and imaging; Spain installed a field hospital in Caracas. Humanitarian groups warn that overcrowding in 94 shelters fosters infections and other complications. Survivors experience muscle pains, headaches and emotional distress, while respiratory and gastrointestinal infections rise and chronic patients lack access to medications.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラ、今度は感染症流行と闘う｜エル・ディア
triage.triage_reason: 地震後のベネズエラ国内避難所における感染症リスクに関する記事であり、対象国（ブラジル等）は医療支援チームの派遣元として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はモニタリング対象外のベネズエラであるため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は地震被災後のベネズエラにおける感染症拡大リスクであり、ブラジル・米国・スペイン・メキシコは医療支援チームの派遣元として登場するのみで、疾病発生国ではない。ベネズエラは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: COVID Returns? New Coronavirus Case Reported in Uttar Pradesh, 27-Year-Old Admitted to BHU Hospital | फिर लौटा कोरोना? यूपी में मिला नया कोरोना केस, अस्पताल में भर्ती युवक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID Returns? New Coronavirus Case Reported in Uttar Pradesh, 27-Year-Old Man Admitted to BHU Hospital
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 case reported in Uttar Pradesh: In Varanasi, a 27-year-old Ashapur resident tested positive for COVID-19 and is admitted to Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Hospital after developing breathing difficulties. Chest and TB department doctors recommended the test; the positive result is confirmed, and the patient is under care with a stable condition. BHU doctors say new cases appear occasionally, averaging one to two per month, much lower than during earlier waves. Experts note the virus is not eradicated and recurs at low levels; immunity from vaccination and prior infections reduces severity, but those with weak immunity, the elderly, or with comorbidities should stay vigilant. The second wave five years ago caused severe strain on healthcare facilities, underscoring ongoing vigilance. If fever, cough, sore throat, or breathing trouble persist, seek prompt medical advice.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ復活？ウッタル・プラデーシュ州で新たなコロナウイルス感染例、27歳の男性がBHU病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: 単発のCOVID-19症例で、医師によれば月1〜2件程度の散発例であり、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大のいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は単発の散発症例を報じたもので、地元医師も通常範囲内の発生と説明しており、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Corona Active Case: देश के इन 3 राज्यों में कोरोना के 10 एक्टिव केस, 2 की मौत, लक्षण दिखते हो जाएं सर्तक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Active COVID-19 Cases: In these three states of the country, 10 active cases, 2 deaths; be vigilant if symptoms appear.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, three Indian states report active COVID-19 cases totaling 10. Kadapa district in Andhra Pradesh has eight active cases and two deaths, including a 52-year-old Rajampet resident who died at Christian Medical College, Vellore after fever and cough, and a 43-year-old Kadapa resident who died at Government General Hospital; a 25-year-old Kadapa Medical College student is in home isolation. In Maharashtra’s Mumbai, one new case is reported, linked to singer Kumar Sanu’s son John Kumar Sanu. In Uttar Pradesh’s Varanasi, a Banaras Hindu University student tests positive. Health authorities have deployed Rapid Response Teams; about 40 samples were collected, 18 negative, with others pending. Genomic sequencing of samples has been sent to a Pune laboratory to understand the infection type and spread. Officials urge adherence to guidelines: identify symptomatic individuals, isolate and test contacts, sanitize areas, and wear masks in crowded places.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ活動症例：国内3州でコロナ活動症例10件、2人死亡、症状が出た場合は警戒を
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の散発的な症例・死亡が複数州で報告されているが、既知の疾患であり大規模拡大の兆候は限定的。ゲノム解析の結果待ちであり続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 既知の疾患であるCOVID-19の散発的症例報告。死亡例が含まれるが規模は小さく、ゲノム解析結果次第で評価が変わる可能性があるため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: 인도·중국 심상찮다...코로나19 재확산 우려
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India and China on edge... Concern over a resurgence of COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, renewed COVID-19 activity is reported in India and China. In India, Andhra Pradesh’s YSR Kadapa district recorded two COVID-19 deaths: a 52-year-old man with fever and cough, and a 43-year-old man who died after hospitalization for complications. Eight additional infections were identified by contact tracing; about 40 residents’ samples were collected, 18 negative, the rest pending. State authorities urged mask use in crowded places and issued a statewide COVID-19 alert; families of confirmed cases were instructed to test and isolate if positive. India’s pandemic totals exceed 45 million cases and about 533,000 deaths. In China, June saw roughly 79,000 new confirmed cases nationwide across 31 provinces, up 3.8-fold from May; 130 severe cases and one death (with underlying conditions). Most circulating strains are Omicron; no new variants detected; officials say the situation is generally under control with seasonal peaks.

triage.headline_ja: インド・中国の状況が尋常でない…新型コロナ再拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の疾患で新規変異株の検出はなく、中国当局も季節性ピークとして「管理下」にあるとしているが、中国での症例数急増（前月比3.8倍）とインドでの死亡例発生があるため、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 既知の疾患(COVID-19)の季節性増加であり、新規変異株は検出されていない。中国当局は状況を管理下にあるとしている。重症度・死亡数は限定的だが、症例数の急増傾向は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 22 जुलाई से शुरू होगा एफएमडी टीकाकरण अभियान, गांव-गांव पहुंचेंगी पशु विभाग की टीमें
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Starting July 22, the Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) vaccination campaign will commence; Animal Department teams will reach villages across the country.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-M Mouth Disease (FMD) vaccination campaign will run July 22–September 8 in Prayagraj district, Uttar Pradesh, with free vaccination for cattle, bulls and buffaloes. Animal Department teams will conduct door-to-door and village-to-village vaccination to safeguard animal health and dairy production, as FMD is highly contagious and can reduce milk output. Each vaccinated animal will receive an ear tag and be registered on the India Livestock app, creating a digital record to facilitate access to future government schemes and livestock services. Officials urge all farmers to participate fully and ensure every bovine is vaccinated, and to tag animals not yet ear-tagged so they can access digital services and public programs.

triage.headline_ja: 7月22日からFMD(口蹄疫)ワクチン接種キャンペーンが開始、家畜部門チームが村々を訪問

triage.notes: 口蹄疫は動物疾病でありヒトへの感染はほぼ発生しない。記事は予防的ワクチン接種プログラムの実施予定を伝えるものであり、アウトブレイク報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠疫情又要來了？中國爆「萬人中標」在地醫生抖大實話：3類人要小心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the COVID-19 outbreak coming again? China reports tens of thousands infected as local doctors speak bluntly: three groups of people to watch out for.
article.articleSummary: China CDC reported in June 2026 about 79,000 new COVID-19 cases nationwide, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (a patient with chronic disease). Genomic surveillance of 3,741 local sequences in June showed all belonged to Omicron lineage NB.1.8.1 and sub-branches; no higher-risk new variant detected. Since January, monthly case counts rose from 17,916 (Jan) to 22,861 (May) before the June surge. Clinically, most infections are mild: low-grade fever, sore throat, cough, nasal congestion/runny nose; some diarrhoea; pneumonia and severe disease much less common than earlier waves. High-risk groups (elderly, chronic conditions, immunocompromised) should seek prompt medical care and receive antiviral therapy when indicated. From 6/29–7/5, domestic ILI surveillance shows COVID-19 positives rising among emergency department samples (2.9%, 4.1%, 5.3%, 6.4% across weeks 23–26). Seasonal influenza activity remains low in the north, rising in the south with influenza B predominating; other viruses (rhinovirus, enterovirus, parainfluenza, hMPV) circulating.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ流行がまた来る？中国で『万人感染』、現地医師が本音を語る:注意すべき3つのグループ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19感染者数増加であり、既知のOmicron系統（NB.1.8.1）で新規変異株や重症化率の上昇は確認されていない。重症例・死亡例も少なく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは低いと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は中国CDCの月次サーベイランスデータに基づく季節性COVID-19増加の報道。既知のOmicron系統で新規変異株は検出されず、大部分が軽症例。見出しはセンセーショナルだが内容は通常の季節性変動を報告するもの。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠肺炎｜中國6月增7.9萬病例　「低度流行」多為輕症 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 | China records 79,000 new cases in June; 'low-level transmission' mostly mild cases | am730.
article.articleSummary: Mainland China recorded about 79,000 new COVID-19 cases in June, with rising but still low-level transmission. There were 130 severe cases and 1 death, the latter in a patient with chronic illness. Of 3,741 locally sequenced samples, all were Omicron; NB.1.8.1 and its sublineages are the prevailing strains, with no higher-risk variant detected. Experts attribute the uptick to waning immunity after infection or vaccination; SARS-CoV-2 lacks a fixed season, and indoor cooling with limited ventilation in hot weather may promote spread. Most infections remain mild, but the elderly, people with chronic diseases, and immunocompromised individuals stay at risk for severe disease; early medical evaluation and antiviral treatment are advised if fever, cough, chest tightness, or shortness of breath occur. Other circulating viruses—influenza B in southern regions, rhinovirus, enterovirus, and parainfluenza—underscore the need for hand hygiene, ventilation, and masking in crowded or poorly ventilated settings.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルス｜中国、6月に7万9千件の新規症例　「低度流行」で大半が軽症
triage.triage_reason: 既知の変異株（オミクロン系統）による低レベルの流行で、重症例・死亡例も少なく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 既知の変異株による季節性の緩やかな増加であり、新規性・重篤性ともに低い。エンテロウイルスなど他のウイルスも言及されているが、いずれも通常の流行状況として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠肺炎｜內地新冠復燃6月增7.9萬宗　1死130宗重症陽性率連續4周上升　中疾控必學3招預防【附中招症狀】|香港經濟日報 TOPick
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 | Mainland China's COVID resurgence: June adds 79,000 cases; 1 death, 130 severe cases; positivity rate up for four consecutive weeks; China CDC's three essential prevention tips [Symptoms to watch for] | Hong Kong Economic Daily TOPick
article.articleSummary: Mainland China recorded 79,000 new COVID-19 cases in June 2026, with 1 death and 130 severe cases. The national positivity rate at sentinel hospital influenza-like illness visits rose for four consecutive weeks, from 2.9% to 6.4% (weeks 23–26, June 1–28). Genomic surveillance of 3,741 local sequences found NB.1.8.1 and its sublineages as the dominant strains, accounting for 95.9–98.8% across weeks 23–26, with no evidence of a higher-risk new variant. COVID-19 ranked second among Class B notifiable diseases in June, with 1,370,653 total cases nationwide and 2,116 deaths; other top Class B diseases included viral hepatitis, tuberculosis, syphilis, and gonorrhea. Experts attribute the June uptick to natural waning of herd immunity; a summer small peak is expected but controllable. China CDC recommends masking, hand hygiene, and vaccination, especially for pregnant women, children, the elderly, and those with chronic diseases.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19｜中国本土で新型コロナが再燃、6月は7.9万人増、死亡1人・重症130人、陽性率は4週連続上昇　中国疾病予防センターが予防法3つを推奨【症状も掲載】
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の予測範囲内の増加であり、新規変異株の懸念もなく、重症・死亡数も少ないため専門家も「制御可能」と評価している。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 中国疾病予防管理センターの定期監視データに基づく報道で、NB.1.8.1系統が優勢だが高リスク変異株は確認されていない。専門家は夏季の小規模な流行を予測しつつも制御可能としている。

article.articleHeadline: Second Ebola-infected US citizen flown to Germany for treatment
article.articleSummary: Two US citizens infected with Ebola have been evacuated to Germany for treatment amid an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The second patient arrived at Frankfurt Airport overnight and was transported to a university hospital in Frankfurt; the CDC says the individual is a US citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the DRC. Laboratory confirmation identified the Bundibugyo strain, which is circulating in the DRC. Gender was not disclosed initially. Ebola is a contagious, potentially fatal disease spread by direct contact with bodily fluids. The DRC outbreak has been hard to contain, and, as of now, there is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. The first US patient, a doctor, arrived in Germany in May and was later discharged after about two weeks of treatment in Berlin's Charité hospital. In Congo, about 1,830 cases and 650 deaths have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに感染した2人目の米国人がドイツへ搬送され治療
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは1,830症例・650死亡と深刻で、感染者が国際搬送されるなど既に国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ドイツ・米国は感染者の搬送先・出身国であり、実際の発生地はDRC。ワクチン・特異的治療法がないブンディブギョ株であり、封じ込めが困難な状況が続いている点にも注意。

article.articleHeadline: 洪水退去防疫不松懈 警惕三类高发传染病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the floodwaters recede, do not let up on epidemic prevention; be vigilant for Category C high-incidence infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Published July 13, 2026, after floods in Nanning, Guangxi, receding waters raise risk of Category C high-incidence infectious diseases. The main concern is enteric infections—acute gastroenteritis, bacillary dysentery, hepatitis A, and hepatitis E—driven by contaminated water and foods. Symptoms include diarrhea, abdominal pain, vomiting, and fever; prevention centers on safe drinking water and food hygiene. Vector-borne diseases and respiratory infections can spread in shelters; conjunctivitis is also possible with close contact. Leptospirosis is another risk, as floodwaters may be contaminated by animal urine, causing high fever and severe calf pain through skin breaks or mucous membranes. Dr. Huang Chaojun, infectious disease specialist at the Nanning CDC, urges: do not touch floodwater with broken skin; wear gloves and rubber boots; rinse skin with clean water and soap after contact; maintain water/food hygiene, vector control, and proper shelter ventilation.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水退去後も油断禁物、防疫継続を—警戒すべき3種の高発感染症
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の一般的な感染症予防啓発記事であり、現時点で具体的な集団発生や患者数増加の報告はないが、今後の水系・媒介動物感染症の発生可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 南寧市CDCによる洪水後の感染症予防啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数や集団発生の報告はない。レプトスピラ症、A型・E型肝炎、細菌性赤痢等のリスクが言及されているが、実際の発生状況は不明のため続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Farhan Kembali Bekerja Usai Dirawat di RS karena Infeksi Pencernaan Picu Maag dan Vertigo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Farhan Returns to Work After Hospitalization for Gastrointestinal Infection Triggering Gastritis and Vertigo
article.articleSummary: Bandung, Indonesia: Wali Kota Bandung Farhan was hospitalized for several days in July 2026 due to a gastrointestinal infection that triggered gastritis and vertigo. Illness began July 10, 2026, after hosting guests at Bandung City Hall, prompting ambulance transport. Laboratory tests confirmed a gastrointestinal infection; vertigo caused dizziness and inability to stand. He received care from the Bandung City Health Office and hospital staff and was ordered to rest for two days. Farhan returned to work on July 13, 2026, resuming duties to oversee School Orientation (MPLS) activities at several Bandung schools. There is no reported outbreak, death, or specific pathogen in the article; the infection appears to be an isolated case affecting a public official.

triage.headline_ja: ファルハン市長、胃炎とめまいを誘発した消化器感染症で入院後、職務に復帰
triage.triage_reason: バンドン市長個人の孤発性消化器感染症であり、アウトブレイクや死亡例の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 公人（市長）の個人的な健康問題を報じた記事であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや病原体特定の報告はない。公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha on alert following Covid cases in neighbouring Andhra
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, Odisha is on alert after multiple Covid-19 cases and two suspected deaths were reported in neighboring Andhra Pradesh's Kadapa district in recent weeks. Odisha health authorities have revived surveillance and intensified testing across facilities to prevent its spread; officials report no positive cases detected in Odisha to date. Public Health Director Rabindranath Mishra says tests continue and results in Odisha have been negative so far, urging the public not to panic. The region is monitoring cross-border transmission and maintaining readiness to respond to any imported cases stemming from Andhra Pradesh infections, with authorities coordinating with district and state health networks to strengthen detection and isolation protocols.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州、隣接アンドラプラデシュ州でのCOVID感染例を受けて警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: アンドラプラデシュ州でCOVID-19の感染例と疑い死亡例が報告され、隣接するオディシャ州が警戒・監視を強化しているが、オディシャ州内では陽性例は確認されておらず、現時点で重大な公衆衛生上の影響は限定的。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、アンドラプラデシュ州での感染例詳細（症例数・死亡数の確定情報）が不足。オディシャ州は予防的監視強化の段階であり、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient wird in Frankfurt behandelt ➤ Hessen am Morgen: Die Nachrichten im Ticker vom 13.07.2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient treated in Frankfurt ➤ Hesse in the Morning: The News in the Ticker from July 13, 2026.
article.articleSummary: On July 13, 2026, an Ebola-positive US citizen infected while working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo was treated in Frankfurt, Germany. The patient arrived at Frankfurt Airport during the night and was taken to Universitätsklinikum Frankfurt, a claim confirmed by a spokesperson of the Federal Ministry of Health to dpa. The US CDC had previously stated the individual is infected with the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola, the strain currently circulating in the DRC. The report did not specify the patient’s gender. For Ebola transports, specialized aircraft are normally used, and patients in Germany are admitted to dedicated isolation units—closed, protected facilities separated from routine hospital operations to prevent contact with other patients.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者、フランクフルトで治療 ➤ ヘッセン朝刊ティッカー（2026年7月13日）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で流行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）に感染した患者がドイツ・フランクフルトへ搬送され治療を受けており、国際的な患者移動を伴う重大事案としてIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国で人道支援活動中に感染し、専用機でドイツへ搬送された。ドイツ・米国は対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCでのエボラ流行が背景にあるためDRCを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: China reports 79,000 COVID-19 cases in June
article.articleSummary: China reports 79,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases in June 2026, including 130 severe cases and one related death, according to the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention. The June total marks a notable rise from about 21,861 cases in May and 23,477 in April, with the CDC noting an overall upward trajectory. All June infections were attributed to the Omicron variant, with no evidence of any new strains emerging. The findings indicate sustained transmission despite a relatively low severity, as the number of severe cases remained far smaller than total infections. The report underscores June as a period of intensified activity within China’s ongoing COVID-19 surveillance, underscoring the continuing public health attention to Omicron-driven transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、6月のCOVID-19感染者数が79,000人と報告
triage.triage_reason: 感染者数は増加傾向にあるが、既知のOmicron株による流行で重症化率は低く、新規株の出現もないため緊急のシグナルとは言えないが、増加トレンドは継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる月次サーベイランス報告。既知のOmicron株のみで新規変異株の証拠なし。重症例は130例/79,000例、死亡1例と重症度は低いが、4月〜6月にかけて感染者数は増加傾向（23,477→21,861→79,000）。ルーチンの疫学報告であり、緊急のリスク評価は不要と判断されるが、増加トレンドの継続を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄防堵登革熱祭出暑假獎勵 東南亞返台者接受快篩可領500元禮券
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung rolls out summer incentives to curb dengue fever; Southeast Asia returnees to Taiwan who take a rapid test can receive a NT$500 gift voucher.
article.articleSummary: 7 local dengue cases and 9 imported in Kaohsiung City this year; all 7 local cases have been cleared of alert, indicating a stable outbreak pattern with most infections being imported. In response, Kaohsiung's health authorities launch a nationwide-unique 'Decisive Battle Against Imported Dengue' incentive program during July–August to curb cross-border transmission. Before traveling to Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand, Singapore, Cambodia, etc.), residents can obtain free mosquito repellent; on return, those who actively undergo rapid testing will receive a NT$500 voucher (up from NT$200 since 2016; expanded to all Kaohsiung residents and students). The program targets students, new residents, and migrant workers; post-travel health monitoring is encouraged. Officials Wang Hongrong, Wang Renxin, and Huang Zhizhong emphasized that over 70% of dengue infections are asymptomatic, underscoring the need for screening within 14 days after returning.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄市がデング熱防止で夏季奨励策を実施、東南アジアから帰国した台湾人が迅速検査を受けると500元の商品券がもらえる
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市における輸入デング熱対策の奨励プログラムに関する行政施策の記事であり、局地7例はすべて警戒解除済みで安定した状況。異常な流行拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（高雄市）における輸入デング熱の予防・奨励施策であり、東南アジア諸国（ベトナム、インドネシア、フィリピン、タイ、シンガポール、カンボジア）は渡航先として言及されているのみで、これらの国での発生事例を報じるものではない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Grade 4 pupil dies of septic shock after school deworming -- DepEd
article.articleSummary: An eight-year-old Grade 4 pupil from Hugo Perez Elementary School-Annex in Cavite Province, Philippines, died on 3 July from septic shock linked to an infection after a school-based deworming activity on 2 July, part of the National School-Based Deworming Program. Initial medical findings indicate infection as the cause; the student was hospitalized after vomiting and subsequently died. Several pupils reportedly fell ill following the activity. DepEd Cavite offered condolences and said it would cooperate with authorities as investigations continue. As of 13 July 2026, no medical or forensic results had been released confirming whether the death was related to the deworming activity or an underlying condition; the investigation remains ongoing and safety procedures are under review.

triage.headline_ja: 小学4年生の児童、学校での虫下し(駆虫)活動後に敗血症性ショックで死亡 ― 教育省(DepEd)
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の死亡事案で感染性疾患か薬剤反応か未確定。他の児童にも体調不良が報告されているが、原因究明中で情報が不足しているため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 感染症としての因果関係は未確定（薬剤反応・基礎疾患の可能性も含め調査中）。他の生徒の体調不良の詳細（人数・症状・原因）が不明であり、続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Weiterer amerikanischer Ebola-Patient jetzt in Deutschland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another American Ebola patient now in Germany.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, a second American with Ebola, infected with the Bundibugyo variant while working for a humanitarian organization in Democratic Republic of the Congo, has been flown to Germany for treatment. He landed at Frankfurt Airport and was taken to University Hospital in Frankfurt. The CDC confirmed the infection; Germany uses aircraft and isolation wards, with officials saying there is no risk to the public. The patient’s wife and four children were brought to Charité in Berlin as high-risk contacts, but were asymptomatic and quarantined in a separate unit. End of June, Europe saw Bundibugyo cases, including a French doctor returning from East Congo who was isolated and discharged in July after negative tests. During the 2014–2015 outbreak in West Africa, over 11,000 died; Germany treated three Ebola patients: a Ugandan doctor in Frankfurt, a Senegalese man in Hamburg, and a UN worker in Leipzig who died.

triage.headline_ja: 別のアメリカ人エボラ患者、現在ドイツへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で感染したエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）患者がドイツへ緊急搬送された事例で、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）が複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 感染源はDRCでの人道支援活動中の曝露であり、ドイツは治療・隔離のための搬送先に過ぎない。DRCでの流行状況・接触者追跡等の詳細情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: टैटू बनवाना शरीर के लिए हो सकता है घातक, संक्रमण, एलर्जी, सोरायसिस, एचआईवी बीमारी का खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Getting a tattoo can be life-threatening to the body: risk of infection, allergy, psoriasis, and HIV infection.
article.articleSummary: Mathura, India-based health warning on tattooing highlights risks of skin infection, allergy, psoriasis, and potential HIV and hepatitis transmission. Dr. Rohtas Meena of the Police Hospital in Mathura told News18 that skin injury during tattooing increases infection risk, and inks contain chemicals harmful to the skin. Reported symptoms from tattooing include redness, pus, and swelling. Reusing needles can spread HIV and hepatitis. The piece stresses that tattoos on any body part may be hazardous due to chemical exposures and post-procedure chemical applications, and advises caution or avoidance. There are no case counts or outbreaks cited, but the article underscores preventable complications associated with tattooing.

triage.headline_ja: タトゥーを入れることは身体に致命的な影響を及ぼす可能性がある:感染症、アレルギー、乾癬、HIV感染のリスク
triage.triage_reason: 特定の症例数やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、タトゥー施術に伴う一般的な健康リスクに関する啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、タトゥー施術に伴う一般的衛生リスクに関する健康啓発記事である。
