article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Keerom Temukan 25 Kasus Baru HIV/AIDS: Paling Muda Berusia 18 Tahun, 3 Orang Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Keerom Health Office Finds 25 New HIV/AIDS Cases: The Youngest Is 18 Years Old, 3 People Have Died.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, Keerom Regency Health Office in Papua reported 25 new HIV/AIDS cases in 2026, with 3 deaths. The youngest patient is 18 years old. Of the 25 cases, 16 are on regular antiretroviral therapy (ARV), while 6 others are reportedly not mentally prepared to begin treatment; the status of the remaining cases is not specified. HIV testing was conducted on 1,250 individuals at RSUD Kwaingga, toward a 2026 target of 4,803 tests, focusing on pregnant women, pre-operative patients, and adolescents. In response, authorities issued a firm appeal to youth and the broader community to shield themselves from risky social contact to interrupt HIV transmission. The report underscores ongoing efforts to expand testing and access to ARV therapy in Keerom.

triage.headline_ja: クリオム保健局、HIV/AIDS新規25症例を発見:最年少18歳、3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 既知の地域流行性疾患であるHIV/AIDSの通常の症例報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: パプアニューギニアは記事本文で言及されておらず、実際の発生地はインドネシア(パプア州クリオム県)のみ。HIVは地域で継続的に発生している既知の感染症であり、通常の保健当局の活動報告に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو يتوسع والإصابات تتجاوز 1800 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding, with cases exceeding 1,800.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo expands to 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths as of July 13, 2026. Affected provinces are Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, with Haut-Uele and Tshopo reported in the national tally for the first time and linked to the Ituri outbreak cluster. Authorities report 763 patients in isolation or treatment, and a treatment-center bed occupancy rate of 95.1%, with 306 recoveries. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain and was first announced on May 15. The report provides no detailed symptoms or transmission specifics beyond the Ituri cluster linkage. Ongoing surveillance and cross-provincial investigations are implied by the broadened geographic scope.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大、感染者数は1,800例を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が複数州に拡大し、致死率も高く（672/1873）、病床占有率も95%超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響及び国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 北Kivuを含む5州に拡大し、致死率約36%と高い。ベッド占有率95.1%は医療体制逼迫を示唆し、外部支援の必要性が高いと推測される。

article.articleHeadline: Second Ebola-infected US citizen flown to Germany for treatment
article.articleSummary: Second US citizen infected with Ebola's Bundibugyo strain has been transported to Germany for treatment, two months after the first US patient arrived there. The patient landed in Frankfurt and was admitted to a university hospital; the CDC confirmed the individual is a US citizen employed by a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Lab confirmation showed infection with the Bundibugyo strain currently circulating in DRC. Ebola is contagious and potentially fatal, spreading via direct contact and exposure to bodily fluids. The first US patient, a doctor, reached Berlin's Charité hospital in May and was discharged after about two weeks; transfer was at times life-threatening. In the DRC, about 650 confirmed deaths and at least 1,830 infections have been reported. There is currently no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: 2人目のエボラ感染米国人がドイツへ搬送、治療のため
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクにより既に650人が死亡、1830人感染しており、国際搬送事例も発生していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクであり、患者搬送先のドイツ・米国は発生地域ではなく治療地であるため対象国リストから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola se está descontrolando
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is getting out of control.
article.articleSummary: 1,830 confirmed Ebola cases and 648 deaths in the DRC as of July 11, 2026, with >90% in Ituri, centered on Bunia. The outbreak began May 15, and the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later. By July 9, it had spread to two more provinces, with risk of crossing into South Sudan. Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine; containment relies on testing, contact tracing, and isolation, but these measures are barely implemented in Ituri amid logistic challenges: armed groups and roughly 900,000 displaced people in camps and mining areas. PPE is scarce; frontline workers are getting sick and at least 25 have died. Salaries for health workers around $80/month have been unpaid for months; Ebola bonuses are $70. Donors pledged over $1.2 billion, but only $115 million disbursed; workers have protested. CDC warns it could reach West Africa’s toll of over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が制御不能になりつつある
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラが1,830症例・648人死亡と拡大し、WHOがPHEICを宣言済み。国際的拡大リスク（南スーダンへの越境懸念）、ワクチン不在、資金・人員不足による対応困難など複数のIHR/WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 南スーダン・アンゴラは越境リスクとして言及されているが、対象国リストに南スーダン・アンゴラは含まれないため除外。WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言しており、フルRRAが必要な緊急性の高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: China reports 79,000 COVID-19 cases in June
article.articleSummary: China reported 79,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases in June 2026, including 130 severe cases and one COVID-19–related death, according to data released by the Chinese CDC. The June total marks a sharp rise from about 21,861 cases in May and 23,477 in April, with the agency noting an overall upward trend in domestic transmission. All June infections were attributed to the Omicron variant, with no evidence of new strains emerging. The release provides monthly totals and variant attribution but offers no regional breakdown, symptom profiles, or details on vaccination impact. The figures reflect surveillance data for the month rather than a single-day snapshot, indicating a continuing wave through June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、6月のCOVID-19感染者数7万9000人と報告
triage.triage_reason: 感染者数は増加傾向にあるが、変異株はOmicronで新規変異株の報告はなく、重症・死亡率も低いためIHR基準は満たさない。持続的な感染拡大の可能性はあるが地域内訳や症状詳細など情報が不足しており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる月次サーベイランスデータ。地域別内訳、症状プロファイル、ワクチン効果に関する情報は含まれていない。既存のOmicron株による国内流行の継続を示すが、新規変異株の出現は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: نانوپانسمان هوشمند برای زخم‌های عفونی
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Smart nanopatch dressing for infected wounds.
article.articleSummary: Chinese researchers at Sun Yat-sen University designed a smart nanocomposite, SH@ZIF-8/AgNPs, that activates only in acidic wound environments (pH ~5.5–6.4) to treat infected wounds. The system uses a zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 (ZIF-8) carrier loaded with Shikonin and coated with silver nanoparticles. At normal physiological pH (~7.4) the carrier remains inert; upon acidification it gradually releases silver ions and Shikonin to kill bacteria, reduce inflammation and neutralize reactive oxygen species, thereby promoting tissue repair. In vitro testing shows a drug-loading capacity of 44.2% and efficacy against Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus, with minimal cytotoxicity to fibroblasts at therapeutic doses. In vivo in an animal infected skin-wound model, treated wounds healed faster, with epithelial restoration, organized collagen, and neovascularization. This preclinical work suggests a targeted, infection-responsive dressing for future smart wound care.

triage.headline_ja: 感染創傷治療のためのスマートナノパッチ包帯
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は創傷治療用のナノ材料開発に関する研究紹介であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の懸念事象ではない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にE. coliが付与されているが、これは実験材料としての言及であり、実際の感染症流行事例ではない。研究開発ニュースのためトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya cases in Samar climb to 259
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya cases in Samar climb to 259 as of 11 July, with Basey reporting 159 cases and Gandara 97; Paranas has 3 cases. Most infections linked to Barangay Mabini in Basey (128) and Barangay Ngoso in Gandara (51). Year-to-date counts show nine cases in February, six in May, 190 in June, and 54 from 1–11 July, indicating a sharp recent surge. No deaths have been reported. Attack rates remain relatively low at about 28 cases per 100,000 in Basey and 27 per 100,000 in Gandara. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, also spreading dengue and Zika, with symptoms including sudden fever and severe joint pain lasting days to weeks. The provincial health office issued a health advisory urging households to eliminate breeding sites, remove stagnant water, and improve waste disposal, while barangays reinforce community-based mosquito control. triage.headline_ja: サマール州のチクングニア熱症例、259件に増加
triage.triage_reason: サマール州での局地的なチクングニア熱の急増が見られるが、死亡例はなく罹患率も比較的低いため、地域レベルでの継続監視が妥当と判断される。
triage.notes: 6月から7月にかけて症例数が急増（5月6件→6月190件）しているが、死亡例なし、致命率・攻撃率とも低水準。州保健局が蚊の発生源対策の勧告を発出し地域レベルで対応中。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola treatment trial begins in Congo at 'record pace'
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bunia, Ituri Province) reports 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths as of July 9. No vaccine or approved treatment exists; the outbreak was declared a WHO public health emergency of international concern on May 17. The Partners treatment trial began in Bunia at a record pace, enrolling patients within six weeks of the PHEIC, randomized to receive remdesivir (Gilead) or MBP134 (Mapp Biopharmaceutical) or combinations or standard care. MBP134 is a monoclonal antibody; remdesivir is an antiviral. Dosing: MBP134 a one-off infusion; remdesivir 10 days IV. Both showed efficacy against Bundibugyo virus in animal models. WHO donations cover up to 1,200 patients; trial sponsored by WHO with funding from Wellcome Trust, FCDO and UKRI. A second post-exposure prophylaxis trial using obeldesivir for contacts is planned, requiring about $18 million, with $6 million committed to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ治療試験が「記録的なペース」で開始
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ（ブンディブギョ）アウトブレイクで1,792例・625死亡と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既にWHOによりPHEICと宣言されている既知のアウトブレイクの継続報道。治療薬治験開始という新規情報を含むが、基本的な公衆衛生上の深刻さは既に確立されている。

article.articleHeadline: 對抗登革熱出奇招！東南亞返國快篩送500元 高雄市民皆可領
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unconventional tactics to fight dengue fever! NT$500 rapid tests for Southeast Asia returnees; Kaohsiung residents all eligible.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung City, Taiwan reports 16 dengue fever cases: 9 imported and 7 locally transmitted. The Health Bureau launches a Summer Overseas Outbreak Reward Program, offering NT$500 vouchers to anyone returning from Southeast Asia who completes rapid screening within 14 days of arrival during July–August, expanding beyond prior targets to include all citizens. Imported cases are mainly from Indonesia, followed by Vietnam and Malaysia. Dengue infections are often asymptomatic (over 70%), yet transmissible, prompting screening to detect hidden carriers. With Typhoon Bavi aftermath and heavy rainfall raising mosquito breeding risk, prompt testing remains crucial. Returnees within 14 days with fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pain, or rash should seek medical care promptly. Pre-travel measures include free mosquito repellent for students below college level, new residents, and migrant workers; and recommendations to wear light-colored long sleeves/pants and avoid mosquito-dense areas.

triage.headline_ja: 対抗登革熱出奇招！東南アジアからの帰国者に迅速検査でNT$500支給、高雄市民は誰でも受給可能
triage.triage_reason: 高雄市での季節性デング熱（輸入例9・地域感染7例）に対するルーティンな公衆衛生対策の報道であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、雨季による蚊媒介感染拡大リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（高雄市）における季節性デング熱の国内対策であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシア・ベトナム・マレーシアは輸入症例の由来地として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生報道ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: أول المرضى المسجلين في تجربة علاج الإيبولا التي حطمت الأرقام القياسية في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first patients enrolled in the Ebola treatment trial that broke records in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: First patients enrolled in an Ebola treatment trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid the Bundibugyo outbreak. As of July 9, 2026, 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths have been reported for Bundibugyo, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapy. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, six weeks earlier. The trial is in Bunia, Ituri Province, with three arms: remdesivir, MBP134, either drug together, or standard supportive care. MBP134 is a monoclonal antibody developed by Mab Biotechnologies; remdesivir is an antiviral from Gilead. Administered IV—MBP134 as a single infusion; remdesivir for 10 days. The trial aims to reduce mortality, building on preclinical activity against Bundibugyo. Challenges include limited contact tracing (~75%), community mistrust, frontline worker strikes over pay, and airport closures delaying response. Bundibugyo mortality about one in three, lower than Zaire, but still high.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で記録的規模となったエボラ治療試験に最初の患者が登録
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクで、1,792例確定・625死亡と深刻。IHR4基準すべて該当し、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。接触者追跡は約75%にとどまり、コミュニティの不信、医療従事者のストライキ、空港閉鎖など対応上の課題が複数存在。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、Bunia（イツリ州）でMBP134・レムデシビル等の治療試験が開始された。

article.articleHeadline: 672 حالة وفاة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونجو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 672 Ebola virus deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 1,873 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 672 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 13, 2026. Affected provinces are Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, with Haut-Uele and Tshopo added to the national report for the first time. There are 763 patients in isolation or receiving hospital care, and bed occupancy at treatment centers stands at 95.1%. The DRC declared the seventeenth Ebola outbreak wave on May 15, and the World Health Organization issued an international health alert regarding the situation, indicating ongoing transmission across eastern provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスによる死者672人
triage.triage_reason: エボラの大規模流行（1873症例、672死亡）が複数州に拡大し、WHOが国際保健アラートを発出している重大事案であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行波として拡大中。病床占有率95.1%と医療体制逼迫が顕著で、WHOが国際保健アラートを発出済み。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: New US Ebola patient will not be treated in Kenya
article.articleSummary: An American aid worker infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo will not be evacuated to Kenya because the Laikipia quarantine facility is not complete. The CDC confirmed the case; the Samaritan's Purse employee, who worked in logistics in Bunia, Ituri Province, has been in isolation since the previous Monday and is being treated at a Samaritan's Purse Ebola treatment centre in Congo. German facilities in Frankfurt are being considered for evacuation, not Kenya, following Kenya's halted Laikipia project amid protests. This is the second U.S. case after the May evacuee to Germany who has recovered. Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has more than 1,800 infections and at least 648 deaths; Uganda has 20 cases and 2 deaths. The strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Kenya, yet to report confirmed cases, remains on high alert. The U.S. pledged Sh1.9 billion to strengthen Kenya's preparedness (surveillance, labs, airport/border screening).

triage.headline_ja: 新たな米国人エボラ患者、ケニアでは治療されず
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のブンディブギョ株エボラ流行は1800人以上感染・648人死亡と深刻で、米国人・ドイツへの国際後送例が続くなど国際的拡大とIHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・米国・ドイツは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダでも20例・2死亡が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため記載のみ。承認されたワクチン・特効薬がない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 통제 불능 빠진 '에볼라 사태'...민주콩고 넘어 남수단으로 확산되나-국제ㅣ한국일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Out-of-control Ebola outbreak... Is it spreading beyond the Democratic Republic of the Congo into South Sudan? - International | Hankook Ilbo
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached uncontrolled levels, with 1,873 confirmed cases across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and neighboring Tshopo and Haut-Uele provinces, and 672 deaths as of July 12. The fragile health system hampers essential measures—rapid testing, contact tracing, and isolation—raising underdetection and ongoing transmission. WHO notes dozens of health workers infected and 25 dead, highlighting frontline risks amid limited protective equipment and pay. Although donors pledged more than $1.2 billion in support, only about $115 million has been disbursed in Congo. CDC warned that without improved response the outbreak could mirror the 2013–2016 West Africa epidemic. Analysts estimate a 70% chance Ebola could spread to neighboring South Sudan within three months, a country with far weaker health infrastructure and ongoing conflict.

triage.headline_ja: 制御不能に陥った「エボラ事態」...民主コンゴを越えて南スーダンへ拡散するのか-国際|韓国日報
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,873人、死者672人と大規模かつ制御不能な状態にあり、医療従事者感染や資金不足、近隣国への拡大リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 南スーダンへの拡散はアナリストによる予測（3か月以内に70%の確率）であり、現時点で確定症例の報告ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。南スーダンおよびアンゴラは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: 인도서 코로나19 확진자 2명 사망...중국서도 확진자 '급증'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two COVID-19 deaths reported in India as confirmed cases surge in China.
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19 deaths were reported in India on July 13, 2026, in Kadapa district of Andhra Pradesh. A 52-year-old man with fever and cough tested positive and died after hospitalisation; a 43-year-old man with complications also tested positive and died after ICU admission. Following the fatalities, eight more infections were confirmed among contacts and are in home isolation. Kadapa’s rapid-response team collected about 40 samples in the area; 18 were negative, with results pending for others. The state government issued a COVID-19 alert across Andhra Pradesh, ordered testing of the infected individuals' family members, and evacuation to isolation wards if positive. In India, cumulative infections exceed 45 million with roughly 533,000 deaths, though rural underreporting is suspected. In China, the CDC reported last month 79,000 new cases and 1 death; 130 severe cases; most infections are Omicron; no new variants of concern.

triage.headline_ja: インドでコロナ19確診者2人死亡…中国でも確診者「急増」
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域でCOVID-19クラスターと死亡例が発生し当局が警戒を発令しているが、既知の疾患であり新変異株も確認されていないため、フルリスク評価より継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 中国での症例増加も言及されているが、新変異株なし・重症度低いとの報告であり、主題はインドのローカルクラスターであるため中国は検証対象国から除外。

article.articleHeadline: تسجيل 1873 إصابة و672 وفاة بفيروس إيبولا بالكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,873 Ebola virus infections and 672 deaths recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,873 confirmed Ebola virus infections and 672 deaths nationwide. Health authorities note the affected provinces as Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, with Haut-Uele and Tshopo included in the national report for the first time. The article provides no further laboratory details, dates of symptom onset, infection sources, or information on imported/exported cases. The figures indicate a persistent Ebola outbreak spanning multiple eastern provinces, underscoring ongoing transmission, though no public health measures or response timeline are described in the brief. No dates for initial cases or provincial timelines are provided, and there is no discussion of imported or exported cases beyond the counts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染1,873例、死亡672例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が複数州にまたがり大規模に拡大しており（1,873例、672死亡）、新たな州（Haut-Uele、Tshopo）にも拡大していることから公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 致死率は約35.9%（672/1873）と高く、Haut-UeleとTshopoが新たに報告対象州となったことは地理的拡大を示唆。詳細な症例定義、発症日、感染経路等の情報は記事に記載なし。継続的な監視とフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient wird in Frankfurter Uniklinik behandelt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient is being treated at Frankfurt University Hospital.
article.articleSummary: Two U.S. citizens infected with Ebola are being treated in Germany. A second infected American—a doctor with a humanitarian organization who worked in the Democratic Republic of the Congo—arrived overnight at Frankfurt and is hospitalized at the University Hospital in Frankfurt. He tested positive for the Bundibugyo variant; there is no vaccine or standard specific therapy for this strain. The U.S. CDC had identified the patient’s occupation in the DRC. There is no danger to the public, given isolation facilities that separate Ebola patients from normal hospital operations. Previously, a first U.S. doctor arrived in May and was treated at Berlin’s Charité; his condition was life-threatening during transit but he was discharged after about two weeks. End-June, Bundibugyo virus was detected in Europe for the first time in France, in a humanitarian worker returning from eastern Congo; he was isolated on arrival and discharged in early July after negative tests and no symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者、フランクフルト大学病院で治療中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）由来のエボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株がドイツ・フランスへ複数回にわたり越境搬送されており、国際的拡大とワクチン・治療法不在という異常性が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCでの人道支援活動中に感染し、ドイツ（ベルリン・フランクフルト）とフランスへ搬送・隔離治療を受けている。ブンディブギョ株はワクチン・特異的治療法が確立されておらず、既に欧州で複数例確認済みであることから、DRC国内での感染拡大状況について続報の確認とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DOH cites Parañaque for mosquito‑borne disease fight
article.articleSummary: Parañaque City was cited by the Department of Health for exemplary efforts against mosquito-borne viral diseases, including dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and yellow fever. The recognition acknowledged outstanding implementation of the National Aedes-Borne Viral Diseases Prevention and Control Program (NAVDPCP) during its Implementation Review held July 7–10 at the Century Hotel in Pampanga. Mayor Edwin Olivarez welcomed the honor, noting the city’s ongoing commitment to protecting residents through strengthened public health services. He credited the City Health Office, healthcare workers, barangay officials, and community volunteers for intensified disease surveillance, early case detection, prompt treatment, vector-control activities, and sustained public information campaigns. Olivarez said the award motivates further enhancements in prevention and control with the DOH and the community. NAVDPCP is the DOH flagship program aimed at reducing Aedes-borne viral diseases through integrated vector management, surveillance, early diagnosis, timely treatment, environmental sanitation, and active community participation.

triage.headline_ja: DOH、蚊媒介性感染症対策でパラニャーケ市を表彰
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症の発生報告ではなく、DOHが蚊媒介性疾患対策プログラムの優良実施都市を表彰したという内容であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規リスクは示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は疾病発生の報告ではなく、蚊媒介性感染症対策プログラム（NAVDPCP）の優良実施表彰に関する内容。トリアージ対象としての新規シグナルなし。

article.articleHeadline: 防登革熱高雄決戰境外　東南亞返台快篩獲500元禮券
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Prevention: Kaohsiung Battles Overseas; Southeast Asia Returnees to Taiwan Receive NT$500 Gift Voucher for Rapid Tests.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung, Taiwan, launched an Overseas Dengue Prevention Reward Program amid summer travel and rising dengue import risk from Southeast Asia. Returnees from Vietnam, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore, and Cambodia within 14 days of entry who develop fever or dengue-like symptoms should promptly visit a clinic for rapid testing; asymptomatic travelers are encouraged to self-monitor and may be tested at district health offices under triage guidelines. Those who meet testing criteria and complete the process are eligible for a NT$500 voucher. The program also provides free mosquito repellent bottles to teachers and students below university level, new residents, foreign workers and their families before travel, to reinforce personal protection. Authorities urge travelers to use mosquito precautions (light-colored long-sleeve clothing, pants) and to seek rapid care if experiencing fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pain or rash, while informing clinicians of travel history and exposure.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱予防：高雄が水際対策を強化　東南アジアからの帰国者への迅速検査に500元の商品券
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市による季節性・恒例のデング熱輸入予防キャンペーンに関する記事であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（高雄）における渡航者向けデング熱予防・検査促進キャンペーンについてのもので、東南アジア諸国（ベトナム、インドネシア、フィリピン、タイ等）は輸入リスク源として言及されているのみで、これらの国での具体的な発生・アウトブレイクの記述はないため、対象国としての該当なしと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: US-Patient mit Ebola landete in Deutschland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. patient with Ebola landed in Germany.
article.articleSummary: On the night of arrival, a United States citizen infected with Ebola landed at Frankfurt Airport and was transported to the University Hospital in Frankfurt, Hesse, Germany, a spokesman for the Federal Ministry of Health told DPA. The U.S. CDC had previously stated the patient works for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The individual tested positive for the Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus, which is currently circulating in the DRC. The report did not disclose the patient’s sex. This information, dated July 13, 2026, confirms an imported Ebola case into Germany linked to work in the DRC, with the Bundibugyo variant identified by laboratory testing. Authorities referenced in the article include the U.S. CDC and the German Federal Ministry of Health.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人エボラ患者、ドイツに到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCで流行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の輸入症例がドイツで確認されており、国際的拡大とIHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は米国人患者のドイツ搬送だが、感染源はDRCで現在流行中のブンディブギョ株エボラであり、対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当する。ドイツ・米国は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura Virus Deaths Spur Health Alert in Gujarat
article.articleSummary: Three children have died from Chandipura virus (CHPV) infection in Gujarat over the past 10 days, prompting intensified surveillance in Panchmahal and Sabarkantha districts. Gujarat Health Minister says laboratory testing has confirmed CHPV in several children; additional suspected cases are under investigation. Authorities are widening active surveillance, contact tracing, and insect-control efforts, including door-to-door checks, as monsoon season elevates risk of vector-borne transmission. CHPV is a rare but potentially life-threatening member of the Rhabdoviridae family, first identified in 1965 in Chandipura, Maharashtra, with outbreaks in western, central, and southern India. Transmission is mainly via sand flies; there is no proven person-to-person spread. Affected children under 15 can deteriorate rapidly, with high fever, vomiting, seizures, and altered consciousness progressing to acute encephalitis. No antiviral or licensed vaccine exists; control focuses on early diagnosis, supportive care, and vector control, including reducing stagnant water and using bed nets and protective clothing.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルスによる死亡がグジャラート州で健康警戒を招く
triage.triage_reason: グジャラート州で小児3名がチャンディプラ・ウイルス感染により死亡し、当局が積極的サーベイランスと媒介動物対策を強化している。重症度が高く行政の関心も高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスは1965年にマハラシュトラ州チャンディプラで初めて確認された既知の病原体で、インド西部・中部・南部で周期的にアウトブレイクが発生している。サシチョウバエ媒介でヒト-ヒト感染は証明されていない。今回はモンスーン季に伴う媒介動物増加により発生が拡大している可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: 6 साल बाद फिर महामारी जैस हालात! Corona से 2 लोगों की मौत और कई मरीज मिले पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six years later, pandemic-like conditions again! Two people died from COVID-19 and several patients tested positive.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurgence prompts Odisha alert after Andhra Pradesh’s Kadapa district reports two suspected deaths and about six additional infections within ten days. A 46-year-old man is among the suspected deceased. Rapid response teams have been deployed; testing has been intensified and isolation facilities prepared in affected areas. Following a spike in June 2025, the central government urged Odisha to scale up testing and containment. The Health and Family Welfare Department has directed hospitals to test all SARI (Severe Acute Respiratory Infection) cases and at least 5% of ILI (Influenza-like Illness) cases for SARS-CoV-2, with positive SARI samples sent to the ICMR VRDL network for whole-genome sequencing. The situation underscores the need for vigilant surveillance and preventive measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 6年後、再びパンデミックのような状況に！新型コロナウイルスで2人死亡、複数の患者が陽性
triage.triage_reason: インド・アンドラプラデーシュ州で新型コロナの局地的な再燃（死亡2名、感染者数名）が報告され、政府が監視強化を指示しているが、規模は小さく国際的拡大の兆候はないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのオリッサ州・アンドラプラデーシュ州における局地的なCOVID-19再燃を報じており、死亡者数・感染者数は少数。中央政府が検査強化を指示しているが、国際的な影響やIHR通知基準には該当しない。続報でクラスター拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: V Evropi bolnik z ebolo, za to različico ni cepiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Europe, a patient with Ebola; there is no vaccine for this variant.
article.articleSummary: Overnight, an American citizen infected with the Ebola virus variant Bundibugyo arrived in Frankfurt and was placed in a strictly guarded isolation unit. Bundibugyo, circulating in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has no vaccine or approved treatment. Germany uses dedicated isolation wards. The CDC had earlier reported that an American humanitarian worker in the DRC tested positive for Bundibugyo; Congo’s outbreak has produced about 650 deaths and at least 1,830 cases. In France, a humanitarian worker returning from eastern Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo; after isolation, negative tests, and no symptoms, he was discharged. The first patient in Germany, an American physician who arrived May 20 at Charité Berlin, was discharged after just over two weeks; his wife and four children remain in quarantine as high-risk contacts. The 2014–2015 West Africa outbreak killed over 11,000, and Germany treated a UN employee in Leipzig who did not survive.

triage.headline_ja: 欧州でエボラ患者確認、このウイルス変異株にワクチンなし
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ・ブンディブギョ株がドイツ・フランス・米国へ越境し、ワクチン・承認治療法がないためIHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ドイツ・フランス・米国での症例は輸入例であり、感染源はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのブンディブギョ株アウトブレイク。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。ワクチン未承認・致死率の高さから国際的懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: മുംബൈയിൽ എലിപ്പനി ഭീഷണി: മഴവെള്ളത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങുമ്പോൾ ജീവൻ രക്ഷിക്കാൻ ഈ മുൻകരുതലുകൾ മറക്കരുത്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Smallpox Threat in Mumbai: Do Not Forget These Precautions to Save Lives When Entering Floodwaters.
article.articleSummary: Following heavy rains in Mumbai, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) issued a health advisory warning of leptospirosis risk from floodwaters. The infection spreads through water contaminated with animal urine and can enter the body via small skin cuts, pores, or animal bites. Preventive emphasis on skin protection: wear gumboots or waterproof shoes when entering floodwater, cover wounds with waterproof bandages, and keep dry socks to protect feet; minimize contact with muddy floodwater. After exposure, wash the affected area with soap and clean water, and dry the body promptly. Separate wet clothes to prevent spread. The first 72 hours after exposure are critical for preventive treatment; seek a doctor to determine eligibility for prophylaxis. Do not self-medicate with antibiotics; only a health professional should prescribe. If fever, headache, or muscle pain appears after flood exposure, seek urgent medical care.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでレプトスピラ症警戒:モンスーン期の洪水に入る際に命を守るための注意点
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイ市当局(BMC)が毎年恒例のモンスーン季節性レプトスピラ症予防啓発を発表したもので、新規性・異常性はなく、単なる公衆衛生キャンペーン記事である。
triage.notes: ムンバイのモンスーン期における毎年恒例の予防アドバイザリー記事であり、具体的な症例数や死亡者数の記載はない。地域保健当局による通常の季節的注意喚起として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Sjuksköterskan Martina mitt i ebolakrisen i Kongo-Kinshasa | Sveriges Radio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nurse Martina in the midst of the Ebola crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | Swedish Radio
article.articleSummary: Over 600 lives have been lost in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the latest Ebola outbreak continues. Swedish nurse Martina Gustavsson spent a month in the Kongo-Kinshasa region assisting efforts to curb transmission. The outbreak is linked to an unusual variant of the Ebola virus, and currently there are no approved medicines or vaccines to treat or prevent infection. The report highlights ongoing efforts to develop an effective treatment and how health workers on the ground respond to the outbreak. For expert insight, Magnus Gisslén, professor of infectious diseases, is featured discussing the challenges and research directions. The piece raises the central question of what is being done now to achieve a viable treatment, amid the lack of established medical countermeasures.

triage.headline_ja: 看護師マルティナ、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機の最前線で | スウェーデンラジオ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で600人超の死者を出すエボラ流行が継続中で、非定型変異株かつ承認された治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないため、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の大規模エボラ流行（死者600人超）を報じるヒューマンストーリーであり、続報としてWHO/CDCの公式リスク評価情報との照合が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Actuala epidemie de Ebola se răspândeşte mai rapid decât toate cele anterioare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The current Ebola epidemic is spreading faster than all previous ones.
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared May 15, is spreading faster than all previous outbreaks, according to Wessam Mankoula of Africa CDC, outpacing the health response across all Ebola strains, including Bundibugyo. The DRC has endured 17 Ebola outbreaks, yet there are no vaccines or licensed treatments for Bundibugyo. The World Health Organization issued a May 19 alert on the scale and rapid spread in eastern DRC. Médecins Sans Frontières cautioned in mid-June about dangerous gaps in the response. By contrast, the 2013–2016 West Africa epidemic remains the deadliest on record, with over 11,300 deaths and about 29,000 cases, primarily in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: 現在のエボラ出血熱の流行は過去のどの流行よりも速く拡大している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが過去の全ての流行より急速に拡大しており、WHOが警告を発出、有効なワクチン・治療法もないためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 西アフリカ(2013-2016)のエボラ流行は過去の比較対象として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン・治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-utbruddet fortsetter å vokse i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak continues to grow in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of July 13, 2026, 1,873 cases and 672 deaths have been reported (Reuters). The outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, with real numbers possibly higher than official tallies. The virus has spread to eastern areas of the DRC previously unaffected, and it causes extensive bleeding. Wessam Mankoula, head of preparedness at the African public health institute, says this is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever across all Ebola virus species, not only the Bundibugyo variant. The Bundibugyo variant carries a case-fatality rate of 30-50%, and there is no approved vaccine or treatment for this variant.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行が拡大を続ける
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速の拡大速度を示すエボラ流行で、致死率が高く未承認ワクチン/治療薬しかないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異株の致死率30-50%、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、これまでで最も拡大速度が速いエボラ流行との報告あり。東部の新規地域への拡大も懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 6月新增新冠确诊7.9万例，专家：多为轻症，不必恐慌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In June, 79,000 new confirmed COVID-19 cases; experts say most are mild, no need to panic.
article.articleSummary: In June 2026, China reported 79,000 newly confirmed COVID-19 cases across 31 provinces and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (due to underlying disease co-infection). The nationwide case count trended upward. Beijing You’an Hospital infectious diseases chief Li Tongzeng attributed the rise to waning population immunity over time, noting most post-infection symptoms are mild and that the public should not panic. Public health advice stresses daily hygiene and handwashing; those with respiratory symptoms should rest at home and monitor health, avoid going to work or school while ill, and seek medical care as needed. Vulnerable groups—older adults and individuals with serious underlying conditions—should pursue early diagnosis and treatment to prevent severe disease. When visiting hospitals, patients and companions should wear masks to reduce cross-infection. Source: Guangdong Release.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年6月、中国全土で新型コロナウイルス新規感染者7.9万人確認 専門家「大半は軽症、パニックの必要なし」
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既に風土病化した疾患であり、免疫低下による季節的増加という予測範囲内の事象。重症化率・致死率も低く、専門家も「パニック不要」とコメントしており、異常性・国際的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 中国当局による定例のCOVID-19サーベイランス報告。79,000例中重症130例、死亡1例（基礎疾患合併）で致死率は極めて低く、季節的な免疫低下による予測内の増加とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Hunderte Opfer: Ebola-Infizierter sucht Hilfe in deutschem Krankenhaus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds of victims: Ebola-infected person seeks help in a German hospital.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with hundreds of victims as an Ebola-infected U.S. citizen arrives in Germany for treatment. The patient, who worked for a humanitarian organization in the DRC, tested positive for the Bundibugyo variant and landed at Frankfurt Airport before transfer to Universitätsklinikum Frankfurt. Age and sex were not disclosed by the CDC. Symptoms were not disclosed. Ebola is transmissible via direct contact with infected persons or body fluids; there is neither a vaccine nor a specific therapy for Bundibugyo. In Germany, patients are treated in dedicated special isolation units, with authorities stating no danger to the public. This marks the second Ebola-infected American treated in Germany within weeks, following a May 20 admission of a doctor at Charité in Berlin, who recovered on June 6. Charité described the isolation unit as a crucial component in handling high-pathogen infections.

triage.headline_ja: 数百人の犠牲者：エボラ感染者がドイツの病院で治療を求める
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で数百人規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、感染者がドイツへ搬送されるなど国際的な人の移動が発生しているため、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 米国人感染者のドイツ搬送は個別症例の国際移送であり、コミュニティレベルでの国際伝播ではない点に留意。DRCでの流行状況（症例数・致死率・地域）の続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: आंध्र प्रदेश के कडप्पा में बढ़ा COVID-19 का खतरा, 8 नए केस मिले, 2 लोगों की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 threat grows in Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh; 8 new cases, 2 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, Kadapa (YSR Kadappa district), Andhra Pradesh, reports eight new COVID-19 cases and two deaths, prompting heightened vigilance. The 52-year-old man, who presented with fever and cough, tested positive and died during treatment at Vellore’s Christian Medical College. The other fatality, a 43-year-old man with preexisting health issues, died after testing positive in a government hospital COVID ICU. A 25-year-old medical student at Kadappa Medical College also tested positive and is in stable condition under home isolation. Contact tracing and sampling have intensified, with ~40 people tested (18 negative; others pending). Eight active cases remain; samples have been sent to a Pune lab for genomic sequencing to identify variants. Andhra Pradesh-wide alert ordered: masks in crowded areas, hospitals, and public spaces; symptomatic individuals to be isolated; family members to be tested and monitored.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州カダパでCOVID-19の脅威拡大、新規8例・死亡2名
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の局地的な小規模クラスターで死亡例もあるが、既知の疾患であり国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。変異株調査中のため続報を注視。
triage.notes: 州レベルで警戒指示（マスク着用、隔離、接触者追跡）が出されており行政の関心は高いが、既知の病原体であり新規性・国際的懸念は低い。ゲノム解析結果次第で評価見直しの可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Cut off from Kinshasa, Congo's AFC/M23 rebels built their own Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola cases in rebel-held North Kivu and South Kivu after the outbreak was declared on May 15; one case in Goma and three near Bukavu. AFC/M23 controls large areas and declared the outbreak over after a 21‑day period without new cases. In rebel zones, 400 contacts were monitored with 98% daily follow-up; 207 samples had been tested as of June 18. The broader Congo outbreak has infected 1,873 people and killed 672, per government data released July 13. Parallel health administrations govern rebel areas; cooperation with Kinshasa is mainly data sharing and laboratory testing. Rwanda supplied specialists to Goma and materials, with about $6,891 in Rwanda-provided supplies and $85,467 from Gisenyi Hospital. Gaps include shortages of PPE and infection-control kits, limited lab capacity (Goma lab with two extraction kits mid‑June), a closed Goma airport, and a shut banking system in rebel zones. A journalist faced 15 days of mandatory isolation.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサから遮断された状態で、コンゴのAFC/M23反政府勢力が独自のエボラ対応を構築
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（累計1,873症例、672人死亡）が紛争地域で発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は北キブ・南キブの反政府支配地域におけるエボラ対応の分断統治構造を扱っている。ルワンダからの支援言及があるが、発生自体はDRC国内に限定されるため対象国リストにはDRCのみを含めた。空港閉鎖・銀行システム停止は紛争起因の可能性もあり、エボラ対策としての渡航制限とは明確に区別できない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémia eboly v Kongu naberá na sile, počet potvrdených prípadov vzrástol takmer na 2000. Zomrelo 672 ľudí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo is gaining strength; the number of confirmed cases has risen to nearly 2,000. 672 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases and 672 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 13 July 2026, with most infections and fatalities in Ituri province in the northeast, from where the outbreak has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and two deaths, and France reported one case in June. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy. Africa CDC describes it as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date. In early July, Congo began testing two potential treatments against Bundibugyo: MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, tested separately and in combination. Ebola symptoms start flu-like, followed by hemorrhagic features and organ failure. ECDC and WHO consider the risk of spread to non-affected areas to be low.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が勢いを増し、確定症例数が約2000人に増加。672人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確定症例約2000人・死者672人という大規模なエボラ流行が発生し、ウガンダやフランスへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランスへの拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ・フランスは含まれないためverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo変異株による過去最速拡大の流行とAfrica CDCが指摘している点にも留意。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 美公民剛果染伊波拉　足球員腦部變化與詐領健保案受矚 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American citizen contracted Ebola in Congo; a soccer player's brain changes and a National Health Insurance fraud case draw attention.
article.articleSummary: One American citizen working for a humanitarian aid organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus. The U.S. CDC confirmed the infection and is coordinating with the organization, U.S. agencies, and Congolese authorities to prevent transmission and trace high-risk contacts; no broader outbreak details are provided. Separately, Imperial College London researchers analyzed 142 retired professional football players (ages 30–60) and 56 controls, finding that frequent heading is linked to subtle brain-structure changes and higher anxiety/depression, but no cognitive decline. The article also notes facial fracture risk and the use of protective masks at the World Cup. In business and policy, Insilico Medicine and Kangzhe Pharmaceutical will pursue CNS disease research with up to $120 million in milestone payments; U.S. HHS OIG reports potential recovery of $5.56 billion and debarment of over 1,200 entities in healthcare fraud enforcement.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人がコンゴでエボラウイルスに感染　サッカー選手の脳変化や医療保険詐欺事件も注目
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でヒト-ヒト感染力の強いエボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）感染が米国人に確認され、致死率の高い疾患であることから国際的拡大リスクを評価する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は人道支援団体職員である米国人1名の感染確認に焦点を当てており、広域アウトブレイクの詳細は記載されていない。CDCとコンゴ当局が接触者追跡を実施中とのことで、続報および感染規模の確認が必要。英国・米国の地域情報は接触者や関係機関の所在地であり、感染発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: कोरोना के नए वैरिएंट BA.3.2 पर वैज्ञानिकों की नजर, भारत में अब तक नहीं मिला कोई मामला
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists monitor the new coronavirus variant BA.3.2; so far no cases have been detected in India.
article.articleSummary: BA.3.2 SARS-CoV-2 variant: No confirmed India cases as of 2026-07-13. Early studies show many mutations in the spike protein—roughly 70–75 changes compared with the JN.1 lineage—suggesting possible partial immune escape, but there is no evidence yet that it causes more severe disease. Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands identified the variant between Nov 2025 and Jan 2026, with additional detections in the United States via patient samples and wastewater surveillance. Experts caution against assuming vaccines are fully ineffective; vaccines may still protect against severe disease, though protection against infection could be reduced. Sub-lineages BA.3.2.1 and BA.3.2.2 are under monitoring. In Andhra Pradesh’s Kadapa district, a few new COVID-19 cases and two deaths prompted heightened surveillance; most patients have mild symptoms and are under home isolation or hospital monitoring. RT-PCR positives prompted additional sampling.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株BA.3.2を科学者が監視、インドではこれまでのところ症例なし
triage.triage_reason: スパイク蛋白に70〜75箇所の変異を持つ新変異株BA.3.2が複数国（デンマーク、ドイツ、オランダ、米国）で検出されており、免疫逃避の可能性が指摘されているため、異常性と国際拡大の両基準に該当する。
triage.notes: BA.3.2変異株自体はインドで未確認だが、アンドラプラデシュ州カダパ地区で通常株の新規COVID-19症例と死亡例が報告され、監視強化中。米国・欧州3カ国での検出は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو .. 1873 اصابة مؤكدة و672 وفاة بفيروس ايبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo: 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths from the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, the Congo reports 1,873 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 672 deaths, underscoring a high mortality burden (roughly 35.8% case fatality). The article centers on Ebola outbreaks in the Congo, providing only the case and death counts without details on symptoms, transmission, laboratory methods, or control measures. No information is given on imported or exported cases. The data indicate an ongoing Ebola situation in the region that has attracted reporting, though the piece does not elaborate on response efforts or timelines. These figures underscore the burden of Ebola virus disease in the region; however, the article does not specify affected provinces, dates of onset, laboratory confirmation methods, transmission chains, or any containment actions, nor any details about imported or exported cases. The report provides limited epidemiological context.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラウイルスによる確定症例1,873例、死亡672例
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約35.8%の大規模エボラ流行がコンゴで継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は症例数・死亡数のみで、発生州、発症時期、感染経路、対応状況等の詳細情報が欠如している。続報でこれらの詳細を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Kisangani désormais touchée par l'épidémie, quatre cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Kisangani now affected by the outbreak, four cases.
article.articleSummary: Four imported Ebola virus disease cases from Ituri have led the Democratic Republic of Congo to declare Kisangani in Tshopo province affected. The four patients, who contracted Ebola in Ituri and were treated in Kisangani, comprise two confirmed in Makiso-Kisangani district, one in Mangobo, and one in Lubunga. Two deaths have been reported; 40 suspected cases and 129 contacts identified. Other zones—Tshopo, Kabondo, Bafwasende, Basali and Waniarukula—have no confirmed cases yet but remain under heightened surveillance. Nosocomial and community transmission risk is considered high in Makiso-Kisangani, Mangobo and Lubunga, with border zones Bafwasende and Waniarukula at high risk due to proximity to Niania in Ituri. By July 10, 2026, 45 alerts were recorded, 30 investigated, 25 confirmed as suspected; samples sent for analysis. Public health authorities emphasize rapid contact tracing and cooperation; symptoms include fever, diarrhea, vomiting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：キサンガニもついに流行地域に、4症例確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がイツリ州からキサンガニ（ツホポ州の主要都市）へ拡大し、死亡例・院内感染リスクも報告されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにMaliが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRC（イツリ州からキサンガニへの拡大）のみを主題としており、Maliは無関係のため除外した。エボラは致死率が高く、DRCの過去の流行では国境を越えた拡大やWHOの緊急対応を要した実績があるため、国際的拡大リスクをYesと評価した。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果叛軍自建伊波拉防疫體系　鄰國盧安達暗中援助引關注 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese rebels build their own Ebola prevention system; neighboring Rwanda's covert aid draws attention.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is being addressed by AFC/M23 rebels who control parts of North Kivu and South Kivu, with four confirmed cases in their territory since the May outbreak. The rebels established a parallel public-health response, enforcing strict measures such as halting government-linked bus routes and isolating contacts, and declaring the outbreak over in their areas after a 21-day no-new-cases window. Government-controlled areas meanwhile report 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths nationwide. Lacking central resources, the rebels sought help from Rwanda, which dispatched six experts (virus testing, logistics, safe burials) and, via the Rwanda Biomedical Center and a border hospital, supplied PPE and medicines valued at over $90,000. Analysts caution that four cases provide limited indicators; rebel-held regions face severe medical-supply shortages, with airports and banks closed, risking wider spread if the epidemic advances on the frontline.”}{

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ反政府勢力が独自のエボラ防疫体制を構築、隣国ルワンダの秘密支援に注目集まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ拡大（全国1,873例・672死亡）が継続中で、反政府勢力支配地域での対応体制の脆弱性や国境を越えたルワンダの関与など、国際的拡大・管理可能性の懸念が複数該当する。
triage.notes: ルワンダは支援国として言及されているが、ルワンダ国内での発生ではないため対象国リストから除外（ルワンダはそもそも対象国リストに含まれていない）。反政府勢力支配地域の医療インフラ崩壊（空港・銀行閉鎖）は感染拡大リスクを高める要因として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Student dies after school deworming activity in Cavite
article.articleSummary: Death of a Grade 4 student at Hugo Perez Elementary School-Annex in Trece Martires City, Cavite, after a routine deworming on July 2. The pupil was hospitalized July 3 after vomiting and died the same day. Initial medical findings link the death to an infection that led to septic shock; the specific pathogen has not been disclosed. Several other students reportedly felt unwell following the deworming, and DepEd is cooperating with the city health office and health authorities to determine what happened and to review health and safety protocols. The incident cites DepEd guidance that deworming is conducted twice yearly with health personnel, DOH coordination, and parental consent, per a 2018 booklet. The article also notes soil-transmitted helminth infections are common, especially in poorer populations, causing symptoms such as diarrhea, intestinal inflammation, and impaired nutrient uptake, per WHO context. Investigations are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: カビテ州の学校での虫下し活動後、生徒が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 駆虫薬投与後に生徒が敗血症性ショックで死亡し他の児童にも体調不良が見られたが、原因病原体は未特定で単発事例のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 死亡の直接原因となった病原体は未公表であり、感染症由来か医薬品反応かなど詳細不明。DepEdと保健当局が調査中であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kesehatan: Ameba 'pemakan otak' telah menyebar ke seluruh dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health: Brain-eating amoeba has spread worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri, the brain-eating amoeba, causes primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (PAM) after nasal exposure to warm freshwater. An 11-year-old, Jordan, died after swimming in a natural hot-spring pool near a Costa Rica hotel, developing severe headache, confusion, hallucinations, seizures, and death within seven days. Globally, PAM remains rare but highly fatal: 488 cases were reported from 1962–2023 with about 97% mortality, mostly in the southern United States, Pakistan, and Australia. Over the last two decades, cases have appeared in northern countries such as Italy and Belgium, and in northern U.S. states like Minnesota; Slovakia reported its first confirmed case in 2025; Taiwan recorded a fatal indoor-water-park exposure in 2023. In India’s Kerala state, around 200 infections were reported last year, with roughly half surviving. Warmer waters boost amoeba activity; early diagnosis and multi-drug therapy with brain‑swelling control offer limited hope, though better detection may inflate apparent case counts.

triage.headline_ja: 健康：「脳を食うアメーバ」が世界中に広がっている
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイクではなく、既知の稀少疾患（原発性アメーバ性髄膜脳炎）に関するグローバルな解説記事であり、対象国インドについても既存の年次統計の紹介にとどまる。
triage.notes: Naegleria fowleriによるPAMはヒト-ヒト感染がなく、温水淡水への曝露が原因の稀な疾患。記事は世界各地での発生事例を紹介する一般解説記事であり、緊急性のある新規シグナルではない。インドのKerala州における昨年約200例の報告は既存データの言及であり、新規アウトブレイクの兆候ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 家里这些东西必须扔！温州市疾控中心发布防疫"避坑指南"......
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These household items must be discarded! Wenzhou CDC releases an epidemic-prevention "pitfall-avoidance guide".......
article.articleSummary: After Typhoon, Wenzhou, Zhejiang, faces flood-related health risks from contaminated water, spoiled food, and mosquito-borne diseases. Zhu Zifu, deputy director of the Wenzhou CDC, releases a disaster-prevention guide on drinking water safety, food handling, wound protection, and environmental disinfection. Do not drink untreated water—even if it looks clear; boil water or use bottled/approved purification. Four food categories must be discarded: flood-soaked items, water-damaged packaging, thawed frozen meat/seafood after 24 hours without power, and any food with odor or mold. Post-flood, small containers can harbor mosquitoes; conduct full “drain water” actions, install screens, wear long sleeves, use nets and repellents. For wounds, cover before wading; rinse with clean water and soap if in contact with floodwater; seek medical care for infection signs and tetanus status assessment. Seek care for diarrhea, vomiting, fever, or abdominal pain; watch for dengue if sudden high fever with rash or myalgia, or dehydration from gastroenteritis.

triage.headline_ja: 家にあるこれらの物は捨てるべき！温州市疾病予防管理センターが防疫『落とし穴回避ガイド』を発表……
triage.triage_reason: 台風後の洪水に伴う一般的な公衆衛生注意喚起（飲料水・食品・防蚊・破傷風予防等）であり、具体的な症例数や実際の感染症発生報告は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は台風後の洪水による衛生リスクへの一般的な予防ガイドであり、破傷風・デング熱の実際の発生や症例報告ではない。地方衛生当局による注意喚起のみで、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの証拠なし。

article.articleHeadline: Filipino expert pushes integrated disease testing to speed up TB elimination
article.articleSummary: TB in the Philippines could be accelerated through an integrated multi-disease testing system using shared diagnostic platforms and centralized molecular laboratories to test multiple conditions, including TB and HIV, from a single specimen pipeline. Speaking at APAC-IRIDS 2026 in Bangkok, Dr. Rugaiya Calapis urged moving beyond disease-specific testing toward a common referral network, electronic result transmission, and a one-stop clinic experience that reduces missed visits, transport costs, and delays. A Philippine health economics study found that a centralized high-throughput strategy could correctly diagnose about 940 additional TB patients annually and identify over 13,000 additional drug-resistant TB cases, though upfront costs rise; overall, it is cost-effective by local standards. Implementation requires investments in specimen transport, laboratory information systems, and cross-program coordination, plus sustained domestic funding as international support fluctuates. Calapis notes reliance on international funding; domestic investment must be sustainable to prevent delayed diagnosis if funding wanes.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンの専門家、結核撲滅を加速するため統合的疾病検査を推進
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性感染症（結核・HIV）に関する診断体制改善の政策提言であり、新規異常事象や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威ではないため。
triage.notes: 会議（APAC-IRIDS 2026）はタイ・バンコクで開催されているが、内容の主題はフィリピンにおける結核対策・診断システムの提言であるため、Philippinesのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: বর্ষার জমা জলে হাঁটার পরই মারাত্মক জ্বর ও ইনফেকশন! জানেন লেপ্টোস্পাইরোসিস কী ও কেন ছড়ায়?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Walking through the monsoon's standing water can trigger a severe fever and infection! Do you know what leptospirosis is and why it spreads?
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis outbreaks are rising in Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, and surrounding areas during the monsoon as floodwaters become contaminated with urine from rodents and other animals. Cases include fitness coach Ananda Sujata Barua and 11-year-old Neelu Pital. Transmission occurs when waterlogged streets allow the Leptospira bacteria to enter through skin cuts or abrasions. It is not mosquito-borne. Diagnosis relies on patient exposure history to floodwater and laboratory tests such as PCR, rapid IgM, ELISA, and MAT. Early treatment with doxycycline can cure; delays increase risk of complications, especially in the elderly, pregnant women, diabetics, and those with asthma or chronic lung disease. Prevention includes wearing waterproof boots, washing and drying feet after exposure, and regular foot checks for diabetics. Severe cases may require IV antibiotics, dialysis, or ventilation.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の溜まり水を歩いた後に激しい発熱と感染症！レプトスピラ症とは何か、なぜ広がるのかご存知ですか？
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイ周辺で毎年雨季に発生するレプトスピラ症の啓発・注意喚起記事であり、異常な流行拡大や国際的リスクを示す情報はないが、季節性の公衆衛生課題として経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 毎年モンスーン期にムンバイ周辺で報告される季節性感染症の一般向け啓発記事。具体的な症例数や公的機関の対応情報はなく、国際的拡大リスクも認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 內地新冠按月增兩倍　港專家指北上無礙　人多戴口罩、謹記勤洗手
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland COVID-19 cases have doubled month-on-month; Hong Kong experts say traveling north to the mainland poses no obstacle; many people wear masks and remember to wash their hands frequently.
article.articleSummary: Mainland China reports 79,000 new COVID-19 cases in June, up from 21,900 in May, per the China CDC, with continued emphasis on mask use. Hong Kong travellers north are common; precautions in crowded settings—masking and frequent hand hygiene—are advised. Xu Shuchang, a CUHK respiratory professor and chair of the Hong Kong DH’s Novel Infectious Diseases and Animal Infections Scientific Committee, notes SARS-CoV-2 remains mutating with waves every 6–9 months, and that 79,000 cases in China’s large population is not high. Most infections are mild, resembling upper respiratory infections. Hong Kong will introduce a vaccine targeting current variants in September; eligible individuals are encouraged to vaccinate to travel with confidence. Hong Kong surveillance data show 1,265 confirmed cases from 31 May to 4 July, up from 194 in 26 April–30 May (about a fivefold rise).

triage.headline_ja: 内地の新型コロナ感染者数が月間で2倍に増加　香港の専門家は北上に支障なしと指摘　人混みではマスク着用・手洗い励行を推奨
triage.triage_reason: 中国本土でのCOVID-19感染者数増加は季節的な波の一環であり、専門家も「多くない」「軽症が多い」と述べる想定内の事象で、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 既知のパンデミック（COVID-19）の季節的増加に関する定例サーベイランス報告であり、専門家コメントも「懸念なし」との評価。香港・マカオはChinaに統合。

article.articleHeadline: Die Pest - heute genauso gefährlich wie im Mittelalter
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Plague - as dangerous today as in the Middle Ages.
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis causes plague in three forms: bubonic (via fleas from infected rodents; painful lymph node swelling), septicemic, and pneumonic (droplets/aerosols; human-to-human transmission possible). A patient in Oregon, USA, initially presented flu-like symptoms after a cat bite, deteriorated to coma, and survived, illustrating non-specific early signs. Worldwide, up to about 3,000 cases are reported annually (RKI). Today’s hotspots are the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and Madagascar (250–500 cases/year); the western United States also sees occasional infections. Historically, the medieval outbreak (1347–1353) killed ~25 million and fueled a ~500-year European pandemic. Evidence of Y. pestis exists in 5,500-year-old skeletons, indicating long-standing presence. Bronze Age evolution produced the ymt gene, enabling flea transmission and major outbreaks. Europe has been plague-free since 1945; Korsika last reported cases. Imported/exported cases remain possible given animal reservoirs and travel.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト―今日でも中世と同じくらい危険
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペストの歴史・病理・現状に関する一般解説記事であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。既知の風土病地域（DRC、ウガンダ、マダガスカル）や米国での散発例に言及しているのみで、新たな異常事態や社会的関心の急上昇は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はペストに関する教育的・歴史的解説であり、DRC・ウガンダ・マダガスカルは既知の風土病地域として言及されているのみで新規発生報告ではない。オレゴン州の症例も既知事例として紹介されている。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当するが、新規イベントではないため参考情報として記載。

article.articleHeadline: 暑期出國旅遊劇增 高雄防登革熱祭決戰境外獎勵
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer surge in outbound travel; Kaohsiung dengue fever prevention launches a decisive overseas travel incentive campaign.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, on 2026-07-13 launched a dengue prevention campaign targeting importation during the summer travel peak to Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand, Singapore, Cambodia). The program offers a 500 New Taiwan Dollar voucher to returnees who, within 14 days of return, show symptoms and visit a clinic for rapid testing; asymptomatic travelers are encouraged to self-monitor and may proactively be tested at district health centers under triage, with voucher eligibility upon completion. Pre-travel prevention includes distributing one bottle of mosquito repellent at health centers to students and staff, new residents and their families, and foreign workers before travel. Advice emphasizes wearing light-colored long-sleeve clothing and avoiding mosquito-dense areas. Officials urge travelers to prevent overseas transmission, monitor health after returning, and seek medical care if symptoms arise to protect the community.

triage.headline_ja: 夏の海外旅行急増に伴い、高雄市がデング熱の水際対策として海外旅行者向け奨励キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市による例年の夏季デング熱予防・水際対策キャンペーンの告知であり、異常な感染拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾・高雄市が実施する夏季デング熱予防（水際対策）キャンペーンの告知であり、東南アジア諸国（ベトナム、インドネシア、フィリピン、タイ、シンガポール、カンボジア）は旅行先として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域としての記述ではない。台湾自体も対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to five provinces, with 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths reported. Affected provinces are Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, with Haut-Uele and Tshopo appearing in the national report for the first time, indicating expanded transmission from the epicenter in Ituri. Transmission is linked to contacts and population movements between communities. Authorities report 763 patients currently in isolation or receiving care, and treatment centres operating at 95.1% capacity. triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がDRCの5州に拡大、死者数672人に上る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例1,873人・死者672人に達し、当初の感染地から5州に拡大している重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、医療体制も逼迫しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
