article.articleHeadline: US citizen tests positive for Ebola amid DR Congo outbreak
article.articleSummary: US citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Ebola, confirmed by the US CDC on 13 July 2026, as the country battles its fastest-growing outbreak on record. Africa CDC reports 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths; cases have also been confirmed in neighbouring Uganda. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, which has no approved vaccine or treatment. Response faces challenges from ongoing eastern Congo conflict, attacks on health facilities, and funding shortages. Congolese authorities declared the outbreak on May 15 after weeks of undetected spread; WHO notes early clinical trials of potential therapies. Earlier this month, another American doctor contracted Ebola in Congo and was transferred to Germany for treatment. The CDC is coordinating with the patient’s employer, U.S. agencies, Congolese authorities, and partners to identify close contacts and prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 米国市民、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の中で陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が発生し、1,830症例・648死亡、ウガンダへの越境拡大や米国人・独への感染者搬送も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行で、東部コンゴの紛争や医療施設への攻撃、資金不足が対応を困難にしている。ウガンダ・米国・ドイツへの感染拡大も報告されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: CDC Confirma Novo Caso de Cidadão Norte-Americano Infectado na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: CDC Confirms New Case of a North American Citizen Infected in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: North American citizen employed by a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Ebola virus, Bundibugyo strain, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announced via Reuters. The patient’s case is in the DRC and the CDC is coordinating with the employer, other U.S. agencies, and partners in the DRC to prevent further transmission and identify high‑risk contacts. A U.S. State Department spokesperson said officials are aware and providing support, but declined to share additional details. The latest updates from DRC authorities put the current outbreak at 648 deaths and 1,830 confirmed cases, with 23 new deaths and 38 new infections since Thursday, underscoring ongoing escalation and ranking as the third‑largest Ebola outbreak on record. Context includes June demonstrations in Nanyuki, Kenya, opposing a planned U.S. Ebola quarantine unit at a Kenyan military base, which a Kenyan High Court temporarily suspended.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：CDCがコンゴ民主共和国で感染した北米人の新規症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（648名死亡、1830症例、史上3番目の規模）に加え、米国人感染者の発生と国際的な対応（CDC、米国務省）が確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ケニア（Nanyuki/Laikipia）は米国のエボラ隔離施設計画への抗議デモの文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の感染発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。米国も対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの流行は史上3番目の規模で継続的にエスカレートしており、国際的な人的往来（人道支援従事者の感染）を伴う点で特に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: A luta sem recursos contra o ébola no epicentro do surto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The resource-poor fight against Ebola at the epicenter of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province, Ebola resurged with Rwampara as a focal point. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, the country has logged over 220 deaths and roughly 900 suspected cases, with the World Health Organization declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments, and a case fatality up to around 50%. Resource-poor conditions hinder response: there are no ambulances, forcing transport by motorcycle; a feverish patient (39.7°C) with nasal bleeding arrived at Rwampara hospital and was isolated by staff in full PPE. Aid is hampered by limited equipment and restricted access via Bunia airport. Two Alima tent isolation units were burned by a crowd demanding a body; security forces fired warning shots to disperse the protests. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, underscoring conflict and mistrust that impede containment.

triage.headline_ja: 資源不足の中、エボラ流行の震源地での闘い
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の流行が継続し、220人以上の死亡・PHEIC宣言済みで、ワクチン・治療薬もなく国際的拡大リスクと社会不安（暴動）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: ルワンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文はDRC(Ituri州)のみを流行地として言及しており、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。WHOはPHEICを宣言済みで既にフルRRA対象となっている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Број преминулих од еболе у ДР Конгу достигао 672
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in DR Congo has reached 672.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths as of 13 July 2026. The DRC's Ministry of Communications previously reported 648 deaths. WHO emergencies director Chikwe Ihekweazu said last week that most new Ebola cases in parts of the DRC have no known link to existing patients, indicating the outbreak could be larger than reported; estimates suggest the true scale may be two to four times higher than official data. The report underscores ongoing transmission and challenges in case finding and contact tracing, with implications for public health response.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ死者数、672人に到達
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者672人・確定症例1,873人に達し、多くの新規症例が既知の感染者と関連が不明であることから未報告例を含めた拡大の可能性が高く、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: WHO幹部が既知患者との関連がない新規症例の多さを指摘しており、実際の規模が公式報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性が示唆されている。症例発見・接触者追跡の課題が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Německo přijalo dalšího Američana nakaženého ebolou. V Kongu už zemřelo 672 lidí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany has admitted another American infected with Ebola. In the Congo, 672 people have died.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, Germany admitted another American infected with Ebola contracted in Congo; the health worker arrived in Frankfurt and is in isolation at a university hospital. Earlier in May, Germany had taken in one American, whose wife and four children in Berlin were not infected; another at-risk American was hospitalized in Prague and released in June. In Congo, authorities report 1,873 confirmed Ebola cases and 672 deaths, concentrated in Ituri with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda has 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; France recorded one imported case in June in a doctor returning from Congo. This is the 17th Congo Ebola outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no vaccine or specific treatment exists. Africa CDC notes it as the fastest-growing outbreak; July trials are evaluating MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, alone and in combination. Ebola begins with flu-like symptoms, progressing to hemorrhagic manifestations and organ failure; overall spread risk outside affected areas is deemed low.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ、コンゴでエボラに感染した別の米国人を受け入れ。コンゴでは672人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,873症例・672死亡の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが継続中で、ドイツ・フランス・ウガンダへの国際的な症例輸出が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 感染地域はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州）が主体。ドイツ・フランス・チェコ・ウガンダは輸入症例のみで対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyo変異株による第17次コンゴエボラ流行で、Africa CDCは最速拡大の流行と指摘している。

article.articleHeadline: 지역대학에서 글로벌 보건 리더로···춘해보건대, 인도네시아 결핵관리 협력 강화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From a regional university to a global health leader: Chunhae Health University strengthens cooperation with Indonesia on tuberculosis control.
article.articleSummary: Chunhae Health University’s International Development Cooperation Center, selected for KOICA’s incubation program, completed a field survey in Indonesia (Jakarta and Bogor) to identify tuberculosis control development opportunities. From July 5–10, lead researchers Prof. Kim Yeon-rae (Radiology) and Prof. Kim Yu-mi (Nursing) assessed TB hospitals, Puskesmas, and private clinics, mapping the national TB management system. Discussions with the MoH TB Control Team focused on early diagnosis using chest X-ray and AI-based readers, enhanced infection-control training for healthcare workers, and capacity-building programs. KOICA Indonesia Office was briefed to refine the project plan and future directions. The center aims to deepen international health cooperation with the MoH and partner institutions. Since 2024, the KOICA Global Training Program run by the center has been awarded Best Training Program by Indonesia’s Ministry of Health.

triage.headline_ja: 地域大学からグローバル保健リーダーへ···春海保健大学、インドネシア結核管理協力を強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は大学とインドネシア保健省の結核対策に関する国際協力事業の視察報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の新規発生や流行を報じるものではなく、韓国の大学とインドネシア保健省との研修・協力事業の視察報告である。既知の疾病であるTBに関する定期的な国際協力活動のためシグナルとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Rain Water Disease: বৃষ্টির জমা জল থেকে আক্রান্ত কিডনি, লিভার, ফুসফুস! 'এই' লক্ষণ দেখলেই সতর্ক হন! নোংরা জলে পা দিলেই বাড়িতে ফিরে করুন 'এটা'...নয়তো জটিল রোগে শিয়রে শমন
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain Water Disease: Affected by Standing Rainwater — Kidneys, Liver, and Lungs! Be Alert if You See These Symptoms! If You Step into Dirty Water, Go Home and Do This... Otherwise You Could Be on the Verge of a Serious Illness.
article.articleSummary: Rain Water Disease stems from standing rainwater that creates ideal conditions for fungi and bacteria, leading to elevated skin infections. In India, the monsoon, though delayed, is now in full swing, with persistent rains causing floods and waterlogging across several states. Floodwaters are often contaminated with animal waste, human feces, industrial pollutants, and other pathogens, increasing the risk of serious infections. The article notes that exposure to dirty water can threaten health, with skin infections highlighted as a common consequence. Dr. Aashish Nandi, head of the Emergency Department at Ruby Hospital Clinic, outlines five immediate steps to take after returning home to protect health. The piece underscores vigilance for symptoms; as the title suggests, infections could potentially involve organs such as the kidneys, liver, and lungs if they progress.

triage.headline_ja: 雨水による病気：溜まった雨水で腎臓・肝臓・肺が侵される！この症状が見られたら要注意！汚れた水に足を踏み入れたら家に帰ってすぐに『これ』をしないと、深刻な病気に陥る恐れ
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、モンスーン期の一般的な健康啓発・注意喚起記事であり、具体的な症例数や公衆衛生上の異常事態は示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はレプトスピラ症等の具体的疾患名を挙げず、モンスーン季の水系感染症一般に関する健康アドバイス記事。具体的な発生報告・症例数の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 攻坚"超级细菌" 成都企业研发疫苗迎来关键突破
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tackling the 'Superbug': Chengdu-based company developing a vaccine has ushered in a key breakthrough.
article.articleSummary: Chengdu-based OLIN Biotech, collaborating with the PLA Army Medical University, announced that its recombinant Staphylococcus aureus vaccine (Escherichia coli) in Phase III has completed unblinding. The trial achieved 73.25% protection, surpassing the 60% efficacy target. Antibody responses peaked 14 days after the first dose, plateaued by day 42, and remained elevated through day 180, indicating strong immunogenicity and favorable safety. S. aureus is among the most dangerous hospital pathogens, causing septicemia, osteomyelitis, pneumonia, endocarditis, and toxic shock; the WHO lists it on a global high-risk, antibiotic-resistant bacteria list. The Lancet notes hospital infections contribute to over 1.1 million deaths annually. Globally, no S. aureus vaccine is approved. OLIN’s multi-antigen vaccine leverages a full-chain vaccine platform with domestic production lines, aiming to file for drug registration by end-2026 and move toward commercialization; HK listing could enable an A+H dual listing.

triage.headline_ja: 「スーパーバグ」攻略へ 成都企業のワクチン開発が重要な突破口を迎える
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は黄色ブドウ球菌ワクチンの臨床試験成功を報じる企業発表であり、感染症の発生・アウトブレイクに関する情報ではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 疾患名にE. coliとあるが、記事内容は黄色ブドウ球菌（S. aureus）ワクチンの開発進捗に関する報道であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: China Reports Summer Surge in COVID Cases
article.articleSummary: China reported a summer surge in COVID-19 with 79,000 confirmed cases in June 2026, up from 21,861 in May, per the China CDC monthly surveillance. There were 130 severe cases and one COVID-related death involving a patient with underlying medical conditions. Omicron subvariant NB.1.8.1 and its descendants accounted for almost all sequenced cases nationwide, with no evidence of a new variant posing additional risk. The rise appears driven by waning population immunity rather than a more dangerous strain. Unlike influenza, COVID-19 lacks a predictable seasonal pattern, though spending more time in air-conditioned indoor spaces during summer may increase transmission. Most infections remain mild; symptoms are predominantly upper respiratory—sore throat, cough, runny nose, and low-grade fever. Pneumonia and severe disease are less common, but older adults and those with chronic illnesses remain at greater risk. Precautions include masking in hospitals or crowded public transport, good hand hygiene, and ensuring vulnerable groups stay up to date with vaccinations.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、夏季にCOVID感染者数が急増と報告
triage.triage_reason: 既知のOmicron系統による季節的な感染者数増加であり新規変異株の証拠はないが、感染者数の大幅増加が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる月次サーベイランスに基づく報告。既知のNB.1.8.1系統による増加であり、重症例・死亡例は限定的。新規変異株の懸念はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola sa potvrdila u ďalšieho amerického zdravotníka. V Nemecku ho prevzala špeciálna jednotka
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has been confirmed in another American healthcare worker. In Germany, a special unit took him in.
article.articleSummary: Two American healthcare workers have been affected by Ebola from the Congo, with the latest confirmed case in Germany. A second American infected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo was transported by an isolation unit to University Hospital Frankfurt and is reported stable. Germany had previously admitted an Ebola patient in May; another American with exposure was hospitalized in Prague, and a Berlin hospital later released all of them without infection. In Congo, authorities tallied 1,873 confirmed Ebola cases and 672 deaths amid the mid-May outbreak that Uganda reports 20 cases and two deaths; France also recorded a June imported case. Ebola symptoms begin like flu and progress to bleeding and organ failure. The Bundibugyo variant currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. ECDC and WHO consider spillover risk outside affected areas to be low.

triage.headline_ja: 別の米国人医療従事者がエボラ陽性と確認。ドイツで特殊部隊が引き渡しを担当
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,873例・672人死亡に達する進行中のエボラ流行があり、複数の輸入症例（米国人医療従事者、ドイツ・プラハ・フランスへの搬送）が国際的拡大を示しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例（20例、2死亡）も報告されているが、ウガンダは本トリアージの対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ドイツ・プラハ・フランス・米国は輸入症例の受け入れ国であり、発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国が主体。ボンディブギョ変異株にはワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点が懸念材料。ECDC/WHOは流行地域外へのスピルオーバーリスクを低いと評価している。

article.articleHeadline: Německo přijalo dalšího Američana, který se v Kongu nakazil ebolou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany has admitted another American who contracted Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Germany has admitted another American who contracted Ebola in Congo, according to the health ministry. The patient, a healthcare worker, is under care at a university hospital in Frankfurt am Main after arriving at the city’s international airport and being transported by isolation ambulance. Germany had already admitted one American with Ebola in May, and at that time another man with suspected infection was hospitalized in the Czech Republic. The U.S. CDC had previously confirmed infection in another American who worked for a humanitarian organization in Congo. Tests have been positive for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, which is currently circulating in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ、コンゴでエボラウイルスに感染した別の米国人を受け入れ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で流行中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が複数の医療従事者を通じて国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 感染源はコンゴ民主共和国での流行。ドイツ・米国・チェコは搬送・治療先であり発生地域ではないため対象国リストから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Weiterer mit Ebola infizierter Mensch in Deutschland: Ärzte kämpfen um Leben
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another person infected with Ebola in Germany: doctors fight for their lives.
article.articleSummary: A second U.S. citizen infected with Ebola has been flown to Germany for treatment, two months after the first Ebola patient arrived. The individual landed overnight at Frankfurt Airport and was taken to University Hospital Frankfurt (Universitätsklinikum Frankfurt). The CDC confirmed the patient, a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. The patient shows Ebola-related symptoms, transport was smooth, and the condition is stable. Ebola is highly infectious and transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids. In the Congo, where the two U.S. doctors worked, the Bundibugyo variant outbreak is difficult to contain. There is no vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola. The case represents an imported/exported incident linked to an ongoing Congo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツでエボラ感染者がさらに1人確認：医師団が救命に奮闘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のブンディブギョ株エボラアウトブレイクに関連し、感染者がドイツへ国際搬送される事例が2例目発生。国際的拡大及び公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 感染源はコンゴ民主共和国におけるブンディブギョ株エボラのアウトブレイクであり、ドイツ・米国は治療搬送先に過ぎないため対象国から除外。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点が管理可能性のリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола в Германия: Още един заразен американец пристигна по спешност за лечение
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Germany: Another Ebola-infected American arrived urgently for treatment.
article.articleSummary: Second American with Bundibugyo Ebola virus arrived in Germany for treatment, overnight at Frankfurt am Main airport and was taken to a university clinic. The patient, an American humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo, tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola, a variant without a vaccine or standard therapy. Less than two months earlier, the first American physician arrived in Germany on May 20 and was treated at Berlin’s Charité; after about two weeks he survived. His wife and four children, high-risk contacts, were admitted to Charité but asymptomatic and quarantined separately. Congo faces a severe outbreak with about 650 confirmed deaths and at least 1,830 infections. The 2014–2015 West Africa epidemic saw over 11,000 deaths. Germany uses specialized isolation units; three Ebola patients were previously brought to Germany, including a UN worker treated in Leipzig who did not survive.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツでエボラ出血熱：緊急治療のためさらに1人のアメリカ人感染者が到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で650人以上の死者を出す深刻なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続しており、国際的な患者搬送も発生しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はドイツでの治療事例だが、感染源・流行の実態はコンゴ民主共和国（ブンディブギョ株エボラ、約650人死亡・1,830人感染）にある。ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 亞 일부 지역 코로나 재확산 조짐···印 남동부서 2명 사망 - 투데이코리아
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Signs of a COVID-19 resurgence in some parts of Asia... Two dead in Southeast India - Today Korea
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19 deaths were reported in YSR Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh, India, as authorities tighten measures amid rising cases; eight active infections were reported. A 52-year-old man, with fever and cough, tested positive and died at Christian Medical College Hospital, Vellore, Tamil Nadu; a 43-year-old man with comorbidities died after admission to a government hospital ICU. Contact tracing expanded, with about 40 samples collected; 18 negative, others pending. The state government ordered mask use in crowded places, isolation for suspected cases, testing of contacts, and movement of positives to isolation wards. Andhra Pradesh issued a statewide alert to bolster surveillance, testing, reporting, and hospital infection control. In China, June's new confirmed cases reached about 79,000 across 31 provinces, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (in a patient with underlying conditions). Omicron remains dominant, NB.1.8.1 and sublineages; officials cite small June–August peaks but no large outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: アジアの一部地域でコロナ再拡大の兆し…インド南東部で2人死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド・アンドラプラデーシュ州およびタミルナードゥ州でCOVID-19による死亡例が報告され、州政府が警戒を強化しているが、症例数・重症度は限定的で国際的な拡大やIHR基準への該当は認められないため、続報の監視が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既存の流行病であり、季節的な再拡大の一環とみられる。インドでは州レベルでの対応強化、中国では全国的な症例増加が報告されているが、いずれも重症度・死亡率は低水準。今後の症例数推移や新変異株(NB.1.8.1)の拡大動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo eleva a 702 el número de muertos y a 1.926 los casos confirmados de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo raises the death toll to 702 and the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 1,926.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases and 702 deaths as of July 11, with a 36.4% fatality rate. Ituri remains the epicenter since May 15, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. As of July 11, 753 patients are in isolation or hospitalized and 318 have recovered; contact tracing stands at 78.3%. Investigations continue in Tshopo and Haut-Uele, many recent cases and deaths imported from Ituri. Ituri accounts for 90.9% of cases and 86.2% of deaths. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases, including 15 imported from the DRC, and 2 deaths. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, with a 30–50% fatality rate and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO classified the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; it ranks as the third-worst Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の死者数を702人、確定症例数を1,926人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICと宣言した大規模エボラアウトブレイクで、致死率36.4%、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例（うち15例はDRCからの輸入例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは2026年5月17日に本アウトブレイクをPHEICと宣言し、史上3番目に深刻なエボラアウトブレイクとされる。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு அச்சுறுத்தல் : முன்பள்ளி மாணவர்கள் தொடர்பில் வெளியான அறிவிப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Threat: Notice Issued Regarding Preschool Students.
article.articleSummary: Dengue threat prompts a protective notice for preschool students. Health authorities report ongoing dengue risk from Aedes mosquitoes and urge preventive measures in early education settings. Minister Sarojha Sawithri Polraj stated that preschool children should wear clothing that fully covers arms and legs to reduce mosquito bites. This guidance follows a recent Education Ministry allowance for school students to attend dressed in concealing clothing as a dengue preventive measure; the minister said the same precautions should extend to preschoolers. To reinforce protection, parents are advised to use safe dengue repellents where appropriate and to implement all feasible precautions to shield children from mosquitoes. The announcement coincides with National Children’s Week and was made during a Government Information Department media briefing today, 13 July 2026. Dengue risk in educational institutions remains a concern, with the next two weeks deemed especially critical for containment.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の脅威：就学前児童の服装に関する通達が発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱に対する予防的な服装ガイダンスに関する通常の公衆衛生広報であり、症例数増加や異常な流行状況を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事はタミル語で、大臣名（Sarojha Sawithri Polraj）や『Government Information Department』という表現、National Children's Weekへの言及から、実際の発生国はインドではなくスリランカである可能性が高い。スリランカは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。BluedotのIndia判定は誤りの可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का प्रकोप बढ़ा: पांच प्रांतों के 1,873 संक्रमित, 672 की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo worsens: 1,873 infected in five provinces, 672 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo worsens, now affecting five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. A total of 1,873 cases and 672 deaths have been reported through Friday. About 763 patients are in isolation or hospital care, with 95.1% bed occupancy; 306 have recovered, and 299 are suspected, including 91 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak was officially declared on May 15. A U.S. humanitarian worker involved in outbreak response tested positive, raising frontline safety concerns as teams conduct contact tracing and transmission-chain work. Africa CDC reports ongoing epidemiological investigations, contact tracing, and risk assessment. The Africa Union’s public health agency notes at least 112 health workers infected and 35 deaths in the DRC to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行悪化：5州で1,873人感染、672人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大の懸念）に該当し、5州への拡大・高い致死率・医療従事者感染・米国人道支援者の感染例など社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行が5月15日に正式宣言され、5州（イツリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ、ツショポ）に拡大。医療従事者112人感染・35人死亡、米国人道支援従事者の陽性事例も報告されており、国際的な対応・支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ألمانيا تستقبل ثاني مواطن أمريكي مصاب بإيبولا لتلقي العلاج - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany receives the second American Ebola patient for treatment
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, Germany has transferred a second American citizen infected with Ebola to a Frankfurt university hospital for treatment, about two months after the first American patient arrived. The individual arrived at Frankfurt Airport overnight and was moved to the hospital. The CDC identified the patient as an American humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo and confirmed infection with the Bundibugyo strain, the lineage currently circulating in DRC. Gender was not disclosed. Ebola is a highly contagious, potentially fatal disease transmitted through direct contact with infected people or body fluids. The DRC outbreak remains hard to contain, partly due to the lack of a vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. The first American patient, a doctor, arrived in May and was treated at Charité University Hospital in Berlin, discharged after about two weeks. In DRC, roughly 650 confirmed deaths and at least 1,830 cases.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ、エボラ感染の2人目の米国人患者を治療のため受け入れ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株、約650人死亡・1830症例）に対し、ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在せず、感染者の国際搬送が発生しているため、IHR基準複数該当・WPRO基準複数該当でフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツでの患者受け入れが主題だが、実際のアウトブレイク発生源はDRCであるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ドイツ・米国は対象国リスト外のため除外。ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・特異的治療がなく、致死率・拡大リスクが高い点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: تفشٍّ بلا لقاح وسط النزاعات... لماذا يصعب احتواء الإيبولا في الكونغو وأوغندا؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An outbreak without a vaccine amid conflicts... Why is Ebola hard to contain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda?
article.articleSummary: On May 15, 2026, an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, faces challenges from conflict. Unlike earlier DR Congo outbreaks, this strain has no licensed vaccines or approved treatments, and diagnosis depends on laboratory tests with limited reach in affected areas. As of July 6, 2026, DRC reported 1,708 confirmed infections, 580 deaths, and 280 recoveries. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Africa CDC issued a continental health emergency; and the US CDC raised its response to Level 1 on June 26. MSF runs treatment centers in Ituri, North and South Kivu (843 admissions, 357 confirmed, 116 recoveries, >430 beds), with key centers in Mangbawulo and Bunia. In Uganda, a 32-bed unit in Kampala and a 14-bed facility in Bwera were reactivated, with health-worker training. The response stresses preserving essential health services alongside Ebola efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンなき流行、紛争の中で… なぜコンゴとウガンダでエボラの封じ込めが困難なのか?
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言し、DRCで1,708例・580人死亡という大規模流行かつワクチン・承認治療薬がない特殊株であり、紛争地域での対応困難や国際拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOのPHEIC宣言、Africa CDCの大陸的緊急事態宣言、米CDCのレベル1対応など国際的関心が非常に高い事案。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス株という点も特筆すべき異常性。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का प्रकोप बढ़ा: पांच प्रांतों के 1,873 संक्रमित, 672 की मौत - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo intensifies: 1,873 infected, 672 dead across five provinces - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has intensified, with 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths across five provinces as of the latest report. The provinces most affected are Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Shopo (Tsopo); Haut-Uele and Shopo are newly included in the national status report. Transmission appears linked to movement from the outbreak epicenter in Ituri. Currently, 763 patients are in isolation or hospital care, with bed occupancy at 95.1%. So far, 306 patients have recovered; 299 suspected cases have been identified, including 91 deaths among suspected. The Bundibugyo outbreak was officially declared on 15 May. A US humanitarian worker contracted the virus amid response activities, raising concerns for health-care workers' safety. The Africa CDC notes ongoing investigation, contact tracing, and risk assessment; at least 112 health workers have been infected, 35 of whom have died.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行拡大：5州で1,873人感染、672人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が複数州に拡大し、医療従事者感染や病床逼迫など公衆衛生上深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染の懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ（Bundibugyo species）流行に関するもの。医療従事者112人感染、35人死亡、米国人援助者の感染も報告あり、病床占有率95.1%と医療体制逼迫が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Zweiter US-Patient in Deutschland behandelt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Second U.S. patient treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: Second U.S. patient with Bundibugyo Ebola virus is being treated in Germany after a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo tested positive. University Medical Center Frankfurt reports the patient has Ebola-like symptoms and remains in a specialized high-containment isolation unit; transport was smooth and the patient is stable. Bundibugyo Ebola has no vaccine or specific therapy. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids. Germany maintains dedicated isolation facilities and says there is no risk to the public. The first U.S. physician treated in Germany (Berlin Charité) survived after a life-threatening course; his wife and four children were quarantined as high-risk contacts. In Congo, 702 deaths and 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases; 318 recovered; 753 in care. End-June saw a Bundibugyo case detected in Europe (France) linked to a returnee from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：2人目の米国人患者がドイツで治療中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱（死亡702人、確定症例1926人）が既に欧州（ドイツ、フランス）へ複数回国際的に波及しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 感染源となっているのはDRCでの大規模アウトブレイクであり、ドイツ・米国・フランスは輸入症例の治療地であるため対象国リストにはDRCのみを含めた。国際的な人道支援従事者を通じた越境感染事例であり、続報でのDRCの流行状況・国際対応の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Second Ebola-infected US citizen flown to Germany for treatment
article.articleSummary: Second US citizen infected with Ebola has been flown to Germany for treatment, landing at Frankfurt and admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital's high-security isolation unit. The patient, a US citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo, tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain, currently circulating in DRC. He is symptomatic but in stable condition; transport and isolation are designed to prevent public or patient exposure. The first US patient arrived in May in Berlin and was discharged after about two weeks; his wife and four children were quarantined as high-risk contacts but remained asymptomatic. The Bundibugyo strain was detected in Europe for the first time in late June in a humanitarian doctor returning from eastern Congo who tested positive in France and was discharged in July. Congo reports about 650 deaths and at least 1,830 infections; no vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 2人目のエボラ感染米国人、治療のためドイツへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で流行中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が国際的に拡大し、米国人感染者が2人相次いでドイツへ医療搬送されるなど、国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生上の影響が認められる。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行がドイツ・フランス・米国人感染者を通じて国際的に波及。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在せず、致死率も高いことから継続的なモニタリングとフルRRAが必要。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: 18.318 Warga Positif, Eliminasi Malaria di Keerom Terbentur Kejenuhan Warga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 18,318 Residents Test Positive, Malaria Elimination in Keerom Hampered by Public Fatigue
article.articleSummary: Malaria elimination in Keerom Regency, Papua Province remains hampered by public fatigue. In 2026, the Health Office targets screening 542,700 residents, but by June only 108,732 had been screened, with 18,318 testing positive. In 2025, about 48,733 malaria cases were detected across Puskesmas, Kwaingga Hospital, clinics, and malaria cadres. Key drivers include behavioral and environmental risk factors, notably unclean surroundings both inside and outside homes, and inadequate treatment completion. Keerom is characterized by extensive standing water, sustaining numerous mosquito larvae. The district has rolled out the “Temukan, Obati dan Kendalikan” (Find, Treat, and Control) approach through Puskesmas Arso 3, Arso Barat, Arso Kota, and Ywan. Authorities report difficulty sustaining testing as residents view malaria as routine and grow weary of repeated screenings, hindering progress toward the 2026 elimination target.

triage.headline_ja: 18,318人が陽性、ケーロムのマラリア排除計画は住民の疲労感により停滞
triage.triage_reason: パプア州ケーロム県における既知の風土病マラリアの排除プログラムに関する定例報告であり、新規性や異常性、社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: パプアニューギニアは発生地域として付与されているが、記事の主題はインドネシア・パプア州ケーロム県であるため、Indonesiaのみをverified_locationsに含めた。マラリアはこの地域で風土病化しており、記事は地域保健当局による既存の排除プログラムの進捗と課題（住民の検査疲れ）に関する定例報告である。

article.articleHeadline: 这种蚊媒传染病可致淋巴水肿，我国已消除，出国旅行仍需警惕
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lymphatic filariasis, a mosquito-borne infectious disease that can cause lymphedema; China has eliminated it, but travelers abroad should remain vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Lymphatic filariasis, a mosquito-borne parasitic disease caused by Brugia malayi, Brugia timori, and Wuchereria bancrofti, can lead to lymphedema and elephantiasis; early infection can be asymptomatic, with later signs including limb swelling, skin thickening, lymphatic inflammation, fever, or lymphadenitis. China has eliminated lymphatic filariasis as a public health problem (achieved by 2007), but global transmission persists in Africa, South Asia, Southeast Asia, Western Pacific islands, the Caribbean, and parts of South America, necessitating ongoing preventive chemotherapy, vector control, and surveillance. Travelers and workers entering or residing in endemic areas face infection risk, especially with prolonged exposure; prevention includes repellents, long sleeves/pants, and accommodations with screens, air conditioning, or nets. Diagnosis combines travel history with nocturnal microfilariae examination, serology, molecular tests, and imaging. Emphasizes continued vigilance for imported cases and vector monitoring to sustain China’s elimination gains.

triage.headline_ja: この蚊媒介感染症はリンパ浮腫を引き起こす可能性がある、中国では既に排除されているが、海外渡航時には引き続き注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: 中国はリンパ系フィラリア症を既に排除しており、本記事は一般的な啓発・注意喚起情報であって新規の発生や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は中国国内での一般啓発記事であり、特定の発生国における新規事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。発生地域として付与された中国・米国・アフリカ等は主題となる特定の発生国ではなく、対象国リストに該当する具体的な発生事例は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠異常？中國6月突爆7.9萬例 疾管署：台灣近二周也快速上升 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 Anomaly? China Surges to 79,000 Cases in June; Taiwan CDC: Taiwan Has Also Rapidly Risen in the Past Two Weeks | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurgence reported in China and Taiwan as of 2026-07-13. China registered 79,000 new cases in June, with 130 severe cases; yearly totals through end-June reach about 180,000, still far below last year’s 1.05 million. Monthly cases rose from over 20,000 (Mar–May) to 79,000 in June. Taiwan’s CDC notes a rapid rise over the past two weeks, with travel season increasing transmission risk. Public health measures emphasize vaccination: free COVID-19 vaccines are available nationwide to residents aged six months and older through July 31, 2026 (180 days). Antiviral stockpiles include 110,000 courses of oral antivirals and 150,000 doses of remdesivir, distributed by county health bureaus. High-risk groups (65+, pregnant, chronic disease or immunocompromised) should seek prompt medical evaluation for antiviral therapy if symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ異常？中国6月に7.9万例急増 疾病管理署：台湾も近2週間で急速に上昇
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な感染増加であり、既存の管理体制（ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬の備蓄と配布）で対応可能。中国の年間累計も前年より大幅に少なく、新規性・異常性は乏しい。
triage.notes: 台湾（Taiwan）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。COVID-19は既知の疾患で季節的増加のパターンとみられ、重症化率も低い（130/79000）。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Monsoon Alert: SoBo Tops Dengue Hotspots, Malaria Cases Increase
article.articleSummary: Monsoon rains in Mumbai have intensified; South Mumbai is the dengue hotspot, with D Ward reporting 15 confirmed dengue cases (Malabar Hill, Walkeshwar, Cumballa Hill, Tardeo, Grant Road, Girgaon). C Ward 9; E Ward 8; B Ward 3; A Ward: 0 confirmed, 3 suspected. Malaria is highest in E Ward with 64 cases; D Ward 22; C Ward 19; A Ward 17; B Ward 9. Breeding sites: Anopheles – E 722, D 251, C 236, A 176, B 160; Aedes – E 1,237, A 1,031, C 811, D 405, B 316. D Ward's dengue burden outstrips higher Aedes site counts, suggesting other factors like surveillance and early detection matter. BMC launched anti-mosquito campaign: anti-larval treatment, fogging, breeding-site elimination, inspections, and door-to-door surveys. Public urged to prevent water stagnation and seek early care for dengue or malaria. June also saw gastroenteritis 34 and typhoid 9 in E Ward; hepatitis/leptospirosis not rising.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ・モンスーン警報：南ムンバイがデング熱ホットスポットの首位、マラリア症例も増加
triage.triage_reason: 毎年のモンスーン季節性のデング熱・マラリア発生報告であり、規模も局地的・管理下にあるが、症例数の推移は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節の毎年の疾病サーベイランス報告。BMCが既に対策（防蚊活動、幼虫駆除、啓発）を実施中で、地域行政のみで管理可能なレベル。

article.articleHeadline: Weiterer amerikanischer Ebola-Patient jetzt in Deutschland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another American Ebola patient is now in Germany.
article.articleSummary: Second United States citizen infected with Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo is now being treated in Germany, with care managed by a different isolation unit than the first patient. The development occurs roughly two months after the arrival of the initial Ebola-stricken American for treatment. The article confirms an additional imported case to Germany, highlighting ongoing cross-border responses to Ebola outbreaks tied to the Congo region. The excerpt does not provide further details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, exact exposure source, or patient outcome.

triage.headline_ja: 別のアメリカ人エボラ患者、現在ドイツで治療中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ出血熱がアメリカ人患者を介して既に国際的に拡大（ドイツへの2例目の輸入例）しており、IHR基準の複数該当が想定されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツでの輸入症例の治療状況を報じているが、感染源であるコンゴ民主共和国のアウトブレイク自体が主題であるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。米国・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Пациент с опасен щам на ебола кацна в Германия посред нощ - Свят -- Новини Стандарт
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient with a dangerous Ebola strain landed in Germany in the middle of the night - World - Standard News
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with a rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain was transported by a special flight to Germany, landing at Frankfurt am Main at night and admitted to an isolation unit at a university hospital. Germany’s Federal Ministry of Health confirmed the case, withholding the patient’s identity. CDC says the patient worked for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Bundibugyo Ebola is circulating. There is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for this strain. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe disease with high mortality. Germany stresses no population risk due to biosafety measures and isolated wards. This is the second American Ebola patient flown to Germany in under two months; the first arrived in May at Charité in Berlin and was discharged after more than two weeks. The Congo outbreak remains severe, with around 650 deaths and over 1,800 infections.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なエボラ株に感染した患者が深夜にドイツへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で稀なブンディブギョ株エボラが流行しており（死者約650人、感染者1800人超）、既に国際搬送事例が2件発生している深刻な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はドイツへの患者搬送だが、根本的な感染源はDRCでの継続的なブンディブギョ株エボラ流行（死者650人、感染者1800人超）。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ワクチン未承認・特異的治療法なしの点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha On High Alert As Neighbouring Andhra Reports Covid Cases, Suspected Deaths
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, Odisha has intensified Covid-19 surveillance after reports of eight confirmed cases and two deaths in Andhra Pradesh’s Kadapa district. Odisha Public Health Director Dr. Rabindranath Mishra says testing is amplified and surveillance is intensified across facilities; no positive cases detected in Odisha so far. Andhra Pradesh has deployed rapid response teams, increased local surveillance, and begun contact tracing; the deaths include a 46-year-old man from Masapeta with severe symptoms. Odisha directs bordering districts to heighten screening, ensure prompt testing at district hospitals, and maintain ready isolation facilities. Centre guidance from June 2025 prompts SARI/ILI testing, with positive SARI samples sent for whole-genome sequencing via ICMR. With Rath Yatra in Puri approaching, Covid-like symptom screening will be conducted at the festival.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州、隣接するアンドラ・プラデシュ州でのコロナ感染例・死亡疑い報告を受け厳戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: アンドラ・プラデシュ州で少数のCOVID-19症例・死亡が確認され、隣接オディシャ州が監視強化を実施しているが、変異株の有無や感染拡大規模など情報が限定的であり、既存の対応体制内で管理されている段階のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: アンドラ・プラデシュ州カダパ県で8例確認・2名死亡と報告されているが、変異株情報や重症度の詳細は不明。ラート・ヤートラ祭りでの人流増加に伴う監視強化が実施されており、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का प्रकोप बढ़ा पांच प्रांतों के 1,873 संक्रमित, 672 की मौत | DR Congo reports Ebola cases in five provinces, caseload nears 1,900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo intensifies; 1,873 infected in five provinces, 672 dead | DR Congo reports Ebola cases in five provinces, caseload nears 1,900.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,873 cases and 672 deaths across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Infections in the latter two provinces are linked to movement from the outbreak center in Ituri. There are 763 patients in isolation or receiving care, with bed occupancy at 95.1%. Recoveries total 306; 299 suspected cases include 91 deaths. The outbreak was officially declared on 15 May. The Africa CDC notes heightened risk to health workers after an American humanitarian worker was infected, prompting intensified contact tracing and investigations. African Union health data report at least 112 health workers infected and 35 deaths among healthcare personnel.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行拡大、5州で感染者1,873人、死者672人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRC5州に拡大し、感染者・死者数が急増、医療従事者感染も多数発生しており国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 病床占有率95.1%、医療従事者112人感染・35人死亡、外国人人道支援者の感染も確認されており、国際的な支援ニーズと拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uele : face à la menace d'Ebola, le gouverneur Jean Bakomito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haut-Uele: Facing the Ebola Threat, Governor Jean Bakomito.
article.articleSummary: Seven laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease deaths attributed to the Bundibugyo strain have been reported in the Wamba health zone of Haut-Uele, with confirmation from the INRB laboratories in Kinshasa and Bunia on 9 July 2026. In response, Governor Jean Bakomito Gambu urged calm and collective responsibility on 10 July, noting additional suspect alerts in the Pawa and Bomokandi health zones and the city of Isiro. Public health measures focus on breaking transmission: avoid physical contact with the sick, suspected, or deceased; wash hands regularly with clean water and soap or use hydroalcoholic gel. Authorities warn against rumors and call residents to rely on official communications. Health authorities continue surveillance of reported alerts, and response teams remain mobilized to contain spread. The governor appealed for a province-wide mobilization to support Ebola containment efforts in Haut-Uele.

triage.headline_ja: オートウエレ州:エボラの脅威に直面し、ジャン・バコミト州知事が呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: オートウエレ州ワンバ保健区でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）による検査確定死亡7例が報告され、複数保健区に疑い例が拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 検査確定死亡7例（ブンディブギョ株）に加え、パワ、ボモカンディ保健区およびイジロ市で疑い例あり。州知事が州全体の動員を呼びかけており、公衆衛生対応が継続中。渡航・貿易制限や外部支援要請の有無については記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 霹骨痛热症病例增27.2%　西华尼申拟赴槟取经防疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Perak dengue fever cases up 27.2%; Xihuani Shen plans to travel to Penang to seek epidemic-prevention insights.
article.articleSummary: Perak dengue fever cases rose 27.2% year-on-year to 1,425 as of July 9, 2026, with one death from Muallim District. Nationally, Malaysia reports 42,848 dengue cases and 34 deaths, up 34.8% and 78.9% respectively from the previous year. Penang has 724 cases and one death, down 30.9% year-on-year; Negeri Sembilan records 2,379 cases (up 13.2%) with no deaths this year. In Perak, weekly data through July 4 (Week 26) show 1,387 cases, rising to 1,425 by July 9; the Kinta District nearly doubled from 490 to 934. Other districts declined (Larut, Matang & Selama 176→89; Muallim 64→45; Batang Padang 19→15; Bagan Datoh 22→14). There are 11 hotspot sites; Manjung and Kampar together account for 58 cases (~46% of hotspots). Measures include indoor residual spraying, improved mosquito traps, enforcement, and community cleanup; some residents refuse entry, which is prosecutable. Datuk Xi Hua Ni Shen plans to visit Penang to learn prevention strategies amid drought forecasts.

triage.headline_ja: ペラ州のデング熱症例が27.2%増加、シイファニ・シェンがペナン視察で防疫策を学ぶ予定
triage.triage_reason: マレーシア国内のデング熱の季節的増加に関する定例報告であり、対象国リストに含まれず、異常性や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はマレーシア（ペラ州、ペナン州、ヌグリ・スンビラン州）のデング熱流行状況に関する定例報告。地元当局による防疫策強化の記述はあるが、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。発生地域にIndonesiaが含まれているが、これはBluedot APIの位置情報付与の誤り（座標がインドネシアのものと一致）であり、記事の主題はマレーシアであるため対象国には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: LCB Worldwide, GHS fumigate public spaces to prevent disease outbreaks
article.articleSummary: LCB Worldwide Ghana Limited, partnering with the Ghana Health Service, conducted a large-scale fumigation in Accra's Korle Klottey Municipality to mitigate sanitation-related diseases (cholera, malaria, typhoid) during the rainy season. The Saturday exercise targeted markets, transport terminals, and other public spaces as part of the National General Cleaning Exercise following floods, with plans to extend to Odawna and Osu. Although Ghana has not recorded a cholera outbreak, officials emphasize proactive prevention to avoid hospital overload and economic disruption. The initiative aligns with ongoing CSR efforts and past disinfection campaigns, including during the COVID-19 pandemic, and underscores government/public health collaboration to safeguard communities. Municipal leaders urged residents and traders to maintain clean surroundings to complement the fumigation.

triage.headline_ja: LCBワールドワイドとガーナ保健サービス、感染症流行防止のため公共スペースを消毒
triage.triage_reason: コレラの流行は記録されておらず、本記事は雨季に向けた予防的な消毒活動を報じるもので、実際の感染症アウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な消毒活動の報道であり、コレラ・マラリア・腸チフスの実際のアウトブレイクは確認されていない（'Ghana has not recorded a cholera outbreak'と明記）。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠異常？中國6月突爆7.9萬例 疾管署：台灣近二周也快速上升 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 abnormal? China suddenly reports 79,000 cases in June; Taiwan CDC: Taiwan has also seen a rapid rise in the past two weeks - OwlNews.
article.articleSummary: China reports a COVID-19 resurgence, with 79,000 new local cases in June and 130 severe cases; monthly totals rose from 20,000 in March–May to over 79,000 in June, bringing cumulative locally acquired cases to about 180,000 by June 30, 2026, well below last year's 1.05 million. Taiwan also records a sharp uptick in COVID-19 activity over the past two weeks. In Taiwan, weekly outpatient and emergency visits for COVID-19 hovered around 2,000, marking a continued rise for four to five weeks. The Taiwan CDC urges vaccination, with publicly funded vaccines expanded nationwide for residents aged 6 months and older through July 31, 2026. High-risk groups (65+, pregnant, chronic disease, immunocompromised) should seek antiviral therapy promptly if symptomatic. Available supplies include roughly 110,000 courses of oral antivirals and 150,000 vials of Remdesivir, with ongoing discretionary allocation across counties; continued precautions advised during travel season.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ異常事態？中国で6月に7.9万例急増、台湾CDC:台湾でもここ2週間で急速増加
triage.triage_reason: 中国・台湾でCOVID-19感染者数が季節的に増加しているが、重症化率は低く既存の対応体制内で管理されているため、直ちにフルRRAが必要な段階ではないが動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 台湾（Taiwan）も発生地域として挙げられているが、対象国リストに台湾は含まれないため除外。中国本土のCOVID-19動向のみを対象国として記載。季節的な感染再拡大であり、重症例数は比較的少ない（130例/7.9万例）。

article.articleHeadline: US embassy tells Americans to avoid Congo over Ebola after aid worker infected
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to escalate, prompting a US embassy travel warning to avoid all travel to the DRC. A second American aid worker has been infected while responding to the outbreak; a prior case, surgeon Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola in eastern Congo in May and was treated in Germany before returning to the United States. Exposed travelers must quarantine outside the DRC for up to 21 days at their own expense, with government assistance for life-saving care noted. The outbreak now spans five provinces, with Ituri accounting for more than 90% of cases; Tshopo and Haut-Uélé were recently added. Last week, 365 new cases were reported, bringing total confirmed infections to 1,926 and deaths to 702. Health workers infected exceed 112 with 35 deaths; international aid groups are central to the response. CDC says risk to Americans remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 米大使館、援助従事者感染を受けコンゴのエボラ流行につき米国人に渡航回避を勧告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行がDRC5州に拡大し感染者・死者数が急増、医療従事者感染や米大使館の渡航警告など国際的関心・拡大リスクが高いためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは感染者の治療・帰国先として言及されているのみで、発生国はDRCのみ。対象国リストにDRCが含まれるため列挙。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo reports Ebola cases in 5 provinces, caseload nears 1,900
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak in Bundibugyo ebolavirus continues across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, with 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths nationwide. The health authorities’ report covers data through Friday, and Haut-Uele and Tshopo are listed for the first time in the national tally. Investigations show cases in Haut-Uele and Tshopo are epidemiologically linked to the Ituri epicenter through contacts and population movement. Currently, 763 patients are in isolation or in hospital treatment, and bed occupancy in treatment facilities stands at 95.1%. Cumulative recoveries reach 306, while there are 299 suspected cases, including 91 deaths. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was declared on May 15, 2026, underscoring ongoing transmission and the need for continued surveillance and infection control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、5州でエボラ症例を報告、累計症例数は1,900人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内5州に拡大し、致死率も高く、病床占有率95.1%と医療体制が逼迫しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率約35.9%(672/1873)と非常に高く、新たに2州（Haut-Uele, Tshopo）が加わり感染拡大が継続中。病床占有率95.1%で医療キャパシティが逼迫しており、国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 洪水退去防疫不松懈 警惕三类高发传染病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With the floods receding, epidemic prevention must not slacken; be vigilant for three high-incidence infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Post-flood in Nanning, Guangxi, as waters recede, the risk of infectious diseases rises. Three high-incidence categories to watch: 1) Enteric infections from contaminated water/food—acute gastroenteritis, bacterial dysentery, hepatitis A, and hepatitis E—with symptoms of diarrhea, abdominal pain, vomiting, and fever; prevention centers on safe drinking water and food hygiene. 2) Natural-foci vector-borne diseases—urge drainage of standing water and heightened mosquito and rodent control; avoid direct skin contact with floodwater; crowded shelters heighten spread of influenza and other respiratory infections, and contact transmission can cause conjunctivitis. 3) Leptospirosis—floodwater contaminated by animal urine can infect via skin wounds or mucous membranes, causing high fever and severe calf pain; recommendations: do not touch floodwater with broken skin, wear gloves and rubber boots, and rinse exposed skin with clean water and soap after contact. Huang Chaojun, Nanning CDC, emphasizes vigilant prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水退去後も防疫の手を緩めるな、高発生の3種類の感染症に警戒を
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の一般的な感染症予防啓発記事であり、具体的な患者数や集団発生の報告はないが、衛生当局が注意喚起している点は継続監視の対象となる。
triage.notes: 本記事は南寧市CDCによる洪水後の感染症予防に関する一般的な注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や発生報告は含まれていない。実際の患者発生状況について続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi Dini dan Pengobatan Putuskan Penularan Kusta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early Detection and Treatment Stop the Transmission of Leprosy.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health underscores that leprosy, caused by Mycobacterium leprae, is curable and free treatment is available at health facilities. At the National Leprosy Conference 2026 in Jakarta on July 10, 2026, under the theme Accelerating Leprosy Elimination: Indonesia's Commitment, Global Collaboration, officials urged early detection to sharply reduce transmission. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin stressed that leprosy is an infection, not a curse, and diagnosing and treating cases promptly is key to preventing disability. Stigma remains a major barrier, he noted. Yohei Sasakawa, Nippon Foundation honorary chair and WHO goodwill ambassador for leprosy elimination, argued that eliminating stigma must accompany cure efforts. Survivor Syamsul shared experiences of discrimination and urged equal opportunities in education, health care, and work. The MOH called on communities, regional authorities, religious leaders, educators, media, and civil society to combat misconceptions and end discrimination against people affected by leprosy.

triage.headline_ja: 早期発見と治療でハンセン病の感染を断つ
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病撲滅に向けた啓発会議に関する内容であり、新規発生や異常な流行を示すものではないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 会議・啓発活動に関する記事であり、感染症の急性発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠異常？中國6月突爆7.9萬例 疾管署：台灣近二周也快速上升 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 Anomaly? China Suddenly Reports 79,000 Cases in June; Taiwan CDC: Taiwan Has Also Risen Rapidly in the Past Two Weeks - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 activity remains elevated in China and Taiwan as of June 2026. China reports 79,000 new local cases in June, with 130 severe cases; year-to-date through June total local cases exceed 180,000, still far below last year’s roughly 1.05 million. Taiwan’s CDC notes a rapid rise in the past two weeks, with domestic COVID-19 activity increasing and about 2,000 related health-care visits last week after a protracted rise. Taiwan has expanded government-funded vaccines to all residents aged 6 months and older through July 31 to boost protection amid travel season. Antiviral stock is ample: oral antivirals (Beilawei) and (Shuguanxiao) plus 150,000 vials of Remdesivir (injectable) are available, managed by county health bureaus. High-risk groups (65+, pregnant, chronic disease, immunocompromised) are urged to seek prompt care and antiviral treatment if symptomatic; travelers should maintain precautionary measures.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ異常？中国6月に7.9万例が突発増加、台湾疾病管理署：台湾もここ2週間で急増
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的増加であり、重症例は少なく前年より低水準。ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬も十分に確保されており、異常性・深刻性は低いと判断される。
triage.notes: 台湾はBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国は本文の主題国として含めた。COVID-19は既に季節性・地方流行的な疾患として扱われており、抗ウイルス薬供給も十分なため深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: UK begins trials of Ebola vaccine developed in just eight weeks
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 625 deaths and 1,792 lab-confirmed cases, with the outbreak still not under control in a conflict zone with mobile populations. The UK regulator MHRA has approved phase I trials of an Oxford University Ebola vaccine—the first of four to enter clinical testing—developed eight weeks after a public health emergency declared on 17 May. The trial will involve 50 adults aged 18–55 in the UK, with first doses expected within weeks; further trials are planned in Africa with partners in Uganda. The vaccine uses a chimpanzee adenovirus vector carrying a Bundibugyo Ebola gene snippet, designed to trigger immune response without infection. Serum Institute of India is manufacturing about 620,000 doses to standard. Three other vaccines are in development, including Moderna’s mRNA candidate; risk of rare blood clots is discussed but considered manageable. Volunteers will be monitored for a year.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、わずか8週間で開発されたエボラワクチンの治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで625人死亡・1792人感染確定のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが紛争地域で制御不能な状況にあり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクとそれに対する英国でのワクチン治験開始。インドはワクチン製造拠点（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのみで、疾病発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ウガンダは今後の治験実施予定地として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれず、また発生国でもない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient in Frankfurt: Droht Ansteckungsgefahr?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient in Frankfurt: Is there a risk of contagion?
article.articleSummary: Second American infected with Ebola is being treated in Germany, admitted to University Medical Center Frankfurt after arriving at Frankfurt Airport. The patient, a humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, tested positive for the Bundibugyo variant; sex not disclosed. Care is provided in an isolated, secured unit separate from routine operations, with wastewater, waste, and exhaust air managed under heightened safety standards. Ebola transmits by direct contact with bodily fluids, not via casual air; incubation is 2–21 days (avg 6–10). Early symptoms include fever, weakness, and head and muscle pains; later stages can involve vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and internal bleeding. There is no licensed vaccine or standard therapy for Bundibugyo; treatment is supportive. The second US patient in Germany, after a Berlin Charité case in May 2026. Germany operates seven containment centers; public risk remains very low, and no broad avoidance of public spaces is required.

triage.headline_ja: フランクフルトのエボラ患者：感染リスクはあるのか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での感染例がドイツへ輸入され、5月のベルリン症例に続く2例目の輸入事例であるため、国際的拡大や公衆衛生への影響の観点からフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCで人道支援活動中に感染しBundibugyo variantで陽性。ドイツでの治療は輸入症例としての対応であり、DRC国内での流行状況（新規発生数・拡大範囲）については記事内に情報がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس نادر يعاود الظهور ويثير القلق فى الهند بعد تسجيل وفيات بين الأطفال - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A rare virus re-emerges and sparks concern in India after deaths among children were reported - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus, a rare rhabdovirus, has re-emerged in India, prompting Gujarat health authorities to intensify surveillance after three pediatric deaths in recent days. A 6-year-old from Rajasthan died in Himatnagar, Sabarkantha district, following the deaths of two other children aged 3 and 4 in Banaskantha. Several other suspected acute encephalitis syndrome cases are under investigation. Chandipura, first identified in 1965 in Chandipura village, Maharashtra, is mainly transmitted to humans via sandfly bites; ticks may contribute. No antiviral or licensed vaccine exists; management is supportive and early hospitalization critical to survival. Symptoms include abrupt fever, severe headache, vomiting, weakness, altered mental status, seizures; progression can be rapid in children under 5. Diagnosis relies on RT-PCR, serology, or virus isolation; prevention centers on vector control, insect repellents, bed nets, protective clothing, and environmental cleanup.

triage.headline_ja: まれなウイルスがインドで再流行、子どもの死亡例報告を受けて懸念高まる
triage.triage_reason: 希少なチャンディプラウイルス（脳炎症候群）による小児死亡例が複数報告され、ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬もないため公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、IHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介の急性脳炎症候群を引き起こす稀な病原体で、グジャラート州・ラジャスタン州で小児3例の死亡が報告されている。人-人感染の証拠はなく、国際的拡大リスクは現時点で不明。

article.articleHeadline: 醫學會：不排除未來一兩個月新冠病毒活躍程度進一步上升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Medical Association: It does not rule out a further increase in COVID-19 activity in the next one to two months.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's Medical Association says local COVID-19 activity remains relatively low but has shown a slight uptick since May 2026; the last active cycle ended nearly a year ago, and the Association does not rule out a further overall increase in the next one to two months. Vaccination program vaccines are due to expire, with a new batch expected to arrive in Q4 2026; eligible residents should book promptly and complete vaccination before the transition to maintain protection. Seasonal influenza activity in Hong Kong has risen in recent weeks, above baseline, indicating a summer flu season that is expected to persist in coming weeks. High-risk individuals should stay vigilant and maintain good personal and environmental hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 医師会：今後1〜2か月で新型コロナウイルスの活動レベルがさらに上昇する可能性を排除できない
triage.triage_reason: 香港におけるCOVID-19・季節性インフルエンザの活動はやや上昇傾向にあるが、依然低水準であり、通常の季節変動の範囲内で異常性・重篤性・国際的拡大の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 香港の医師会による季節的な注意喚起・ワクチン接種推奨に関する定例的な報告であり、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo: Ebola Outbreak Spreads to Provinces Haut-Uele and Tshopo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces as of 2026-07-13, per the National Institute of Public Health. The rare Bundibugyo strain now affects five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Investigations indicate that all detected cases in Haut-Uele and Tshopo are primarily imported from Niania in Ituri, yet these two provinces should be considered an epidemic zone. The outbreak has killed hundreds in the eastern provinces Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The report provides no precise case or death counts, nor details on symptoms or laboratory confirmation. The situation highlights ongoing spread and the need for expanded surveillance and response across eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ出血熱の流行、オートウエレ州とチョポ州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がコンゴ民主共和国の複数州にまたがり拡大しており、既に多数の死者が出ている重大な公衆衛生事案であるため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAが必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事にはマリの地名（Koulikoro、Niania）も含まれるが、サマリー上ではNianiaはイトゥリ州内の地名として言及されており、マリでの発生ではないため対象外。具体的な症例数・死者数は本記事には記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: وفاة 672 بإيبولا وارتفاع الإصابات المؤكدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: 672 Ebola deaths and rising confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reports 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths. As of Sunday, the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to face rising Ebola spread. A second American aid worker has been infected during response efforts, prompting US travel advisories to avoid travel to the DRC, per Bloomberg. The US embassy in Kinshasa issued a health alert on Saturday requiring travelers exposed to Ebola to quarantine outside the Congo for up to 21 days at their own expense. The alert notes the US government will provide life-saving medical care to citizens exposed to the virus but does not specify whether this includes humanitarian workers or medical teams already in the country. This underscores ongoing international concern and response to the outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱で672人死亡、確定症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（確定症例1,873例、死亡672例）が継続しており、米国人援助関係者への感染や渡航勧告発出など国際的懸念が高まっているためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 米国大使館が渡航者への隔離要件・健康警告を発出しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が顕著。致死率も高く(約35.9%)、継続的なモニタリングとフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: CDC confirms Ebola case in American aid worker
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, the CDC confirms a laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola virus infection in a US citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The patient has tested positive for Ebola virus disease; the CDC collaborates with the employing organization, other federal agencies, and DRC partners to prevent further transmission and identify high-risk contacts. A US State Department spokesperson said the agency is aware and providing support to the affected American, though no additional details were disclosed. No information on symptoms, severity, or initial exposure is provided. The response emphasizes containment measures and contact tracing to limit secondary cases, with ongoing coordination between U.S. authorities and DRC health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: CDC、米国人援助従事者のエボラ感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）感染が米国人援助従事者に確認され、国際的な渡航者を介した感染拡大リスクと、既知の高致死率疾患であることからIHR基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。感染者は米国人だが感染発生・曝露はDRC国内であるためDRCを主題国とした。症状の重症度や感染経路の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: La ONU interviene por el ébola: "más que una emergencia de salud pública"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN intervenes in the Ebola crisis: "More than a public health emergency"
article.articleSummary: UN aid chief Tom Fletcher calls for faster action against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ituri remains the epicenter and the virus is spreading to other provinces due to conflict and displacement. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, the Bundibugyo strain has infected more than 1,700 people and caused about 700 deaths in DRC; Uganda reports 20 cases. The crisis is worsened by ongoing conflict, hunger, displacement, weak health systems, and limited care. The UN released up to $60 million in May to accelerate response, while WHO and MONUSCO are supplying medical equipment and building isolation and treatment units. A System-Wide Scale-Up is active and Julien Harneis is deployed to assist containment. Key defenses: surveillance, lab testing, triage, infection prevention/control, and community engagement, with locally led, community-centered approaches. Travel restrictions impede operations; safe access for aid workers and supplies is essential.

triage.headline_ja: 国連がエボラ危機に介入：「公衆衛生上の緊急事態以上のもの」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が1700人以上に感染し約700人が死亡、ウガンダへも拡大しており、国連が緊急介入を行うなど国際的関心・支援が極めて高い重大事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。紛争・避難民問題が感染拡大を助長しており、渡航制限が対応活動の障害となっている。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠肺炎｜本港「新冠＋流感」同時夾擊門診2/3病人已中招　醫生解析確診數字上升3大成因　料高峰期將持續至1時間回落|香港經濟日報 TOPick
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 | In Hong Kong, the 'COVID-19 + Flu' are simultaneously hitting outpatient clinics; two-thirds of patients have already been infected; doctors explain three major factors behind the rise in confirmed cases; the peak period is expected to last about an hour before subsiding | Hong Kong Economic Daily TOPick.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong sees simultaneous COVID-19 and influenza activity in outpatient clinics, with the dominant SARS-CoV-2 NB.1.8.1 variant. Symptoms resemble past seasons: sore throat, cough, fever, fatigue, and runny nose. Rapid tests show about one-third of patients positive for SARS-CoV-2, one-third for influenza, and the rest for rhinovirus, RSV, or other infections. Three drivers of the surge are humidity and crowding plus summer travel increasing transmission, waning immunity after roughly one year, and sharply lower vaccination coverage, including among newborns. High-risk groups include people with chronic conditions (e.g., hypertension, diabetes), the elderly, those with kidney dysfunction, unvaccinated infants, and pregnant women; vaccination should be discussed with a GP. Most infections recover in about two weeks, and the current peak may last 1–2 months before herd immunity reduces cases, with broader decline expected by late September. Preventive measures emphasize hand hygiene and masking in public and home environments, plus isolation if infected.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19｜香港で「新型コロナ＋インフルエンザ」が同時流行、外来患者の3分の2が感染　医師が確診数増加の3大要因を解説　ピーク期は1～2ヶ月続く見込み
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19とインフルエンザの同時流行であり、重症化や医療逼迫の明確な報告はないが、感染者数増加と免疫低下・ワクチン接種率低下が指摘されており動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ流行に関する報道で、香港特別行政区の事例は中国(1814991)に含めた。重症例や死亡数など詳細な公衆衛生影響データは記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 西华尼申拟向槟城取经 加强霹州骨痛热症防控|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Xihua Ni Shen plans to learn from Penang to strengthen dengue prevention and control in Perak
article.articleSummary: Datuk Xihua Ni Shen, Perak’s executive councillor for health, says dengue fever in Perak rose modestly while Penang’s cases dropped 30.9% year-on-year, prompting a visit to Penang to study its control measures. Nationally, 42,848 dengue cases and 34 deaths were reported as of July 9, 2026, up 34.8% and 78.9% respectively from the previous year; Perak has 1,425 cases (up 27.2%) and 1 death in Muallim District. Penang reported 724 cases and 1 death, down from 1,047; Negeri Sembilan recorded 2,379 with no deaths. As of July 4 (week 26), Perak had 1,387 cases (+25.4%) across 11 hotspots, with Manjung and Kampar each on 29 cases (46% of the local total). Kinta District rose from 490 to 934 cases. Indoor Residual Spraying refusals by residents are legally actionable under current laws.

triage.headline_ja: 西華尼申、槟城の経験を学びペラ州のデング熱対策強化へ
triage.triage_reason: マレーシアにおける季節性・地域的なデング熱の増加を報告する定例のサーベイランス記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。また対象国リストにマレーシアは含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事はマレーシア（ペラ州・ペナン州・ネグリ・スンビラン州）の国内デング熱動向と対策に関する内容。インドネシア（Jawa Tengah）は発生地域タグに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず除外。マレーシアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Gia Lai chuyển từ "xử lý dịch" sang "quản trị nguy cơ" sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gia Lai shifts from outbreak response to risk management for dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Gia Lai, Vietnam: July 1–7, 2026, 220 dengue cases were reported, down 80 from the previous week; year-to-date totals 2,532, up 1,531 from 2025. Six outbreaks were detected this week, bringing 2026 total to 157; 40 outbreaks remain active in districts, with hotspots in Chư Păh, Ia Boòng, Ia Púch, Pleiku, Biển Hồ. The province shifts from reactive outbreak control to risk management, prioritizing vector surveillance, early detection, rapid containment, and updated diagnostic and treatment guidelines; essential medicines, IV fluids, and timely referrals for severe cases are emphasized. Public communication and surveillance are expanded. Monitoring will target high-incidence areas, with continued response in Đức Cơ and Ia Nan and collaboration with the Tay Nguyên Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology. Citizens are urged to eliminate standing water, sleep under nets, and seek care for persistent fever or warning signs. First dengue death in 2026 reported in Biển Hồ.

triage.headline_ja: ザーライ省、デング熱対応を『流行対応』から『リスク管理』へ転換
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ザーライ省で例年より症例数が大幅増加（前年同期比+1,531例）し死亡例も発生しているが、デング熱は同地域で毎年流行する風土病であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナム・ザーライ省で季節性・風土病的に発生しており、今回は症例数増加と死亡例1件が報告されているが、省当局は既にリスク管理体制へ移行し外部支援は要請していない。

article.articleHeadline: בית חולים גרמני מטפל בחולה שנדבק באבולה בקונגו - וואלה חדשות
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A German hospital treats a patient who contracted Ebola in Congo - Walla News
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, a Bundibugyo virus variant of Ebola virus disease is being treated at University Hospital Frankfurt after infection in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The German hospital reports the patient arrived in isolation during the night and remains in stable condition. He is fully isolated in a highly secure department separated from the rest of the facility. The case represents an imported Ebola infection from the DRC; no local transmission details are reported. The hospital emphasizes strict isolation and infection-control measures. No information on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or exposure specifics is provided. Ongoing monitoring and contact tracing would be expected in such imported Ebola cases to prevent secondary spread, given the high consequence of Ebola virus disease.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツの病院、コンゴでエボラウイルスに感染した患者を治療 - Walla News
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)由来のエボラウイルス病（ブンディブギョ株）の輸入症例がドイツで確認されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 感染源はDRCであり、輸入症例がドイツ(対象国リスト外)で確認された事例。DRCにおける発生状況（症例数、地域、アウトブレイクの継続性）についての続報を要確認。ブンディブギョ株はエボラの中でも稀な株であり、DRCでの感染源・接触者追跡状況の把握が重要。
