article.articleHeadline: 聖嬰現象助長病媒蚊繁殖　疾管署籲：落實「這些事」防登革熱 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño phenomenon fuels breeding of disease-carrying mosquitoes; the CDC urges: implement these measures to prevent dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: El Niño is forecast to intensify, potentially increasing dengue transmission by speeding mosquito breeding and shortening the virus’s incubation within the mosquito, with higher temperatures and abnormal rainfall expanding breeding sites. After heavy rains, standing water indoors and outdoors creates more mosquito habitats. In Taiwan, 83 dengue cases were confirmed as of July 6, 2026, including 7 locally acquired cases all in Kaohsiung; 76 imported from Southeast and South Asia (Indonesia 21, Maldives 14, Vietnam 11). This year’s total (83) is below 2025’s 91 at the same point. Globally, dengue remains a threat; by May 2026, about 1.44 million cases, mainly in the Americas (Brazil, Bolivia, Colombia), with rising cases in Asia (Vietnam, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Cambodia, Bangladesh, Laos) and multiple circulating serotypes. Preventive measures: remove standing water after rain; practice “巡、倒、清、刷”; wear light-colored long sleeves/pants outdoors and use approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR-3535). Seek medical care for fever and report travel history; inform airport quarantine on return.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョ現象が媒介蚊の繁殖を助長　疾病管理署が呼びかけ：登革熱予防のためこれらの対策を実施せよ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾では今年の登革熱症例数（83例）は前年同期（91例）を下回っており、季節性かつ既知のリスク上昇（エルニーニョ）に関する定例的な公衆衛生広報であり、突発的異常事象とは言えない。ただしベトナム・インドネシア・ブラジル等での症例増加や世界的な血清型多様化は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 台湾（Taiwan）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事の主眼はエルニーニョによる蚊媒介感染症リスク上昇の注意喚起であり、台湾国内の症例は前年より少なく深刻化の兆候は見られない。インドネシア・ベトナム・ブラジルは輸入症例の由来国および世界的流行地として言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو يتوسع إلى 5 مقاطعات والإصابات تتجاوز 1800 حالة - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo expands to five provinces, with cases exceeding 1,800 - Ardu Point
article.articleSummary: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Aout-Owili, and Chobo provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report Ebola virus infections rising to 1,873 confirmed cases, with 672 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak was declared on May 15. Aout-Owili and Chobo are listed in the national report for the first time, with cases linked to the Ituri epicenter. As of the latest data, 763 patients are in isolation or receiving treatment, and treatment-center bed occupancy stands at 95.1%; 306 people have recovered. This update confirms five provinces affected, and ongoing transmission tied to the Ituri outbreak epicenter; no details are provided on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行が5州に拡大、感染者数が1800人を超える - Urdu Point
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC内で5州に拡大し、致死率も高く（672/1873）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内の州拡大のみが言及されており、アンゴラでの発生は確認されないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ДРК сообщила о случаях заражения вирусом Эбола в пяти провинциях, общее число заболевших приблизилось к 1900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC reported Ebola virus infections in five provinces, with the total number of cases approaching 1,900.
article.articleSummary: Laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo total 1,873 across five provinces as of Friday, July 10, 2026, with 672 deaths. Infections are reported in Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, and Tshopo (Chopo). The last two provinces appear in the national tally for the first time and are epidemiologically linked to the Ituri epicenter through contact tracing and population movement. Some 763 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, with hospital bed occupancy at 95.1%. So far, 306 patients have recovered, and 299 suspected Ebola cases have been reported, including 91 deaths among suspected cases. The data come from local health authorities and cover the situation through Friday, July 10, 2026, and were released in Kinshasa on July 13, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRC(コンゴ民主共和国)、5州でエボラウイルス感染例を報告、累計症例数は1900人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州に拡大し、死者672人・病床占有率95.1%と深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 新たにTshopo州とUpper Uele州で感染が確認され、Ituri震源地との疫学的関連が指摘されている。病床占有率95.1%は医療体制逼迫を示す重要指標。

article.articleHeadline: Résurgence de maladies animales au Kasaï : le gouvernement tire la sonnette d'alarme - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reemergence of animal diseases in Kasai: the government sounds the alarm
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo, Grand Kasai region, reports a dangerous deterioration in animal health. In Lusambo territory, Sankuru province, a resurgence of peste des petits ruminants (PPR) has killed 315 goats in five days, decimating livestock and poultry and threatening rural livelihoods. The disease is spreading to neighboring Kasai, Kasai-Central, Kasai-Oriental, and Lomami provinces, raising fears of uncontrolled spread. Concurrently, canine rabies has caused more than 30 human deaths in the affected area. The government demands a coordinated, durable response, including accelerating the second phase of a nationwide epizootic vaccination campaign and boosting prevention and surveillance to protect livestock and human lives. This alert comes as Congo faces its 17th Ebola outbreak in the eastern region, underscoring the need for reinforced prevention and rapid response to health threats, both animal and human.

triage.headline_ja: カサイ地方で動物由来感染症が再燃：政府が警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病により30名以上の人的死亡が発生し、家畜のペスト・デ・プティ・ルミナン（PPR）も複数州に急速拡大しており、政府が緊急対応を求めている。人的被害と異常な拡大傾向からIHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 同記事はDRC東部で進行中の第17次エボラ流行にも言及しているが、これは本イベント（カサイ地方の動物疾患・狂犬病）とは別の流行であり、地理的にも異なる地域のため、今回のverified_locationsには影響しない。狂犬病とPPRの人的・畜産被害の実態把握のため続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: تسجيل 1873 إصابة و672 وفاة بفيروس إيبولا بالكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,873 cases and 672 deaths from the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report 1,873 cases and 672 deaths as of July 13, 2026. The Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the country most affected, with ongoing transmission reflected in the mortality burden. The article provides no further specifics on geographic distribution within the DRC, laboratory confirmation status, exposure sources, or whether cases are imported or exported. There is no detail on symptom profiles, time-to-diagnosis, or response activities. The figures underscore a sustained, high-fatality public health challenge from EVD in Central Africa, signaling the need for continued surveillance and response efforts to interrupt transmission and reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスによる感染1,873例、死亡672例を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による大規模な症例数(1,873)と高い死亡数(672)が報告されており、致死率が高く公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は感染者数・死者数のみを報告しており、地理的分布、検査確定状況、曝露源、対応状況等の詳細情報は不明。continued surveillance and responseの必要性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaudbrud i DR Congo spreder sig til flere provinser
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads to several provinces.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread from the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu to Haut-Uele and Tshopo in the northern part of the country. The total of confirmed Ebola cases has risen to 1,926 with 702 deaths. The national Institute of Public Health says new cases in Haut-Uele and Tshopo are largely imported from Ituri, but authorities deem these two provinces part of an ongoing epidemic area. In total five provinces are now designated as epidemic areas. The situation remains centered in eastern DRC, with cross-provincial transmission prompting expanded surveillance and regional response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、複数州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国東部から北部の複数州へ拡大し、確定症例1,926例・死亡702例に達しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いと判断される。
triage.notes: 致死率約36%と高く、既に5州が流行地域指定されている。国際的な支援や渡航制限の可能性について続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع الإصابات المؤكدة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 1873 إصابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 1,873.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths, according to the latest update cited by Reuters. The previous Friday update reported 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths. The virus is believed to have been spreading for months before officials formally confirmed the first cases on 15 May, suggesting undetected transmission and increasing exposure risk among healthcare workers. Authorities report a critical shortage of basic personal protective equipment, including gloves and masks, hindering response efforts. The figures indicate ongoing transmission and underscore the need for strengthened infection prevention, rapid laboratory confirmation, and comprehensive case tracking. The article does not mention any imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定症例が1,873例に増加
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約36%の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、数ヶ月間の未検知感染とPPE不足が指摘されるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 致死率が非常に高く（約36%）、数ヶ月にわたる未検知の感染拡大とPPE不足が報告されており、医療従事者への感染リスクを含め深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。国際的な症例輸出入は報告されていないが、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha on high alert as two Covid-19 deaths reported in Andhra Pradesh
article.articleSummary: Odisha is on high alert after a rise in Covid-19 cases and two suspected Covid-related deaths reported in neighbouring Andhra Pradesh. The state has reinforced surveillance in border districts and directed CDMOs to heighten vigilance, ensure testing of all suspected cases at district headquarters hospitals, and respond promptly to any signals. Public Health Director Dr. Rabindranath Mishra said no positive Covid-19 cases have been detected in Odisha so far and urged people not to panic. Testing and surveillance continue across healthcare facilities. Ahead of the Rath Yatra festival, which is expected to draw lakhs of devotees, officials will test and treat anyone with Covid-like symptoms as per prescribed Covid-19 protocols. The border-area focus mirrors AP's deaths while Odisha maintains ongoing vigilance to prevent cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州、隣接アンドラプラデシュ州でのCOVID-19による2人の死亡報告を受けて厳戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: アンドラプラデシュ州でのCOVID関連死亡2件を受けオディシャ州が警戒態勢を強化しているが、確定患者は未検出であり、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生上の影響や国際的拡大の兆候はない。ただし大規模宗教祭事（ラート・ヤートラ）を控え人流増加に伴う感染拡大リスクがあるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の感染症であり、現時点でオディシャ州内での確定症例は報告されていない。大規模祭事前の予防的措置としての警戒強化であり、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: German hospital treats US Ebola patient infected in Congo
article.articleSummary: American citizen working for a humanitarian organization, infected with the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital’s isolation unit around 3:00 a.m. local time (01:00 GMT) on Monday. The patient’s condition is stable, and care occurs in a structurally separated, complete isolation unit; authorities say there is no public risk. The U.S. CDC confirmed the positive Congo-wide Ebola test. Congo’s outbreak has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces per the country’s public health institute. In June, a U.S. citizen treated in Berlin after contracting Ebola in Congo was discharged from Charité hospital, underscoring imported/exported-case dynamics in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツの病院、コンゴで感染した米国人エボラ患者を治療
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で拡大中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（1926症例、702死亡）に加え、感染者が国際的に(ドイツへ)搬送されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ドイツ・米国は感染者の搬送先・出身国であり、アウトブレイク発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。CFRが約36%と非常に高く、Haut-Uele・Tshopo州へ拡大している点が特に懸念される。6月にもベルリンへの搬送例があり、国際的な二次拡散リスクが継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : un policier meurt d'Ebola à Kisangani, des ambulances attendues et un nouveau CTE annoncé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: A police officer dies of Ebola in Kisangani, ambulances expected and a new Ebola Treatment Center announced.
article.articleSummary: As of July 12–13, 2026, Ebola remains active in Kisangani, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of Congo. Four imported cases in Lubunga, Mangobo, and Makiso-Kisangani have exposed over 100 contacts, with about 30% already identified. A provisional Ebola Treatment Center at Hôpital du Cinquantenaire has eight beds and recorded the death of a police officer from Nia-Nia after several days of hospitalization. MSF plans a new Ebola Treatment Center in Kisangani, with two football-field-sized plots provided by the governor; construction aimed within three weeks. The Ministry of Health will supply three ambulances; Belgium’s development agency donated one to Makiso-Kisangani. The DSE has two days to identify additional contacts. A river-based surveillance initiative, Fleuve sans Ebola, will protect western provinces. Minister Roger Kamba plans to return in three weeks to review progress.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:キサンガニでエボラにより警察官が死亡、救急車の到着待ちと新たなエボラ治療センターが発表される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の輸入症例が拡大し死亡例も発生、ヒト-ヒト感染継続と国際支援（MSF、ベルギー等）の関与がありIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 100人以上の接触者が確認され、うち約30%が特定済み。MSFによる新治療センター建設や保健省・ベルギーによる救急車提供など国際支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Neuer Patient erreicht deutsche Spezialklinik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: New patient reaches German specialist clinic.
article.articleSummary: An American Ebola patient infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo is being treated in Frankfurt, Germany—the second Ebola case treated in Germany this year. The individual, whose gender was not disclosed, was flown overnight from Congo and admitted to the University Hospital in Frankfurt on a dedicated isolation ward to prevent transmission. Ebola spreads through direct contact with body fluids, not through the air. The Congo outbreak remains severe, with at least about 1,830 infections and around 650 deaths reported; fighting, weak health systems, and hard‑to‑reach areas complicate containment. The current outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo strain, for which the WHO notes there is no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment; care centers on rehydration, circulatory support, and management of complications. Germany previously treated a US doctor in May at Charité in Berlin; his wife and four children were long‑term high‑risk contacts under quarantine but asymptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：新たな患者がドイツの専門病院に到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（感染者約1830人、死者約650人）が継続しており、患者がドイツへ搬送されるなど国際的な拡大・関心が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ドイツやアメリカは患者搬送先であり発生国ではないため、verified_locationsから除外した。DRCの流行はBundibugyo株によるもので、ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Even Hospitals Launches ₹299 Fever & Dengue Package, 24/7 Hotline
article.articleSummary: On 13 July 2026, Bengaluru-based Even Hospitals launched a ₹299 Fever & Dengue Screening Package to mark its first anniversary and a 24/7 Dengue Hotline (9187213889) to prompt early diagnosis amid Bengaluru's monsoon fever surge. The package includes a free internal medicine consultation and a full workup: CBC; Dengue Panel NS1 Antigen, IgG & IgM; Malaria Parasite Test MPQB; LFT; Urine Routine. Targeted at adults with fever 1–5 days and symptoms such as body ache, headache, chills or fatigue, or those suspecting dengue, malaria or viral fever. Early testing is critical, as these illnesses share similar early symptoms but require different treatments. Since launch, Even Hospitals has served over 40,000 Bengaluru members and delivered more than 1.37 lakh specialist consultations, reflecting a model prioritizing prevention and coordinated care. A ₹999 Care Package offers unlimited 24/7 online consultations.

triage.headline_ja: Even病院、299ルピーの発熱・デング熱検査パッケージと24時間ホットラインを開始
triage.triage_reason: これは病院の商業的なプロモーション記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常な流行や深刻な事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はBengaluruのモンスーン季節における発熱の増加に言及しているが、これは季節性の一般的傾向であり、特定の異常な流行やアウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、病院の商業サービス案内が主目的である。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha Ramps Up Covid Surveillance As AP Reports Rise And Suspected Deaths
article.articleSummary: Odisha tightens Covid-19 surveillance as Andhra Pradesh reports rising infections and two suspected deaths in Kadapa. Odisha’s Public Health Director Dr. Rabindranath Mishra says regular testing across facilities shows no positive cases so far, and urges calm. The Health Department directs Chief District Medical Officers of border districts to intensify entry-point screening and ensure that every suspected Covid-19 case is tested at district headquarters hospitals, ahead of the Rath Yatra festival expected to draw large crowds. Anyone with Covid-like symptoms will be tested and managed per standard protocols. In Andhra Pradesh, several fresh infections have been recorded; Kadapa reports two suspected Covid-related deaths, with rapid response teams deployed and isolation wards kept ready. Odisha will continue close monitoring, testing, and preparedness in light of cross-border movement.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州、アンドラプラデシュ州での感染増加と疑い死亡例を受けCOVID監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の局地的な感染増加と疑い死亡例が報告されているが、オディシャ州では陽性例なく、規模や重症度の詳細も不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: アンドラプラデシュ州カダパでの疑い死亡例2件の詳細（検査確定の有無、原因）は記事内で不明。Rath Yatra祭前の予防的措置として国境地区での監視強化が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolabesmettingen Congo opgelopen tot meer dan 1900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in Congo have risen to more than 1,900.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, Congo reports 1,926 confirmed Ebola infections and 702 deaths, with the virus circulating in five provinces. Haut-Uele and Tshopo are newly affected; authorities say all identified cases in these provinces appear imported, yet these areas are deemed epidemic regions. The Bundibugyo variant has been identified in a patient admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital, who arrived Sunday night and is in isolation; the patient is reported to be doing well. Germany had previously admitted an Ebola patient in May, missionary doctor Peter Stafford. The report highlights ongoing cross-border concerns and the import/export dynamics of Congo's outbreak across international borders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が1,900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで確認例1,926件・死亡702例に達する大規模エボラ流行が5州に拡大し、さらにドイツ・フランクフルトで確認患者が発生するなど国際的拡大が確認されているため。
triage.notes: ドイツ（フランクフルト）での確認例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大の重要な証拠として特筆すべき事項。

article.articleHeadline: Video: Mandat Prabowo ke Wamenkes Benny: Atasi Kasus Tuberkulosis RI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: Prabowo's Directive to Deputy Health Minister Benny: Tackle Indonesia's Tuberculosis Cases
article.articleSummary: Indonesia remains the world’s second-largest TB burden after India, with about 1,090,000 TB cases and roughly 125,000 TB deaths in 2025. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus, Sp.P(K), sworn on October 8, 2025, is tasked with accelerating national health transformation and eliminating TB. The Health Ministry implements periodic TB screening for families of TB patients across 53,335 locations, reaching over 5 million people. It also emphasizes education and prevention, including campaigns on the dangers of smoking. Beyond TB, the ministry highlights three major diseases burdening the country: heart disease, stroke, and kidney dialysis resulting from uncontrolled hypertension and diabetes. The remarks come from a CNBC Indonesia Profit interview dated July 13, 2026, outlining ongoing measures to tackle these health challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 動画:プラボウォ大統領からベニー保健副大臣への指令:インドネシアの結核症例に対処せよ
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性的な公衆衛生課題（結核）に関する政府の政策・対策紹介記事であり、突発的・異常な感染症イベントではないため。
triage.notes: 結核はインドネシアにおいて既知の高負担疾患であり、本記事は政府の恒常的対策方針を報じるものでアウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。インドは比較対象として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はインドネシア。

article.articleHeadline: 미국인 에볼라 환자 또 독일 이송
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another American Ebola patient transferred to Germany.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been transferred to Germany for treatment. He arrived at Frankfurt Airport overnight and was admitted to the special isolation ward at Frankfurt University Hospital. The U.S. CDC had earlier confirmed that the individual, employed by a humanitarian organization in the DRC, contracted Ebola there. On May 20, another American medical missionary, Peter Stafford, infected in the DRC, was moved to Berlin’s Charité – University Medicine and discharged after about two weeks. Germany’s Federal Health Ministry said the country has Ebola-specific expertise and top isolation facilities, and noted the U.S. government requested assistance due to shorter flight time from Africa to Germany; U.S. media reported the White House opposed repatriation in the earlier case.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人エボラ患者、再びドイツへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上常に重大疾患であり、DRCでの感染者が国際搬送された事実は国際的拡大リスクを示すため、IHR基準を2つ満たしPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで感染した米国人患者がドイツへ搬送された事例を報じている。DRCにおけるエボラ流行の継続を示唆するが、ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolabesmettingen Congo boven 1900: 702 doden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in Congo exceed 1,900: 702 dead.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, Congo reports 1,926 confirmed Ebola infections and 702 deaths. The outbreak has spread to five Congolese provinces, including two newly affected Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Officials say all detected cases in these provinces are imported, but the two provinces are to be considered an epidemic area, indicating ongoing transmission across multiple regions. The health institute notes the virus is circulating within the country. Internationally, the Frankfurt University Medical Center treated an Ebola patient arriving overnight with the Bundibugyo variant, who was placed in isolation and reportedly remains stable. Germany previously admitted an Ebola patient in May—the missionary doctor Peter Stafford. The report highlights a widening outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the international medical community’s response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数1,900人超え：死者702人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで大規模なエボラ流行が拡大し複数州に波及、致死率も高く、さらにドイツへの国際的な患者搬送事例も発生しており国際拡大リスクが確認されるためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: ドイツ(Hessen/Frankfurt)は輸入症例の治療事例であり対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: German hospital treats US Ebola patient infected in Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus infection from Congo is treated in a German hospital's special isolation unit after arrival around 03:00 local time (01:00 GMT). The patient, a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo, has tested positive for the Bundibugyo variant according to the U.S. CDC. Condition is stable, and care is provided in complete isolation in a unit separated from the rest of the facility; authorities say there is no risk to the public or other patients. The Congo outbreak now totals 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces. In June, another U.S. citizen treated in Berlin after contracting Ebola in Congo was discharged from Charité hospital, underscoring ongoing export/import dynamics of the Congo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツの病院、コンゴで感染した米国人エボラ患者を治療
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定症例1,926件、死亡702人）が続いており、感染者の国際的な移送（ドイツへの搬送）が発生しているため、国際的拡大リスクが高くフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴで感染した米国人でドイツに搬送・隔離治療中。6月にも別の米国人がベルリンで治療を受け退院しており、輸出入事例が繰り返し発生している点は国際拡大リスクの高さを示す。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaudbrud i DR Congo spreder sig til flere provinser
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads to several provinces.
article.articleSummary: Two new provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reported Ebola exposure, according to the National Institute for Public Health, via Reuters. As of July 13, 2026, the number of confirmed Ebola cases has risen to 1,926, with 702 deaths reported. The development indicates that the outbreak has expanded to additional provincial regions within the country. The excerpt provides no further details on clinical presentation, transmission pathways, or the methods used to confirm the cases. The information cited in the article comes from Reuters and the DR Congo's National Institute for Public Health. No time frame for containment milestones is given.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、複数の州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例が1,926人、死亡702人に達し、複数州に拡大していることから、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 致死率は約36%と高く、複数州への拡大は流行のさらなる拡大を示唆する。臨床像や感染経路の詳細情報は不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Более 700 человек умерли в ДР Конго от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 700 people have died in DR Congo from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports 1,926 Ebola cases, with 702 laboratory-confirmed deaths, up 53 cases and 30 deaths in the past 24 hours. The case fatality rate is 36.5%. There are 753 patients hospitalized or in medical isolation facilities, while 318 have recovered. The data indicate an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the country, according to the ministry of communications and media. The report provides laboratory-confirmed death counts but offers no details on infection sources, transmission chains, or imported/exported cases. Laboratory confirmation underpins the mortality figure, underscoring the continued burden of Ebola virus disease in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により700人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが継続しており、致死率36.5%と重篤で、症例・死亡者数が急増していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 感染源や伝播経路、越境事例についての詳細は記事に記載がなく不明。24時間で53例・30人死亡の増加は急速な拡大を示唆し、継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Počet obetí eboly v Kongu už prekonal 700, počet potvrdených prípadov sa blíži k dvetisíc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in Congo has surpassed 700, and the number of confirmed cases is approaching two thousand.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 700 deaths with confirmed cases nearing 2,000. Declared in mid-May, the outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. The majority of cases and fatalities are in Ituri province in the northeast, from which transmission has extended to North Kivu and South Kivu. Authorities say two neighbouring provinces, Tshopo and Haut-Uele, should be treated as part of the epidemic zone. Cross-border cases include Uganda reporting 20 confirmed infections and two deaths; France reporting a June case. Germany has admitted a second American patient infected in Congo for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が700人を超え、確定症例数は2000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで700人超の死者、確定症例約2000人という大規模アウトブレイクであり、ウガンダ・フランス・ドイツへの越境感染も確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランス・ドイツでの症例は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際拡大の重要な事実として記載。承認済みワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行である点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Pacijent s ebolom stigao u europsku zemlju: Usred noći ga prevezli u bolnicu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with Ebola arrived in a European country: He was transported to a hospital in the middle of the night.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola, for which there is no vaccine or drug, was transported to Germany for treatment overnight. The patient landed at Frankfurt Airport and was moved to a university hospital, a spokesperson for the Federal Ministry of Health confirmed. The individual, sex unknown, had worked for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The CDC had earlier said the person of American origin who worked for a humanitarian organization in the DRC tested positive for Bundibugyo. Ebola spreads by direct contact and bodily fluids and is highly deadly. In Congo, the outbreak has caused about 650 deaths and at least 1,830 infections, with rapid case counts. Bundibugyo was first detected in Europe in late June among a French humanitarian physician returning from eastern Congo. Germany previously treated another infected American at Charité in Berlin; transport uses dedicated aircraft and patients are kept in isolation wards.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者、欧州の国に到着：深夜に病院へ搬送
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクにより既に650人以上が死亡、1830人以上感染しており、既にドイツ・フランスへの国際的な症例輸出が確認されている重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 感染源はDRCでのアウトブレイクであり、ドイツ・米国・フランスは症例の搬送先/輸出先であるため対象国リストには含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株であり、致死率が高く国際的懸念が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola Vaka Sayısı 1.800'ü Aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Case Count in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Surpasses 1,800
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo total 1,873 confirmed with 672 deaths. The outbreak spans five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—with Haut-Uele and Tshopo newly incorporated and epidemiologically linked to Ituri, the presumed epicenter. Some 763 patients are in isolation or hospital treatment, and 306 have recovered. There are 299 suspected cases, among which 91 deaths have been recorded. Treatment centers are operating at 95.1% occupancy, underscoring the strain on care capacity. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain and was officially declared on May 15. This reflects ongoing transmission across multiple provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症例数が1,800人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模エボラアウトブレイク（1,873症例、672死亡）が5州にわたり拡大し、治療センターが95.1%の稼働率で逼迫しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が5州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ、ツォポ）に拡大し、致死率約36%（672/1873）。治療センターの高稼働率が医療体制の逼迫を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: MSF appelle le Fonds mondial à maintenir le Nord-Kivu dans ses priorités concernant le paludisme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: MSF calls on The Global Fund to keep North Kivu in its malaria priorities.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns that funding for malaria control in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, could be cut as The Global Fund plans 2027–2029 priorities, potentially removing North Kivu from support due to declining international finance. If North Kivu is dropped, malaria treatments delivered through Global Fund-supplied stocks may cease in many health centers; MSF cannot substitute Fund support across the entire province, risking a worsening health situation already strained by armed conflict and supply challenges. MSF notes malaria remains the main reason for consultations in its health facilities in North Kivu. The province also faces outbreaks of measles and cholera, underscoring ongoing humanitarian crisis and the need for external support. MSF France program head Stéphane Doyon highlights the risk that reduced funding would undermine malaria control and overall health services in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：MSFがグローバルファンドにマラリア対策における北キブ州の優先度維持を要請
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州ではマラリアに加え麻疹・コレラの流行も同時進行しており、資金削減が保健サービス崩壊を招くリスクがあるため、国際支援の必要性が明確に示されている。

Wearing my favourite designer: Kokilaben. Checked in: COVID from Wuhan.' Fans expressed concern and wished him a speedy recovery. article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết dễ bùng phát sau mưa lớn, phòng bệnh thế nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is prone to outbreaks after heavy rain; how can it be prevented?
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreaks in Vietnam spike after heavy rain, driven by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. After rainfall, high humidity and temperatures of 25–32°C accelerate the mosquito life cycle to roughly 7–10 days from egg to adult, with case numbers often rising 1–2 weeks later as eggs hatch, larvae mature, and infected mosquitoes transmit the virus. Most breeding sites are found inside homes: flower vases, air-conditioner drip trays, potted plants, uncovered water storage, roof gutters, old cans and tires, tarps, and construction-site containers. Prevention focuses on eliminating breeding sites and personal protection: cover water tanks, change water weekly and scrub containers, remove items that hold water, and consider fish in larger tanks to eat larvae. Community cleanup, environmental hygiene, and vaccination with Qdenga (Takeda) approved by Vietnam’s Ministry of Health provide additional defense. Mosquito bite prevention remains essential, as Aedes typically bites in morning and late afternoon.

triage.headline_ja: 大雨の後にデング熱が流行しやすい、予防法は？

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго от Эболы умерли более 700 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 700 people have died from Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpassed 700, with 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases, 318 recoveries, and 702 deaths as of July 13, 2026. Response efforts cover five provinces—Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Chopo—with authorities noting two additional provinces affected and that the list of officially affected areas was expanded to include Chopo and Haut-Uele. The World Health Organization had declared the Congo–Uganda Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, with regional risk assessed as high, prompting intensified surveillance. Cross-border transmission concerns persist as health authorities monitor ongoing transmission in the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により700人以上が死亡

article.articleHeadline: פותח בתוך 8 שבועות: החיסון החדש לאבולה ייבחן בבני אדם
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Developed within 8 weeks: The new Ebola vaccine will be tested in humans.
article.articleSummary: Britain's health regulator approved the first-in-human trials of a new Ebola vaccine developed by Oxford University, the first of four candidates, as the Democratic Republic of Congo faces a deadly Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak with 1,792 lab-confirmed cases and 625 deaths. The Oxford team, leveraging the same chimpanzee adenovirus vector technology used in the Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine, developed the vaccine in about eight weeks since a May 17 public-health emergency declaration. The vaccine does not cause Ebola infection; it introduces a viral protein fragment to prime immunity. Serum Institute of India will manufacture about 620,000 doses under clinical-grade standards. In the UK, 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 will receive the vaccine, with a year-long follow-up. Researchers are coordinating with partners in Uganda to plan trials in Africa. A rare blood-clot risk exists, but is lower than the Bundibugyo Ebola risk; two other vaccines, including a Moderna version, are in development.

triage.headline_ja: 8週間で開発:新しいエボラワクチンがヒトで試験へ

triage.notes: 記事の主題は新規エボラワクチンの臨床試験開始だが、背景にあるDRCのBundibugyo株エボラ流行(1,792例確定・625死亡)自体が重大なため、DRCを発生国としてPICKUP判定とした。UK・India・Ugandaはワクチン開発・製造・将来の治験実施国であり、実際の感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: В Китае выросла заболеваемость COVID-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 incidence has risen in China.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 incidence in China rose in June 2026, with about 79,000 confirmed cases, including 130 severe cases and one death, per the Chinese CDC cited by Day.Az from China Daily. June's total marks an upturn from May (~21,900) and April (~23,500), signaling a continued upward trajectory. All June infections were attributed to the Omicron variant; no evidence of new virus strains was detected. The report provides no symptom-level data or geographic breakdown for the cases. Ongoing rise underscores persistent transmission and the need for sustained public health surveillance and response measures as of 13 July 2026. The article notes the data come from the China CDC and are reported via Day.Az, with no mention of imported or exported cases.

article.articleHeadline: 曾祈殷：新冠病人數量增　籲市民提高警惕 (17:15) - 20260713
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zeng Qiyin: The number of COVID-19 patients has increased; he urges the public to heighten vigilance (17:15) - 20260713
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 activity has risen in Mainland China from late May to early June after a period of near dormancy two months earlier, with tens of thousands of confirmed cases nationwide. In the local region, among patients with respiratory symptoms, 30–50% test positive on rapid antigen tests, while most cases present with mild or unclear symptoms. Public guidance emphasizes using past experience to decide whether to quick-test. For travelers going north to Mainland China, preventive measures are advised. Oral antiviral therapy is effective but relatively expensive in private clinics; physicians urge eligible patients to seek treatment at government clinics, and suggest decentralizing antiviral dispensing to private doctors amid rising cases. Climate change is linked to hotter, wetter conditions and variable pathogen activity; continued use of masks and hand sanitizers is recommended.

article.articleHeadline: Śmiertelnie groźny wirus w szpitalu w pobliżu Polski. Potwierdzono zakażenie najgorszym wariantem
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus in a hospital near Poland. Infection with the worst variant has been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, a patient arrived at a Frankfurt hospital around 03:00 after contracting Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapy. The hospital's Timo Wolf said the patient is currently stable and isolated in a wing separated from the rest of the facility; no risk to other patients or to German society. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola infections reached 1,926 with 702 deaths since the outbreak began in spring, announced 15 May. On 10 July, the CDC reported a US citizen working for a humanitarian organization infected with Bundibugyo. In June, another US citizen treated in Berlin after Congo contact was discharged.

triage.headline_ja: ポーランド近郊の病院で致死性ウイルス感染。最悪の変異株の感染が確認される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ・ブンディブギョ株アウトブレイク（1,926症例、702死亡）に関連し、ドイツ・米国への輸入症例が複数発生しており、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の観点からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにドイツ・米国・ヘッセン州・ベルリン等が含まれるが、これらは輸入症例（治療地）であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生国はDRCのみ。ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株であり、致死率が高い点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Zweiter mit Ebola infizierter US-Bürger wird in Frankfurt behandelt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second Ebola-infected U.S. citizen is being treated in Frankfurt.
article.articleSummary: Two months after the arrival of the first U.S. Ebola patient from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a second patient has been transported to Germany and admitted to University Hospital Frankfurt am Main, where he is fully isolated on a dedicated isolation ward. The Health Ministry said there is no danger to the public or other patients. Germany operates seven special isolation wards, including Berlin, Hamburg and Munich. The first U.S. Ebola patient was treated in May at Berlin’s Charité; his wife and four children from Congo were later moved to Berlin, and the man was discharged in early June. The DRC remains the outbreak’s epicenter, with UN figures showing more than 600 deaths since mid-May. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids, and funerals pose a high transmission risk. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or targeted therapy.

triage.headline_ja: 2人目のエボラ感染米国人がフランクフルトで治療中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは既に600人以上の死者を出しており、ワクチン・特効薬が存在しない。感染者が国境を越えてドイツへ搬送される事例が複数発生しており、国際的拡大及び公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツでの患者治療状況を報じているが、アウトブレイク自体はDRCで継続中であり、ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国やドイツの地名はBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、実際のアウトブレイク発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 India: कुमार सानू के बेटे जान कोरोना संक्रमित, यूपी-आंध्र समेत कई राज्यों में बढ़े केस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 India: Kumar Sanu's son Jaan infected with coronavirus, cases rise in several states including Uttar Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurgence in India as of 13 July 2026: Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, and Andhra Pradesh report rising cases. Famed singer Kumar Sanu’s son Jaan Kumar has been hospitalized with coronavirus. In Uttar Pradesh, a 27-year-old man with breathing difficulties was admitted to Banaras Hindu University in Varanasi; doctors say about 1–2 new cases are observed each month. Andhra Pradesh reports 8 active cases and 2 deaths confirmed. Health Ministry has been put on alert amid the uptick. Context: COVID-19 emerged in Wuhan, China in December 2019; India’s first case was on January 30, 2020. Since then thousands of variants have circulated, including Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta, and Omicron; WHO maintains these variants in a special category.

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला ने किया बेहाल, अब तक 1873 लोग हुए वायरस से संक्रमित, 672 की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has wreaked havoc in Congo; so far 1,873 people have been infected with the virus, 672 have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues with 1,873 confirmed infections and 672 deaths across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Shopo. A latest situation report shows 763 patients hospitalized or in isolation, with bed capacity over 95% filled. So far, 306 patients have recovered, while 299 suspected cases have 91 deaths. On May 15, the government declared the outbreak a national epidemic. The Africa CDC reports an American humanitarian worker assisting response teams has tested positive, prompting renewed concerns for frontline staff; contact tracing is underway, though the infection source remains unclear. Health workers are heavily affected, with 112 infected and 35 dead. Ebola, first identified in 1976, spreads via human transmission and certain wildlife; the outbreak name derives from the Ebola River near Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが猛威、これまでに1,873人が感染、672人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラアウトブレイクが継続し、致死率が高く医療従事者への感染・死亡も多数発生、国家的流行として宣言されており国際的拡大リスクもあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国人人道支援者の感染確認や病床稼働率95%超など、対応能力の逼迫が示唆される。5州にまたがる大規模アウトブレイクであり、国家的流行として宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ingresado en Alemania un segundo paciente estadounidense contagiado con ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A second American patient infected with Ebola in the DRC, admitted in Germany.
article.articleSummary: Two months after a U.S. physician treated in Germany for Ebola contracted in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), a second American patient infected with Ebola has been admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital in Hesse, Germany. The patient arrived at Frankfurt airport and was immediately transferred to the hospital. The CDC stated the individual works for a humanitarian organization in the DRC; the gender was not disclosed. The patient has tested positive for the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus. In May, the earlier patient—an American doctor infected in the DRC—was moved to Berlin’s Charité hospital in a high-security isolation unit, treated for about two weeks, and discharged. The doctor’s wife and four children, asymptomatic, were also admitted at Charité as high-risk contacts. The cases illustrate imported Ebola infections from the DRC and Germany’s continued isolation and monitoring measures.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツで、コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)でエボラウイルスに感染した2人目の米国人患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラウイルス感染例がドイツへ越境搬送される事案が続いており、IHR基準（深刻性・国際的拡大）を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 感染源はDRCであり、ドイツは搬送先・治療地であるため対象国リストには含まれない。過去2か月で2例目の越境搬送例であり、DRCでのエボラ流行状況の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Oxford begins first human trial of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: Oxford launches the first human trial of a Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine (BD-Ebov) to address outbreaks spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The early-stage study will evaluate safety and immune response in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 in Oxford, with vaccinations expected in coming weeks pending regulatory approval. BD-Ebov (ChAdOx1 BDBV) uses the same viral-vector platform as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Serum Institute of India has manufactured about 620,000 doses and supplied 4,000 investigational doses for this trial. In May, the WHO urged prioritising ChAdOx1 BDBV alongside the single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo candidate for clinical evaluation. CEPI plans up to $8.6 million to support development, with additional Ugandan studies planned via MRC/Uganda Virus Research Institute and LSHTM Uganda Research Unit, subject to regulatory approval. If successful, late-stage trials and authorisation could follow to ensure rapid, affordable vaccine supplies for affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、ブンディブギョ型エボラワクチンの初のヒト臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダで進行中とされるブンディブギョ型エボラのワクチン臨床試験開始であり、アウトブレイク自体の規模・症例数等の詳細情報がなく、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疾患名はCOVID-19とタグ付けされているが、実際はブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスワクチン（ChAdOx1 BDBV）の臨床試験に関する記事。インドはワクチン製造国（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC・ウガンダでのアウトブレイクの詳細（症例数・死亡数等）が記載されておらず、既存アウトブレイクへの対応（ワクチン開発）に関する二次的情報のため、新規シグナルとしてよりも経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Kumar Sanu's Son Jaan Hospitalised With COVID, Says "China Se Aaya Mera Dost"
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 patient Jaan Kumar Sanu, son of veteran playback singer Kumar Sanu, tested positive and was hospitalised at Kokilaben Dhirubai Ambani Hospital in Mumbai. The diagnosis was disclosed in a July 12 social-media video, with the July 13, 2026 publication date marking the current reference point. The post featured light-hearted humor about the infection, including lines about 'China se aaya mera dost' and jokes about Wuhan, but offered no medical specifics. The article does not provide information on when symptoms began or the expected duration of hospitalization, nor any details on laboratory confirmation beyond testing positive. There is no mention of symptoms, severity, or additional cases or contacts. The development underscores ongoing public attention to COVID-19 among public figures in India.
