triage.triage_reason: 有名人個人のCOVID-19感染に関するエンターテインメント系記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常性・重大性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 有名人の単発COVID感染報道で、医学的詳細（症状・重症度・接触者等）は一切記載されていない。中国やWuhanへの言及はジョークであり実際の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: انتشار جديد لفيروس إيبولا في الكونجو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease has spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to two new provinces, Out-Wili and Chobo, as of 13 July 2026. The National Institute for Public Health reports the outbreak now covers five provinces, with hundreds of deaths in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in eastern DRC. Investigations indicate that virtually all cases identified in Out-Wili and Chobo are imported from the city of Nyanya in Ituri Province, but the two provinces are still considered part of the outbreak zone. The Bundibugyo strain is a rare Ebola lineage. No laboratory confirmation details are provided in the brief. The ongoing transmission appears linked to Nyanya, underscoring cross-provincial spread within the eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスの新たな流行拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（バンディブギョ株）がDRC東部で5州に拡大し、多数の死亡者が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるバンディブギョ・エボラの流行拡大を主題としており、南キブ、イトゥリ、北キブ、及び新規2州（Out-Wili、Chobo）が対象。アンゴラ・南スーダンは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola patient treated in Frankfurt hospital
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 1,926 cases and 702 deaths as of July 13, with the outbreak spreading to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces. A United States citizen infected with the Bundibugyo variant in Congo was admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital’s special isolation unit around 3:00 a.m. local time on July 13; the patient remains in complete isolation and in stable condition, with officials saying there is no risk to the public. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) reported on July 10 that another US citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus. In June, a US citizen treated in Berlin after contracting Ebola in Congo was discharged from Charite hospital, highlighting international movement of cases.

triage.headline_ja: フランクフルトの病院でエボラ患者を治療
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が1,926症例・702死亡に拡大し、複数の患者が国際的に(ドイツへ)移送・治療されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 感染源・アウトブレイク地はDRCであり、ドイツ(ベルリン・フランクフルト)や米国は感染者が搬送・治療された地であって発生地ではないため対象国リストから除外。CFRが約36%と非常に高く、国際的な患者移送も発生していることから緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: The Ebola epidemic is getting out of control
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, concentrated in Ituri, reached 1,830 confirmed infections and 648 deaths as of July 11, with over 90% of cases in Ituri. By July 9 the government admitted spread to two additional provinces; there is a high risk of crossing into South Sudan, with a Lancet Infectious Diseases paper estimating a 70% chance of introduction within three months. No vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak; containment relies on testing, contact tracing, and isolation, but these are scarce in Ituri due to logistics, dense forests, armed groups, and about 900,000 displaced people. Bunia has some facilities, but PPE is scarce and remote areas see clinics closing. Front-line workers have fallen ill; about 25 have died, and salaries are delayed. Donors pledged over $1.2 billion, but only $115 million has been disbursed, and health workers have gone on strike. A pregnant woman from Ituri died after transport to Kisangani (Tshopo) and was confirmed Ebola, highlighting ongoing fear.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が制御不能になりつつある
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が確認1830例・死亡648例に達し、ワクチンなし・医療体制崩壊・南スーダンへの越境リスクが高いなど深刻かつ国際的拡大の懸念が明確なため。
triage.notes: 南スーダンへの拡大リスクが指摘されているが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。医療従事者のストライキ・資金不足・武装勢力による活動制限など、対応能力の著しい低下が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Evacuado a Alemania desde RDC un segundo ciudadano estadounidense contagiado con ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second American citizen infected with Ebola evacuated to Germany from the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Second American citizen infected with Ebola has been exported to Germany from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) for treatment, about two months after the first U.S. patient was evacuated in mid-May as the eastern DRC outbreak continues. Germany's Health Ministry says a second patient is receiving care at Frankfurt University Hospital; the identity is undisclosed and the patient is symptomatic but in stable condition. U.S. CDC notes the patient is a humanitarian worker in the DRC. Congolese authorities report 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with 753 in isolation and 318 recoveries. Surveillance is reinforced in Alto Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo. The WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Uganda reports two deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with no approved vaccine or treatment. DRC has extensive Ebola experience, though the Kasai outbreak ended in December 2025.

triage.headline_ja: DRCから第2の米国籍エボラ感染者がドイツへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みのDRCエボラアウトブレイクで、確定例1,926人・死亡702人と規模が大きく、米国籍患者2名がドイツへ国際搬送されるなど国際的拡大が確認されているためフルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: WHOによりPHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダでも死亡例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれず、ドイツは治療目的の搬送先であり発生国ではないため除外。承認されたワクチン・治療薬がない点にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 西华尼申：霹蚊症疫情严峻 民众应配合卫生局灭蚊 - 地方 - 时事焦点
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Xihuani Shen: Severe Perak mosquito-borne disease outbreak; the public should cooperate with the Health Department to eradicate mosquitoes - Local - Focus on Current Affairs
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Perak, Malaysia remains severe. In Week 26 (Jun 28–Jul 4), 63 new cases were reported, bringing the cumulative total to 1,387 (up 281 from last year, +25.4%). The highest rise was in Kinta District with 29 new cases, followed by Kampar (11), Batang Padang (6), Sungai Siput (3), and Muallim and Perak Tengah districts (2 each); single cases were recorded in Bagan Datoh, Gopeng, and Manjung. Hotspots include Sakura Garden and several kampungs. The Health Department redeployed personnel from Sungai Siput, Kampar, and Perak Tengah to assist Kinta, conducting house-to-house checks, waste cleanup, and enforcement of vacant lots. There are 7 outbreak zones under control, 2 uncontrolled, and 5 ended; 42.2% of total cases occurred in outbreak zones, 57.8% outside. Nationally, Perak ranks sixth as of July 9, with Selangor, Kuala Lumpur, Johor, Sabah, and Negeri Sembilan ahead. Separately, local governments have halted new e-cigarette licenses; existing licenses remain until expiry, with new legislation planned for Parliament by Oct; Perak supports.

triage.headline_ja: 西華尼申氏：ペラ州の蚊媒介感染症の流行が深刻、住民は保健局の蚊駆除活動に協力すべき
triage.triage_reason: マレーシア・ペラ州における例年通りのデング熱流行状況の定例報告であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生でもなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はマレーシア・ペラ州のデング熱流行であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する国は含まれない。発生地域にIndonesiaが記載されているが、記事内容と無関係と判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: US-Patient wird in Frankfurter Uniklinik behandelt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak: American Patient Treated at Frankfurt University Hospital.
article.articleSummary: Two months after the first Ebola patient from the United States arrived in Germany, a second Ebola-infected American was flown to Germany for treatment, landing at Frankfurt Airport and transferred to Universitätsmedizin Frankfurt. The CDC identifies the patient as a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo and infected with the Bundibugyo variant. Frankfurt researchers report Ebola symptoms with the patient in stable condition; transport occurred without incident. For Bundibugyo Ebola, there is no licensed vaccine or standard therapy; experimental trials are recruiting Remdesivir and MBP134 antibody cocktail. Blood tests now detect Bundibugyo, aiding outbreak mapping. Previously, a U.S. physician admitted May 20 to Berlin’s Charité was discharged after about two weeks; his wife and four children, high-risk contacts, were quarantined but asymptomatic. In the DRC, 702 deaths, 1,926 cases, 318 recovered, 753 hospitalized; France also reported a Bundibugyo case, with isolation on arrival and release in early July.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：米国人患者、フランクフルト大学病院で治療
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ変異株）アウトブレイクは症例数1,926、死亡702人と規模が大きく、既に複数の患者が国際搬送されている実績があり、国際的拡大とワクチン・治療法未確立という管理困難性からIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域には米国・ドイツ・フランスが含まれるが、これらは搬送・治療を受けた国であり、感染発生地はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）である。ドイツ・米国・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Jaan Kumar Sanu hospitalised with COVID-19: Doctor explains symptoms and risks
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, Jaan Kumar Sanu has been hospitalised in Mumbai after testing positive for COVID-19. Doctors note SARS-CoV-2 remains circulating globally and mutating into new variants, causing periodic spikes similar to seasonal influenza. Dr Deepesh Agrawal of Saifee Hospital, Mumbai, says most infections are mild but vigilance is needed, especially for those at higher risk. COVID-19 typically begins with high fever, chills, fatigue and body aches, followed by respiratory symptoms such as runny nose, sore throat, cough, hoarseness, and sometimes breathing difficulty; diarrhoea, conjunctivitis or skin rashes may occur. Loss of smell and taste is less common now. Diagnosis is by RT-PCR or rapid antigen tests. Preventive measures—handwashing, masking in crowded or poorly ventilated places, avoiding close contact, and self-isolating—remain effective. High-risk groups include older adults, pregnancy, cancer, chronic diseases, and immunocompromised individuals.

triage.headline_ja: ジャーン・クマール・サヌ氏、COVID-19で入院:医師が症状とリスクを解説
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人のCOVID-19罹患・入院に関する一般的な健康解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 有名人個人の症例報告であり、集団発生や異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではないため対象国の感染症イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: قفزة كبيرة في إصابات إيبولا بالكونغو وحركة متمردة تسيطر على جهود الاستجابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A major spike in Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as a rebel movement takes control of the response efforts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surged to 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths as of July 13, 2026. Amid the outbreak, the rebel movement AFC/M23 has seized control of response efforts in areas under its sway, running a parallel operation separate from Kinshasa's government response and receiving partial support from Rwanda. The shift underscores how insurgent groups are expanding administrative reach into conflict zones, potentially complicating coordination, logistics, and infection-control measures. Analysts warn that fractured leadership of the outbreak response could hinder containment and risk wider spread, especially where violence already limits access to affected communities. The country faces ongoing security and health challenges, with Ebola circulating in remote, conflict-affected regions, underscoring the need for synchronized action among local authorities, international partners, and humanitarian groups.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染が急増、反乱軍が対応活動を掌握
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例が大幅増加（1,873例、死亡672例）し、反政府武装勢力が対応を掌握するなど公衆衛生対応が著しく混乱しており、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの複数のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: ルワンダは対応への部分的支援の文脈で言及されているが、疾患発生国ではないため対象国リストのDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: إسلام عنان يفجر مفاجأة حول التصريحات المثيرة للصحة العالمية عن حقيقة انتشار"إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Islam Anan drops a bombshell about the World Health Organization's sensational statements on the true extent of Ebola's spread.
article.articleSummary: Dr. Islam Anan, professor of health economics, cites WHO warnings that Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may involve far more cases than official tallies. He says signals have indicated unrecorded infections for over a month among people with no known contact, suggesting actual cases could approach 7,000 versus about 1,700 reported, and deaths around 1,700–2,000 versus ~600 announced. The outbreak remains confined to Ituri Province, with transmission averaging over three secondary cases per index patient. The current Ebola strain appears less severe than earlier ones, with lower fatality and milder symptoms, though Ebola can start with fever, headache, and fatigue and, in severe cases, progress to internal and external bleeding if not treated early. The report emphasizes potential under-detection while noting the outbreak’s localization rather than a widespread global transmission.

triage.headline_ja: イスラム・アナン氏、世界保健機関のエボラ感染拡大に関する衝撃発言の真相を暴露
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たし、WHO統計を大幅に上回る過小報告の可能性が指摘されているエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであるため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は専門家の見解に基づく推測を多く含み、WHO公式発表との数値乖離が大きいため、実際の症例数・死亡数については続報での確認が必要。アウトブレイクはイトゥリ州に限定されているとされる。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Records 1,873 Confirmed Ebola Cases, 672 Deaths
article.articleSummary: DRC records 1,873 confirmed Ebola cases and 672 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Chubu; Haut-Uele and Chubu are included in the national report for the first time. As of 13 July 2026, 763 patients are in isolation or hospital treatment, with bed occupancy at 95.1%, signaling substantial pressure on facilities. The outbreak was declared on May 15, marking the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the country, which prompted the World Health Organization to issue an international health alert. The report notes geographic spread across multiple provinces, with Haut-Uele and Chubu included in the tally for the first time.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定症例1,873件、死亡672人を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で17回目のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大し、WHOが国際保健アラートを発出。死亡者数・病床占有率も高く、複数州への地理的拡大が確認されているため。
triage.notes: 発生地域に日本が含まれているが、記事本文はDRC国内の状況（イトゥリ、南北キブ、オートウエレ、チュブ州）のみに言及しており、日本での発生は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: US citizen in Congo tests positive for Ebola virus, US CDC says
article.articleSummary: A US citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is coordinating with the patient’s employer, other federal agencies, and partners in the DRC to prevent further transmission and identify high-risk contacts. The US State Department said it is aware of the case and providing support to the affected American. UNICEF and ECHO are sending medical supplies to the DRC to contain the Ebola outbreak. A related image shows UNICEF staff and airport workers with an ECHO humanitarian aircraft at Bunia National Airport, Bunia, Ituri province, on May 29, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでアメリカ人がエボラウイルス陽性、米CDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）感染確認事例であり、米国籍者への感染および米CDC・国際機関の関与から国際的拡大リスクと重篤性が高いと判断される。
triage.notes: 米国人感染者の情報は国際的注目度を高める要素だが、対象国リストには米国が含まれないためverified_locationsからは除外。DRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）での発生が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya : MSF ouvre un centre de simulation dédié à la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: MSF opens a simulation center dedicated to the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's MSF opened a simulation center in Kajiado, near Nairobi, to train doctors, nurses, clinicians and laboratory staff for Ebola response ahead of deployments to the Democratic Republic of Congo. The simulated Ebola Treatment Center reproduces beds, a lab, full PPE, preparing staff for technical, psychological and logistical demands in outbreak zones. The DRC outbreak, declared in May, has reached at least 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, including 112 health workers and 35 deaths. It is described as Africa's fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic. The center also trains community mobilizers to support early detection, safe burials, reduce transmission and counter stigma amid poverty, insecurity and misinformation. Open since mid-June, it will run through August, training about 100 people per month, initially MSF personnel and then Kenyan Health Ministry staff and others. Cisse Papa Ndiaga, a 43-year-old Senegalese health worker, says the training brings more calm and less fear, though field reality remains tougher.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：MSFがエボラ対策のためのシミュレーションセンターを開設
triage.triage_reason: 記事はDRCで進行中のエボラ流行（確定症例1,759例、死亡600人、医療従事者112人感染）を背景としており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当するため、フルRRAでの評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのMSF訓練センター開設だが、実際のエボラ発生国はDRCであり、アフリカ最速拡大の流行として深刻な状況が記述されている。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの流行状況（症例数・死亡者数・医療従事者感染）を踏まえ、フルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak spreads to two more provinces
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has spread to two more northeastern provinces, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. The National Institute of Public Health said the outbreak—Congo’s 17th—declared May 15, with cases largely in Ituri and also in North Kivu and South Kivu, now includes four cases in Tshopo (two deaths) and one death in Haut-Uele as of Saturday. Total confirmed cases across the country reach 1,926 with 702 deaths. Transmission occurs by direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include high fever, vomiting and bleeding. Tracing of potentially exposed people began in late June; authorities say cases in these provinces are primarily imported from Niania in Ituri and should be treated as an epidemic zone. Kisangani is the provincial capital of Tshopo; Haut-Uele borders South Sudan and the Central African Republic. WHO notes the true scale may be larger, with four of five new cases lacking known links.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、さらに2州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4基準中3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に加え、致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が新たな州へ拡大し感染経路不明の症例も存在するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo各州）でのエボラ拡大を報告。中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダンは国境隣接の地理的言及のみで、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOは新規症例の感染経路不明が多く、実際の規模はより大きい可能性を指摘しており、越境拡大リスクにも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي إيبولا يمتد إلى إقليمين جديدين في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads to two new provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 13 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s National Institute of Public Health announced that the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has spread to two additional provinces, Ot-Wili and Chobo, after cases linked to the city of Nyania in Ituri province were recorded. Investigations indicate the newly reported infections are largely imported from Ituri, but Ot-Wili and Chobo are now part of the outbreak’s containment area. The Bundibugyo strain has now reached five provinces, as hundreds of deaths continue to be reported in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in the eastern part of the country. The report highlights ongoing transmission around Nyania and cross-provincial spread, underscoring the northeastern outbreak dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国の新たな2州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が新たに2州へ拡大し、複数州で数百人規模の死者が報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数該当が確認された。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにGhana・Angolaが含まれるが、記事本文はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州、新規のOt-Wili州・Chobo州）における流行拡大のみを扱っており、他国は主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - Weiterer amerikanischer Patient in Deutschland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - Another American patient in Germany.
article.articleSummary: Two months after the first Ebola patient from the United States arrived in Germany for treatment, a second US citizen infected with Ebola was flown to Germany for care. The patient landed at Frankfurt Airport overnight and was transported to the University Hospital in Frankfurt, Hesse, according to a German Health Ministry spokesperson. The CDC had previously stated that the patient is a US citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The individual tested positive for the Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus, currently circulating in the DRC; gender was not disclosed. The report confirms a second imported Ebola case into Germany, with treatment at a German university hospital. No symptoms are described in the report.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 - ドイツでさらに1名のアメリカ人患者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)で流行中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の感染者がドイツに搬送される事例が2例目となり、国際的な拡大とヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツへの輸入例を報じているが、感染源はDRCでの流行（ブンディブギョ株）であり、DRCが実際の発生国。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Evacuado a Alemania desde RDC un segundo ciudadano estadounidense contagiado con ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second American citizen infected with Ebola evacuated to Germany from the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Second American Ebola patient evacuated to Germany from the Democratic Republic of the Congo for treatment. Germany’s University Hospital Frankfurt admitted a symptomatic patient on Sunday; he is a humanitarian worker in DRC and remains in stable condition. This follows the first American patient evacuated to Germany about two months earlier amid an outbreak in eastern DRC. Congolese authorities report 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases and 702 deaths, with 753 patients in isolation and 318 recoveries; Uganda has recorded two outbreak-related deaths. Surveillance remains reinforced in Haut-Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. The WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting the Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. DRC—having declared the end of a Kasai outbreak in December 2025—has extensive Ebola experience, tracing origins to the 1976 Yambuku event.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国からエボラ熱に感染した2人目の米国人がドイツへ搬送される
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した進行中のエボラ流行で、死亡者・症例数が多く、国境を越えた患者搬送や隣国ウガンダへの拡大も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの死亡例やドイツへの患者搬送は国際的拡大の証左だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはPHEICを宣言済みで、Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点が重症度・管理可能性の懸念を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Un Américain malade d'Ebola soigné en Allemagne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American with Ebola treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: Second American infected with Ebola admitted in Germany, arriving overnight from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and transported to Frankfurt University Hospital for treatment. The patient is infected with the Ebola virus, Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved vaccine or treatment. Since mid-May, the DRC has declared its 17th Ebola outbreak, with official figures listing 1,792 cases and 625 deaths. German Health Ministry says there is no danger to the general population or other patients at the Frankfurt hospital, and the risk of an infected person entering Germany remains very low. Earlier in May, another American with Ebola and his family were quarantined at Berlin’s Charité; that patient reportedly recovered after roughly two weeks. The United States has asked for Germany’s assistance, citing medical expertise and shorter flight times from the outbreak region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに感染したアメリカ人がドイツで治療
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行（症例1,792件、死亡625件）に関連し、感染者が国際搬送され複数国に影響が及んでいるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクの発生源はDRCであり、ドイツ・米国は感染者の搬送先・出身国であるため対象国リストには含めない。ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyo株であることも重症度・拡大リスクを高める要因。

article.articleHeadline: عالم أوبئة: الحجم الحقيقي لتفشي إيبولا أكبر من المعلن..والتفشي لا يزال محدودًا بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An epidemiologist: The true size of the Ebola outbreak is larger than announced... and the outbreak remains confined to Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, WHO officials warn the Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Congo may be 2–4 times larger than official tallies, with most new infections not linked to known cases. Dr. Islam Anan, epidemiology professor, says WHO’s back‑of‑the‑envelope method estimates one observed case for every five infections. If official counts reach 1,700, the true burden could be about 7,000; if 600 deaths, actual fatalities may total 1,700–2,000. Transmission per case remains high, around three new infections (R≈3), with some outbreaks up to 3.5; reducing this to roughly 1.5–2 is key to ending the outbreak, potentially yielding 5,000–6,000 total cases. The case fatality rate is about 25%. Despite higher lethality, Ebola’s spread has been confined to Ituri and has not spread beyond Congo, unlike COVID-19 whose transmission is broader but less deadly.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学者:エボラ流行の実際の規模は公表より大きい…流行はコンゴ国内に限定
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ・イツリ州でのエボラ流行が公式発表の2〜4倍規模である可能性があり、致死率約25%、R≈3と高い伝播力を示しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19とエボラを比較する文脈で言及しているが、主題は現在進行中のコンゴ・イツリ州エボラ流行の実際の規模に関する専門家の警告であり、COVID-19自体の新規発生情報ではない。国際的拡大については明確に『コンゴ国内に限定』と記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Do Nemecka previezli ďalšieho Američana, ktorý sa v KDR nakazil ebolou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another American who contracted Ebola in the DRC was transported to Germany.
article.articleSummary: Second American infected with Ebola in the DRC was flown to Germany for treatment, arriving in Frankfurt late Monday and admitted to a university hospital. This follows the first American treated in Germany about two months earlier at Berlin’s Charité; that patient’s condition was critical during transit but stabilized and he was discharged after roughly two weeks. The case involves the Bundibugyo variant driving the current outbreak, confirmed by the U.S. CDC in a citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the DRC. The Frankfurt hospital reported the patient had compatible symptoms and is currently stable. End of June saw Europe’s first Bundibugyo case in France—a health worker returning from eastern Congo—who was isolated on arrival and released earlier this month. In the DRC, 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths; 753 people are hospitalized or in isolation. Africa CDC notes this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツにコンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスに感染した別のアメリカ人が搬送された
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続しており、致死率の高い深刻な公衆衛生事案であり、複数の国際医療搬送（独・仏）を伴う国際的拡大が確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでの流行は1,926症例・702死亡、753人が入院/隔離中。ブンディブギョ株はアフリカCDCにより史上最速拡大の流行と評価されている。ドイツ・フランス・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外したが、国際的拡大の重要な指標として本文に記載。

article.articleHeadline: خبير يحذر العدد الحقيقي لمصابي إيبولا قد يتجاوز 7 آلاف والوفيات مرشحة للارتفاع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An expert warns that the true number of Ebola cases may exceed 7,000, and deaths are likely to rise.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province may include more than 7,000 cases, with deaths likely to rise. An expert told Egyptian TV that unobserved cases exist, suggesting only about one in five infections are detected. The case fatality rate could reach 25%. The current outbreak remains confined to Ituri and has not spread to other regions. The circulating strain appears less virulent than earlier ones. Initial symptoms resemble influenza—fever, headache, fatigue—before progressing to severe illness with internal and external bleeding in some patients. Prompt diagnosis and treatment are said to significantly improve survival chances. The article emphasizes surveillance gaps and the need for rapid detection to control transmission, as unrecorded infections could sustain hidden chains of transmission even while the outbreak remains geographically limited.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、エボラ出血熱の実際の感染者数は7000人を超える可能性があり、死者数はさらに増加する見込みと警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクについて、専門家が実際の感染者数が公式報告を大幅に上回る可能性（7000人超、致死率25%）を警告しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はエジプトのテレビ番組で専門家が発言した内容を報じたもので、発生地はあくまでDRCイトゥリ州。エジプトは発信地に過ぎず、感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。未検出感染者による隠れた感染連鎖の継続が懸念されており、続報の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Evacúan a Alemania a un segundo estadounidense contagiado de Ébola en la República del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A second American infected with Ebola in the Republic of the Congo is evacuated to Germany.
article.articleSummary: Second American infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo evacuated to Germany for specialized care. The patient arrived Sunday at Frankfurt University Hospital and remains isolated; authorities say symptoms are compatible with Ebola and the condition is stable. The U.S. CDC identified the evacuee as a humanitarian worker in the DRC, with few additional details released. In the DRC, authorities report 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases and 702 deaths, with 753 in isolation and 318 recoveries. The response extends across Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, with surveillance, detection, treatment, and community engagement ongoing. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to transmission risk. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no vaccine or approved treatment. The DRC recently ended its Kasai outbreak in December 2025; Uganda has reported two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラに感染した2人目のアメリカ人がドイツへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、確定症例1,926例・死亡702例と規模が大きく、国際搬送や近隣国での死亡例も報告されており国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEICを宣言済み。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行でワクチン・承認治療法なし。ウガンダでも死亡例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ドイツは搬送先であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - Ebola: un nouveau patient américain soigné en Allemagne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - Ebola: a new American patient treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: An American patient infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is being treated in Germany at the request of the United States. The patient arrived in Frankfurt overnight and was transported to the University Hospital in the city, where he is currently under care; authorities gave no further details on his condition. Since mid-May, the DRC has declared its 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, for which there is neither vaccine nor specific treatment. Congolese health authorities’ latest tally, published Thursday, lists 1,792 infections and 625 deaths linked to this outbreak. No laboratory confirmation details are provided in the report. The case represents an imported patient from the ongoing Ebola outbreak centered in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:新たなアメリカ人患者がドイツで治療中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行（1,792感染、625死亡、ワクチン・特効薬なし）に関連し、患者がドイツへ国際搬送されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCで感染し治療目的でドイツへ搬送された事例。実際の発生地はDRCであり、ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Trung Quốc ghi nhận gần 80.000 ca COVID-19 trong tháng 6
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China reports nearly 80,000 COVID-19 cases in June.
article.articleSummary: China's CDC reports COVID-19 cases in June approached 80,000, with about 79,000 new infections across 31 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities in 2026. There were 130 severe cases and one death in a patient with underlying conditions infected by SARS-CoV-2. The month rose steadily. Hospital surveillance found SARS-CoV-2 positivity among inpatients rising from 2.9% in early June to 6.4% by month’s end. Genomic sequencing of 3,741 samples showed all Omicron variants, with NB.1.8.1 and sublineages predominating (95.9–98.8%). No evidence of a new variant with greater public health risk. In the week 29 Jun–5 Jul, influenza accounted for 11.6% of positive respiratory tests, SARS-CoV-2 for 9.6%, and enterovirus for 9.1%. Health authorities advise masking in healthcare settings, crowded places, and public transport, especially for the elderly and chronically ill, and urge vaccination for high-risk groups. Separately, researchers report an oral COVID-19 drug with activity against Nipah virus.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、6月のCOVID-19感染者数が約8万人に達したと報告
triage.triage_reason: 既知のオミクロン系統による季節性の感染者数増加であり、新規変異株や重症化率の上昇は確認されていない定例サーベイランス報告のため。
triage.notes: 全31省・自治区・直轄市での約7.9万件の新規感染、重症130件、死亡1件（基礎疾患あり）。ゲノム解析ではオミクロン系統（NB.1.8.1等）が優勢で、公衆衛生リスクが高い新変異株の証拠はなし。ニパウイルスへの経口COVID-19薬の効果に関する研究は別件として言及されているが本イベントの主題ではない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Britons will be injected with EBOLA 'within weeks' in vaccine trial
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda has caused about 645 deaths and around 1,800 confirmed cases by early July 2026; Europe has one confirmed case in France. The US CDC reports about 100 fatalities in the first week of July. Oxford University will launch a phase 1 vaccine trial in the UK, testing on 50 volunteers aged 18–55 within weeks; Uganda may follow, adding around 20 confirmed cases. The Serum Institute of India–developed vaccine uses a harmless vector to deliver Bundibugy o genetic material to prompt antibody production; MHRA approved it after testing in mice and macaque monkeys. This is the first human test of this vaccine, eight weeks after development, with safety monitored for up to a year. Three other vaccines are in development (Moderna with mRNA, IAVI, Public Health Vaccines). Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood/bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces; incubation up to 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 英国民、数週間以内にエボラワクチン試験で接種へ
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダでのブンディブギョ・エボラアウトブレイクが645人の死者・1800例の確定例を出し、フランスでも症例確認と国際的拡大が見られるため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダでの大規模エボラアウトブレイクとその国際的拡大（フランス症例、米国での死亡報告）、及び英国でのワクチン第1相試験開始を報じている。インドはワクチン開発元（Serum Institute of India）としての言及のみで、アウトブレイク発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。米国・フランス・英国・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Oxford begins first human trial of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine, Germany treats infected US citizen
article.articleSummary: Oxford launches the first human trial of the Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine BD-Ebov (ChAdOx1 BDBV), enrolling 50 healthy adults (18–55) in Oxford to assess safety and immune response; vaccinations are expected in coming weeks pending regulatory approval. The vaccine uses the same viral-vector platform as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 shot; Serum Institute of India has about 620,000 doses stockpiled and supplied 4,000 investigational doses for the study. WHO urges prioritization of ChAdOx1 BDBV alongside the rVSV Bundibugyo candidate for evaluation, with CEPI pledging up to $8.6 million to support development. Uganda trials are planned with MRC/Uganda Virus Research Institute and LSHTM Uganda Research Unit, pending approvals. In Germany, a US citizen treated for Bundibugyo Ebola contracted in Congo was admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital in isolation; patient is in stable condition. Congo’s outbreak totals 1,926 cases and 702 deaths, with spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo; a US patient discharged in June from Berlin.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学がブンディブギョ型エボラワクチンの初のヒト臨床試験を開始、ドイツでは感染した米国人を治療
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（1,926症例・702死亡）が拡大し、ドイツへの越境感染例も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: インドはワクチン製造・供給元（Serum Institute of India）としての言及のみであり、実際の症例発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。英国・ドイツ・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nemecko prijalo ďalšieho Američana nakazeného ebolou v KDR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany admitted another American infected with Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Second American humanitarian worker infected with Ebola, Bundibugyo variant, arrived at Frankfurt am Main and was hospitalized in stable condition after being infected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. This follows the earlier May transfer of a first American patient to Berlin's Charité; he was critically ill en route and, after about two weeks of treatment, discharged. The Bundibugyo variant is driving the current outbreak in the DRC, which has 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases and 702 deaths; 753 people are in hospital or in isolation as of July 13, 2026. In Europe, France reported the first Bundibugyo case in late June, a healthcare worker returning from eastern Congo; isolated at once and discharged in early July. Africa CDC says this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人をさらに1名受け入れ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が拡大しており（確定症例1,926人、死亡702人）、Africa CDCが史上最速の流行と指摘。ドイツ・フランスへの国際的な症例輸出も発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ドイツ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし国際的な症例輸出が発生している点はIHR基準の国際拡大リスクとして重要。DRCでの流行規模（症例数・死亡数・院内隔離者数）が急速に拡大している点に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak spreads as German hospital treats infected Congo patient
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, has spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo, raising total confirmed cases to 1,926 with 702 deaths as of July 11. Four Tshopo cases (two deaths) and one Haut-Uele death were reported, with authorities cautioning these provinces as an epidemic zone and noting most new cases imported from Niania in Ituri. The outbreak centers in Ituri, with spillovers to North Kivu and South Kivu. A U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization contracted Bundibugyo Ebola virus and was admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital in isolation around 03:00 local time; condition stable. The U.S. CDC confirmed another U.S. patient treated in Congo and later Berlin, also infected with Bundibugyo virus. WHO says the true scale may be 2–4 times higher due to many new cases lacking links to known patients. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids; early symptoms include fever, headache, and muscle pain; later vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, rash, and bleeding; mortality around 60% for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大、ドイツの病院がコンゴからの感染患者を治療
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行が新たな州へ拡大し感染者数・死者数が増加、さらに感染者がドイツへ搬送され国際的拡大が確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 感染者が国際搬送されドイツ・米国でも治療例が報告されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。WHOは実際の症例数が報告の2〜4倍の可能性を指摘しており、監視強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Makin Luas, Wabah Ebola di Kongo Menyebar ke Dua Provinsi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Kongo widens, spreads to two provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo expands to Haut-Uele and Tshopo, provinces. As of 12 July 2026, confirmed Ebola cases nationwide total 1,926 with 702 deaths. In Tshopo, four cases have been reported, including two deaths; Haut-Uele has one death confirmed as of 11 July. The outbreak, the 17th in the country, was first announced on 15 May, with most cases in Ituri and additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals, causing fever, vomiting, and bleeding. A WHO official cautions the true scale may be 2-4 times higher than official counts, since four of five new cases lack known links to existing patients. Authorities are tracing contacts in Tshopo and Haut-Uele, though these provinces were not yet in daily government updates. Kisangani is the capital of Tshopo; Haut-Uele borders South Sudan and Central African Republic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が拡大、2州に拡散
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（1,926症例、702死亡）が新たに2州に拡大し、感染経路不明の症例が多数存在するためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: WHO当局者は実際の感染規模が公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘。新規症例の5分の4が既知患者との関連が不明であり、ヒト-ヒト感染追跡が困難な状況。国境を接する南スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国への越境リスクも懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 暑假出國注意！返國驗登革熱領500元 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer break travel abroad: Return to the country to get tested for dengue fever and receive 500 yuan.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-13, Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, launched a dengue fever prevention campaign amid peak summer travel and return flows. Dengue imported from Southeast Asia poses community transmission risks; authorities urge travelers returning from Vietnam, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore, and Cambodia to seek rapid testing if symptomatic within 14 days of return, while asymptomatic individuals are encouraged to visit district health centers for testing. A 500 yuan voucher is offered to those who complete testing. The program also distributes free anti-mosquito repellent to students below university level, new immigrants, and foreign workers before travel or return, and promotes protective measures such as wearing light-colored long-sleeve clothing. The core aim is early detection and diagnosis to prevent imported dengue from triggering local transmission, achieved through collaboration among city and central governments, medical institutions, schools, and NGOs.

triage.headline_ja: 夏休みの海外渡航に注意！帰国後にデング熱検査を受けると500元がもらえる
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市における季節性のデング熱予防・啓発キャンペーンに関する記事であり、特定国での異常な流行やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（対象国外）における輸入デング熱予防のための定例的公衆衛生キャンペーンについてであり、ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピン・タイ等は渡航先として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生・流行を報じるものではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kumar Sanu's son Jaan hospitalised after testing Covid-positive, cracks China joke
article.articleSummary: Jaan Kumar Sanu, son of veteran playback singer Kumar Sanu, has been hospitalised in Mumbai after testing positive for COVID-19. He posted a video from Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital on July 12 confirming the diagnosis and lightening the news with a joke: 'China se aaya mera dost' and a Wuhan reference in the caption. In the clip, he gives a 'fit check' of his hospital attire and quips that Kokilaben is his designer, noting admission for COVID-19. He did not reveal when symptoms began or how long the stay will last. A singer and former Bigg Boss 14 contestant, he frequently shares music and life updates. This report is current as of July 13, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: クマール・サヌの息子ジャーン、コロナ陽性で入院しつつ中国ジョークを飛ばす
triage.triage_reason: 有名人個人のCOVID-19感染に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 個人の芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生イベントとしての重大性はない。武漢や中国への言及はジョークであり実際の発生地域とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Bangun Fasilitas Karantina Ebola hanya 3 Hari, Satgas Kizi TNI Konga Diganjar Penghargaan PBB - Zona Jakarta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Built Ebola quarantine facilities in just three days, Satgas Kizi TNI Konga awarded a UN award - Jakarta Zone
article.articleSummary: On July 13, 2026, MONUSCO mission support Director Nicoleta Verestiuc awarded Indonesian peacekeeping engineers for rapid Ebola quarantine facility construction in Mavivi, Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Ebola quarantine facility was completed in three days, dramatically faster than the customary ten days, by the Garuda Contingent's Zeni Engineering Task Force. Verestiuc praised Lt. Col. Czi Tommy J.O. Sunggu and Maj. Czi Edwin Handitya Murdiantoro for leadership and tactical coordination that enabled timely completion and personnel safety. The collaboration between MONUSCO civilian and military components facilitated critical infrastructure work under the UN mandate. The award recognized improved readiness and contribution to Ebola outbreak response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ検疫施設をわずか3日で建設、TNI Konga即応部隊（Satgas Kizi）が国連表彰を受賞 - Jakarta Zone
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ検疫施設建設に対するインドネシア平和維持部隊への国連表彰を報じる人事・活動紹介記事であり、新規の症例数・拡大状況等の疫学的シグナルは含まれていない。
triage.notes: インドネシアはBluedotが誤って発生地域に含めているが、実際の事案地はDRCベニ（北キブ州）であり、インドネシアは平和維持部隊派遣国に過ぎない。記事はエボラ流行そのものの新規情報を含まず、既知のDRCエボラ対応活動における表彰報道である。

article.articleHeadline: वाराणसी में म‍िला कोरोना का मरीज, सांस लेने में द‍िक्‍कत होने पर जांच में सामने आया चौंकाने वाला तथ्‍य - corona patient found in varanasi shocking facts revealed in the investigation after breathing difficulties
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A COVID-19 patient found in Varanasi; a shocking fact revealed in the investigation after breathing difficulties.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, a 27-year-old man from the Ashapur locality in Varanasi tested positive for COVID-19 after breathing difficulties and was admitted to the Chest and TB Department at the Institute of Medical Sciences, Banaras Hindu University (BHU-IMS) for observation. Officials say the coronavirus persists. The report explains that earlier a novel variant circulated with few antibodies in the population, but vaccination and prior infections have since boosted antibody levels, making current infections generally less severe. Nevertheless, individuals with weak immunity remain at higher risk, though serious illness is less common. Family members are being monitored, with no symptoms reported so far. The case underscores that COVID-19 remains in circulation and ongoing vigilance and immune health are important.

triage.headline_ja: ワーラーナシーでコロナ患者が見つかる、呼吸困難で調査したところ衝撃の事実が判明
triage.triage_reason: 単一のCOVID-19散発症例で重症度も低く、異常性・国際的拡大リスクも認められないため見送り。
triage.notes: 単発の軽症例報告であり、COVID-19は流行状態ではなく通常の感染継続を示す内容。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Behandlung in Deutschland: Zweiter mit Ebola infizierter US-Bürger wird in Deutschland behandelt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola treatment in Germany: The second Ebola-infected US citizen is being treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-infected US citizen is being treated in Germany, marking the second US national to be treated there. The patient arrived at Frankfurt Airport overnight and is receiving care on a dedicated isolation ward at a university hospital; officials said there is no danger to the public or other patients. About two months earlier, a first Ebola patient from the United States was treated at Berlin's Charité and released in early June. The CDC previously reported the infection is due to the Bundibugyo variant. The patient is a US citizen who works for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo; gender was not disclosed. The article will be updated as more information becomes available.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療:ドイツで2人目のエボラ感染米国人患者が治療中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)由来のエボラ感染者が国境を越えてドイツで治療されており、IHR基準の複数（重大性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価に進めるべきである。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCで人道支援活動に従事していた米国人で、感染源はDRCのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）とみられる。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC国内の流行状況について続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Trung Quốc ghi nhận gần 80.000 ca COVID-19 trong tháng 6
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China records nearly 80,000 COVID-19 cases in June.
article.articleSummary: China’s CDC reports a rising June 2026 COVID-19 wave with about 79,000 new cases across 31 provincial-level regions. The month saw 130 severe cases and one death in a patient with underlying conditions co-infected with SARS-CoV-2. Hospital surveillance indicates SARS-CoV-2 positivity rising from 2.9% in early June to 6.4% by month end. Genomic sequencing of 3,741 samples in June all belonged to the Omicron lineage, dominated by NB.1.8.1 and sublineages at 95.9–98.8% across four weeks. There is no current evidence of a new variant increasing public health risk. For the week of 29 June–5 July, influenza was the most detected pathogen (11.6% of positives), followed by SARS-CoV-2 (9.6%) and enteroviruses (9.1%). Public health guidance urges masking in healthcare facilities, crowded places, and public transit, especially for older adults and those with chronic diseases; high-risk groups should consider vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、6月にCOVID-19感染者約8万人を記録
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19増加であり既知のOmicron系統(NB.1.8.1)による流行で新規変異株の証拠もないが、陽性率上昇傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる定期サーベイランス報告。既知のOmicron系統が優勢で新変異株の証拠なし。重症例130件、死亡1例（基礎疾患あり）と重症度は低い。季節性流行として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يمتد إلى إقليمين آخرين في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Ebola" spreads to two more provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to two additional provinces, Out-Wili and Choobo, though investigations indicate most cases there originated from Nianiya in Ituri; these provinces are to be considered part of the outbreak. The rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain has now reached five eastern provinces, with hundreds of deaths reported in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The DRC tallies stand at 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths. Germany has transferred a second American national—working for a humanitarian organization in the DRC—to a Frankfurt university hospital for treatment after testing positive for Bundibugyo. The first American patient arrived in Germany in May and was treated at Charité in Berlin, with critical condition during transport and discharged after about two weeks. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo at present.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」がコンゴ民主共和国のさらに2州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 確認症例1,873例・死亡672例に達し、稀なブンディブギョ株が5州に拡大、さらに患者がドイツへ搬送されるなど国際的波及も確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ドイツへの患者搬送は国際拡大の一例だが、ドイツは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsには含めていない。渡航・貿易制限に関する記載はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 1,873 केस और 672 मौतें: इबोला वायरस ने बढ़ाई वैश्विक चिंता, क्या फिर बन रहा है बड़ा स्वास्थ्य संकट?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,873 cases and 672 deaths: The Ebola virus has heightened global concern—Is a major health crisis forming again?
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 1,873 cases and 672 deaths. The outbreak spans five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo (Shopo)—with Haut-Uele and Tshopo newly added to the national tally; many new cases are linked to movement and contacts from Ituri. Hospitals and isolation centers are strained, with 763 patients admitted and 95.1% of beds occupied. So far, 306 patients have recovered, while among 299 suspected cases, 91 deaths have occurred. An American humanitarian aid worker has been infected, triggering intensified contact tracing and investigations by Africa CDC. Health workers account for 112 infections and 35 deaths. Ebola spreads through body fluids and causes fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes internal or external bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 1,873例と672人の死亡：エボラウイルスが世界的懸念を高める—再び大きな健康危機となりつつあるのか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5州にわたる大規模エボラ流行が拡大しており、死亡率が高く医療従事者にも感染が広がっている。米国人援助従事者の感染も確認され国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 病床占有率95.1%、医療従事者112人感染・35人死亡と医療体制逼迫。米国人援助従事者感染によりAfrica CDCが接触者調査を強化。北キブ州も影響地域に含まれるが対象国リストにはコンゴ民主共和国のみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Khoảng trống trong tầm soát bệnh lao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gaps in TB screening.
article.articleSummary: TB, now increasingly affecting working-age adults in Nghệ An Province, Vietnam, with Nghệ An Lung Hospital reporting 6–10% of inpatients treated for TB. A representative case: N.T.D., 35, from Do Luong commune, admitted with severe pulmonary tuberculosis after months of persistent cough, fatigue, and weight loss; he self-medicated and delayed medical care, and lacks health insurance, exacerbating economic hardship. Experts note a trend of younger patients; TB in this group stems from study/work pressure, long hours, inadequate nutrition, smoking, alcohol, and crowded living conditions, which impair immunity. TB often begins silently; symptoms such as a cough lasting over two weeks, evening fever, night sweats, fatigue, weight loss, or chest pain are easily overlooked as colds or bronchitis, until coughing up blood or severe dyspnea prompts hospitalization. The article highlights the need to strengthen TB screening at the primary-care level to close gaps in early detection.

triage.headline_ja: 結核検診の空白
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に関する啓発・診療体制の課題を扱う記事であり、異常な集団発生や急性の公衆衛生危機を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 個別症例と一般的な検診体制の課題を報じる記事であり、アウトブレイクの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Σε γερμανικό νοσοκομείο Αμερικανός που διαγνώστηκε με Έμπολα μετά την παραμονή του στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In a German hospital, an American diagnosed with Ebola after his stay in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with the Ebola virus Bundibugyo variant was admitted to University Hospital Frankfurt’s isolation unit early on Monday, July 13, 2026, after contracting the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The 60-year-old Samaritan’s Purse employee, working as a warehouse supervisor in Congo, arrived at about 3 a.m. in full isolation; his condition is currently stable. U.S. CDC had announced a few days earlier that another American humanitarian worker in Congo tested positive for Ebola Bundibugyo. The hospital stressed there is no risk to the public or other patients. Congo’s outbreak has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with spread extending to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces. In June, a separate American treated in Berlin after Congo infection was discharged, highlighting cross-border management of imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツの病院で、コンゴ滞在後にエボラ出血熱と診断されたアメリカ人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で拡大中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが1,926症例・702死亡に達し、複数州へ拡大、さらに米国人感染者がドイツへ搬送されるなど国際的拡大が確認されているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国で発生しているエボラアウトブレイクであり、ドイツ・米国は輸入症例の治療地であるため対象国リストには含めない。コンゴでの症例数（1,926例）・死亡数（702例）は非常に深刻であり、複数州への拡大と国際的な症例輸出（米・独）が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Do Nemecka previezli ďalšieho Američana, ktorý sa v KDR nakazil ebolou - Svet - Správy - pravda.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another American who contracted Ebola in the DRC was transported to Germany
article.articleSummary: An American humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for the Ebola Bundibugyo variant and was transported to Germany, with Frankfurt University Hospital noting symptoms and a stable condition. Separately, an American physician transported from the DRC to Germany on May 20 was treated at Berlin’s Charité; he was critically ill during transit but discharged after about two weeks. In Europe, late June saw the first Bundibugyo case in France, a male aid worker returning from eastern Congo who was isolated and released earlier this month. In the DRC, through last Sunday there have been 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with 753 patients currently in hospital or isolation. Health officials emphasize this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history, faster than previous Bundibugyo and other Ebola-virus outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラに感染した別のアメリカ人がドイツに搬送される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続し、感染者数・死者数とも多く、複数の患者が国際搬送されるなど国際的拡大がみられるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ドイツ・フランスへの患者搬送は国際的拡大の証左だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRC国内での症例数・死者数が主要な公衆衛生上の懸念点。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: University of Oxford tests new vaccine developed in UK
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues; the Bundibugyo epidemic is already the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record, with rising infection numbers as of 57 days since WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern. The University of Oxford is testing a new Ebola vaccine (ChAdOx1 BDBV) developed in the UK, using the same technology as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. In a UK study, 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 will be assessed for safety and immune response; monitoring extends to one year. To support rapid development, 620,000 doses are stockpiled for potential future use and 4,000 investigational doses are supplied for the trial. Researchers are also collaborating with partners in Uganda to prepare for trials in Africa. Teresa Lambe leads the study; Cepi emphasizes urgency of a safe, effective vaccine to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：オックスフォード大学が英国で開発された新ワクチンを試験
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ・エボラアウトブレイクはWHOによりPHEICが宣言されており、史上3番目の規模で感染者数も増加中であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクの継続とワクチン開発（英国オックスフォード大学主導、ウガンダとの試験協力準備）に関するもの。ウガンダは今後の試験実施準備段階であり、現時点で発生国とは確認できないため verified_locations には含めない。UKは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad Doctors Save 32-Year-Old Woman Doctor With Advanced ECMO Treatment After Severe Influenza Pneumonia
article.articleSummary: In Hyderabad, doctors at KIMS Hospitals treated a 32-year-old woman from Solapur, Maharashtra, for severe ARDS after influenza pneumonia, using advanced ECMO support and comprehensive critical care. The patient was admitted in Solapur with high fever and severe breathing difficulty and deteriorated despite mechanical ventilation. The KIMS ECMO retrieval team, led by Dr. Vamsi Krishna, travelled to Solapur, initiated ECMO at the referring hospital, and transferred her overnight by road to KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, on ECMO. After 25 days of treatment and rehabilitation, she made a full recovery and was discharged in stable condition.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバードの医師団、重症インフルエンザ性肺炎の32歳女性医師をECMO治療で救命
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の医療対応に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態やアウトブレイクを示す内容ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 個別患者の治療成功事例であり、アウトブレイクやクラスター発生の報告ではない。季節性インフルエンザの重症例と考えられる。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola vaccine breakthrough as Oxford launches first jab against outbreak
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with 1,792 laboratory-confirmed infections and 625 deaths. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern about 57 days ago, marking it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Oxford University has rapidly developed ChAdOx1 BDBV, a vaccine using the same chimpanzee adenovirus platform as the AstraZeneca Covid shot, and has stockpiled about 620,000 doses manufactured at the Serum Institute of the India. The UK regulator granted a first safety trial in 50 healthy adults (18–55), with a year-long monitoring plan and rapid assessment of protective immune responses; a second trial is planned in Uganda. There are no approved vaccines or drugs for Bundibugyo Ebola. Potential rare clot risk similar to the AstraZeneca vaccine is acknowledged, and volunteers will be fully informed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチンに進展、オックスフォード大学がアウトブレイク対策として初の治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のBundibugyoエボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクはWHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、感染者1,792人・死者625人と規模が大きく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が継続しているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はオックスフォード大学によるワクチン開発（ChAdOx1 BDBV）だが、背景としてDRCでの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（PHEIC宣言済み、史上3番目の規模）が継続していることを示す続報。Indiaはワクチン製造拠点（Serum Institute of India）としての言及のみで発生国ではないため除外。Ugandaは第二相治験予定地としての言及のみで対象国リストに含まれず、また発生国でもないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola se propaga "más rápido" que los anteriores, advierte la Unión Africana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading faster than previous outbreaks, the African Union warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than previous outbreaks, according to Africa CDC. As of the current epidemic, 1,759 confirmed cases have produced 600 deaths in the DRC. In neighboring Uganda, 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths are reported. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and there is no vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. The DRC has experienced 17 Ebola outbreaks to date. The World Health Organization’s situation report dated July 7 highlights that the virus is outpacing response efforts. The most deadly outbreak on record occurred in West Africa from 2013 to 2016, with more than 11,300 deaths among about 29,000 cases, predominantly in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. The report does not specify infection sources or details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの流行、過去よりも「速いスピード」で拡大とアフリカ連合が警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）が急速に拡大し、ウガンダにも波及、致死率も高くワクチン・特異的治療法がないためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも患者発生地域だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン・治療法がない点、拡大速度が過去より速い点がAfrica CDC/WHOにより指摘されており、国際的懸念が高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: First patients enrolled in record-breaking Ebola treatment trial in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Ituri region has 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths as of 9 July. The PARTNERS adaptive randomized trial in DR Congo enrolled first patients, testing remdesivir and MBP134 alone, in combination, or in other arms. The study launched six weeks after WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. An Oxford-developed vaccine against Bundibugyo, using a chimpanzee adenovirus vector, received UK MHRA approval for phase 1 trials in healthy adults; Serum Institute of India has manufactured about 620,000 doses and will supply African trials via Uganda partners. The vaccine aims to trigger production of an Ebola protein to elicit immunity; no vaccine exists for Bundibugyo yet. Other vaccines and platforms (e.g., Moderna’s mRNA approach) are under development. The outbreak persists in conflict zones with mobile populations, hindering control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で記録的なエボラ治療薬の治験に初の患者が登録
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC(国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態)を宣言済みの大規模エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクであり、症例数・死亡者数ともに多く、紛争地域での制御困難な状況が続いているため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイツリ州でのエボラ(ブンディブギョ種)アウトブレイクに関するもので、既にWHOがPHEICを宣言済み。ウガンダ・インド・英国はワクチン開発・供給関連の言及であり、発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس نادر يعود للظهور في الهند ويسبب وفيات بين الأطفال
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A rare virus re-emerges in India and causes deaths among children.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus, first identified in 1965 in Maharashtra, belongs to the Rhabdoviridae family. It re-emerged in India with three child deaths in Gujarat's Panchmahal district and a six-year-old hospitalized in Himatnagar; authorities are assessing additional Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES) cases after two earlier deaths in Panchmahal. The virus is tied to AES, a severe brain inflammation that can progress rapidly. Transmission occurs via bites of sandflies (Phlebotomus); human-to-human spread is not established. Some studies suggest ticks could participate, but sandflies remain the main vector. Outbreaks are rare in India but have occurred in rural areas during the monsoon season. The report does not mention vaccination or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 稀なウイルスがインドで再出現し、子どもたちの間で死亡例が発生
triage.triage_reason: チャンディプラウイルスによる急性脳炎症候群で子どもの死亡例が複数報告されているが、検査確定情報やヒト-ヒト感染の証拠がなく、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスは季節性にモンスーン期のインド農村部で散発的に発生する既知の病原体だが、小児死亡例の集積があるため経過観察が必要。検査確定・感染経路の詳細情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴのエボラ熱、北東部2州に拡大　南スーダンや中央アフリカに隣接
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus disease in the Congo expands to two northeastern provinces, bordering South Sudan and the Central African Republic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has expanded from Ituri and neighboring North Kivu and South Kivu to the northeastern Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces, which border South Sudan and the Central African Republic. The outbreak, declared May 15 as the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country, remains centered in Ituri, with spillover reported in North and South Kivu. A public health institute report dated July 11 notes that cases detected in Haut-Uele and Tshopo are, in current investigations, likely imported from Ituri’s Niania, but it is appropriate to treat both provinces as part of the outbreak zone. Late June, authorities began tracing potentially exposed individuals in these provinces. As of July 11-12, official data show 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths nationwide; Tshopo reported 4 infections (2 deaths) and Haut-Uele 1 death.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱、北東部2州に拡大　南スーダンや中央アフリカに隣接
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国の第17次エボラ流行が南スーダン・中央アフリカ国境に近い北東部2州に拡大し、感染者数・死亡者数も多く国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内のエボラ流行拡大が主題。マリ、中央アフリカ共和国、南スーダンは国境近接の言及のみで、感染事例が確認されているわけではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: تحذير أميركي من السفر إلى الكونغو بعد إصابة عامل إغاثة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. warning against travel to Congo after an aid worker contracted Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, Ebola virus disease prompts a U.S. travel warning for the Democratic Republic of Congo. Americans are urged to avoid travel; travelers exposed to Ebola must quarantine outside Congo for up to 21 days at their own expense. The U.S. embassy in Kinshasa says Washington will provide life-saving medical care to exposed citizens, but it does not specify whether humanitarian or medical workers are covered. The outbreak has spread to five provinces, with Ituri accounting for more than 90% of cases, and adds in Tshopo and Haut-Uele. Last week, 365 new infections were reported, including 151 entering treatment centers on Wednesday, bringing confirmed cases to 1,926 and deaths to 702. A second American aid worker has been infected. Separately, a patient infected with Ebola arrived in Frankfurt for treatment; in May, surgeon Peter Stafford was treated in Germany before returning to the United States.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、援助従事者のエボラ感染を受けコンゴへの渡航を警告

triage.notes: 米国およびドイツ（フランクフルト）は患者搬送・治療先として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC国内でイツリ州が症例の90%以上を占め、チョポ州・オートウエレ州にも拡大している。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ébola: Epidemia avança sem travões e crenças esotéricas e feiticismo estão a ajudar no seu alastramento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: The Ebola epidemic is spreading unchecked, and esoteric beliefs and witchcraft are aiding its spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province with spread to North and South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele) driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Declared May 15 in Ituri near Uganda and South Sudan; by June 13, official counts reached 702 deaths and 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases (up from 580/1,700). As of July 11, 753 patients were in isolation or hospital, with 318 recoveries and a case fatality around 36.4%. Transmission continues through direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include high fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. Uganda reports 20 cases (15 imported from DRC, including two deaths). Contact tracing is 78.3% in affected eastern provinces. WHO classifies regional risk as high for sub-Saharan Africa and low globally. Local belief in traditional cures and witchcraft hampers containment efforts and early detection; authorities emphasize improved detection, care, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ:感染拡大は歯止めがかからず、呪術的信仰が拡散を助長
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で致死率36.4%のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・特効薬なし)が複数州に拡大し、ウガンダへの越境例も確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Many Filipinos still mistake TB for an ordinary cough, expert says
article.articleSummary: TB in the Philippines remains under-recognized, with many patients delaying care, mistaking TB for a common cough. Dr. Calapis, speaking at APAC-IRIDS 2026 in Bangkok (July 8–9), urges those with a cough lasting more than two weeks, unexplained fever, or weight loss to seek care. TB is preventable and curable. High-risk groups include household contacts of TB patients, people living with HIV, diabetics, and residents of crowded or low-income communities. The DOH National Tuberculosis Program conducts active case finding with local government support, using mobile chest X-ray vans to screen communities; suspicious cases provide sputum for lab testing via the specimen referral system. TB services have been expanded at health centers for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up, with IEC materials and videos to raise awareness and encourage early care.

triage.headline_ja: 多くのフィリピン人が結核を単なる咳と誤解している、と専門家が指摘

article.articleHeadline: Can walking through floodwater make you sick? All about Leptospirosis
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis, a bacterial infection caused by Leptospira, is highlighted as a major risk during the monsoon floodwater in Mumbai, India, as of 13 July 2026. Contaminated water—mixed with urine from infected animals, especially rats—can enter the body through broken skin or mucous membranes (eyes, nose, mouth). Symptoms typically appear a few days to two weeks after exposure and resemble flu: fever, severe calf muscle pain, headache, chills, vomiting, weakness; severe cases may involve kidneys, liver, lungs, or brain. Early diagnosis and antibiotic treatment are highly effective. Prevention focuses on avoiding contact with floodwater when possible, wearing waterproof boots, covering wounds, washing exposed skin, and changing clothes promptly. Dr. Sanah Merchant emphasizes that even seemingly clean floodwater can carry bacteria, and seek medical care if fever or severe pain follows exposure.

article.articleHeadline: Shkencëtarët - Shpërthimi i Ebolës: Universiteti i Oksfordit teston vaksinën e re të zhvilluar në Mbretërinë e Bashkuar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists - Ebola Outbreak: University of Oxford tests the new vaccine developed in the United Kingdom.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus, Bundibugyo strain, is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, prompting Oxford University to test a new vaccine candidate, ChAdOx1 BDBV. The UK trial will assess safety and immunogenicity in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55. To support rapid deployment, about 620,000 doses are stockpiled for potential future use, with roughly 4,000 investigational doses allocated for the Oxford study. Researchers are also partnering with Uganda to prepare for trials in Africa. Volunteers will be monitored for one year as scientists seek early signs of protective immunity. The vaccine uses the same platform as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine, enabling rapid development, with Phase I in the coming weeks. The WHO declared the outbreak a PHEIC about 57 days ago; Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks are among the largest, with infections rising.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : ce que l'on sait des médicaments testés sur des patients pour trouver un traitement contre le virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: What We Know About Medications Tested on Patients to Find a Treatment for the Ebola Virus
article.articleSummary: In Ituri, the epicentre of the Democratic Republic of Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, patients have begun the PARTNERS trial to seek a treatment for Bundibugyo virus (MVB). The international adaptive randomized study, sponsored by the World Health Organization and coordinated by the National Institute for Biomedical Research (DRC) along with Belgium's Institute of Tropical Medicine and the University of Oxford, tests two antivirals. MBP134, a monoclonal antibody from Mapp Biopharmaceutical, is given as a single intravenous infusion, while remdesivir (Gilead Sciences) is administered over a ten-day course. The aim is to improve survival in diagnosed MVB infections, noting that there is no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. As of mid-May 2026, the Congo reported about 1,792 cases and 625 deaths. The trial reflects rapid, collaborative efforts to generate concrete results for affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：治療薬発見のため患者に投与されている薬剤について分かっていること

article.articleHeadline: 6月新增新冠确诊病例环比激增近3倍，原因为何？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: June: Newly confirmed COVID-19 cases surge nearly threefold month-on-month; what are the reasons?
article.articleSummary: June 2026 saw 79,000 newly confirmed COVID-19 cases across 31 Chinese provinces and Xinjiang, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (underlying conditions). This follows eight months under 30,000 monthly cases, and represents a 3.61-fold rise from May’s ~21,900 cases. Genome data from 3,741 local sequences identified only Omicron variants, dominated by NB.1.8.1 and sublineages, with no new high-risk variant detected. Experts attribute rising cases to waning population immunity (antibody protection ~4–6 months) and summer mobility, though severe disease and mortality have not increased. Public health guidance remains mask-wearing, hygiene, and vaccination; other respiratory viruses remain active. Guangzhou hospitals offer free COVID testing in pulmonary function rooms for fever patients. Six domestically approved oral antivirals exist (RealBio, Simcere, Junshi, Zhongsheng, Guangsheng Tang, Aisen). Meituan reports a 32% week-on-week rise in COVID-related drug orders (July 6–13), with influenza meds surging regionally and several cities exceeding 40% WoW growth.

triage.notes: 記事は中国国内（広東省・新疆含む31省）のCOVID-19症例増加に関する国内向け医療ニュースであり、既知のOmicron系統（NB.1.8.1等）のみ検出。免疫低下と夏季の人流増加が主因とされ、重症化・死亡率の増加は見られない。インフルエンザ薬の需要増加も併記されているが、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 本港過去一周錄得4宗退伍軍人病個案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four cases of veteran illness recorded in Hong Kong in the past week.
article.articleSummary: Four Legionnaires’ disease cases were reported by the Hong Kong Centre for Health Protection in the past week (July 5–12, 2026), all male aged 66–89 with chronic illnesses. Three are community-acquired in North District, Sham Shui Po and Yuen Long; investigations indicate they are sporadic with no epidemiological links to earlier cases. One hospital-acquired case occurred at Queen Mary Hospital in late June; laboratory testing showed Legionella pneumophila serogroup 1, with 25 water samples collected before disinfection, 3 testing positive in the neurosurgical ICU and intensive care unit at 0.1–0.3 CFU/mL; the patient’s respiratory sample matched the same strain. Environmental samples (15) were negative. Queen Mary Hospital disinfected the affected water system. A second hospital-acquired case at the Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital is under investigation, with 16 water and environmental samples pending. Medical surveillance is ongoing; no secondary cases detected to date.

article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Hong Kong is on an upward trend, per the Hong Kong Medical Association (HKMA). article.articleHeadline: 5.18L Screened, 28K Get Poshan Kits In Odisha's 100-Day TB Drive
article.articleSummary: Odisha's 100-Day TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan 2.0, under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP), ran across all 30 districts from March 24 to July 5, 2026. The drive screened over 518,000 people for tuberculosis and distributed more than 28,000 Poshan Kits to patients; 4,470 TB Screening Shivirs were held, with over 344,000 participants. 9,013 household contacts of TB patients were started on TB Preventive Treatment (TPT). The Ni-kshay Mitra Initiative delivered 28,348 Poshan Kits as nutritional support. The effort emphasized Jan Bhagidari with elected representatives, officials, civil society, and volunteers, alongside health workers to extend screening to vulnerable groups. Campaign concluded July 5, 2026; Odisha commits to sustaining momentum toward TB elimination with timely diagnosis, quality treatment, preventive care, and comprehensive support for every citizen.

article.articleHeadline: Oksfordi fillon provën e parë të vaksinës për variantin Bundibugyo të Ebolës
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford begins the first vaccine trial for the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant of Ebola is being advanced to clinical testing. Oxford University in the United Kingdom has received regulatory clearance to run vaccine trials, eight weeks after a public health emergency was declared on May 17. This vaccine is the first of four in development to enter clinical trials. Doses for initial testing will be given to 50 healthy adults aged 18-55 in the UK within weeks, with Uganda partners preparing for African trials. The Ebola outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, having caused 625 deaths and 1,792 laboratory-confirmed cases; the situation remains uncontrolled in a conflict zone with mobile populations, driving vaccine need. Volunteers will be monitored for one year to evaluate immune responses and any adverse effects, with broader Africa trials planned.
