triage.notes: 記事はオックスフォード大学によるワクチン臨床試験開始が主題だが、背景としてDRCでの大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み、625人死亡、1,792人確定症例、紛争地域で制御困難）が記載されている。ウガンダは今後の試験実施地として言及されているが、現時点でのアウトブレイク発生国はDRCのみ。UK・Africa大陸は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: أستاذ أوبئة: إيبولا يمر بمرحلتين.. والخطورة تبدأ في الرطبة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Epidemiology Professor: Ebola Goes Through Two Stages... The Danger Begins in Al-Rutba.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, Ebola virus disease progresses in two stages. The dry phase features fever, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and headache, with an incubation period of about one week during which transmission is unlikely. The real danger arises when illness advances to the wet phase, including diarrhea, vomiting, and a rash, followed by internal bleeding and then external bleeding from body openings; without timely treatment, death often occurs soon after entering this phase. Mortality in the wet phase is high and relies on the capacity of health systems and medical readiness. The report notes that control would be better with stable access to medical supplies in the Democratic Republic of Congo, but domestic problems and disrupted international supply lines have hampered response. The title links danger to Al-Rutba.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学教授:エボラは2つの段階を経る…危険はラトバで始まる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラウイルス病の病期に関する専門家の一般的解説であり、具体的な新規発生・症例数・発生地の明確な報告がない。DRCへの言及も医療供給体制に関する一般論に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの病期に関する医学解説記事であり、具体的な発生国・症例数の報告がない。見出しのAl-Rutba(イラク)は対象国リスト外。DRCへの言及も医療体制の一般論であり、新規発生の具体的証拠はないため、verified_locationsは空とした。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Le nombre de cas confirmés d'Ebola en RDC s'élève à 1 873
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC has risen to 1,873.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 1,873 laboratory-confirmed cases with 672 deaths, according to Kinshasa authorities cited by Reuters. The update marks an increase from last Friday’s report of 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, reflecting an ongoing escalation. The article provides no geographic breakdown within the DRC or infection-source details, and does not specify laboratory confirmation methods beyond the case tally. No information on imported or exported cases is provided. The figures emphasize a continuing and rising outbreak in the DRC, underscoring the need for sustained surveillance and public health response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定症例数が1,873人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ流行が継続的に拡大しており（1,873症例、672死亡）、致死率が高く公衆衛生への深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 症例数と死亡者数が前回報告から増加しており、流行の継続的拡大が示唆される。地理的詳細や感染源情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: US State Department Tells Americans to Avoid Congo Due to Ebola
article.articleSummary: U.S. State Department warns Americans not to travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to a months-long Ebola outbreak. The Kinshasa embassy cautions that exposure to Ebola could put travelers at serious risk, with potential quarantine outside the United States for up to 21 days and uninsured costs. Congolese authorities report 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases, 702 deaths, 318 recoveries, and 753 in isolation or hospital care. The outbreak has extended into neighboring Uganda, and Americans have been advised to avoid Uganda as well. The CDC says it is coordinating with U.S. federal agencies and DRC authorities to prevent transmission through contact tracing and risk assessments of high-risk contacts. An American doctor who tested positive was transported to Germany for isolation and treatment. The CDC maintains the likelihood of Ebola reaching the United States is very low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国務省、エボラ出血熱によりコンゴ渡航回避を米国民に勧告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によるDRCでの大規模アウトブレイク(1926症例、702死亡)がウガンダにも拡大し、渡航制限や国際的な感染拡大リスクが顕在化しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。米国人感染者がドイツへ搬送されたとの記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتمدد إلى إقليمين جديدين في الكونغو الديمقراطية - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads to two new provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - El Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) has spread to two northeastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Out-Wili and Tshopo. National tallies show 1,926 confirmed cases nationwide, with 702 deaths. Four confirmed cases in Tshopo with two deaths; Out-Wili recorded one death on Saturday. The outbreak, the seventh in the DRC, began May 15, centered in Ituri with reports also from North Kivu and South Kivu. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected person or animals, with fever, vomiting, and internal/external bleeding. A July 11 INSP update said these two provinces’ cases are largely imported from Nyania in Ituri, yet they remain part of the outbreak. Kisangani, capital of Tshopo, lies in this region; Out-Wili borders South Sudan and the Central African Republic. WHO cautions the true scope may be 2–4 times higher due to unlinked cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国の新たな2州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（第7波）が新たに2州へ拡大し、全国で1,926例・702名の死亡が報告されている。IHR基準複数該当かつWHOも実際の規模がより大きい可能性を指摘しており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGhana・Central African Republic・Sudanが含まれるが、記事本文はDRC国内（Ituri、Tshopo、South Kivu、North Kivu、Out-Wili）の状況のみを述べており、これら他国での発生は確認できない。Out-Wiliは南スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国と国境を接するとの記載があるが、越境発生の事実は記述されていないため対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Reuters - Αμερικανός ασθενής με Έμπολα από το Κονγκό νοσηλεύεται σε ειδική μονάδα στη Γερμανία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reuters - American patient with Ebola from the Congo is hospitalized in a specialized unit in Germany.
article.articleSummary: An American humanitarian worker, about 60 years old, was admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital in a high-containment isolation unit after testing positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus acquired in the Democratic Republic of Congo. He was transported at about 03:00 local time; his condition is stable, according to Tim Wolf, head of the hospital’s isolation unit. Samaritan’s Purse confirms the Congo-based warehouse supervisor role and notes timely treatment and air evacuation organized by the U.S. Department of State. The hospital states there is no public risk due to full isolation. The DRC Ebola outbreak continues, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, now spreading to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces. In June, another American infected in Congo was discharged from a Berlin hospital.

triage.headline_ja: ロイター - コンゴ由来のエボラ出血熱に感染したアメリカ人患者、ドイツの特別病棟で治療中
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（1,926症例・702死亡）が新たな州に拡大しており、感染者の国際搬送事例も発生しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 患者はドイツで隔離治療中だが感染はDRCで発生したものであり、ドイツ・米国は感染発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。DRCのエボラアウトブレイクはHaut-UeleおよびTshopo州へ拡大中で、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : l'hôpital du Cinquantenaire se vide après l'enregistrement d'un deuxième décès - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: Cinquantenaire Hospital empties after a second death is recorded - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola-related deaths in Kisangani, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as Cinquantenaire Hospital experiences a mass exodus of patients fearing contamination. The second Ebola death was recorded Sunday in the Tshopo province, bringing the outbreak's toll to two. Dr. Falay Sadiki, medical director, said most patients fled after the first case, endangering hospital operations. The Health Ministry visit to Ebola treatment centers in Kisangani highlighted challenges, including a lack of diagnostic equipment for rapid case confirmation and ongoing financial strain from patient departures and reduced outpatient visits; only newborns’ parents continue to attend due to lack of alternatives. Health official Dr. Roger Samuel Kamba announced fast-tracking three dedicated Ebola treatment centers in Kisangani, with a three-week aim for Cinquantenaire to stop receiving Ebola patients and return to standard services. He requested staff rosters to plan government support during this exceptional period. The deceased patient was from Nia-Nia.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでエボラ流行:第2例の死亡確認後、五十周年記念病院から患者が離散
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のキサンガニでエボラ出血熱による死亡例が発生し、病院機能に支障が出ている。エボラはIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的懸念が高い疾患であるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 診断機器不足や病院機能の混乱が報告されており、症例確認体制に課題がある。続報でのアウトブレイクの拡大状況・WHO対応の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pacjent z rzadką odmianą wirusa ebola w szpitalu za Odrą. Niemcy uspokajają: sytuacja jest pod kontrolą
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient with a rare strain of the Ebola virus in a hospital across the Oder. Germany reassures: the situation is under control.
article.articleSummary: Germany is managing an import of a rare Ebola virus strain, Bundibugyo, detected in a US humanitarian worker hospitalized at the University Hospital in Frankfurt. The patient—an American employed by a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo—is stable after arrival and transport was uneventful. There is currently no approved vaccine or targeted therapy for Bundibugyo. This marks Europe's first Bundibugyo case after France detected the strain in a returning humanitarian worker from eastern DR Congo at the end of June. Earlier, in May, an American doctor with Ebola was treated in Berlin's Charité and discharged after about two weeks. In the DRC, the Ebola outbreak has caused 702 deaths among 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases, spanning five provinces (including Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu), with experimental therapies being tested in Ituri. Germany reassures: the situation is under control.

triage.headline_ja: オーデル川対岸の病院で希少株のエボラウイルス感染患者。ドイツ「状況は制御下にある」と発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で702人死亡・1926人の検査確定症例を伴う大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、希少株（ブンディブギョ株）の輸入症例が欧州（フランス・ドイツ）で相次いで確認されるなど国際的拡大が現実化しているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株含む）であり、ドイツ・フランス・米国は輸入症例の発生地・治療地に過ぎないため対象国リストには該当しない。DRCでの流行規模（5州にわたる1926例・702死亡）は極めて深刻でありフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Пациент со ебола пристигна во Германија: Заразен со сој за кој нема вакцина или терапија
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient with Ebola arrived in Germany: infected with a strain for which there is no vaccine or therapy.
article.articleSummary: Second American citizen infected with Ebola, Bundibugyo virus (no vaccine or approved therapy), was transported to Germany and admitted to a university hospital after landing at Frankfurt. He follows the first American Ebola patient, who arrived in Germany about two months earlier and was treated at Charité in Berlin; the patient’s wife and four children were also admitted as high‑risk contacts but remained asymptomatic. The CDC had confirmed the initial case involved a humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Bundibugyo Ebola virus currently has no licensed vaccines or therapies, complicating outbreak control. Ebola spreads via direct contact and bodily fluids; in DRC the outbreak has about 650 deaths and at least 1,830 confirmed or currently infected. Europe’s Bundibugyo cases include Germany and France, the latter confirmed by a clinician who returned from eastern DRC in late June. After isolation and negative tests, the patient in France was discharged. Germany uses specialized aircraft and isolated wards for such patients.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者がドイツに到着：ワクチンも治療法もない株に感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは死者約650人・感染者1,830人規模で、ワクチン・治療法が存在せず、既にドイツ・フランスへ患者搬送による国際的拡大が確認されているため。
triage.notes: 患者搬送先のドイツ・フランス・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。アウトブレイク発生地であるDRCのみを記載。ワクチン・治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株である点、および国際的な患者搬送が続いている点は特に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: MSF za ta aika likitocin da ta horar zuwa Congo don yaƙi da Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF will send the doctors it has trained to the Congo to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: MSF, the international medical humanitarian organization, announced from Kenya its plan to deploy Ebola-trained health workers to the Democratic Republic of Congo to support outbreak response. The effort follows an Ebola surge that has killed at least 700 and infected about 2,000 people. MSF states the trained clinicians will deliver care to reduce deaths among health workers on the front lines. Since mid-May, 112 health workers have contracted Ebola, with 35 fatalities, bringing total cases to 1,926. Congolese authorities report the epidemic has spread to two additional areas in the northeast, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, with 4 infections and 2 deaths. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, with most cases in Ituri Province and a smaller number in North and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、コンゴでのエボラ対策のため訓練済み医師を派遣へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（700人以上死亡、約2000人感染）が新たな地域に拡大し、医療従事者にも多数感染しており、国際支援（MSF）が動員されているため。
triage.notes: ケニアはMSFが発表を行った場所であり、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC第17次エボラ流行で、Ituri州が中心だが北・南キブ州、Haut-Uele、Tshopoにも拡大中。医療従事者112人感染・35人死亡という深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha on alert after COVID-19 death reported in neighbouring Andhra Pradesh
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 alert in Odisha as neighboring Andhra Pradesh reports fresh cases and a COVID-19–related death in Kadapa district. On July 9, a 46-year-old man from Kadapa died after severe breathlessness and cough; he had a history of alcohol use. Odisha has not detected positive or active cases and is intensifying surveillance and testing amid cross-border movement. Public Health Director Rabindranath Mishra says all tests so far are negative and the state remains on alert. Odisha has revived COVID‑19 surveillance and follows Union Health Ministry guidelines: test all Severe Acute Respiratory Illness (SARI) patients for COVID-19; test at least 5% of Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) cases; send positive SARI samples for whole-genome sequencing through the ICMR Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratory network to identify circulating variants. No confirmed active cases, but monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州、隣接するアンドラプラデシュ州でのCOVID-19死亡例報告を受け警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: アンドラプラデシュ州での単発の死亡例（基礎疾患あり）に対する隣接州の日常的な監視強化であり、活動性症例は確認されておらず、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに顕著な該当はない。
triage.notes: アンドラプラデシュ州カダパ地区での単発死亡（基礎疾患：飲酒歴あり）を受け、隣接オディシャ州が通常のCOVID-19サーベイランス（SARI全数検査、ILI5%検査等）を実施しているという報道。オディシャ州内での確認例はなく、既存のインド国内保健省ガイドラインに沿った日常的対応。

article.articleHeadline: রাস্তায় বেরিয়েই আচমকা বৃষ্টিতে ভিজে স্নান? ভাইরাল ইনফেকশন রুখতে চিকিৎসকদের সেরা দাওয়াই!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stepping out onto the street and getting drenched in sudden rain? Doctors' best remedy to prevent viral infection!
article.articleSummary: During Bengal's monsoon, a red weather alert signals heavy rainfall and elevated risk of viral, bacterial, and fungal infections. To prevent illness after sudden showers, doctors advise: seek shelter under a roof; promptly change out of wet clothes; dry skin and hair with a towel; bathe on returning home to wash away rainwater and pollutants; and drink warm beverages while dressing in warm clothing. To further reduce infection risk during flooding: wash hands with soap immediately after returning home; thoroughly dry feet to prevent fungal infections; avoid touching eyes, nose, or mouth with dirty hands; eat vitamin C–rich foods to bolster immunity; drink boiled water; avoid walking through contaminated water to prevent foot infections; opt for home-cooked light meals; and regularly clean umbrellas, shoes, and raincoats to prevent mold.

triage.headline_ja: 突然の雨に濡れてしまったら？ウイルス感染を防ぐ医師おすすめの対処法！
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症の発生を報じるものではなく、モンスーン季節における一般的な健康・予防啓発記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性はない。
triage.notes: 特定の疾病アウトブレイクではなく、季節性の健康アドバイス記事のため、対象国であるインド（West Bengal）を含む具体的な感染症イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Des dispositifs de prévention contre Ebola volés et vandalisés au marché central de Butembo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola prevention measures stolen and vandalized at Butembo's central market.
article.articleSummary: Ebola prevention equipment at Butembo's central market in the Democratic Republic of Congo was stolen or vandalized, according to authorities after a July 9 inspection. Water tanks were taken and handwashing stations damaged at market entrances deployed weeks earlier to curb Ebola transmission. Gérard Kakule Kayihembako, head of the urban office of the National Economy, led the visit with market managers and urged traders and shoppers to safeguard the installations. The central market is a major hub, serving thousands daily and drawing travelers from Beni (North Kivu) and Bunia (Ituri), provinces heavily affected by Ebola. Officials reiterated adherence to preventive measures: regular handwashing, use of disinfection devices, and disinfectant after handling money. They also announced new devices in coming days and urged the public to report sabotage to ensure continuity of prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ブテンボ中央市場でエボラ予防設備が盗難・破壊される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ対策設備の破壊という運用上の懸念はあるが、新規感染者数や流行拡大に関する具体的データが記事内になく、公衆衛生への直接的影響度を判断する情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものではなく、既存の予防対策インフラ（手洗い場・貯水タンク）の盗難・破壊に関する報道。北キブ州ベニ及びイトゥリ州ブニアはエボラの影響を受けている地域として言及されており、感染継続のリスク要因として注視が必要。新規症例数等の疫学情報は本記事に含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: US warns citizens against travel to DR Congo due to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: US warns against travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) amid one of the region’s most serious Ebola outbreaks. Exposed travelers may be required to quarantine outside the United States for up to 21 days at their own expense; a voluntary process ensures access to life-saving medical care for those potentially exposed. The advisory follows confirmation that a US humanitarian worker in the DRC tested positive for Ebola; the CDC is collaborating with Congolese authorities and international partners to trace contacts and prevent further transmission. The CDC has introduced enhanced health screening for returning US travelers from affected areas and maintains temporary entry restrictions for certain visitors to outbreak zones. As of 13 July 2026, the DRC reports Ebola cases in five provinces, with a nationwide total of 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱発生を受けコンゴ民主共和国への渡航に対し警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州に拡大し1,873例・672人死亡と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、米国からの渡航警告・検疫措置も発令されるなど国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクが確認されるため。
triage.notes: 米国はDRC発生地域ではなく、渡航警告・検疫措置を発令した対応国であるため verified_locations には含めない。致死率(672/1873≈35.9%)が高く、深刻度が高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola Vakaları 1.873'e Yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Have Risen to 1,873.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has risen to 1,873 confirmed cases with 672 deaths as of a 12 July update from local authorities, up from 1,830 cases and 648 deaths on 10 July. The outbreak began before the May 15 official acknowledgment of the first cases, indicating months of transmission prior to detection. Healthcare workers face elevated infection risk due to severe shortages of basic protective equipment such as gloves and masks, contributing to ongoing transmission within medical settings. The situation underscores the need for strengthened infection prevention, procurement of PPE, and public health response to contain spread in the DRC and prevent potential international spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が1,873人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死亡率が高く、医療従事者への院内感染拡大やPPE不足など公衆衛生への深刻な影響とIHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 致死率は約35.9%と高く、検出前から数ヶ月の感染拡大があったと報告されており、サーベイランス体制の脆弱性が示唆される。医療施設内でのPPE不足による院内感染も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 6月全国新增新冠确诊7.9万例 广东疾控提醒7月关注这些传染病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 79,000 new COVID-19 cases were confirmed nationwide in June; Guangdong CDC reminds to pay attention to these infectious diseases in July.
article.articleSummary: June 2026 nationwide COVID-19: 79,000 new confirmed cases across 31 provinces and Xinjiang; 130 severe cases; 1 death with underlying conditions. Sentinel hospital influenza-like illness shows rising SARS-CoV-2 positivity: 2.9%, 4.1%, 5.3%, 6.4% across weeks 23–26. From June 1–30, 3,741 local genomes submitted; all Omicron variants; predominant NB.1.8.1 and sublineages, accounting for 95.9–98.8% across weeks 23–26. No evidence of a new variant with additional public health risk. Guangdong July health risk advisory lists priority infectious diseases: Dengue fever, Chikungunya fever, Zika virus disease, Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease, Hepatitis A, Ebola virus disease, COVID-19, Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome, Monkeypox, food poisoning; plus floods and heatstroke. With rising temperatures and more rainfall and summer travel, emphasis on prevention and early reporting; avoid poisonous mushrooms and foods contaminated by pathogens.

triage.headline_ja: 6月の全国新型コロナ確定症例7.9万例、広東省疾病予防管理センターが7月に注意すべき感染症を注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の症例数増加は季節的変動の範囲内で新変異株の公衆衛生リスク増大の証拠はなく、その他疾患も定例的な夏季注意喚起リストであり、シグナルとしての異常性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 定例の月次公衆衛生統計報告および季節性感染症の注意喚起であり、新変異株や異常な重症化傾向の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue caem mais de 84% no Acre, mas três municípios mantêm alta incidência
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases fall by more than 84% in Acre, but three municipalities maintain high incidence
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Acre, Brazil, declined markedly in 2026, though three municipalities remain high risk. Between epidemiological weeks 1–20, Acre reported 1,455 probable dengue cases, down from 7,063 in the same period in 2025 (−79.3%), and confirmed cases fell to 993 from 6,407 (−84.5%). Xapuri leads incidence at 670.5 per 100,000 inhabitants, followed by Mâncio Lima (408.3) and Porto Walter (408.2). The statewide incidence is 165.2/100,000 (medium). Rio Branco accounts for the largest share of confirmations, with 607 (about 61% of Acre’s total up to week 20), while Cruzeiro do Sul has 153 and Mâncio Lima 66. The reduction may reflect greater population immunity to DENV-1, intensified vector control, and environmental factors, but circulation of DENV-3 could shift the scenario toward more cases or severe disease. Authorities urge sustained surveillance, vector control, health education, and expanded dengue vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州でデング熱症例が84%以上減少するも、3市町村では依然高い罹患率が続く
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アクレ州でデング熱症例は前年比大幅減少しており、既知の風土病の季節的動向を示す定例報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: DENV-3の流行が今後の状況を変化させる可能性が言及されているが、現時点では減少傾向にあり継続監視で十分と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola v DR Kongo zahtevala več kot 700 življenj, v Nemčiji se zdravi okužen Američan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo has claimed more than 700 lives; an infected American is being treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has claimed 702 lives from 1,926 infections since the outbreak began on 15 May, with most cases and deaths in Ituri province. The epidemic has spread to neighboring Uganda, which has 20 confirmed infections and 2 deaths. In Germany, an American infected in DR Congo arrived in Frankfurt for treatment and is isolated in a dedicated unit at the University Hospital Frankfurt; his condition is stable, and officials say there is no danger to other patients or staff, with only a very small risk of further imported cases. Earlier, in late May, an American physician treated in Berlin's Charité was discharged after quarantine; his wife and four children were quarantined as high-risk contacts but asymptomatic. The United States requested Germany's medical expertise and shorter transport times. The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in this outbreak has no vaccine or approved therapy.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が700人以上の死者、ドイツでは感染した米国人が治療中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行（死者702人）しウガンダへ越境拡大、さらに感染者の国際搬送事例も発生しており、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ドイツ・米国も記事に登場するが対象国リストにないため除外。DRCが主たる発生国として該当。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療薬未承認で重症化リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية.. اتساع رقعة تفشي فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Widening geographic spread of the Ebola virus outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has widened to northeastern regions, Out Willy and Chobo. Total 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. Four cases are in Chobo, with two fatalities; one death was confirmed in Out Willy. Declared May 15, the outbreak was initially centered in Ituri and has also affected North Kivu and South Kivu. Ebola spreads by direct contact with body fluids of a patient or infected animals; symptoms include fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. In late June, health authorities began tracing contacts in Out Willy and Chobo, not previously in daily government reports. Investigations indicate most cases in these two regions originate from Nyania in Ituri, but are part of the outbreak. Kisangani, capital of Chobo, is a major city. WHO cautions the true scale may be 2–4 times higher, and four-fifths of new cases have no known links.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラウイルス感染症の流行地域が拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が新たな地域（Out WillyおよびChobo/キサンガニ）に拡大し、確認症例1,926例・死亡702例に達しており、WHOは実際の規模がさらに大きい可能性を指摘している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにGhana・Angolaが含まれているが、記事本文はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ、南北キブ、Out Willy、Chobo/キサンガニ）のみを対象としており、他国は関連していないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Navi Mumbai Civic Body Intensifies Anti-Mosquito Drive at 270 Construction Sites to Prevent Dengue and Malaria
article.articleSummary: Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation (NMMC) intensifies its anti-mosquito drive to curb dengue and malaria during the monsoon, covering 270 construction sites across the city. The Health Department maps sites under 26 Urban Primary Health Centres and runs a fixed weekly anti-larval treatment and inspection schedule. Among sites, 152 employ up to 50 workers; 45 have 51–100; 40 exceed 100; and 33 are excavated plots awaiting construction, totaling about 14,390 workers. Measures include regular inspections, anti-larval spraying, chemical fogging, granular larvicide, and health camps. Guppy fish have been released into stagnant water at 265 sites to feed on larvae; anti-larval powder has been sprayed in labour camps housing 3,560 workers over three months. Follow-up inspections ensure efficacy. Officials urge builders and residents to eliminate stagnant water and maintain hygiene; sustained measures are essential.

triage.headline_ja: ナビムンバイ市当局、デング熱とマラリア予防のため270の建設現場で蚊駆除活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性モンスーン対策としての予防的な蚊駆除活動の報告であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱・マラリアの発生報告ではなく、モンスーン期における自治体の予防的な蚊対策活動（ラーバイサイド散布、グッピー放流等）についての通常業務報告である。感染者数や発生状況への言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Universitatea Oxford începe testarea unui nou vaccin împotriva virusului Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford University Begins Testing a New Vaccine Against the Ebola Virus
article.articleSummary: Oxford University is initiating testing of a new Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo variant, amid an outbreak spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Researchers will assess safety and immune response in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 in the UK. To support rapid testing, about 620,000 doses of the ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine have been stockpiled, with roughly 4,000 experimental doses allocated for the Oxford study. Partnerships with Uganda are planned to prepare clinical trials in Africa. Volunteers will be monitored for one year, with expectations of swift data on protective efficacy. The candidate uses the same technology as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine, potentially enabling production in weeks. Prof. Teresa Lambe stressed the urgent need for vaccines as Bundibugyo Ebola devastates communities; WHO declared the outbreak a PHEIC about 57 days ago. CEPI’s Nicole Lurie highlighted this as a crucial step toward a safe, effective vaccine entering Phase I.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、新型エボラウイルスワクチンの試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱がWHOによりPHEICと宣言されており、IHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はオックスフォード大学（英国）でのワクチン治験に関するものだが、背景にあるDRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の流行はWHOがPHEICを宣言済みであり、既存の公衆衛生危機として重要視すべき事案。ウガンダは今後の臨床試験パートナー国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。英国も治験実施国だが発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Second US humanitarian worker airlifted as Ebola outbreak worsens in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Second US citizen infected with Ebola Bundibugyo virus evacuated from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Germany for specialized care, while outbreak worsens in Ituri Province's Bunia, eastern DRC. The patient, a humanitarian worker based in Bunia, had been receiving clinical care and close monitoring before transfer. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus confirmed the evacuation and said WHO is working with the DRC government and Africa CDC to strengthen surveillance, case management, contact tracing, and other emergency measures to contain the outbreak. The move underscores ongoing international support as frontline responders face infections; protecting responders remains a top priority. WHO reaffirmed its commitment to assisting response efforts across the DRC and expressed wishes for a speedy recovery for all Ebola patients. The outbreak is spreading in eastern DRC, prompting calls for intensified local, national, and international support.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ流行悪化、2人目の米国人人道支援者が空輸退避
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が悪化し、国際人道支援者の感染・国外搬送が発生していることから、IHR基準の複数項目に該当しWPRO基準も全て該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは患者搬送先であり発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。WHO事務局長が直接コメントしており国際的関心が高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak intensifies across DRC as risk of spread to South Sudan grows
article.articleSummary: EBOLA outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies with 1,926 cases and 702 deaths confirmed by the Ministry of Health as of 11 July 2026. Five provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo (Kisangani) and Haut-Uele. Operational constraints and security challenges are limiting response, risking undetected transmission. Contact tracing is 78.3%, below the WHO target of 90–95%. The outbreak is expanding to new areas; Kisangani sits about 500 km west of Bunia, while two confirmed cases in Wamba, Haut-Uele, near the South Sudan border, heighten cross-border risk. The WHO estimates a 70% chance of spread to South Sudan if cross-border transmission occurs. The IRC supports high-risk areas with preparedness, IPC, surveillance, community engagement, and frontline health worker support to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRC全域でエボラ流行が激化、南スーダンへの拡大リスクが高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,926症例・702死亡が確認され、5州に拡大、南スーダンへの越境伝播リスクも高いためIHR基準を複数満たすシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 南スーダンへの拡大リスク（WHO推定70%）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大リスクの根拠として重要。

article.articleHeadline: أستاذ أوبئة: إيبولا ليس كورونا.. والتفشي في الكونغو فلا داعي للقلق في مصر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemiology Professor: Ebola is not the coronavirus... and the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, there is no need to worry in Egypt.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, Egypt’s epidemiology professor Dr. Islam Anan says the country has an Ebola vaccine approved for Egypt, but it targets the Zaire (Zaïre) strain and is not effective against the strain driving the current outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province). WHO guidance advises against using this vaccine for the current strain. Three vaccines are under development for the current strain, all in early stages; earliest trials won’t begin for several months, and even with accelerated development, a vaccine before 2027 is unlikely, potentially after the current outbreak subsides. The outbreak remains localized in Ituri; a France case was imported from Congo. Egypt and the region are not considered at high risk, with no North African cases in previous major outbreaks (2006). Egypt maintains robust preventive health and border screening at airports, and there is no expectation of COVID-like lockdowns due to Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学教授:「エボラは新型コロナではない…コンゴでの流行はエジプトでは心配無用」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で既存ワクチンが効かない新たな株によるエボラ流行が発生し、フランスへの輸入症例も確認されており、国際的拡大と異常性の観点からIHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 既存のザイール株ワクチンが有効でない新株によるエボラ流行がイトゥリ州で発生。フランスへの輸出例も確認されており、国際的拡大のリスクが既に顕在化している。エジプトやフランスは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 사망자 700명 넘어...5개 주로 확산
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 700... spreading to five provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 700 deaths. As of July 11, 2026, cumulative confirmed cases reached 1,976 with 702 deaths (case fatality 36.4%), 318 recoveries, and a 78.3% contact-tracing rate. The outbreak has spread to five provinces, including Ituri in the northeast—the origin—with new confirmed deaths in Tshopo (2) and Haut-Uele (1); all cases are reported to be imported from Ituri. Separately, a United States citizen working for Samaritan's Purse diagnosed with Ebola on July 10 in Congo was admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital in Germany and is in stable condition, in his 60s. Earlier, in May, another American surgeon affiliated with a medical missionary group contracted Ebola and was treated at Berlin's Charité University Hospital, later recovering and discharge.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ死者700人超え…5州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5州に拡大し死者700人超・致死率36.4%と深刻で、国際搬送例（米国・ドイツ）も発生しており国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは感染者の搬送・治療先であり発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。DRC国内で5州（Ituri起源、Tshopo、Haut-Ueleなど）へ拡大中。

article.articleHeadline: Human trials of new Ebola vaccine set to begin in UK
article.articleSummary: UK Oxford University will begin Phase I trials of ChAdOx1 BDBV, a vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus, in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55. Vaccinations are due to start in the coming weeks pending regulatory approval. The trial follows WHO's May 17 declaration of a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as a public health emergency of international concern, now with 1,926 cases and 702 deaths confirmed in the DRC as of Monday. About 620,000 doses have been stockpiled, with 4,000 investigational doses allocated to the Oxford study. The vaccine uses the same viral vector as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 shot, enabling rapid development. A US humanitarian worker infected with Bundibugyo is hospitalized in Frankfurt, Germany; WHO officials warn the true outbreak size may be 2–4 times higher than official data. CEPI calls this Oxford progress pivotal.

triage.headline_ja: 英国で新型エボラワクチンのヒト試験開始へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクがWHOによりPHEIC宣言され、1,926症例・702死亡と深刻化しており、国際的な感染拡大（米国人患者がドイツで入院）も確認されているため。
triage.notes: 記事はUKでのワクチン治験開始が主題だが、背景にあるDRCのエボラ(ブンディブギョ)アウトブレイクがPHEIC宣言されるほど深刻であり、実際の発生地域として重要。UK、ドイツ、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。真の感染規模は公式データの2〜4倍の可能性があるとWHOが警告している点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو.. إيبولا يواصل الانتشار وتحذير أميركي من السفر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo: Ebola continues to spread, and a U.S. travel warning.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with spread extending to Ou-Wili and Chobo after initial concentration in Ituri. The public health institute reports 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. The outbreak began mid-May and is the country’s seventeenth, with early transmission in Ituri followed by North Kivu and South Kivu. Transmission via direct contact with infected people or fluids; animal-to-human transmission is possible. Investigations indicate Ou-Wili and Chobo cases originated from Nyania in Ituri, though these regions are now outbreak areas. Kisangani underscores cross-border risk with South Sudan and the Central African Republic. WHO warns the true scale may be 2–4 times higher, with about 80% of new infections lacking epidemiologic links. The U.S. travel advisory urges Americans not to travel to DRC; up to 21-day overseas quarantine; Germany evacuated a second American patient; Bundibugyo strain detected.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ出血熱の拡大続く、米国が渡航警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行が拡大し1,926症例・702人死亡、国際的な渡航警告や国外への患者搬送も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 米国の渡航勧告、ドイツへの患者搬送、南スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国への越境リスクなど国際的懸念が高い。WHOは実際の症例数が報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘し、新規感染の約80%が疫学的関連不明であることから流行制御の困難さが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: German hospital treats U.S. Ebola patient infected in Congo
article.articleSummary: A U.S. citizen infected with the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola contracted in the Democratic Republic of Congo was admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital’s special isolation unit around 3 a.m. local time on Monday. The patient is in complete isolation and reported in stable condition, with officials saying there is no risk to the public. This represents another imported case from Congo to Germany; in June, a U.S. citizen treated in Berlin after contracting Ebola in Congo was discharged from Charité hospital. The DRC’s public health institute reported 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases and 702 deaths, with the outbreak spreading to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control had previously said a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツの病院、コンゴで感染した米国人エボラ患者を治療
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ(ブンディブギョ型)アウトブレイクが継続中(確定1,926例、死亡702例)であり、国際的な輸入症例が複数発生していることから、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの継続的アウトブレイクが本イベントの主因であり、致死率も高く(約36%)、複数の国際輸入例が発生していることから注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: جامعة أكسفورد تعتزم اختبار لقاح جديد ضد فيروس إيبولا تم تطويره في المملكة المتحدة - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: University of Oxford plans to test a new Ebola vaccine developed in the United Kingdom - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain, developed in the United Kingdom, planned for testing by University of Oxford as the Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The vaccine, using the ChAdOx1 BD-BPV platform, will be evaluated for safety and immunogenicity in 50 healthy UK volunteers aged 18–55. A stockpile of about 620,000 doses is prepared for potential future use, with roughly 4,000 experimental doses allocated for the Oxford trial. Partners in Uganda are also being coordinated to prepare for African testing. Volunteers will be followed for a year, with early indications expected on rapid protection potential. The vaccine employs the same technology as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine, enabling development within weeks.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、英国で開発された新しいエボラワクチンの試験を予定
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はワクチン臨床試験であり、DRCで継続中とされるエボラ流行の詳細（症例数・重症度・拡大状況）が記載されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発・臨床試験（英国主体）に関する内容が中心で、DRCでのエボラ流行自体の詳細情報（症例数、地域、致死率等）は記載されていない。ウガンダは将来の試験実施候補地として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 cases are rising again: Doctor reveals the early symptoms you should never ignore and the precautions that can protect your family
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising again globally due to SARS-CoV-2 evolution and waning immunity from prior infection or vaccination. While new variants spread more easily, vaccines continue to strongly protect against severe disease. Transmission is facilitated by crowded indoor spaces, poor ventilation, travel, schools reopening, workplaces, and large gatherings; WHO emphasizes ongoing circulation and surveillance. Most infections are mild, but older adults, pregnant individuals, people with chronic illnesses, and those immunocompromised remain at higher risk for severe outcomes. Early symptoms often resemble a cold and include fever, sore throat, persistent cough, runny or blocked nose, unusual tiredness, headache, muscle pain, and loss or alteration of taste or smell; some may experience shortness of breath, chest pain, or confusion, necessitating medical evaluation if breathing worsens. In Pune, India, clinicians report rising cases, with global monitoring by CDC and WHO.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19感染者が再び増加：医師が見逃してはいけない初期症状と家族を守るための予防策を解説
triage.triage_reason: 一般向け健康啓発記事であり、COVID-19の一般的な症状・予防策の紹介にとどまる。異常な増加や重症化の急増を示す具体的データはなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は健康啓発・症状解説が主目的であり、具体的な症例数増加率や重症度データは記載されていない。COVID-19は既知の流行性疾患であり新規性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Varanasi Reports Fresh COVID-19 Case, BHU Doctors Advise Caution For Vulnerable People
article.articleSummary: Varanasi reports a fresh COVID-19 case as of 2026-07-13: a 27-year-oldAshapur resident tested positive for coronavirus and is admitted for monitoring at BHU Hospital’s Chest and TB Department, after experiencing breathing difficulties; his family’s health is also being monitored, with no complications reported among other members. IMS BHU officials note that the coronavirus has not been eradicated: early infections occurred when antibodies were lacking, and the second wave during vaccination built antibodies. Currently, COVID-19 remains active but infects fewer people, with those having weakened immune systems at higher risk though serious illness remains rare. Authorities urge vigilance and maintaining immunity, and infected individuals should seek medical advice and hospitalize if complications arise; the situation underscores that the virus is still present.

triage.headline_ja: バラナシで新たなCOVID-19症例を報告、BHU医師団が脆弱層への注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 単発の散発例であり、重症例・集団感染・異常事態を示す情報はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響も認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo rise to 1,873
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths as of July 13, 2026, per local health authorities cited by Reuters. The prior update reported 1,830 cases and 648 deaths. Officials say the virus had been circulating for months before the first officially confirmed case on May 15, exposing many healthcare workers to infection before awareness. Severe shortages of basic protective equipment, including gloves and face masks, hinder containment efforts. The accompanying caption notes health workers at a displaced persons camp in Bunia, underscoring ongoing risks to frontline staff and displaced populations amid the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定症例数、1,873人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで致死率が高く（672/1873）、医療従事者への感染や防護具不足による封じ込め困難があり、国際的拡大リスクを伴うため。
triage.notes: 症例数・死亡者数が前回更新から増加しており、防護具不足による医療従事者への感染拡大リスクが継続している。数か月間検知されずに感染が広がっていた点は異常性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola s'étend à deux nouvelles provinces
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak has spread to two new provinces.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to the northeastern provinces of Haut-Uele and Tshopo, marking the 17th declared outbreak in the country. Official INSP data report 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. Four cases are in Tshopo (two fatalities) and one death in Haut-Uele. Investigations indicate these infections were imported from Niania, Ituri, though authorities classify Haut-Uele and Tshopo as epidemic zones with potential broader spread. Kisangani, a major city in Tshopo, and the provinces’ borders with South Sudan and the Central African Republic heighten concerns about cross-border transmission. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids and causes fever, vomiting, and severe bleeding. The World Health Organization cautions that true case counts may be two to four times higher, with about 80% of cases lacking an identifiable epidemiological link to known patients, complicating contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱の流行が新たに2州へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国内で新たに2州へ拡大し、確定症例1,926例・死亡702例と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、南スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国との国境地帯での越境感染リスクも指摘されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国・スーダンは発生地域として言及されているが、記事の主題はDRC国内での感染拡大であり、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOは実際の症例数が報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性があると警告しており、接触者追跡が困難な状況（80%の症例で疫学的関連が不明）。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola no Congo se espalha para mais duas províncias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo spreads to two more provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo in the northeast. The country’s total confirmed Ebola cases reach 1,926 with 702 deaths as of the end of Sunday. Four cases are in Tshopo (two deaths) and one death in Haut-Uele (as of Saturday), signaling further spread of the 17th outbreak, declared May 15 and previously centered in Ituri with cases in North Kivu and South Kivu. Ebola transmits through contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. Reuters reported in late June that health authorities began tracing exposed individuals in Tshopo and Haut-Uele, though not yet reflected in daily government reports. INSP stated on July 11 that most cases in these provinces are imported from Niania in Ituri and urged treating them as an epidemic zone. WHO cautions the true scope may be 2–4 times higher, with about 80% of new cases having no known link to diagnosed patients.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行がさらに2州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行が新たに2州（Haut-Uele、Tshopo）に拡大し、累計1,926症例・702死亡、WHOは実際の規模がさらに大きい可能性を指摘しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにマリ（Koulikoro Region）が含まれているが、記事本文はDRC国内のエボラ流行拡大のみを扱っており、マリでの発生は記載なしのため除外。WHOは新規症例の約80%が既知の感染者と関連づけられておらず、実際の感染規模は報告の2〜4倍の可能性があると警告している。

article.articleHeadline: V Evropi potrdili nov primer ebole! Za to različico ni cepiva, bolnikom lahko pomagajo le s podpornim zdravljenjem
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new case of Ebola confirmed in Europe! There is no vaccine for this strain; patients can only receive supportive care.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-13, University Hospital Frankfurt confirmed a new Ebola case in an American national treated there, the second patient repatriated from the Democratic Republic of Congo within two months. The patient arrived by special air transport and remains in a high-security isolation unit. German authorities confirm infection with Bundibugyo Ebola virus, fueling the current Congo outbreak; there is no vaccine or standard specific treatment, only supportive care. The German Health Ministry says strict in-hospital isolation and transport measures negate public risk. Earlier this year a Berlin Charité doctor infected during humanitarian work in Congo recovered after about two weeks. Bundibugyo was first confirmed in Europe in late June, with a doctor in France isolated and discharged after multiple negative tests. In the DRC, approximately 1,830 cases and 670 deaths; the 2014–2015 West Africa outbreak caused over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 欧州で新たなエボラ症例確認！このウイルス株にはワクチンがなく、患者には対症療法しか行えない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株のアウトブレイク（約1,830症例、670死亡）がドイツ・フランスへの越境搬送症例を通じて国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念となっており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクであり、ドイツ・フランスは搬送先の非対象国のため verified_locations から除外した。ワクチンが存在しない株である点、既に複数の国際搬送・院内感染例（ベルリン・フランクフルト・フランス）が発生している点は重大な懸念material。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Oxford inicia primeiro teste em humanos de vacina contra o vírus causador do surto atual
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Oxford begins first human trial of vaccine against the virus responsible for the current outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDBV) vaccine BD-Ebov (ChAdOx1 BDBV) begins the world’s first Phase I trial in Oxford, evaluating safety and immune response in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 amid the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Developed by the Oxford Vaccine Group and Pandemic Sciences Institute, it uses the same viral-vector platform as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. The study, initiated 57 days after the WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, aims to accelerate vaccine readiness; additional trials are planned in Uganda (MRC/UVRI and LSHTM Uganda). Serum Institute of India has produced about 620,000 doses and provides 4,000 experimental doses for this Phase I. CEPI funds roughly $8.6 million to support Oxford and SII; Africa CDC hails the development as a pivotal step.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：オックスフォード大学が現在の流行の原因ウイルスに対するワクチンの世界初のヒト臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダで継続中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行（WHOがPHEICを宣言済み）に関連する内容であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクという2つのIHR基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事本文はコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダで継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行を背景としたオックスフォードでのワクチン第I相試験開始に関する内容。インドはワクチン製造（Serum Institute of India）の文脈でのみ言及されており、流行発生国ではないため対象外。ウガンダはBluedot発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに非該当のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : à Rwampara, les agents de la riposte contre Ebola reprennent leur mouvement pour exiger le paiement de leurs salaires - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: in Rwampara, Ebola response personnel resume their protest to demand payment of their salaries - Le Potentiel
article.articleSummary: Frontline Ebola response personnel in Ituri Province, near Bunia, resumed protests at Rwampara General Reference Hospital demanding immediate payment of salaries earned since mid-May, when the response to the 17th Ebola outbreak in Ituri began. Protesters burned tires at the main entrance, expressing frustration over persistent arrears as they treat patients daily in a high-risk environment. They say assurances from the Health Minister (Public Health, Hygiene and Social Welfare) have not yielded actual payments. They will maintain the mobilization until all back pay is settled. The protests accompany growing discontent among frontline teams and could further jeopardize outbreak response if not resolved. By midday, there had been no official comment from health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：ルワンパラにて、エボラ対応要員が給与支払いを求めて抗議活動を再開
triage.triage_reason: 現在進行中の第17次エボラ流行（DRC・イトゥリ州）において、対応要員の給与未払いによる抗議活動が対応体制の機能不全を招く恐れがあり、疾患の重篤性と流行管理への影響から注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの新規症例情報ではなく、対応要員の給与未払いによる抗議活動が主題。ただし進行中のエボラ流行対応の継続性に影響しうるため、オペレーション上のリスクとして監視対象とする。Rwandaは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kumar Sanu's Son Jaan Hospitalised With Covid-19, Shares Light-Hearted Health Update From Hospital - Woman's era Magazine
article.articleSummary: Jaan Kumar Sanu, son of veteran playback singer Kumar Sanu, has been hospitalised in Mumbai after testing positive for Covid-19 at Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital. He released a video from his hospital bed confirming the positive test and ongoing treatment, but did not specify when symptoms began or how he contracted the virus. The update, delivered with humor in the caption, has no accompanying medical bulletin and no discharge date. He remains under observation as of 2026-07-13. The report notes isolated Covid-19 cases continue to be reported in parts of India, with overall infections well below peaks of previous waves, while health authorities maintain cautious guidance. Symptoms or severity were not disclosed, and the piece highlights supportive messages from fans and attention on his recovery.

triage.headline_ja: Kumar Sanu氏の息子Jaan氏、COVID-19で入院し病院から明るい健康近況を発表
triage.triage_reason: 有名人個人の一入院例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 有名人個人の健康ニュースであり、感染症危機管理上のシグナルとしては該当しない。インドでの散発的な症例に言及があるが、全体的な感染は過去の波を大きく下回るとされている。

article.articleHeadline: Solidariedade em ação: a luta de Pedro André contra a chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Solidarity in Action: Pedro André's Fight Against Chikungunya
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya confines Pedro André, a self-employed professional, to bed for 50 days, rendering him unable to work while his family faces mounting bills and emotional strain. A fundraising campaign launched by his friend Juliana Miranda has raised over R$9,000, about 60.2% of a R$15,000 goal, to cover private treatments not fully reimbursed by his health plan, which only covers hospitalizations. The financial and psychological burden threatens his recovery and return to work. The campaign reflects community solidarity, with donations of any size needed to help Pedro access essential treatment and resume normal life. Published July 13, 2026, the piece highlights the human impact of chikungunya and illustrates how small acts can provide critical support during medical hardship.

triage.headline_ja: 行動する連帯:ペドロ・アンドレのチクングニア熱との闘い
triage.triage_reason: 個人の闘病と募金活動に関する人間味のある記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規性を示す情報がないため見送りとする。

article.articleHeadline: UK begins trials of Ebola vaccine developed in just eight weeks
article.articleSummary: UK regulators have approved phase one trials of an Ebola vaccine developed by the University of Oxford in eight weeks after a May 17 public health emergency. It is the first of four vaccines under development to enter clinical testing. The vaccine targets the Bundibugyo species of Ebola; there are no approved drugs or vaccines currently. Trials will enroll 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 in the UK, with first doses expected within weeks and participants monitored for a year to assess immune response and potential side effects. Researchers are coordinating with partners in Uganda to prepare trials in Africa. The outbreak remains in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 625 deaths and 1,792 laboratory-confirmed cases in a conflict zone with highly mobile populations, underscoring the need for rapid vaccination. The technology used is the same as that behind the Oxford/AstraZeneca Covid vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、わずか8週間で開発されたエボラワクチンの治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（625人死亡、1792症例確認）は紛争地域における人口移動性の高さも相まって深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを有し、既存の対応の枠を超えた緊急ワクチン開発が行われている点でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は英国でのエボラワクチン治験開始だが、背景として言及されているDRCでの進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（致死数625、確定症例1792）が重大なリスク要因。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。UKは治験実施国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: US citizen working for humanitarian organization tests positive for Ebola in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Democratic Republic of Congo: A U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization tested positive for Ebola, Bundibugyo variant, and was admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital’s isolation unit around 3 a.m. local time, after contracting the virus in Congo. The CDC is coordinating with the employer, U.S. agencies, Congolese authorities, and partners to prevent further transmission and identify close contacts. As of 2026-07-13, the outbreak in Congo is the fastest-growing on the continent, with 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths; cases have also been detected in neighboring Uganda. Earlier this month, an American doctor infected in Congo was treated in Germany. The Congolese outbreak was declared May 15; Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or treatment. Efforts are hampered by funding shortfalls, attacks on health centers, and ongoing conflict in eastern Congo, though clinical treatment trials began earlier this month.

triage.headline_ja: 米国籍の人道支援団体職員がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱に陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）は1,830例・648死亡と大陸最速の拡大を見せ、ウガンダへの拡大やドイツへの症例輸送も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびドイツでの症例確認は記事に記載されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認済みワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株であること、資金不足や東部紛争による対応困難も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: बरसात के मौसम में बकरियों को गला घोटू, PPR, खुरपका का बढ़ जाता है खतरा, ऐसे करें देखभाल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: During the monsoon season, goats are at increased risk of throat choke, PPR, and foot-and-mouth disease; here's how to care for them.
article.articleSummary: Monsoon humidity in India accelerates growth of bacteria, viruses and parasites, hitting goats hardest. In Uttar Pradesh’s Lakhimpur Kheri district, goats face rising outbreaks of Peste des petits ruminants (PPR, throat choke), Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), pneumonia, diarrhea, intestinal worms and skin diseases; untreated cases can be fatal. To mitigate risk, goats should not be tethered in muddy or waterlogged areas; provide elevated, dry shelter to prevent water accumulation and hoof infections. Veterinary expert N.K. Tripathi notes goats are especially affected during the rains; vaccination should be prioritized before the monsoon. Green fodder during the season may harbor fungi and parasites, so avoid moldy or spoiled feed and, if possible, supply dry, balanced rations. The Department of Animal Husbandry urges timely vaccination and good husbandry to protect goats through the wet season.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季にヤギは喉づまり病(PPR)や口蹄疫のリスクが高まる、こうしてケアしましょう
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の家畜疾病（PPR・口蹄疫）に関する一般的な予防・飼育管理の啓発記事であり、特定の異常なアウトブレイク報告ではなく、人への公衆衛生影響も記載がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は獣医専門家によるヤギの季節性疾病（PPR、口蹄疫、肺炎、下痢等）予防のための一般的な飼育管理アドバイス記事であり、特定の異常な流行やヒトへの感染リスクを示すものではない。家畜衛生上の日常的な注意喚起に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: New American Ebola Patient Arrives In Germany For Treatment
article.articleSummary: An American humanitarian worker infected with Ebola—Bundibugyo strain—arrived in Frankfurt, Germany, for treatment and was transferred to a university hospital after contracting the virus in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the outbreak epicenter. The DRC Ebola outbreak, declared in mid-May, reports more than 1,900 confirmed cases and about 700 deaths. The World Health Organization provided initial clinical care before arranging the safe transfer. German health authorities say the patient poses no risk to the public. The transfer follows US requests for German assistance due to medical expertise and the efficient flight path from the DRC. This case follows the earlier May recovery of another American treated at Berlin’s Charité Hospital. There is currently no vaccine or cure for the Bundibugyo strain, underscoring ongoing containment and international coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな米国人エボラ患者が治療のためドイツに到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（1900例以上、死者700人）に関連し、国際的な患者搬送が発生しているため、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的拡大リスクからフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC・イトゥリ州ブニアで発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行であり、感染者が治療目的でドイツ・米国に搬送された事例。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: New US Ebola patient arrives in Germany for treatment
article.articleSummary: An American Ebola patient arrived in Germany for treatment, landing in Frankfurt overnight and being transferred to a university hospital. The patient, a humanitarian worker who had been in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, is part of the current outbreak centered in Ituri. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak in mid-May and it is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or cure. As of now, the outbreak has over 1,900 confirmed cases and more than 700 confirmed deaths, according to the WHO. German authorities say the patient poses no danger to the general population or other patients in Frankfurt, and that the risk of importation is very low. The move followed a US request exploiting Germany’s Ebola-treatment expertise and shorter flight from the DRC. A second US patient was quarantined in May at Berlin’s Charité and recovered after two weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな米国人エボラ患者、治療のためドイツに到着
triage.triage_reason: DRC第17次エボラアウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株、確定症例1900人超、死亡700人超）に関連し、既に国際的な患者搬送が発生しているため、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大）を満たす。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は米国人患者のドイツ搬送に関する内容だが、根本的な感染症イベントはDRC・イトゥリ州における第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療法なし）であり、既存の大規模アウトブレイクとして継続的な監視が必要。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: En RDC, deux traitements contre Ebola à l'essai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, two Ebola treatments are being tested.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola treatments are being tested in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid the worst outbreak there. As of July 12, 2026, the DRC reports 1,926 infections and 702 deaths, with neighboring Uganda reporting at least 20 cases and 2 deaths by July 7. There is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment yet. The WHO-coordinated Partners program began July 2 in Ituri province to evaluate remdesivir (an antiviral) and MBP134 (a monoclonal antibody) for Ebola and Ebola Bundibugyo, with animal studies indicating efficacy against Bundibugyo. The initiative follows rapid mobilization six weeks after outbreak declaration. Separately, healthcare workers in Ituri, and also North Kivu and South Kivu, have protested unpaid salaries and poor working conditions, triggering a national doctors’ strike starting June 24 and a “Hospitals without doctors” action July 7–16. Government discussions led to consensus on priority measures and a pledge to lift the strike.

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo alcanza los 1.926 casos confirmados y deja 702 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and left 702 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with data updated to 12 July. The outbreak spans Haut-Uélé, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu and Tshopo, where a reinforced response remains active. Some 753 patients are in isolation or receiving care, and 318 have recovered. The 78.3% contact-tracing rate is pivotal to interrupt transmission. Authorities stress ongoing epidemiological surveillance, early detection, clinical management, and community engagement to identify new cases and reduce spread. The response is supported by national and provincial authorities and international partners, with surveillance and coordination continuing. A second American infected with Ebola has been evacuated from DRC to Germany for specialized treatment, about two months after the first American patient; the CDC notes this development.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行、確定症例1,926件、死者702人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が複数州に拡大し、致死率も高く、国際的な患者搬送事例も発生しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国人患者2名がドイツへ搬送された事例があるが、これは治療目的の移動であり、米国・ドイツでの感染拡大を意味するものではない。主たる発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo reports Ebola cases in give provinces, caseload nears 1,900
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports Ebola across five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo—with 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths. Haut-Uele and Tshopo are linked to the Ituri epicenter through contacts and movement. The report lists 763 patients in isolation or treatment; bed occupancy is 95.1%. Cumulatively 306 have recovered; 299 suspected cases, including 91 deaths, are recorded. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and was declared May 15. Oxford University has begun the first human trial of a BD-Ebov vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55. Recruitment has begun; vaccinations are expected pending regulatory approval. The ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine, developed with the Pandemic Sciences Institute, uses the same vector as Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID shot. Serum Institute of India has ~620,000 doses in stock, with 4,000 investigational doses; CEPI funds up to $8.6 million, and Uganda studies are planned via MRC/Uganda Virus Research Institute and LSHTM Uganda Research Unit.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、5州でエボラ症例を報告、累計症例数は1,900人近くに

triage.notes: ウガンダやインドは記事中で言及されているが、発生地ではなく研究協力・ワクチン備蓄拠点としての言及のため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Alemanha recebe segundo cidadão norte-americano infetado com ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany receives second American citizen infected with Ebola
article.articleSummary: Germany receives a second American citizen infected with Ebola, evacuated from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Frankfurt University Hospital, where the patient is in stable condition and displaying symptoms. The CDC says the patient is an NGO worker in DRCongo; the transfer follows a roughly two-month gap since the first American Ebola patient was moved to Germany amid the outbreak that began in May in Ituri province. Congo reports 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with 753 in isolation and 318 recovered; Uganda has 20 cases (15 imported from DRCongo) and 2 deaths. The current outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, with a 30-50% case-fatality rate and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; Germany’s population risk is described as very low.

article.articleHeadline: "أكسفورد" تختبر لقاحاً جديداً ضد فيروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford tests a new vaccine against the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Oxford scientists have developed a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. In the United Kingdom, 50 healthy volunteers aged 18–55 will be enrolled to assess safety and immunogenicity. A stockpile of about 620,000 doses of the ChAdOx1 BD-BPV Ebola vaccine has been prepared for potential future use, while around 4,000 experimental doses are allocated for the Oxford trial. Preparations are also underway with partners in Uganda to conduct trials in Africa, as the Ebola outbreak continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Volunteers will be monitored for one year; researchers expect to quickly determine whether the vaccine provides strong, rapid protection. The vaccine uses the same chimpanzee adenovirus technology as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine, enabling development within weeks.

article.articleHeadline: नागपुर मनपा: उपराजधानी में दो जोन पर विशेष नजर, आसीनगर और मंगलवारी जोन में बरसाती संक्रमण के लिए उपाय आरंभ | Special focus on two zones in the sub-capital; measures to tackle monsoon-related infections have been initiated in the Asi Nagar and Mangalwari zones
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nagpur Municipal Corporation: Special focus on two zones in the sub-capital; measures to tackle monsoon-related infections have been initiated in the Asi Nagar and Mangalwari zones.
article.articleSummary: Nagpur Municipal Corporation targets malaria and other mosquito-borne infections in Asi Nagar and Mangalwari zones as the monsoon worsens, with stagnant-water breeding in coolers, plant pots, debris, and construction sites. Authorities have identified several high-risk 'black spots' and launched intensified control in these zones. Measures include Emilo IL spray and zone-wise fogging (vehicle-mounted, handheld, and cold) plus larvicide. Resources deployed: 11 vehicle fogging units, 51 handheld fogging machines, 10 cold fogging machines, and 126 spraying pumps. From 1 July, 50 temporary sanitation workers from the Malaria Department will inspect breeding sites and conduct awareness campaigns for three months. Monitoring will cover about 10 locations, plus Lakshminagar and Dharampeth zones. From July to December, 100 breeding checkers will be recruited for door-to-door surveys to curb transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Rutan Rantau siapkan skrining TBC bagi warga binaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rantau Detention Center prepares TB screening for inmates.
article.articleSummary: Rantau Detention Center (Rutan Kelas IIB Rantau), Tapin Regency, South Kalimantan, Indonesia, is preparing Free Health Check (Cek Kesehatan Gratis, CKG) with chest X-ray for early detection of infectious diseases, especially tuberculosis (TB), among inmates (WBP). The initiative follows a June 29, 2026 directive (PAS.6.PK.07.03-7) from the Directorate of Health Care and Rehabilitation, and aims to optimize the System Database Pemasyarakatan (SDP) Watkesrehab for outbreak management. The Rutan has begun compiling participant data and will coordinate with the Tapin Health Office (Dinkes) on scheduling and technical execution, subject to provincial guidance on how many sites will offer the CKG with chest X-ray. Nurul Hidayah, Secretary of Dinkes Tapin, supports the program but notes that implementation depends on further coordination and Kalimantan Selatan Provincial Health Office directives. The program seeks to improve inmate health services and strengthen TB prevention in the correctional environment.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, two Ebola treatments are being tested.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains the worst outbreak on record, with 1,926 infections and 702 deaths reported in the DRC as of July 12, 2026; Uganda has recorded at least 20 cases and 2 deaths by July 7. There is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment to end an Ebola outbreak. A clinical trial program called Partners, coordinated by the WHO and involving the DRC’s INRB, Belgium’s Institute of Tropical Medicine (IMT) in Antwerp, and the University of Oxford, began July 2 in Ituri province (northeast DRC). It evaluates two candidates—remdesivir (antiviral) and MBP134 (monoclonal antibody)—to improve survival against Ebola and Ebola Bundibugyo; animal studies showed efficacy against Bundibugyo. The trial runs amid political tensions and healthcare worker strikes in Ituri and other eastern provinces, including a June 24 doctors’ strike and a July 7–16 “Hospitals Without Doctors” campaign.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany receives the second American infected with Ebola from the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Germany has taken in a second U.S. citizen infected with Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The patient, who works for a humanitarian organization in the DRC, arrived at Frankfurt airport and was transported to a Frankfurt University Hospital under strict security for specialized care. The U.S. CDC reports the infection source but does not disclose gender. The Bundibugyo strain is a less common Ebola variant detected during the Congo stay. This follows a May 2026 evacuation when another American physician infected in the DRC was evacuated to Berlin's Charité, treated in a high-security isolation unit, and discharged after just over two weeks. His wife and four children, asymptomatic, remained hospitalized as high-risk contacts. The DRC has faced multiple Ebola outbreaks in recent years.

article.articleHeadline: Alemania acoge por segunda vez a un estadounidense contagiado por ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany hosts for the second time an American infected with Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to spread, with the Democratic Republic of Congo reporting an outbreak declared in May in eastern provinces—Alto Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo—now tallying about 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths. The current wave is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy. In Europe, Germany has received a second American patient infected in the DRC, a humanitarian worker admitted to Charité University Hospital in Berlin; the second case remains in Frankfurt. The U.S. CDC confirms the infection source as exposure while caring for patients in DRC; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and bleeding in severe cases. France reported a doctor infected and evacuated on June 24. Kenya opened a 50-bed quarantine center at Laikipia airbase; U.S., Canada, and Bahrain have tightened traveler controls from affected areas.

article.articleHeadline: Illegal mosquito agarbattis are as dangerous as dengue, warn 70% of doctors
article.articleSummary: Illegal mosquito repellent agarbattis sold in India, many unregulated and untested, pose a greater immediate health threat than dengue or malaria, according to a Kantar study commissioned by HICA ahead of National Dengue Day. Across 12 Indian cities, 1,264 households reported 59% using such products; 85% of the Rs 2,000 crore market is illegal without CIR registration or transparent ingredient disclosure. Among 405 doctors surveyed, 70% classify illegal agarbattis as a major respiratory hazard, with 67% equating health risks to cigarette smoke; 84% link regular use to higher household healthcare costs. Consumers wrongly equate chemist-sold products with safety (48%), while 50% trust herbal variants; 66% doctors cite misleading claims and lack of regulatory oversight. Calls for enforcement, CIR compliance, and safer, approved alternatives to protect vulnerable groups such as children and COPD patients.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths. Health authorities say the outbreak remains active. The United States has urged citizens to avoid travel to the DRC amid ongoing response efforts, following a second American aid worker contracting Ebola. The U.S. Embassy in Kinshasa warns that any traveler infected with Ebola may be quarantined outside the DRC for up to 21 days, at their own expense, reflecting heightened international precaution. The report underscores continued transmission and international concern regarding the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で拡大継続…確定症例1,873件、死亡672人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模拡大しており（1873症例・672死亡）、米国が渡航自粛勧告や検疫措置を発令するなど国際的な関心・対応が高まっているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国はDRC発生地域として扱われているが、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。米国は渡航勧告・援助関連の言及に過ぎないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: У току испитивање лекова против еболе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Testing of Ebola drugs is underway.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, clinical trials test two experimental Ebola therapies for the Bundibugjo (Bundibugyo) strain as part of an international project involving universities, pharmaceutical companies, and WHO. The regimen combines remdesivir, already in use, with MBP134, an experimental agent that recognizes and neutralizes the virus. Belgian doctor Laurence Lizenborgs of the Institute of Tropical Medicine (Antwerp), collaborating with Oxford University and WHO, says one or both drugs could reduce mortality, with combination potentially more effective. Reliable efficacy will require about 700–1,000 patients. Trials began roughly six weeks after the outbreak emerged; Bunia, where Bundibugjo was detected in May, is stabilizing, but the epidemic has spread to other areas, risking Kisangani. Without stronger contact tracing and isolation capacity in Congo, containment remains challenging. Africa CDC reports 1,830 cases and 648 deaths; Bundibugjo remains highly deadly for a third of those infected.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療薬の試験が進行中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo株エボラの大規模流行（1,830症例、648死亡）が継続しており、国際的な治療薬治験も行われているため、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準にも合致する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはベルギー（アントワープ）や英国が含まれるが、これらは治験実施機関の所在地であり、実際のエボラ発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（ブニア、キサンガニ周辺）のみである。致死率は約1/3と高く、接触追跡・隔離能力の不足により封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 700 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the DR Congo has surpassed 700.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has killed 702 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases and 318 recoveries. Authorities are maintaining intensified monitoring in five provinces: Upper Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, and two additional provinces were added to the list of high‑risk areas. The World Health Organization has recognized the situation as an emergency and warned of a high risk of cross-border spread to neighboring countries. The outbreak status remains active, with ongoing transmission and deaths; the report does not specify the infection source. Separately, Russia announced readiness to begin large-scale Ebola vaccine production, stating that African fieldwork and rapid testing identified the strain and that there is capacity to ramp up manufacturing.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでのエボラ死者数が700人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでエボラ感染者1,926人・死者702人と大規模な流行が継続しており、WHOが緊急事態と認識し越境拡大リスクを警告しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ロシアのワクチン量産準備に関する言及があるが、発生国はDRコンゴのみであり、ロシア（Russian Federation）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。
