article.articleHeadline: Oxford Ebola Vaccine: What to Know About the New Shot Entering Human Trials
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola in DRC outbreak: Oxford University launches first human trial of BD-Ebov (ChAdOx1 BDBV) in Oxford with 50 volunteers; Serum Institute stockpiled ~620,000 doses; 4,000 investigational doses used for early-stage study; Uganda trial planned pending approvals. The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the largest Bundibugyo epidemic on record, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, spreading to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces. No approved vaccine for Bundibugyo; licensed vaccines Ervebo and Mvabea/Zabdeno target Zaire strain and are not recommended for current outbreak. WHO prioritized evaluating ChAdOx1 BDBV alongside rVSV Bundibugo, CEPI investing up to $8.6 million to support development and potential emergency-use authorization if early results positive. International evacuations include a US citizen treated in Frankfurt and another in Berlin; July 2 began a trial of MBP134 and remdesivir in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード発エボラワクチン：新規注射薬のヒト試験開始について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（症例1,926件、死亡702件）が発生しており、複数州への拡大と国際的な患者搬送（ドイツ）も確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは承認待ちの試験計画のみで実際の流行発生地ではない。英国・ドイツはワクチン試験実施地・患者搬送先であり、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 專家預計香港未來兩個月新冠病毒傳播勢頭或加劇 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts predict Hong Kong's COVID-19 transmission trajectory may intensify in the next two months | Telecom
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, Hong Kong expects COVID-19 transmission to intensify over the next one to two months during the summer influenza peak. An infectious diseases specialist from the Hong Kong Medical Association reports private COVID-19 consultations have risen about 30% recently, with population immunity waning and potential for further community spread. COVID-19 is described as endemic with active cycles every 6–9 months, linked to variant shifts and immunity decline; cases have climbed since late May, with possible further increases. Symptoms remain generally milder than during peak pandemic waves, but high-risk groups still face severe outcomes, reinforcing vaccination for eligible residents. Department of Health data show SARS-CoV-2 positivity in respiratory samples rising to 6.02% (from 0.45% in early May). Wastewater and genomic analyses indicate locally circulating variants from the JN.1 lineage, including XFG and NB.1.8.1. RSV positivity has risen to 2.59%, still below historical peaks of 8–10%.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、香港のCOVID-19感染は今後2か月で拡大する見通しと予測
triage.triage_reason: 香港でのCOVID-19季節的増加は既知の風土病サイクルの範囲内であり、重症度も軽度とされるが、今後の拡大傾向は続報を要する。
triage.notes: COVID-19は季節性・風土病化した感染症として記載されており、症状も軽度とされる。香港の記事のためChinaに分類（香港・マカオはChinaに含める規定）。

article.articleHeadline: 正值夏季流感季節　新冠未來兩月或趨活躍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the summer influenza season is underway, COVID-19 may become more active over the next two months.
article.articleSummary: July 13, 2026 — Hong Kong is in the summer influenza season, with SARS-CoV-2 activity possibly rising over the next one to two months. The Hong Kong Medical Association says COVID-19 has become endemic; overall activity remains low but has gradually increased since May. COVID-19 typically shows cycles of about 6–9 months linked to variant changes and waning immunity, and a renewed uptick cannot be ruled out as the last cycle nears one year. Government COVID-19 vaccines are due to expire; a new batch is expected to arrive in Q4 2026, during which eligible individuals may temporarily lose access to free government vaccination. Influenza activity has also risen above baseline and is expected to stay elevated in the coming weeks, with heightened vigilance advised for high-risk groups. Last summer’s flu season started late and lasted longer, while this year’s winter season did not occur.

triage.headline_ja: 夏の流感シーズンを迎え、新型コロナは今後2か月で活発化する可能性
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既に風土病化しており季節的な活動増加は想定内の範囲。インフルエンザも例年の季節的変動であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 香港におけるCOVID-19とインフルエンザの季節的活動増加に関する通常の公衆衛生報告であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。ワクチン供給の一時的な空白期間について言及があるが、これも管理された事象。

article.articleHeadline: 東協財經／高端EV71疫苗撤回新加坡查驗登記　待補件重提申請
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ASEAN Finance / Premium EV71 vaccine withdrawn from Singapore inspection and registration; application to be re-submitted after additional documents are provided.
article.articleSummary: Taiwanese company Gaoduo Vaccine (MVC EV71) withdrew its Singapore drug-registration filing during the Administrative Pre-Review stage to supply supplemental documents, with a re-submission planned after completion. The EV71 vaccine targets children aged 2 months to under 6 years for active immunization to prevent enterovirus 71–related disease. Singapore, a high-incidence EV71 area, had about 27,500 newborns in 2025, and no EV71 vaccine is on the market there. The company has already earned Taiwan’s formal regulatory approval and received a Vietnam license in March 2026, with ongoing applications in other Southeast Asian nations. EV71 is a prevalent, neurotropic enterovirus capable of causing limb paralysis, encephalitis, meningitis, pulmonary edema, hemorrhage, and death. The next step is to refile for drug-approval review after addressing the Screening Input Request.

triage.headline_ja: ASEAN経済／高端EV71ワクチン、シンガポール査証登録を撤回　追加書類提出後に再申請へ
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、台湾企業のEV71ワクチンのシンガポールにおける薬事登録手続き（書類不備による申請撤回）に関する商業・規制ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はEV71ワクチンの薬事規制手続きに関する内容であり、対象国（Vietnam等）における実際の疾病発生や流行状況を報告するものではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: un nouveau patient américain soigné en Allemagne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a new American patient treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, Germany has admitted a new imported Ebola virus disease case in a U.S. citizen who was infected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The German Ministry of Health stated that the patient landed in Frankfurt, in western Germany, overnight and was immediately transported to a medical facility for treatment under medical surveillance. The evacuation was requested by the United States. The report provides no further details on the patient’s presenting symptoms, clinical status, laboratory confirmation, or exposure history, and no information is available about additional contacts or exported cases beyond the patient’s travel to Germany.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:新たな米国人患者がドイツで治療
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)で感染したとされる米国人患者がドイツへ空輸・入院した事例であり、致死率の高いエボラウイルス病の国際的移送というIHR基準複数該当のため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : un site de déplacés réclame ambulance et équipements de protection - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: an internally displaced persons site demands an ambulance and protective equipment - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak context in Ituri: At the Kigonze displacement site in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, as of July 13, 2026, ten suspected Ebola cases are reported within a single family, including a father who died of the disease; three bodies await evacuation. The site shelters about 17,000 people and faces persistent logistical challenges despite the operation of a Transit Treatment Center (Centre de traitement de transit, CTT). Étienne Dz'Djo Ndrutsi, leader of the Kigonze site, appealed for a permanent ambulance to enable rapid transfers and for sampling teams to be equipped with infrared thermometers (thermo-flash devices) and personal protective equipment. The request aims to accelerate patient care and reduce mortality by improving rapid response capabilities at this displacement camp amid ongoing outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ出血熱：避難民サイトが救急車と防護具を要求 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州の避難民キャンプでエボラ疑い例10名（うち1名死亡）が報告され、人口密集・資源不足の環境で拡大リスクが高く、外部支援の要請もあることからフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 避難民キャンプ内での家族内クラスター発生（疑い例10名、死亡1名、遺体3体未搬送）であり、CTT運営下でも救急車・防護具・体温計不足が指摘されている。ヒト-ヒト感染及び国境を越えた拡散リスクを含め、既存のエボラ流行状況を踏まえた詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Over 1,000 persons acquire new HIV infections in Bono within five months - GAC
article.articleSummary: 1,145 new HIV infections were recorded in Bono region from January to May 2026, per the Ghana AIDS Commission (GAC), spanning Bono, Bono East and Ahafo regions. Infections are rising among vulnerable male and female populations. To curb transmission, GAC is distributing Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP), described as highly efficacious for at-risk individuals; PrEP adherence is urged. People living with HIV should consistently take antiretroviral therapy to suppress the virus. Case distribution shows Sunyani Municipality 222; Berekum Municipality 184; Jaman South 126; Wenchi 119; Tain 112; Dormaa East 95; Dormaa Municipal 71; Sunyani West 65; Jaman North 60; Dormaa West 57; Berekum West 27; Banda 7. Public health messages call for avoidance of unprotected sex and voluntary HIV status checks to know one’s status.

triage.headline_ja: ボノ州で過去5か月間に1,000人以上が新規HIV感染 - GAC
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の風土病であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: GACによる既存のHIV対策プログラム(PrEP配布・ART推奨)の一環としての統計報告であり、新興感染症の異常な増加や国際的懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتمدد شمال شرق الكونغو.. تفشٍ جديد يرفع مستوى القلق الصحي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads to northeastern Congo... a new outbreak raises health concerns.
article.articleSummary: July 13, 2026 – Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has extended from Ituri to two new northeastern provinces, Chobo and Out-Wili. The outbreak, first announced mid-May and initially centered in Ituri, now threatens to widen. Official tallies released Sunday evening show 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. Four cases have been reported in Chobo, with two deaths among them; one death has been reported in Out-Wili. Investigations indicate the new cases originate from Niania in Ituri, but health authorities say the two provinces are now part of the outbreak, necessitating expanded response. The National Institute of Public Health urges seriousness; WHO warns the true scale may be two to four times higher than official counts due to weak links between many new cases and known cases. Contact tracing is under way; Kisangani border towns are of concern as transmission continues via direct contact with infected bodily fluids, producing fever, vomiting, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ北東部に拡大…新たな流行が保健上の懸念を高める
triage.triage_reason: 確定1,926例・死亡702例に達するエボラ流行がイトゥリ州から新たに2州へ拡大し、WHOは実際の規模が公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性があると警告しており、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクいずれも該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にMali(Koulikoro)やAngola(Cuanza Norte)が含まれているが、記事内容はDRCのエボラ流行に関するものであり、これらは誤タグと判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Oxford inicia primeiro ensaio clínico em humanos de vacina contra cepa Bundibugyo do Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford begins first human clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: Oxford launches the first human trial of an Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain, using the same viral vector platform as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Recruitment has begun and vaccination is expected to start in coming weeks pending regulatory approval. The Serum Institute of India has manufactured about 620,000 doses in two weeks and supplied 4,000 experimental doses for a Phase I study. In May, the World Health Organization recommended prioritizing the ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine alongside the rVSV Bundibugyo candidate as part of the response to the ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. CEPI will invest up to $8.6 million initially and is coordinating expanded trials in Uganda through partnerships with the Medical Research Council/Uganda Virus Research Institute and the Uganda unit of the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine. If Phase I succeeds, CEPI will back later-stage studies to pursue emergency use authorization or full regulatory approval.

article.articleHeadline: أول تجربة سريرية على البشر.. لقاح يستهدف سلالة بونديبوجيو النادرة من فيروس إيبولا - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First human clinical trial: a vaccine targeting the rare Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University has launched the first human trial of a ChAdOx1-based vaccine candidate targeting the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, amid active outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The Phase I study will assess safety and immunogenicity in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 in Oxford, with dosing expected in the coming weeks after regulatory approvals. The vaccine, developed by Oxford’s Vaccines Group and the Epidemic Diseases Research Institute, uses the same viral-vector platform previously employed for the Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Serum Institute of India has produced and stored about 620,000 doses in two weeks, earmarking 4,000 for the early trial phase. The program has World Health Organization backing and up to $8.6 million from CEPI to fund later-stage studies, with Uganda trials planned once regulatory steps are met, aiming for rapid, affordable production and distribution to affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: 初のヒト臨床試験開始:エボラウイルスの希少株ブンディブギョ型を標的とするワクチン
triage.triage_reason: DRCとウガンダでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが進行中とされ、WHO・CEPIが関与する国際的なワクチン開発対応が行われている点で公衆衛生上の懸念とWPRO基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はオックスフォード大学によるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）ワクチンの臨床試験開始であり、疾患名がCOVID-19となっているのはワクチンプラットフォームの由来（ChAdOx1、旧AstraZeneca製COVID-19ワクチンと同技術）による誤登録と考えられる。ウガンダも発生地域として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの実際のアウトブレイク状況（症例数等）は記事に記載なく不明。

article.articleHeadline: أكسفورد تبدأ أول تجربة على البشر للقاح وقاية من سلالة نادرة من إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford begins first human trial of a vaccine to prevent a rare Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: Oxford has launched the first human trial of a vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus to accelerate the outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The Phase 1 study in Oxford will assess safety and immunogenicity of ChAdOx1 BDBPV in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55, with enrollment begun and vaccinations expected soon, pending regulatory approval. The candidate uses the same viral-vector platform as the Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Serum Institute of India has produced and stockpiled about 620,000 doses, with 4,000 for this early test. If Phase 1 succeeds, partners will back later-stage studies for emergency-use authorization or full approval and aim to provide rapid, affordable supplies to affected countries.

article.articleHeadline: 甲流再次爆发，可能不发烧！医生：出现7个症状，别犹豫赶紧就医_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 influenza outbreak again; fever may not occur! Doctors: seven symptoms—don’t hesitate to seek medical care immediately.
article.articleSummary: H1N1 influenza outbreak resurges with numerous cases lacking fever, prompting renewed caution in diagnosis and care. Reports from tertiary hospitals’ respiratory and pediatric clinics show patients with several days of malaise and normal temperatures testing positive for influenza A (H1N1) antigens. The virus exhibits two clinical patterns: high fever and no fever; no-fever infections can carry high viral loads and risk pneumonia or myocarditis, especially in the elderly, children under five, and those with chronic diseases. Seven hallmark symptoms include: widespread muscle and joint pain with fatigue; occipital headache and eye strain; severe sore throat with dry cough; persistent chilly sensation with cold extremities; temporary taste/smell loss; gastrointestinal upset; and quiet palpitations or chest tightness at rest. Management emphasizes: if 2+ symptoms, do home antigen testing; 4+ symptoms, seek hospital care; antiviral therapy within 48 hours; preventive measures: ventilation, disinfection, masking, vaccination considerations.

triage.headline_ja: 甲流（H1N1インフルエンザ）が再流行、発熱しないケースも！医師：7つの症状が出たら迷わず受診を
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の流行に関する一般的な医療情報記事であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限等のIHR基準には該当しないが、症状の非典型性や重症化リスクへの言及があり経過観察の対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事は医療啓発的な内容で、具体的な症例数や地域範囲、統計データが記載されていないため、感染規模や重症度の詳細は不明。季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行パターンの可能性もある。

article.articleHeadline: Bupati Kupang Yosef Lede Minta Pencegahan Rabies Diperkuat hingga ke Desa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kupang Regent Yosef Lede Urges Rabies Prevention to Be Strengthened Down to the Village Level
article.articleSummary: On 13 July 2026, Kupang Regent Yosef Lede urged intensified rabies prevention education down to the village level after fatalities from bites of rabies-transmitting animals occurred in Kupang Regency. Speaking at a Coordination Meeting for Socialization, Communication, Information, and Education (KIE) on Rabies Disaster Risks, he called for cross-sector collaboration among BPBD, the Disaster Risk Reduction Forum, the Health Department, the Livestock Service, and district and village authorities to bolster community awareness and preventive measures. The Health Department reported that stocks of anti-rabies vaccine (VAR) in Kupang are sufficient, and will continue partnering with the Livestock Service and BPBD to educate the public and manage rabies cases (GHPR) in line with SOPs. Health centers (puskesmas) are identifying every GHPR case to ensure timely treatment and vaccination, with an emphasis on extending education to the desa level to prevent further fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: クパン県知事ヨセフ・レデ氏、村レベルまで狂犬病予防の強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡例が報告されているが、具体的な症例数や増加傾向など定量的な情報が不足しており、地方行政の予防啓発活動としての側面が強いため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドネシアの東ヌサトゥンガラ州クパン県で地域流行がみられる疾病であり、本記事は地方政府による予防啓発の呼びかけが主旨。具体的な症例数・死亡者数・発生時期の急増等の情報がないため、フルリスク評価への移行は保留し続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Bavarian Nordic A/S: Bavarian Nordic's Chikungunya Vaccine Submitted for Regulatory Approval in Brazil
article.articleSummary: Anvisa marketing authorization submission in Brazil for Bavarian Nordic’s chikungunya vaccine CHIKV VLP, for individuals 12 years and older. The filing, by Bavarian Nordic’s partner Eurofarma, follows an exclusive Brazil distribution deal (Jan 2026) where Eurofarma handles regulatory, commercialization, and distribution while Bavarian Nordic remains the manufacturer; Eurofarma has a right of first refusal for broader Latin America. Brazil accounts for a substantial share of global chikungunya burden, with 2025 data showing more than 500,000 cases and about 200 deaths worldwide, over half of which were in Brazil. CHIKV VLP is a single-dose, prefilled, adjuvanted recombinant protein vaccine that is non-infectious and induces protective immunity starting about one week after vaccination. The vaccine has prior approvals in the U.S., EU, UK MHRA, Switzerland, and Canada under the name VIMKUNYA, illustrating expanded access beyond travel markets.

triage.headline_ja: バヴァリアン・ノルディック社:同社のチクングニアワクチンがブラジルで規制当局への承認申請を提出
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチンの規制承認申請に関する企業発表であり、新規の疾病発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン承認申請の企業ニュースであり、チクングニア熱の発生状況自体を報じるものではない。ブラジルの2025年の疾病負荷データは背景情報として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: ডেঙ্গু রুখতে কোটি কোটি মশা ছাড়ছে ব্রাজিল, কেন
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil releases hundreds of millions of mosquitoes to curb dengue — why?
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, Brazil is confronting one of history’s most severe dengue outbreaks. In addition to vaccines and insecticide spraying, health authorities are deploying a novel approach: releasing millions of genetically modified mosquitoes across several cities. Laboratory-bred insects are designed to lower the population of dengue-carrying mosquitoes, with the expectation that fewer vectors will curb transmission. The surge in dengue cases is placing extraordinary pressure on hospitals nationwide. Officials describe the release program as a major tool in the outbreak response, aiming to complement traditional control methods and reduce the disease burden. The article notes the ongoing nature of the outbreak and Brazil’s adoption of this vector-control strategy as part of its broader public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: デングを抑えるためブラジルが数億匹の蚊を放つ、その理由とは
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで記録的規模とされるデング熱大流行が続き、病院システムへの深刻な負荷が報告されている。IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常性（史上最悪級との表現）」の2点が該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルの風土病だが、本記事は『史上最悪級』の流行と遺伝子組み換え蚊放出という新規対策導入を報じており、規模と対応の両面で注視が必要。外部支援の要否や具体的症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載なく不明。

article.articleHeadline: 中国新冠确诊7.9万例，新加坡高峰已过，这波夏季疫情什么情况？网友反应出乎意料 - 新加坡眼
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China reports 79,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases; Singapore's peak has passed—what's the situation with this summer wave of the epidemic? Netizens' reactions are surprising — Singapore Eye.
article.articleSummary: 79,000 new confirmed COVID-19 cases were reported in China during June 2026, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (in a patient with underlying conditions). May had about 21,900 cases. Sentinel hospital surveillance shows rising influenza-like illness COVID-19 positivity: 2.9% in week 1, 4.1% in week 2, 5.3% in week 3, and 6.4% in week 4 of June; in the first week of July (week 27) the rate reached 9.6%, second only to influenza at 11.6%. Genomic data indicate dominance of Omicron NB.1.8.1 and its sublineages, comprising over 95% by late June; this lineage is descended from JN.1 with enhanced immune escape but no clear evidence of increased virulence. No details on imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で新型コロナ7.9万例確認、シンガポールはピーク越え―この夏の流行状況とネット民の反応
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の流行病であり、季節性の感染再拡大を報告する定期サーベイランス情報。重症化率・死亡率は低く、異常性や国際的拡大の明確な証拠もない。
triage.notes: 季節性のCOVID-19流行に関する定点サーベイランス報告。免疫逃避が強いNB.1.8.1系統が優勢だが、重症度増加の明確な根拠はなく、死亡例も基礎疾患保有者1例のみ。中国国内の通常監視体制下での報告であり、フルRRAの対象とはしない。

article.articleHeadline: Marcos Oliveira, o Beiçola, volta ao CTI após cirurgia por infecção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marcos Oliveira, the Beiçola, returns to the ICU after surgery for infection.
article.articleSummary: Marcos Oliveira, the Brazilian actor known for Beiçola in A Grande Família, has returned to the Intensive Care Unit at Hospital São Lucas in Rio de Janeiro due to a perineal infection after surgery. An update posted on social media by friend Rose Scalco on Saturday, July 11, reports he is afebrile with very good blood pressure, conscious, and deeply moved by visitors. He has been hospitalized since June 30 and is currently a resident at Retiro dos Artistas. The infection is localized to the perineal region. Prior to this admission, Oliveira underwent surgery on May 13 to treat a herniated disc. He awaits a new medical evaluation as doctors monitor his condition and continue care. The update underscores ongoing support and prayers from friends and fans.

triage.headline_ja: 俳優マルコス・オリベイラ（ベイソーラ）、感染症手術後にICUへ再入院
triage.triage_reason: 個人の術後感染症に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や感染拡大の可能性を示す情報がない単発の医療事例。
triage.notes: 個人の術後合併症（会陰部感染）に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: un nouveau patient américain soigné en Allemagne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a new American patient treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, Germany treated a new American Ebola patient at the request of the United States. The humanitarian worker infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo was flown to Frankfurt overnight and admitted to the city’s university hospital; authorities gave no further health details. The World Health Organization identifies Bunia, capital of Ituri Province, as the epicenter of the current Ebola outbreak in DRC, declared in mid-May. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO’s latest tally reports 1,947 cases and 704 deaths. Officials say there is no danger to the German population or to other patients at the Frankfurt hospital, and the risk of an infected person entering Germany remains very low. Earlier, in late May, another American patient and his family were quarantined at Berlin’s Charité; that patient recovered after two weeks. The United States cited Germany’s medical expertise and shorter flight times from the DRC as reasons for seeking assistance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：新たなアメリカ人患者がドイツで治療を受ける
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクは死亡者704人・致死率約36%と深刻で、ワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、患者の国際搬送（米国→ドイツ）も発生しており国際的波及の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題であるアウトブレイクはDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）で発生。ドイツ・米国は患者搬送・治療先であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株にはワクチン・特異的治療がなく、致死率が高い点は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: RCA : les enfants représentent près de la moitié des cas de choléra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central African Republic: Children account for nearly half of cholera cases.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in the Central African Republic continues with 435 suspected cases and 36 deaths as of July 6, 2026, after official declaration on June 26 following confirmation by the Institut Pasteur de Bangui. Children under 10 account for 44% of cases. Transmission is spreading along the Ubangi River, marking the border with the Democratic Republic of Congo and raising cross-border concerns due to population movement and the river as a transport axis. UNICEF has intensified support to the Ministry of Health, delivering treatment kits for up to 300 patients, 2,000 doses of oral rehydration salts and zinc for community care, and installing tents to increase the cholera treatment center capacity from 40 to 70 beds. Water, sanitation and hygiene interventions are being scaled. Populations are urged to seek care for acute watery diarrhea or vomiting and to practice hygiene measures; rapid care is essential to prevent and treat cholera.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ共和国:コレラ患者の約半数が子供
triage.triage_reason: コレラ流行は中央アフリカ共和国（対象国外）で発生しており、致死率が高く深刻だが、DRC（対象国）への越境拡大は「懸念」段階でまだ確定例の報告がないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 流行の主体は中央アフリカ共和国（対象国リスト外）。ウバンギ川沿いでの人口移動によりDRC（対象国）への越境拡大懸念が記載されているが、DRC国内での確定症例の記述はなく、現時点ではリスクとして言及されるのみ。DRCでの症例確認があれば速やかにPICKUPへ格上げすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Evacuan a Alemania a un segundo ciudadano estadounidense contagiado con ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A second American citizen infected with Ebola in Congo evacuated to Germany
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths; 753 in isolation and 318 recovered. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo strain (no approved vaccine or treatment), continues under reinforced surveillance across Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. The World Health Organization has declared it a public health emergency of international concern. A second American citizen infected in the DRC has been evacuated to Germany for treatment, admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital with symptoms but in stable condition; the patient is identified as a humanitarian worker. About two months earlier, another U.S. patient was evacuated to Germany. Uganda reports two Ebola-related deaths amid cross-border concerns. Congo had declared the end of its Kasai outbreak in December 2025.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスに感染した2人目の米国人がドイツへ緊急搬送
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラアウトブレイク（1926症例・702死亡）が継続中で、国際的な患者搬送やウガンダでの関連死亡も報告されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ドイツ・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。WHOはこのアウトブレイクをPHEICと宣言しており、ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株による感染拡大が継続している点で高い懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le bilan officiel atteint 1 926 cas et 702 morts, l'épidémie gagne cinq provinces
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the official toll has reached 1,926 cases and 702 deaths; the outbreak has spread to five provinces.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: as of 11 July, 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths (case fatality 36.4%), with 318 recoveries and 753 in isolation or hospital. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak began 15 May in Mongbwalu, Djugu (Ituri) and now spans five provinces: Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo (Kisangani's Makiso-Kisangani, Lubunga, Mangobo), and Haut-Uele (Wamba). Ituri remains epicenter, with most cases and deaths across 26 of 36 health zones. Strikes over pay and personnel management persist; the health minister in Bunia pledged payroll reforms, including professional cards that double as payment cards. Civil society warns of underfunding; a $510 million Jun-Nov plan with WHO was only 35% funded by mid-June. Security barriers from CODECO/ADF hinder access; a treatment center was attacked in Ituri. No licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; Ervebo protects Zaïre strain. PARTNERS trial evaluates MBP134 and remdesivir; several vaccine candidates may enter trials soon. Suspected cases: call 151.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：公式集計は1,926症例、死者702人に達し、感染は5州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行が5州に拡大し、致死率36.4%、ワクチン未承認、資金不足・治安悪化によりアクセス困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、資金計画（5.1億ドル）は6月中旬時点で35%しか賄われていない。CODECO/ADFによる治安悪化が対応を妨げており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: СВЕТОТ СО НАДЕЖ ГЛЕДА КОН КОНГО - Започна тестирање на нова терапија против ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The world looks to Congo with hope - Testing of a new Ebola therapy has begun.
article.articleSummary: Two experimental Ebola therapies are being tested in the northeast Democratic Republic of Congo against the Bundibugyo strain. The clinical trial uses the antiviral remdesivir alongside MBP134, an experimental agent containing proteins designed to recognize and neutralize the virus. The study is part of an international effort led by universities, pharmaceutical companies, and the World Health Organization. Belgian physician Laurens Liesenborghs of the Institute of Tropical Medicine in Antwerp, collaborating with the University of Oxford and WHO, says that one or both drugs are expected to help reduce mortality, and that their combined use could be more effective than either alone. The initiative follows promising animal studies and aims to determine whether the therapy can lower death rates among affected patients.

triage.headline_ja: 世界がコンゴに希望を寄せる - 新たなエボラ治療法の試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC北東部でBundibugyo株エボラの発生を背景に国際的な治療薬臨床試験が進行中であり、エボラは深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるためフルRRAが必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は治療薬（remdesivir・MBP134）の臨床試験に関する報道だが、その背景にDRC北東部でのBundibugyoエボラ株の発生が示唆されている。アウトブレイクの規模・症例数など詳細情報は記事中に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : la sécurité biologique, priorité de l'Institut national de recherche biomédicale (médecin biologiste) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Biosafety, a Priority of the National Institute of Biomedical Research (medical biologist) - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, in Bunia, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, biosafety is a top priority at the National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB) for handling suspected Ebola samples. Dr. Tony Wawina Bokalanga notes that no manipulation occurs before an inactivation step that destroys the virus to protect laboratory staff. Post-inactivation, samples are processed in cartridges and run on the Radio One platform, which determines Ebola positivity within about 65 minutes. Overall, from receipt to result, the turnaround is capped at approximately 1 hour 15 minutes, with additional PCR platforms available for precise rapid diagnostics. Waste management is stringent, with used cartridges disinfected before incineration to prevent contamination. Results are immediately transmitted to Ebola treatment center teams to enable rapid care for confirmed cases and discharge for negative results, underscoring robust laboratory safety and prompt clinical integration.

triage.headline_ja: イツリのエボラ出血熱：国立生物医学研究所（医師・生物学者）が優先するバイオセーフティ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でエボラ疑い検体の検査体制・治療センター連携が稼働していることが示唆されており、エボラという致死率の高い疾患である点から、実際の症例動向を確認するためフルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は検査ラボのバイオセーフティ手順・迅速診断体制に関する内容であり、実際の症例数・死亡者数・アウトブレイク宣言の有無は明記されていない。エボラ疑い検体が存在し治療センターへの連携が行われている点から、現在進行中の対応があると推測されるため、続報および公式発表の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lindsey Graham's Cause of Death; Legionnaires' at the Guggenheim; Renowned Doc Dies
article.articleSummary: Sen. Lindsey Graham, 71, died of an aortic dissection attributed to arteriosclerotic cardiovascular disease, per a preliminary medical examiner’s report. Actor Sam Neill, 78, died; he had disclosed angioimmunoblastic T‑cell lymphoma in 2023 but was cancer-free at death. The University of Oxford launched a BD-Ebov vaccine trial targeting the Ebola strain circulating in Congo and Uganda. The World Health Organization stated that 80% of new Ebola cases have no known contact with another infected person, underscoring ongoing transmission. In New York City, the Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum and several nearby Manhattan buildings tested positive for Legionella bacteria, indicating Legionnaires’ disease risk. Across the United States, cyclosporiasis outbreaks prompted state mapping and restaurant menu adjustments as health authorities monitor the foodborne illness.

triage.headline_ja: リンゼー・グラハム上院議員の死因、グッゲンハイム美術館でのレジオネラ症、著名医師の死去
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで継続しているエボラ流行に関し、新規症例の80%が感染経路不明という異常な伝播状況が報告されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 本記事は米国政治家の死去、NYCのレジオネラ症、米国内サイクロスポラ症、コンゴ/ウガンダのエボラ流行という複数の話題を扱うダイジェスト記事。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ（ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外）。WHOによる『新規エボラ症例の80%が感染源不明』という指摘は市中伝播の可能性を示唆し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Barcelona identifica 77 zonas de riesgo para frenar la reproducción del mosquito tigre este verano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Barcelona identifies 77 risk zones to curb the tiger mosquito's breeding this summer.
article.articleSummary: 77 risk zones identified in Barcelona to curb tiger mosquitoes this summer, with intensified surveillance from April through November to locate and eliminate breeding sites before reproduction. Most breeding occurs on private properties—balconies, terraces, and gardens—and the city maintains the 'A casa teva' program with home visits (over 700 last year) to advise residents on prevention. In 2025, inspectors checked more than 37,000 points (drains and ornamental fountains) and carried out 20,549 larvicidal treatments using biological products, after 164 citizen reports, most of which found no mosquito activity. Weekly checks of balconies and gardens are recommended; remove water-collecting containers such as plant saucers, buckets, toys, or clogged drains. Local transmission risk for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya remains low but possible if an infected traveler returns from tropical countries (e.g., Thailand, Brazil, Senegal) and is bitten early on.

triage.headline_ja: バルセロナ、今夏のヒトスジシマカ繁殖抑制のためリスクゾーン77カ所を特定
triage.triage_reason: バルセロナにおける蚊媒介感染症予防のための日常的な監視・防除活動を報じる記事であり、実際の症例発生や異常事態の報告はない。対象国での発生事例でもない。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン・バルセロナの蚊対策プログラムに関する内容。タイ・ブラジル・セネガルは感染者が渡航しうる例示国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: CAR cholera outbreak spreads along Ubangi river
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in the Central African Republic (CAR) spreads along the Ubangi River, affecting Bangui 2, Bimbo, and Mbaïki health districts. It was declared on 26 June 2026 after laboratory confirmation by Institut Pasteur in Bangui. As of 6 July 2026, 435 suspected cases and 36 deaths have been reported, a case fatality rate of 8.3%. Children under 10 account for 44% of cases, underscoring their vulnerability. The epidemic continues along the Ubangi River, forming the CAR-DRC border and a transport corridor, raising concerns about further spread. UNICEF is scaling up response with cholera kits for up to 300 patients, 2,000 doses of ORS and zinc for community management, and expansion of the cholera treatment and referral centre from 40 to 70 beds; WASH interventions are underway. Authorities urge care for watery diarrhoea or vomiting and emphasize handwashing, safe water treatment, and sanitation; surveillance and infection prevention are being strengthened.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ共和国のコレラ流行がウバンギ川沿いに拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率8.3%、死者36名を伴うコレラ流行がCAR-DRC国境を成すウバンギ川沿いに拡大しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 確認された症例はすべて中央アフリカ共和国（CAR）国内（バンギ2区、ビンボ、ムバイキ）で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。DRCとの国境（ウバンギ川）沿いでの拡大懸念が言及されているが、DRC国内での確認症例は記載がないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 大陆6月新冠确诊近8万例为上月3.6倍 传广东疫情严重(图)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland China's June COVID-19 confirmed cases near 80,000, 3.6 times that of last month; reports say Guangdong's outbreak is severe (photo).
article.articleSummary: As of June 2026, Mainland China reported 79,000 newly confirmed locally transmitted COVID-19 cases, 130 severe cases and 1 death, a 3.6-fold rise from May. Sentinel data show 3,741 positive samples, all Omicron variants. In weeks 23–26, emergency department influenza-like illness tests for COVID-19 rose from 2.9% to 6.4%. In week 27, COVID-19 made up 9.6% of influenza-like respiratory samples, second to influenza (11.6%) and ahead of enterovirus (9.1%). May had 21,861 new cases (35 severe, 1 death); April had 23,477 (64 severe, 4 deaths). Data authenticity is debated by observers. Guangdong is rumored to have a severe outbreak, with residents reporting painful symptoms and widespread testing discussions. On July 10, Guangdong CDC issued a health-risk alert focusing on dengue, chikungunya, influenza, COVID-19, hand-foot-mouth disease/ herpangina, malaria, monkeypox, and Ebola. Hong Kong reports rising cases and hospitalizations, signaling a possible summer outbreak. Public reaction includes skepticism toward official data and perceptions that COVID-19 persists like a cold.

triage.headline_ja: 中国本土の6月新型コロナ確定診断者数は約8万人で前月の3.6倍、広東省の流行が深刻と報道（写真）
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19増加ではあるが、広東省CDCが健康リスク警報を発出し、公衆の関心・懸念（データの信憑性への疑念含む）が高まっているため、WPRO基準（持続的曝露・流行しやすさ）と社会的関心の両方に該当する。
triage.notes: 重症化率・死亡率は低く、季節性のオミクロン株流行と見られる。広東省・香港での症例増加が報告され、住民の関心とデータ信憑性への疑念が社会的関心として存在する。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ada Temuan DBD di Kota Padang, Warga Diminta Antisipasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases found in Padang City, residents urged to take precautions.
article.articleSummary: Padang City, West Sumatra, Indonesia reports 9 dengue fever cases from January–June 2026 at the UPTD Puskesmas Lapai in Nanggalo District; 5 of these cases are in Kelurahan Tabing Banda Gadang near areas affected by a November 2025 flood disaster. Officials say the cases are linked to environmental hygiene rather than residence in disaster zones, with no residents from disaster-affected areas recorded. Surveillance remains intensive; rapid case detection, fogging, and community education are prioritized. Environmental health expert Elsa Yuniarti warns post-disaster and extreme weather conditions can raise Aedes aegypti breeding risk due to standing water in poorly drained areas. Recommendations include the 3M Plus approach (drain and clean water sites, cover and reuse containers), routine larval checks, and ovitrap use. Families with high fever for 2–3 days suggestive of DBD should seek prompt care. Not yet a declared outbreak (KLB).

triage.headline_ja: パダン市でデング熱の発生を確認、住民に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドネシアの風土病であり、9症例という規模も小さく、KLB（アウトブレイク）宣言もされていないため、通常のサーベイランス範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: デング熱は同地域の風土病であり、症例数も少なく（半年で9例）、現地当局もKLB未宣言としている。洪水後の環境衛生対策として通常の対応がとられている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Американец примен со ебола во болница во Франкфурт
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American infected with Ebola in hospital in Frankfurt
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola, the Bundibugyo strain, was admitted to University Hospital Frankfurt after midnight, while working as a humanitarian aid worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient's condition is currently stable, and hospital officials confirm the isolation unit is structurally and organizationally separated, posing no risk to the public or other patients. The case represents an imported Ebola infection to Germany; a previous U.S. patient treated in Berlin after Congo exposure was discharged last month. In Congo, the Ebola outbreak has reached 1,926 cases and 702 deaths, with the virus spreading to two new provinces. The report emphasizes ongoing international responses and the cross-border nature of Ebola infections linked to humanitarian work in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: フランクフルトの病院にエボラ出血熱感染のアメリカ人が入院
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で拡大中のエボラ出血熱（1,926症例、702死亡、新たに2州へ拡大）がドイツへ輸入された事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行拡大とその国際的波及（ドイツ・米国への輸入例）。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。渡航・貿易制限については記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: 大陸6月新冠確診近8萬例為上月3.6倍 傳廣東疫情嚴重(圖)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland China’s June COVID-19 cases near 80,000, 3.6 times the previous month; Guangdong outbreak reportedly severe (photo).
article.articleSummary: Mainland China’s June COVID-19 outbreak rose to about 79,000 locally confirmed infections, 3.6 times May, with 130 severe cases and 1 death; 3,741 reported cases were Omicron infections. Sentinel hospital data show influenza-like illness samples positive for SARS-CoV-2 rising through weeks 23–26 (2.9%, 4.1%, 5.3%, 6.4%), and week 27 positivity at 9.6% (second to influenza at 11.6%). May’s new cases were 21,861 (35 severe, 1 death); April had 23,477 (64 severe, 4). Guangdong province is reportedly severe, with social-media accounts of painful symptoms and speculation that Guangdong may peak earlier due to proximity to Hong Kong/Macao. Guangdong CDC health tips (July 10) flag dengue, chikungunya, influenza, COVID-19, hand-foot-mouth disease, herpangina, malaria, monkeypox and Ebola as priorities. Hong Kong reports rising cases and admissions; some netizens question data reliability and debate whether COVID becomes endemic or triggers lockdowns.

triage.headline_ja: 中国本土の6月新型コロナ確定患者数が約8万人に急増、前月の3.6倍—広東省の疫情が深刻と伝えられる（写真）
triage.triage_reason: 6月の症例数が前月の3.6倍に急増し、広東省で疫情が深刻との報道があり、SNS上でも関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価による確認が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に流行が定着した疾患であり、新規性や国際拡大リスクは低いが、広東省での急増報告とSNS上のデータ信頼性への懸念から社会的関心が高まっているため、続報の確認が望ましい。香港・マカオの情報は中国に統合して扱った。

article.articleHeadline: Pacjent z ebolą w Niemczech. U mężczyzny wykryto rzadki szczep wirusa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient in Germany. A rare strain of the virus was detected in the man.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen treated at University Hospital Frankfurt, Germany, has Ebola virus disease, confirmed as the rare Bundibugyo strain. The patient, who worked on humanitarian missions in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, was admitted on July 13 around 3:00 and placed in an isolated unit. He remains stable and poses no threat to other patients or residents, according to hospital officials; the CDC had noted his DR Congo work before transfer for specialized care. Bundibugyo Ebola is a rare Central African strain with no vaccine or proven therapy. Ebola can cause fever, headache, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, organ dysfunction, and sometimes internal or external bleeding; incubation is typically 2–21 days. The DR Congo outbreak was officially declared on May 15, with more than 1,900 confirmed cases and hundreds of deaths, amid challenging sanitary conditions. This is an imported case to Germany.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツでエボラ患者、男性から稀な株のウイルスを検出
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクからの輸入症例がドイツで確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準の複数該当が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで進行中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクからの輸入症例（ドイツ・フランクフルト）。ドイツ・米国は輸入先国であり対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCの流行状況（2026年5月15日正式宣言、確定症例1900件以上、数百人死亡）が主要な公衆衛生上の懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch viel größer als gedacht: Behörden schlagen Alarm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak much larger than previously thought: authorities sound the alarm.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-13, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is believed to be two to four times larger than the officially reported total. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific therapy; care is supportive, with clinical trials under way. The epicenter remains eastern DRC’s Ituri Province (Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nyakunde) and has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo, with international spillover into Uganda and an imported case in France marking the first export linked to this outbreak. The DRC reports about 1,830 laboratory-confirmed cases and 648 deaths, though death tolls may rise as undetected transmission chains expand. An American humanitarian worker in the DRC tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus—the second known U.S. infection; the CDC is coordinating high-risk contact tracing. Ongoing conflict and weak health infrastructure hinder containment; U.S. risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、想定よりはるかに拡大:当局が警戒を強める
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が公式報告の2〜4倍規模に拡大し、ウガンダやフランス、米国への越境・輸入例も発生しているため、IHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツ語圏メディアだが主題はDRCでのエボラ流行拡大。ウガンダ・フランス・米国への輸出例は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: un nouveau patient américain soigné en Allemagne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a new American patient treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: An American humanitarian worker infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo arrived in Germany for treatment, taken by ambulance to Frankfurt University Hospital on May 11, 2026. He is being treated in Frankfurt, transferred from Bunia, capital of Ituri Province and epicenter of the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, declared mid-May. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments. The World Health Organization reports 1,947 cases and 704 deaths to date. The German Health Ministry says there is no danger to the public or other patients in Frankfurt, and the risk of an Ebola-infected person entering Germany remains very low. Earlier, at the end of May, another American patient and his family were quarantined in Berlin’s Charité; the man recovered after two weeks. The U.S. sought Germany’s help for medical expertise and shorter transit from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：新たな米国人患者がドイツで治療中
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラアウトブレイク（1,947症例、704死亡）に関連し、感染者の国際搬送が発生しておりIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 感染者はDRCのブニアからドイツ（フランクフルト）へ搬送された事例。アウトブレイク自体の発生国はDRCであり、ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン・承認された治療法がないブンディブギョ株による大規模流行で、致死率が高い点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeito Renato Junior testa positivo para Covid-19 e seguirá em isolamento com trabalho remoto - Portal Zukka Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mayor Renato Junior tests positive for COVID-19 and will remain in isolation while working remotely - Portal Zukka Brasil.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, Manaus, Brazil, Mayor Renato Junior tested positive for COVID-19 and will remain in isolation for three days while working remotely. The mayor reported fever, sore throat, and dry cough over the weekend; his condition is stable with a good clinical trajectory and normal oxygen saturation. He is up to date with the COVID-19 vaccination and is following medical guidance during recovery. The city notes that updates on his health will be released by the Municipal Secretariat of Communication (Semcom). In the meantime, the municipality reiterates guidance for people with respiratory symptoms to seek medical care when needed and to maintain preventive measures to reduce transmission of COVID-19 and other respiratory illnesses. No further details on infection source or contacts were provided.

triage.headline_ja: レナト・ジュニオル市長がCOVID-19陽性、リモートワークで隔離継続
triage.triage_reason: 個人（市長）のCOVID-19罹患に関する単発報道であり、症状は軽度・安定しており公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 市長個人の罹患報告であり、地域的な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の危機を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha govt strengthening COVID-19 surveillance: Official
article.articleSummary: Odisha government is strengthening COVID-19 surveillance, especially in bordering districts, after reports of multiple coronavirus cases in neighbouring Andhra Pradesh. State Public Health Director Rabindranath Mishra said tests are being conducted at district-level health facilities across the state, including border districts; no positive coronavirus case has been detected in Odisha so far. He urged people not to panic and asked chief district medical officers to step up surveillance in light of Andhra Pradesh infections. The heightened monitoring comes ahead of the annual Rath Yatra in Puri, expected to draw lakhs of devotees from across the country. The measures aim to ensure early detection and rapid response during the festival period.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州政府、COVID-19サーベイランスを強化:当局者
triage.triage_reason: オディシャ州では陽性例は未検出であり、隣接するアンドラプラデシュ州での複数症例を受けた予防的サーベイランス強化の段階に留まるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: アンドラプラデシュ州での症例発生が事実上のトリガーだが、詳細な症例数・重症度は記事に記載なし。オディシャ州は予防的措置段階であり、大規模宗教行事(ラト・ヤトラ)前の対応として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : premier essai chez l'homme d'un vaccin contre la souche Bundibugyo qui frappe la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: first-in-human trial of a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain that is affecting the DRC.
article.articleSummary: ChAdOx1 BDBV, the first-in-human Ebola vaccine candidate against the Bundibugyo strain, launched a phase 1 trial at Oxford on 13 July 2026 to assess safety and immunogenicity in 50 people aged 18–55; recruitment is ongoing and first doses are expected in coming weeks pending regulatory clearance. Bundibugyo drives the 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda; the outbreak is the third-largest on record, with no vaccine against Bundibugyo. Ervebo protects only the Zaïre strain, leaving outbreak response to isolation, contact tracing and safe burials. The Oxford candidate uses the same viral-vector platform as the Covid vaccine. CEPI, Oxford and Serum Institute of India formed an $8.6 million collaboration two weeks after outbreak declaration May 15 to accelerate development; Serum Institute has produced about 620,000 doses and provided 4,000 for the trial. If Phase 1 succeeds, Ugandan studies are planned; a vaccine is unlikely this wave.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国を襲うブンディブギョ株に対するワクチンの初のヒト臨床試験
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はオックスフォードでのワクチン第1相試験開始であり新規発生イベントではないが、背景にあるDRC/ウガンダでの第17次エボラ流行（史上3番目の規模）は継続中であり動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発に関する科学ニュースが主眼であり、DRC・ウガンダでの既存流行（第17次エボラ流行、ブンディブギョ株）は既知情報として言及されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。新規発生情報ではなくワクチン開発進捗の続報のためWATCHと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de hepatite A diminuem em Campinas, mas Saúde alerta para cuidados contra B e C
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis A cases decline in Campinas, but Health Department warns to take precautions against Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, reports a 50.7% drop in hepatitis A cases from 2023 (126) to 2025 (62), with four cases in 2026 (partial). Hepatitis B shows fluctuations: 69 in 2023, 63 in 2024, 86 in 2025, and 39 in 2026 (partial). Hepatitis C declined from 166 in 2023 to 110 in 2024, then rose to 151 in 2025 and 58 in 2026 (partial). July Yellow, the national hepatitis awareness month, urges reinforced prevention and testing since infections are often silent but can progress to cirrhosis and liver cancer. Vaccines for A and B are part of the National Immunization Program and available at all Campinas health centers; keep vaccination records. Hepatitis A vaccine is a single dose at 15 months; adults on HIV PrEP should also be vaccinated. Hepatitis B vaccine is given to newborns within 12 hours of birth, with high coverage aided by pentavalent vaccines at 2, 4, and 6 months; older unvaccinated individuals require three doses.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスでA型肝炎症例は減少するも、保健当局はB型・C型肝炎への注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: A型肝炎症例は減少傾向であり、B型・C型肝炎も通常の啓発月間に伴う注意喚起の内容で、異常な増加や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は毎年恒例の『7月のイエロー月間（肝炎啓発月間）』に関する定例的な公衆衛生広報であり、統計データも減少・変動の範囲内で通常の疾病サーベイランス報告に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: South Sudan intensifies preparedness as DRC Ebola outbreak surges
article.articleSummary: DRC’s Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak has reached 1,947 confirmed cases (704 deaths, 336 recoveries), with transmission extending from Ituri into four additional provinces. The 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC is spreading faster than prior epidemics—over 1,000 confirmed infections within 40 days of response activation, and more than 100 deaths in early July; about half of those tested in affected areas are positive. South Sudan, sharing porous borders with DRC and Uganda, has no confirmed cases but faces high importation risk due to cross-border movements and ongoing displacement. South Sudan has expanded laboratories, trained frontline workers, established Infectious Disease Units in Juba, Nimule, Yei and Yambio, pre-positioned medical supplies, and intensified entry screening at Nimule, Kaya, Olupai, River Yei and Juba International Airport; about 390,000 travellers have been screened. Authorities stress enhanced surveillance, rapid PCR testing, early detection, isolation and treatment, rather than border closures. Uganda is deploying labs inside DRC to boost regional surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダン、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行拡大を受け対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,947例・死亡704例に達し、既存の流行より速いペースで拡大、複数州へ拡散し周辺国への越境リスクも高いためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 南スーダン・ウガンダ・スーダン・ブルキナファソは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの流行が本記事の主題であり、周辺国は越境リスクとして言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola Spreads in Two More Provinces, NanoViricides Has Received National Ethics Committee Approval for a Phase II Clinical Trial of NV-387 Oral Gummies as a Treatment for Ebola in Congo
article.articleSummary: July 13, 2026 — Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces, with confirmed cases 1,926 and 702 deaths. The outbreak involves a new Bundibugyo Ebolavirus variant for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. NanoViricides reports National Ethics Committee approval for a Phase II trial of NV-387 Oral Gummies as Ebola treatment in the DRC and plans to file a Clinical Trial Application with ACOREP. NV-387 has already been shipped to the DRC for a Mpox trial, and sufficient drug product is available to begin Ebola study. The company touts NV-387 as a broad-spectrum oral antiviral that mimics host cell features, potentially reducing viral escape versus antibody therapies such as MBP134 or MBP134 plus Remdesivir. WHO declared a PHEIC on May 17, 2026; CDC models project 10,000–20,000 cases and 2,000–4,000 deaths in three months. Om Sai Clinical Research Pvt Ltd serves as the CRO.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが新たに2州に拡大、NanoViricides社がコンゴでのエボラ治療薬NV-387経口グミの第II相臨床試験について国家倫理委員会の承認を取得
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したエボラ（新規Bundibugyo variant）がDRC国内で複数州に拡大し、症例1,926例・死亡702例に達しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として深刻度・異常性・国際拡大のいずれも該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は新規Bundibugyo Ebolavirus variantの拡大とWHOのPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）、CDCによる今後3か月で1万〜2万症例・2千〜4千死亡の予測を報告。DRC国内のHaut-UeleおよびTshopo州は同国内地域のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Gefährliches Virus: Ebola-Patient in Frankfurt bisher stabil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous Virus: Ebola Patient in Frankfurt Remains Stable.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient at Frankfurt University Hospital is stable after arriving around 03:00 local time, treated in a dedicated special isolation ward with no age or gender disclosed; symptoms are consistent with Ebola but the disease has not progressed since arrival. Treatment focuses on fluids and nutrition, with care adjusted to symptoms. Hospital officials emphasize no risk to the public and that staff are protected; the isolation ward employs multiple containment levels to prevent any leakage. The case represents the second Ebola patient treated in Germany, arriving by air at Frankfurt Airport overnight, about two months after the first Ebola-infected US citizen. The patient is a US national working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo and tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, per the CDC. Further travel or outcome details remain under clinical management.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なウイルス：フランクフルトのエボラ患者、これまでのところ安定
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）感染者がドイツへ空路搬送された事例で、短期間に2例目の国際輸入例が確認されており、IHR基準（重大性・異常性・国際拡大）に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCで人道支援活動に従事していた米国籍者で、ブンディブギョ株エボラに感染。ドイツでの輸入例は2例目であり、DRCにおけるエボラ流行の継続・拡大が示唆される。DRC国内の流行状況・規模に関する続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Al meer dan 700 doden sinds ebola-uitbraak in Congo, intussen verspreidt virus zich naar twee nieuwe provincies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 700 dead since the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, meanwhile the virus is spreading to two new provinces.
article.articleSummary: DRC’s Ebola outbreak has 1,926 cases and 702 deaths as of July 11 (INSP). The Bundibugyo ebolavirus has spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo, now five provinces affected. In Tshopo: four confirmed cases (two deaths); Haut-Uele: one death. All new cases are imported from Niania in Ituri. Kisangani, ~1.5 million, lies ~600 km west of the epicenter; Haut-Uele borders South Sudan and the Central African Republic. The Bunia epicenter reports a 24-year-old pregnant woman who died after transport from Ituri; traditional funerals fuel transmission. Internationally, a US humanitarian worker tested positive in Congo; two Americans treated in Germany; a humanitarian doctor positive in France—the first Bundibugyo case in Europe. Oxford and INRB, with WHO and ITM Bunia, launched vaccine and treatment trials; first dose given in Bunia. Official counts may underestimate; four-fifths of new infections lack a known link. Ituri remains hardest hit; no approved vaccine or treatment; Bundibugyo variant is rare.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行、死者700人超に達し、ウイルスは新たに2つの州へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,926症例・702人死亡の大規模流行が継続中で、新たな州への拡大と米国・ドイツ・フランスへの国際的な症例流出が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツ・フランスで症例が確認されているが、これらは輸入例であり流行発生地ではないため対象国リストの verified_locations には含めない。承認されたワクチン・治療法は未確立で、公式集計は過小評価の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: India's Dengue vaccine in final trials, likely launch in 6-8 months: Experts
article.articleSummary: India's indigenous dengue vaccine has entered Phase-3 trials and could be launched in 6-8 months after regulatory approval, as announced in Nagpur on July 13, 2026. Alongside the domestic candidate, two foreign pharmaceutical firms are also developing dengue vaccines. Dengue currently has no specific antiviral treatment; management remains supportive with emphasis on hydration, nutrition, fever control, and close monitoring for warning signs such as falling platelet count, bleeding, shock, and organ complications. Parents are advised to seek immediate medical consultation if children exhibit loss of appetite, extreme weakness, or deterioration in health during fever. The candidate vaccine is planned for two doses with a three-month interval between them. The paediatricians’ workshop, attended by Dr Uday Bodhankar and colleagues, noted the ongoing monsoon-related rise in dengue cases in Nagpur.

triage.headline_ja: インドのデング熱ワクチン、最終治験段階へ 6~8ヶ月後の発売見込み:専門家
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン開発の進捗に関する情報提供記事であり、アウトブレイクの異常性や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱ワクチンの臨床試験進捗とナグプールでの季節性デング熱増加への一般的な医療アドバイスに関するもので、新たなアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Oxford Inicia Primeiro Ensaio Humano de Vacina Contra a Variante Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Oxford Begins First Human Trial of Vaccine Against Bundibugyo Variant
article.articleSummary: Oxford launches the first human trial of an Ebola Bundibugyo strain vaccine (ChAdOx1 BDBV, BD-Ebov). The Phase 1 study in Oxford will evaluate safety and immunogenicity in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55, with vaccination expected to start in coming weeks after regulatory approval. The vaccine uses the same viral-vector platform as the Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 shot. Serum Institute of India has produced about 620,000 doses and supplied 4,000 experimental doses for this initial trial. In May the World Health Organization recommended prioritizing ChAdOx1 BDBV alongside the IAVI rVSV Bundibugyo candidate for evaluation in response to the outbreak spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. CEPI will invest up to $8.6 million initially to support development, with Uganda trials planned through the MRC/Uganda Virus Research Institute and LSHTM Uganda Research Unit. Positive results could lead to Phase 3 studies and emergency-use authorization, with rapid, affordable access in affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：オックスフォードがブンディブギョ株ワクチンの初のヒト臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダで拡大中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに対するワクチン開発の動きであり、既知の重大感染症の国際的拡大・重症度の観点からIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はオックスフォードでのワクチン臨床試験開始だが、背景としてDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイク拡大が言及されている。ウガンダは対象国リスト外、インドはワクチン製造国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, al via il primo trial clinico del vaccino per il virus Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the first clinical trial of the Bundibugyo virus vaccine begins.
article.articleSummary: Phase 1 clinical trial begins for the Ebola Bundibugyo virus vaccine ChAdOx1 BDBV, developed by the University of Oxford with CEPI support, enrolling 50 healthy volunteers to assess safety and immunogenicity. This marks the first human trial of a vaccine against Ebola Bundibugyo. The ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola epidemic continues to affect the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, described as the third-largest Ebola outbreak to date with rising case counts. Doses for the trial are supplied by Serum Institute of India (SII), with CEPI and Oxford collaborating to enable rapid, affordable vaccine access for affected communities. If Phase 1 is successful, CEPI plans to partner with Oxford and SII for later-stage trials to support emergency use authorization or licensing. Africa CDC welcomes the progress as part of global efforts to accelerate development of safe, effective tools against the virus.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:ブンディブギョ型ウイルスワクチンの第1相臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン試験が主題だが、DRCとウガンダで進行中のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が『史上3番目に大きい流行』で症例数が増加中と記載されており、公衆衛生上重大な懸念があるため。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験が主題だが、進行中のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（DRC・ウガンダ）に関する情報を含む。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドはワクチン供与元（Serum Institute of India）としての言及であり、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Cercetătorii de la Universitatea Oxford lucrează la primul vaccin din lume împotriva variantei Ebola care se răspândește în Congo. A început prima fază a studiului clinic
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers at the University of Oxford are working on the world's first vaccine against the Ebola strain circulating in Congo. The first phase of the clinical trial has begun.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University in the United Kingdom has announced the first-phase clinical trial of the world’s first vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola circulating in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The study will be conducted in Oxford and enroll 50 healthy adults aged 18–55, with recruitment underway. About 4,000 experimental doses are available, and British researchers will collaborate with partners in Uganda to prepare Africa-based trials. Volunteers will be followed for one year to assess safety and potential protection, with early indications of efficacy anticipated. The vaccine uses the same technology as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. While vaccines exist for other Ebola variants, the DRC outbreak season has already resulted in at least 625 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学の研究者らが、コンゴで流行中のエボラ株に対する世界初のワクチンを開発中。臨床試験の第1相が開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はワクチン開発だが、DRCで流行中のブンディブギョ株エボラにより既に625人の死者が出ていることが明記されており、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性）に該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事本文の主眼はオックスフォードでの第1相ワクチン臨床試験だが、背景としてDRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行（死者625人以上）に関する重要情報を含むため、DRCでの流行状況について別途フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。ウガンダは臨床試験協力国として言及されているが、流行発生国ではないため対象国リストに含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 6月新冠病例增加？专家：新冠感染没有明显季节性_南方网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are COVID-19 cases increasing in June? Experts say COVID-19 infections show no obvious seasonality.
article.articleSummary: China CDC's National COVID-19 Epidemic Situation for June 2026 reports 79,000 newly diagnosed cases nationwide in June, up from May. COVID-19 shows no obvious seasonality; fluctuations are normal. The majority of infections are mild, but the elderly and people with chronic diseases remain high-risk and should strengthen protection. The circulating Omicron variant is NB.1.8.1 and its sublineages, with no marked change in virulence. Common symptoms include low-grade fever, sore throat, cough, nasal congestion, and runny nose; some patients experience diarrhea. Seek medical care for persistent high fever, dyspnea, chest tightness, or altered consciousness; avoid self-medication and rely on medical guidance. Summer also involves rhinovirus, parainfluenza virus, human metapneumovirus, Mycoplasma, and Chlamydia; ensure ventilation and hygiene, avoid crowded, poorly ventilated venues, and seek care if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: 6月の新型コロナ症例は増加？専門家「新型コロナ感染に明確な季節性はない」
triage.triage_reason: 定例のCOVID-19流行状況報告であり、変異株の毒性変化なし、重症度も軽度中心で異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる月例COVID-19状況報告。流行株NB.1.8.1系統に毒性変化なく、症状は軽度が中心。定例監視情報でありシグナルとしては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura Virus: Symptoms, Causes and Why Gujarat's Latest Cases Are Raising Concern
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus deaths in Gujarat as three children die, prompting health alert during monsoon when sandfly activity rises. The virus is transmitted by infected sandflies; outbreaks reported across India, with monsoon peak. In children under 15, infection can rapidly progress from fever to acute encephalitis, seizures, confusion, vomiting, drowsiness; coma within 48-72 hours without timely care. No specific antiviral or vaccine; treatment is supportive (fever, seizures, dehydration, complications) and early hospitalisation improves outcomes. Prevention focuses on reducing sandfly exposure: full-sleeved clothing, age-appropriate insect repellents, bed nets, and environmental measures to reduce sandfly breeding (garbage disposal, eliminating stagnant water/damp areas). Seek immediate medical attention for fever above 101°F (38.3°C) with neurological symptoms. Emphasize monsoon vigilance; parents should monitor children.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス:症状、原因、そしてグジャラート州で新たな症例が懸念を呼んでいる理由
triage.triage_reason: グジャラート州で小児3名が死亡するチャンディプラウイルス(脳炎)の集団発生が報告されており、重症度が高く季節性(モンスーン)の流行拡大が懸念されるためIHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはインド、特にグジャラート州で季節的(モンスーン期)に発生が報告される既知の再発性疾患。ワクチン・特異的治療法がなく小児の致死率が高いため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Flambée de diarrhée aiguë à Shabunda : Dr Pacifique Kapimbu alerte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surge in acute diarrhea in Shabunda: Dr Pacifique Kapimbu warns.
article.articleSummary: Acute diarrhea surge in Shabunda territory (Mulungu health zone) with 52 cases and 11 deaths between 23 June and 7 July 2026; case fatality rate 21.1%. Severe dehydration dominates, especially in Lubila health area lacking logistical support. The outbreak concentrates in epidemiological weeks 26–27. Adults 18–50 are most affected, with children 1–5 also impacted. Risk linked to consumption of untreated drinking water from the Lubila and Ulindi rivers during low water, accelerating household transmission. No external support mobilized to date. Four-pronged response: strengthen surveillance and field investigations; rapid dehydration management; intensified sanitation messaging; distribution of water potabilization kits. Dr. Pacifique Kapimbu Wilondja appeals to partners and NGOs for urgent delivery of rehydration solutions, medications, and chlorine stocks to avert a catastrophe.

triage.headline_ja: シャブンダで急性下痢が急増：パシフィック・カピンブ医師が警鐘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国シャブンダ地域で致死率21.1%という高い急性下痢の流行が発生し、外部支援がないまま拡大の恐れがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率21.1%は非常に高く、汚染された河川水の飲用が原因とされコレラ等の水系感染症が疑われる。ブラジルの地名（Paraíba、Mulungu）はBluedotによる誤付与と考えられ、記事はDRC南キブ州シャブンダのみが主題であるため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 cases in Baguio mild, manageable
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 cases in Baguio City remain mild and manageable, with 41 infections reported since January and 37 in the last week of June; about 78% were mild and largely among health care workers. City officials have intensified hospital surveillance, case investigation and contact tracing, and reinforced safety protocols, while urging residents and visitors at crowded events to wear masks, avoid handshakes, and consider vitamin C to boost immunity. The health system says it can handle the uptick. Separately, the City Health Services Office notes 1,480 influenza-like illness cases from January 1 to July 9, with roughly one in five hospitalized, mostly children aged 1–14; illnesses overlap among influenza A/B, SARS-CoV-2 and RSV. In the Cordillera region, 3,771 ILI cases Jan 1–Jul 6, down 36% YoY; 71 Covid-19 cases Jan–Jul 11, 44.8% lower than 2025.

triage.headline_ja: バギオ市の新型コロナ感染は軽症で管理可能
triage.triage_reason: 症例数は前年より減少傾向で、地元当局も軽症・管理可能と評価しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の保健当局は既存のサーベイランス体制内で対応可能と報告しており、前年比で症例数も減少傾向にある。

article.articleHeadline: ایبولا ویکسین کی آزمائش شروع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccine trial begins.
article.articleSummary: UK regulator approves clinical trials for a rapidly developed Ebola vaccine; Oxford University scientists began testing eight weeks after May 17 health emergency was declared. Among four candidate vaccines, this one is the fastest to reach human testing; volunteers are being recruited, with the first dose expected in healthy UK adults within weeks. Global alert follows the rapid spread of the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with about 1,100 suspected cases; Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. CEPI has allocated up to $50 million to Moderna for preclinical and early clinical trials; Moderna reports positive early results. The vaccine aims to protect against a deadly virus and simplify dosing, though it remains unclear whether it will be single- or two-dose. Security in eastern Congo could complicate trials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチンの臨床試験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo株エボラの拡大（確認282例・死亡42・疑い約1100例）、ウガンダにも拡大しグローバルアラートが発令されており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はUKでのワクチン臨床試験だが、背景にDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）流行があり、これがイベントの本質。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。UK/Oxfordはワクチン試験実施地であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola quitte l'Ituri : comment l'épidémie a gagné cinq provinces
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola exits Ituri: how the outbreak has spread to five provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the DRC has spread to five provinces, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of July 11. Ituri remains epicenter; other affected provinces are Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé. In Kisangani, Tshopo, four imported Ituri cases were confirmed on July 12, with three health zones (Makiso-Kisangani, Mangobo, Lubunga) and about 40 suspected cases and 130 contacts. Kisangani’s position as a transport hub raises spread risk to multiple provinces via road, river, and air links; high-risk areas include Bafwasende and Waniarukula near Nia-Nia in Ituri. Haut-Uélé reported first cases in Wamba; Ituri’s Boga zone near the Uganda border is now affected. Ituri accounts for 26 of 36 zones affected; Bundibugyo strain with no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; Ervebo only targets Zaïre. Response relies on early detection, contact tracing, and isolation, with five-province expansion increasing cross-border concerns.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、イツリを越えて広がる：5つの州への拡大の経緯
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ（ブンディブジョ株、承認ワクチン・特効薬なし）が5州に拡大、1,926例・702死亡、交通拠点キサンガニでの輸入例確認、ウガンダ国境地域にも拡大しており国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブジョ株は承認ワクチン・特効薬なし（Ervebo対象外）。ウガンダ国境地帯のBoga地区にも拡大し、隣国への越境リスクが指摘されている。イタリアの地域名（Lombardia等）は本記事の主題とは無関係と判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: 瑪嘉烈男病人染退伍軍人症　四樣本驗出桿菌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Male patient named Margaret contracted glanders; four samples tested positive for the bacillus.
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis due to Brucella serotype 1 was identified in a 39-year-old male patient in the Neurosurgery Intensive Care Unit and Critical Care Unit at Caritas Margaret Hospital, Hong Kong. The Centre for Health Protection collected samples; among 25 water samples, 4 tested positive for Brucella serotype 1 in the ICU wards, while the remaining 15 environmental samples were negative. In response, the hospital implemented enhanced cleaning and disinfection of the water system and, per CHP guidance, installed bacterial filters on faucets in high‑risk wards and provided boiled or bottled distilled water for patient use. Contact tracing found no additional hospital-acquired Brucellosis cases. The incident has been reported to the Hospital Authority, and environmental sampling and source investigations continue as of July 13, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 瑪嘉烈医院の男性患者がブルセラ症に感染　4つの検体からブルセラ菌検出
triage.triage_reason: 香港の一病院内での単発ブルセラ症症例であり、給水系統からの菌検出があったものの院内感染拡大は確認されておらず、国際的拡大やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 単一症例で院内水系統からブルセラ菌が検出されたが、追加の院内感染例は確認されていない。継続的な環境調査と対策が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا: أكسفورد تطلق أول تجربة بشرية للقاح ضد سلالة نادرة من الفيروس القاتل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: Oxford launches the first human trial of a vaccine against a rare strain of the deadly virus.
article.articleSummary: First human trial of a vaccine against Bundibugyo Ebola virus by Oxford University. The Phase 1 trial in Oxford will assess safety and immune response in 50 healthy adults aged 18-55. The candidate vaccine, ChAdOx1 BDBV, uses the same chimpanzee adenovirus vector as the Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Serum Institute of India produced about 620,000 doses and supplied 4,000 for the early trial; participant recruitment has begun, with vaccinations expected in coming weeks pending regulatory clearance. The current outbreak affects the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. WHO has prioritized evaluating ChAdOx1 BDBV alongside a single-dose candidate, rVSV-BDBV, as part of outbreak response. The Alliance for Innovations in Epidemic Preparedness plans to invest up to $8.6 million to develop the vaccine; additional trials in Uganda await approvals. If early results are favorable, later studies could lead to emergency use authorization or full approval and affordable supplies.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：オックスフォード大学が致死性ウイルスの希少株に対する初のヒト用ワクチン試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 現在進行中のブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱の流行（DRC・ウガンダ）に対するワクチン開発・臨床試験の動きであり、IHR基準複数（重大性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はオックスフォード大学によるワクチンPhase1試験の開始だが、その背景には現在進行中のブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱の流行があり、DRCとウガンダで感染が確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。UK（オックスフォード）は試験実施国であり発生国ではないため除外。
