article.articleHeadline: Оксфордският университет ще тества нова ваксина срещу ебола, разработена във Великобритания
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The University of Oxford will test a new Ebola vaccine developed in the United Kingdom.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University will test a new Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. Researchers will assess safety and immunogenicity of the ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 in the United Kingdom. About 620,000 doses are stockpiled for potential future use, with roughly 4,000 doses allocated for research. Partners in Uganda will help prepare clinical trials in Africa. Volunteers will be followed for one year to gauge protection. The vaccine uses the same platform as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine, potentially enabling rapid development within weeks. CEPI backs the effort, underscoring the ongoing Ebola impact. The work comes 57 days after the WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern. Phase I trials are expected to start within weeks.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、英国で開発された新たなエボラワクチンを試験へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱の流行（WHOがPHEICを宣言済み）に関連するワクチン開発報道であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクを有するため、既存のRRA継続対象としてフォローが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はオックスフォード大学によるエボラワクチン（ChAdOx1 BDBV）の第I相試験に関する報道で、DRCで進行中のブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行（WHOがPHEICを宣言）を背景としている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。英国は治験実施国であり流行地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Protozooses: entenda as doenças causadas por protozoários e como se prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protozoan Diseases: Understand the diseases caused by protozoa and how to prevent them.
article.articleSummary: Toxoplasmosis, caused by Toxoplasma gondii, is among the world’s most common protozoal infections. Humans acquire it via ingestion of cysts in soil, water, or contaminated produce, or through contact with infected animal feces; most healthy individuals are asymptomatic, but the infection threatens pregnancy and immunocompromised patients. In Brazil, diagnosis relies on serology; treatment uses pyrimethamine with sulfadiazine to eradicate the parasite; prevention hinges on strict food hygiene and safe handling of domestic cat litter. Leishmaniasis, transmitted by sandflies of the genus Lutzomyia, presents mainly cutaneous and visceral forms in Brazil. Leishmania parasites can attack skin, mucosa, or internal organs (liver/spleen) depending on species. Early treatment is crucial, often with amphotericin B, to prevent severe complications. Personal protection (repellents, screens) remains the most effective risk-reduction strategy in endemic areas. Brazil's protozoal diseases reflect links to sanitation, hygiene, and vector exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 原虫症:原虫が引き起こす病気とその予防法について理解する
triage.triage_reason: 一般向けの啓発・予防解説記事であり、特定の発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、シグナルとして扱う根拠がない。
triage.notes: トキソプラズマ症とリーシュマニア症の一般的な疾病解説記事であり、ブラジルにおける具体的な発生報告や症例数増加を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ganjam Intensifies COVID Surveillance Following Fresh Cases Reported In AP
article.articleSummary: Ganjam district intensified COVID-19 surveillance after fresh cases and suspected fatalities in neighbouring Andhra Pradesh. On July 13, 2026, the CDM & PHO directed all government facilities to stay alert and ensure preparedness to prevent spread. The DMO-MS-cum-Superintendent of City Hospital, Brahmapur, and the superintendents of all Sub-Divisional Hospitals (SDHs) and CHCs were instructed to strictly follow surveillance protocols. With cross-border movement to Andhra Pradesh, testing and monitoring were strengthened: mandatory COVID-19 testing for all Severe Acute Respiratory Illness (SARI) patients and random testing of at least 5% of Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) patients. Hospitals must review isolation wards, oxygen-supported beds, and critical infrastructure; PSA oxygen plants, oxygen concentrators, and cylinders should be ready. Frontline workers (ASHA, ANM) to monitor fever and respiratory clusters and report promptly. Public urged to maintain respiratory hygiene and seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州での新規感染例報告を受け、ガンジャム県がCOVID監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の新規発生に対する行政の予防的サーベイランス強化措置であり、重症例数や規模など具体的な公衆衛生インパクトの情報が不足しているため、継続的な観察が必要。
triage.notes: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州での新規COVID-19症例・疑い死亡例を受け、隣接するオリッサ州ガンジャム県が予防的措置としてサーベイランスを強化。具体的な患者数・死亡数・重症度の詳細は記事に記載されていない。国内の行政対応であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Германия прие за лечение американски хуманитарен работник, заразен с вируса ебола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany admitted for treatment an American humanitarian worker infected with the Ebola virus in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Germany admitted an American humanitarian worker infected with the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, after a U.S. request. The patient arrived by plane in Frankfurt and was transported to the University Hospital for ongoing treatment; no personal health details were released. The individual had been in Bunia, the Ituri provincial capital and epicenter of the current 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC’s history, declared in mid-May. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated the agency provided care and strict medical surveillance before the patient’s safe transfer to Germany. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. As of the latest WHO data, 1,947 people have been affected and 704 have died.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ、DRコンゴでエボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人人道支援者を治療のため受け入れ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（1947人感染、704人死亡）に関連し、感染者が国際的に空輸・搬送された事例であり、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認される。
triage.notes: 感染者はDRC・イツリ州ブニアで感染し、米国からの要請でドイツ（フランクフルト）へ搬送・治療。エボラのBundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・特効薬がなく、致死率は約36%（704/1947）と高い。WHOが医療監視のもと安全に搬送を実施したとされ、国際協力・支援体制が既に機能している点は管理可能性の観点から留意すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : Mambasa face au défi de l'adhésion communautaire à la riposte contre Ebola (Société civile) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Mambasa faces the challenge of community buy-in to the Ebola response (Civil Society) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola response in Mambasa health zone, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, struggles with partial community buy-in. Civil society forces vives of Mambasa report persistent resistance among residents to Ebola control measures, notably during dignified and safe burials and in persuading sick individuals to seek care, complicating outbreak response. To change perceptions, calls were made for intensified community sensitization sessions and closer engagement with residents to emphasize the ongoing danger of Ebola. The group also urged substantial material, financial, and technical support for frontline responders. Despite challenges, mobilization activities continue, with repeated outreach to raise vigilance against the persistent Ebola threat in Mambasa near Bunia, the Ituri provincial capital.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州:マンバサ、エボラ対応への地域社会の協力という課題に直面(市民社会) - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州マンバサでエボラ出血熱の対応が続いており、地域社会の抵抗により感染対策(埋葬・受診)が阻害されている。致死率の高いエボラであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のエボラ流行への対応状況(地域住民の協力不足)を報じるもので、新規発生ではなく既存アウトブレイクの継続状況に関する続報。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ganjam district put on high alert following COVID outbreak in Andhra Pradesh
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 outbreak in Andhra Pradesh triggers high alert in Ganjam district, Odisha. The Chief District Medical & Public Health Officer directed district healthcare facilities to implement immediate measures: mandatory COVID-19 testing for all Severe Acute Respiratory Illness (SARI) patients and random testing of at least 5% of Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) cases. Hospital preparedness should ensure isolation wards, oxygen-supported beds, and full functionality of PSA oxygen plants, oxygen concentrators, and cylinders. Frontline public awareness activities should monitor fever or respiratory clusters, promote respiratory hygiene, and encourage early medical consultation. Stock management must maintain essential medicines (ORS, Paracetamol, Zinc, Vitamin A, B2 stimulants, respiratory solutions, Azithromycin) and address shortages of Tetanus Toxoid injections via local procurement using Rogi Kalyan Samiti funds. Daily reporting to the District Public Health Unit on SARI/ILI testing, infrastructure readiness, and logistics is required; lapses will be acted upon.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラプラデシュ州でのCOVID感染拡大を受け、ガンジャム地区（オディシャ州）が厳重警戒態勢に入る
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の感染増加に対する行政的な予防対応を報じているが、実際の症例数・重症度・死亡者数等の具体的なデータが不明であり、現時点ではIHR基準への明確な該当は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は行政による予防的措置（検査強化・物資確保・報告体制)を報じているのみで、実際の感染者数や重症度に関する具体的データが記載されていない。続報の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Les relais communautaires face aux agressions et au déni dans la traque d'Ebola à Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Community health workers face aggression and denial in the Ebola hunt in Bunia
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) reaches its 17th iteration, with community health workers in the Bigo health area and the Kigonze displacement site on the front lines. Field teams face frequent insults, threats, and physical violence from residents resisting health messages, posing a threat to epidemiological surveillance and outbreak control. In Bigo, a dense relay network—three volunteers per avenue—conducts door-to-door education on barrier measures, screens febrile individuals, and alerts the response coordination. The Kigonze site program, composed of locally recruited relays, overcomes language and cultural barriers, contributing to a marked reduction in community Ebola mortality. Ongoing challenges include severe staffing shortfalls and security risks that impede surveillance and safety for community workers. If protections are not ensured, transmission chains in Ituri could rebound. As of July 13, 2026, progress is observed but requires enhanced staffing and security.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ブニアでのエボラ追跡における地域保健推進員が受ける暴力と拒否
triage.triage_reason: DRC・イトゥリ州で継続中のエボラ流行（17次流行）であり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ地域社会での感染制御を脅かす暴力・拒否事例が報告されており、WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はDRCイトゥリ州ブニアで継続中（17次流行）。地域住民の抵抗・暴力によりサーベイランス活動が阻害されており、人員・治安支援の強化が必要とされている。国際的拡大や渡航制限については記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : près de 1 900 cas d'Ebola confirmés, 672 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Nearly 1,900 confirmed Ebola cases, 672 deaths.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: As of 12 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,873 confirmed Ebola cases and 672 deaths since the outbreak was declared on 15 May. The virus is now present in five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, with Haut-Uele and Tshopo reported for the first time; epidemiological links to Ituri are driven by contacts and population movement. The health system is under pressure: 763 patients are in isolation or hospitalised, with bed occupancy at 95.1%. Cured: 306. Suspected cases: 299, including 91 deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and authorities continue enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, and response activities to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ確定例約1,900人、死者672人
triage.triage_reason: 確定例約1,900例・死者672例に達する大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、新たに2州へ拡大し医療体制も95%超の病床占有率で崩壊寸前であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、5月15日の発生宣言以降5州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートウェレ、ツォポ）に拡大。病床占有率95.1%と医療システムへの負荷が高く、続報の監視と国際支援の必要性を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : une bonne collaboration recommandée entre équipes de la riposte et population (Division provinciale de la santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: a good collaboration between outbreak response teams and the population is recommended (Provincial Health Division) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, with 11 of 34 health zones affected as of July 9, 2026. The 17th outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo strain, was announced in May. Cumulative confirmed cases total 158, with 90 deaths (case fatality rate 57%). Recovered patients total 24 across the 11 affected zones, including seven declared recovered—five in the Beni health zone and two in the two health zones comprising the city of Butembo. Authorities urge strong collaboration between outbreak response teams and communities to curb spread: residents should report suspected illnesses, ensure evacuation and isolation, and secure and dignified burial of corpses. The involvement of community leaders and other actors has helped restore awareness after initial resistance among youths.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州のエボラ出血熱：対応チームと住民の良好な協力が推奨される（州保健局）
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱（第17次流行）は致死率57%と高く、複数保健区に拡大しており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性）に2つ以上該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブジョ株）による第17次DRC流行。2026年5月発生、7月9日時点で34保健区中11区が被害を受け、確定例158件・死亡90件（CFR57%）。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する明示的記載はないが、エボラの性質上リスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: Corona Virus Again in India: भारत में एक बार कोरोना की एंट्री, इस राज्य में दो लोगों की मौत से हड़कंप, सरकार ने जारी की एडवाइजरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coronavirus enters India again: Two deaths in this state spark panic; the government issues an advisory.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, Odisha reports no active COVID-19 cases, but neighboring Andhra Pradesh has seen multiple recent deaths, prompting heightened vigilance. Two COVID-19 fatalities have occurred in Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh, with one death on 9 July involving a 46-year-old patient; a second death also reported. In response, Odisha launched intensified monitoring and testing, directing all public and private hospitals to stay on alert. Odisha’s health department notes all samples collected so far are negative, while rapid response teams have been deployed in Andhra Pradesh and isolation wards prepared in hospitals. Odisha requires mandatory COVID testing for every SARI patient and sampling five of every 100 ILI patients. Positive cases will be genome-sequenced to identify variants. Citizens are urged not to panic, seek medical care for fever, cough, sore throat, or breathing difficulties, and maintain hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: インドで新型コロナウイルス再流行：この州で2人死亡し混乱、政府が注意喚起を発表
triage.triage_reason: アンドラプラデシュ州で散発的なCOVID-19死亡例が報告され当局が監視強化しているが、感染拡大の規模や国際的リスクを示す情報は不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾病であり、記事は国内の散発的死亡例と地方自治体の対応強化を報じるもの。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : les inspecteurs du marché central de Kisangani appelés à sensibiliser contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Kisangani Central Market inspectors called upon to raise awareness about Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kisangani central market inspectors in Kisangani, head city of Tshopo in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, were urged by the market manager to raise awareness about Ebola prevention. During the weekly parade, mayor Delly Likunde Litawehe called on inspectors and colleagues to educate vendors and buyers on barrier measures to prevent Ebola virus disease transmission. Lokenge noted that although some merchants still spread goods on the ground, authorities will clear access routes to reduce crowding and ensure interior stalls maintain a one-meter distance. He also said that starting Tuesday, inspectors and teams will work to draft a public-sensitization text and will deliver the message three times daily to raise market-wide awareness. The Kisangani central market’s prominence warrants decisive action by decision-makers to curb Ebola in the third economic hub of the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：キサンガニ中央市場の検査官らがエボラに関する啓発活動を呼びかけられる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラは重大な公衆衛生上の懸念を伴う疾患だが、本記事は市場での予防啓発活動を報じるのみで、新規感染者や確定例についての具体的情報がなく、実際の発生状況が不明であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は市場管理者・行政による予防的啓発活動の呼びかけであり、確定患者数や新規発生に関する具体的情報は記載されていない。エボラという疾患特性上、続報（実際の感染者数、地域拡大の有無）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Covid in Andhra: Odisha steps up surveillance
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 in neighbouring Andhra Pradesh prompts Odisha to step up surveillance, especially in southern districts bordering AP. As of 13 July 2026, Andhra Pradesh reported fresh Covid-19 cases and two related deaths; Odisha has detected no positive cases so far. Public Health Director Rabindranath Mishra directed CDMOs to intensify testing at district facilities, monitor Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) and Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI), and maintain preparedness for a potential rise. Southern Odisha districts near the border will systematically intensify screening, testing and reporting of suspected cases. Hospitals should ensure isolation facilities, oxygen supply, medicines and essential equipment. Surveillance teams will emphasize early detection and rapid response to suspected cases. Enhanced measures aim to safeguard the Rath Yatra in Puri, which is expected to attract lakhs of devotees.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデシュ州でのコロナ感染拡大、オディシャ州が監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: 隣接州でのCOVID-19感染拡大を受けた予防的な監視強化であり、現時点でオディシャ州内に感染例はなく、深刻性・異常性は限定的だが、大規模宗教行事（ラート・ヤトラ）との重なりで継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: アーンドラ・プラデシュ州で死者を含む新規COVID-19症例が報告され、隣接するオディシャ州が国境地域での検査・監視を強化。大規模巡礼行事ラート・ヤトラを控え、ILI/SARIサーベイランスの強化が行われているが、季節性の通常対応の範囲内と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Zweiter Ebola-Patient in Deutschland gelandet | Heute.at
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second Ebola Patient Lands in Germany
article.articleSummary: Second Ebola patient lands in Germany: A U.S. citizen infected with Ebola was flown to Germany, arriving at Frankfurt Airport and transported to the University Hospital in Frankfurt. The CDC identifies the patient as a U.S. national working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo, positive for the Bundibugyo variant. Symptoms were present on arrival; transport was smooth and the patient is stable. There is no vaccine or established therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola. Experts are recruiting patients for a drug study testing the antiviral Remdesivir and the MBP134 antibody cocktail; animal studies suggested activity against Bundibugyo. In the DRC, authorities report 702 confirmed deaths and 1,926 lab-confirmed cases; about 753 people are hospitalized or in isolation. The first American patient was treated at Berlin’s Charité from May 20 for about two weeks and discharged; his wife and four children were high-risk contacts but asymptomatic. The Health Ministry says the public is not at risk; patients are treated in special isolation units fully separated from regular hospital operations.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツで2人目のエボラ患者が到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で702人死亡・1,926人感染確認という大規模なエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行が継続中であり、患者の国際搬送も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブジョ変異株）流行と、それに関連した米国人患者のドイツへの医療搬送。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・確立された治療法がない点、既に2例の国際搬送例が発生している点から国際的拡大リスクが高いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Pradesh COVID-19 Update: Kadapa Reports 8 Active Cases, Health Department on Alert
article.articleSummary: Eight active COVID-19 cases are reported in Andhra Pradesh's YSR Kadapa district as of July 13, 2026, after renewed cases and two deaths in recent weeks. A 52-year-old man from Rajampet died at Christian Medical College, Vellore, after testing positive with fever and cough; a 43-year-old Kadapa man died in the COVID-19 ICU at Government General Hospital while ill with health complications. A 25-year-old medical student from Kadapa Medical College tested positive and is in home isolation. Health teams deployed rapid response units and collected samples from about 40 contacts (18 negative; results of others awaited). Samples have been sent to Pune for genome sequencing to identify the circulating variant and transmission pattern. Authorities tightened containment, mandated masks in crowded places, intensified sanitation, and urged testing of family members of infected individuals. A statewide COVID-19 preparedness alert was issued.

triage.triage_reason: 小規模な散発事例（8例、死亡2例）で現時点では深刻な公衆衛生上の影響や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、当局が対応強化とゲノム解析を実施しており続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: COVID-19の既知の変異株監視の一環と考えられる散発的なクラスター。ゲノムシーケンス結果待ちで、新規変異株の出現有無は不明。

article.articleHeadline: أول تجربة بشرية للقاح يستهدف سلالة "إيبولا" النادرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First-in-human trial of a vaccine targeting a rare Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University scientists have launched a first-in-human trial of a vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare Ebola strain. About 50 adults aged 18–55 from the United Kingdom will participate in Phase I study to assess safety and immune response. Bundibugyo has no licensed vaccine and can yield case fatalities up to 50%. The outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with 1,800 confirmed infections and hundreds of deaths; undercounting is feared due to conflict. An imported case in France linked to a humanitarian mission in DRC highlights cross-border risk. The Oxford vaccine is the first of four Bundibugyo candidates; developed with Serum Institute of India, it uses a non-pathogenic virus to deliver Bundibugyo genetic material, provoking antibody production. MHRA approved after animal testing in mice and rhesus macaques. Led by Dr Katrina Pollock, expansion to Uganda—where about 20 confirmed cases exist—could follow. Development took eight weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 希少なエボラ株を標的としたワクチンの初のヒト試験
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで発生中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株の大規模流行（確認例1,800件、死亡多数）に加え、フランスへの輸入例が報告されており、国際的拡大と重篤性の両面でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。フランス・英国・インドはワクチン開発・試験・輸入例関連の記載であり、発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。1,800例という規模は通常のブンディブギョ株流行としては極めて大きく、続報での確認が望まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Jerman Buka Pintu Rawat Warga AS dari Kongo Terinfeksi Virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany Opens Its Doors to Treat Americans from Congo Infected with Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo is being treated at Frankfurt University Hospital in Germany as of July 13, 2026, after arriving at a dedicated isolation unit in Spain around 3:00 a.m. local time. The U.S. CDC had on July 10 confirmed a separate Bundibugyo Ebola case in a humanitarian worker in Congo. Spain’s Institute of Public Health notes the country has received Ebola patients from abroad amid Congo’s outbreak, which has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces. In June, another American treated in Berlin after Congo exposure was discharged from Charité. The ongoing international response involves isolating and transporting patients for care outside the Congo region.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定患者1,926人・死亡702人に達するエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）の大規模流行が継続し、感染者が欧州（独・西）へ搬送治療されるなど国際的拡大が実際に発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Oxford begins first human trial of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine | Today News
article.articleSummary: Oxford Vaccine Group has launched the world's first Phase I clinical trial of a vaccine against Bundibugyo Ebola, evaluating the ChAdOx1 BDBV BD-Ebov candidate. The study will assess safety, tolerability and immune responses in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55. The trial began 57 days after the World Health Organization declared the Bundibugyo outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. The Serum Institute of India supplied 4,000 investigational doses for the Phase I study, and has manufactured and stockpiled about 620,000 doses for potential future use. The effort is funded by an $8.6 million CEPI programme to the University of Oxford and SII. India has enhanced screening at international airports and entry points to bolster preparedness. Preparations for later clinical assessments involve the MRC/Uganda Virus Research Institute and the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine Uganda Research Unit.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、ブンディブジョ・エボラワクチンの世界初のヒト臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 既にWHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言したブンディブジョ・エボラ出血熱の流行に関連するワクチン開発の動きであり、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダで発生し既にPHEICが宣言されたブンディブジョ・エボラ出血熱に対するワクチン臨床試験（オックスフォード大学・セラム・インスティテュート・オブ・インディア等）の報道。実際の発生国はウガンダであり対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。インドは製造・空港スクリーニング強化の文脈で登場するのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Chile impulsiona exportações de ovos brasileiros após surto de gripe aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chile boosts exports of Brazilian eggs after an avian influenza outbreak.
article.articleSummary: June egg exports from Brazil totaled about 2,600 tonnes (fresh and processed), up 19% from May, with Chile the leading destination for the fifth straight month as demand recovered in Chile after its first avian influenza case in April. Chile imported about 1,900 tonnes in June, up 41% MoM. Despite these gains, total exports remain roughly 60% below the level of the previous period, signaling the ongoing disruption to Chile’s poultry sector from the outbreak. Secex and Cepea provide the analyzed figures.

triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジル産鶏卵の対チリ輸出動向という経済・貿易ニュースであり、ヒト感染や新規の疫学的異常事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチリの家禽鳥インフルエンザ流行に伴う卵の貿易動向であり、ブラジルは輸出国として言及されているのみでブラジル国内での発生を示すものではない。チリは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. citizen working in Congo tests positive for Ebola
article.articleSummary: U.S. citizen working for Samaritan's Purse in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, confirmed by the CDC. The agency is coordinating with the worker's employer, other U.S. federal agencies, and DRC authorities to prevent transmission through contact tracing and high-risk contact risk assessments. Bundibugyo Ebola is a rare Ebola strain with no approved medicines or vaccines. The patient has been isolated and is being treated at one of Samaritan's Purse Ebola treatment centers in Ituri. The Congo outbreak is described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in Africa, with 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, and has spillover cases in Uganda. This is the second American case in the outbreak; a prior American diagnosed in Congo was evacuated to Germany for treatment in Berlin, and by June 15 had arrived in the United States with his family, remaining Ebola-free since May 30.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで働く米国人がエボラ検査で陽性

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | الكونغو الديمقراطية.. اتساع رقعة تفشي فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Widening reach of Ebola virus outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has expanded to Out Willy and Chobo in the northeast. As of late Sunday, 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths were reported nationwide. Four new cases in Chobo (two deaths) and a death in Out Willy were confirmed. The outbreak, declared on May 15, is the seventeenth and remains centered in Ituri, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals or animals; symptoms include fever, vomiting, and internal/external bleeding. In late June, health authorities began tracing contacts in Out Willy and Chobo; both regions are now considered part of the outbreak, though previously absent from daily reports. Kisangani, the capital of Chobo, lies nearby, and Out Willy borders South Sudan and the Central African Republic. A WHO official told Reuters the true scale could be 2–4 times the official counts due to many unlinked cases, with Nyania in Ituri suspected as a common source.

article.articleHeadline: Cidade de SC que já teve 80 mortes por dengue vai ampliar mosquito de laboratório para todos os bairros, usando bactéria Wolbachia para bloquear transmissão e tentar manter longe o fantasma da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City in Santa Catarina that has already recorded 80 dengue deaths will expand lab-reared mosquitoes to all neighborhoods, using the Wolbachia bacteria to block transmission and try to keep the specter of the disease at bay.
article.articleSummary: Joinville, Santa Catarina, Brazil, plans to expand the Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti release to 100% of its urban neighborhoods starting August 2026, after a strong dengue reduction and no recent deaths. The city previously released Wolbachia-laden mosquitoes in phases, with a central biofactory in the Nova Brasília neighborhood. Officials say the Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes reduce the mosquitoes' ability to transmit dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, as confirmed by the World Mosquito Program. The city aims to reach full geographic coverage via official cars releasing insects door-to-door. In context, Joinville reported about 80,000 dengue cases and 80 deaths in the previous year; in 2026, through July, fewer than 50 cases and zero deaths. Santa Catarina statewide recorded 22 dengue deaths in the previous year (2025) and 341 in 2024, underscoring ongoing risk. Traditional prevention—mutirões, school education, removing standing water—continues alongside Wolbachia deployment.

triage.headline_ja: 80人のデング熱死者を出したサンタカタリーナ州の都市、ボルバキア菌を使った実験室産蚊を全地区に拡大し感染拡大を阻止へ
triage.triage_reason: 既知のデング熱流行地域における予防対策（Wolbachia蚊放出）の拡大に関する記事であり、2026年の感染数・死者数は前年より大幅に減少している。新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症対策（ワクチンではなくWolbachia感染蚊の放出拡大）に関する内容で、感染状況自体は改善傾向にある。デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱は当該地域で毎年流行する既知の疾病であり、新規異常事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Covid Returns To Andhra! Ganjam Hospitals On Strict High Alert Now!
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 alert in Ganjam district, Odisha, as of 13 July 2026, with hospitals on strict high alert to prevent cross-border spread to Andhra Pradesh. The Chief District Medical Officer ordered mandatory Covid testing for all patients with severe respiratory illness (SARI) and a 5% testing rule for influenza-like illness (ILI) across government hospitals and CHCs. Health authorities have stocked oxygen plants, isolation wards, and essential medicines, including Paracetamol, ORS, Zinc, Vitamin A/B2, and Azithromycin, and mobilized ASHA and ANM workers to report fever clusters immediately. The directive emphasizes surveillance, rapid testing, and readiness rather than reporting confirmed cases. Full guidelines and family safety tips are to be found in the detailed report. This is a public health measure reported by Kanak News, highlighting ongoing concerns about Covid-19 in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コロナが再びアンドラプラデシュ州に流行！ガンジャム県の病院に厳重警戒指令
triage.triage_reason: オディシャ州ガンジャム県で新型コロナへの警戒レベルが上げられ検査体制が強化されたが、確定患者数や重症例の具体的報告はなく、予防的措置の域を出ていない。
triage.notes: 記事は確定患者数や死亡例を報告しておらず、県医療当局による予防的な監視強化・検査体制強化措置の発表が主な内容。続報で実際の感染者数増加が確認されればPICKUPへ再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Staff at DR Congo Ebola centre strike as virus continues spreading
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak intensifies as staff at Rwampara General Hospital in Ituri province strike over months of unpaid salaries, halting care at the epicenter. Strike participants include epidemiologists, case investigators, drivers and gravediggers. Payroll issues and list changes are delaying payments; officials pledge fixes. The outbreak—the worst in Africa—has reached 1,926 cases and 702 deaths, with five provinces currently reporting confirmed infections after the virus expanded to Haut-Uele and Tshopo in the northeast. Response efforts are hampered by misinformation, burial practices and distrust, plus attacks on health workers, as rebels exploit northern areas for mineral wealth. The World Health Organization calls for urgent, accelerated action; risk of spread to South Sudan is noted. Separately, a second U.S. citizen infected with Ebola was admitted to Frankfurt's isolation unit; the patient, in his 60s, contracted the disease in the DRC and is stable.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ対応拠点で職員がストライキ、ウイルスは拡大を続ける
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は1,926例・702人死亡と拡大を続け、複数州へ拡大し国際的な感染者（米国人がフランクフルトで隔離治療）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCのエボラ流行。ドイツ（フランクフルト）・米国・南スーダンは感染者搬送・拡大リスクの文脈で言及されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない、またはDRC由来の輸入例のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo reforça alerta e convoca população para atualização da vacinação contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reinforces the alert and calls on the public to update their measles vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Seven measles cases have been reported in São Paulo state in 2026, prompting a strengthened vaccination alert by SES-SP. Immunization is highlighted as the most effective protection for individuals and public health. Since June 25, a 'dose zero' of the measles–mumps–rubella (triple viral) vaccine has been recommended for infants aged 6 months to 11 months 29 days in São Paulo and Guarulhos to bolster protection. Dose zero does not replace the routine schedule: the first MMR dose is at 12 months and the second (preferably tetraviral, including varicella) at 15 months. For older groups: 5–29 years require two doses; 30–59 need one; health workers two. A vaccination drive at CPTM rail stations—Comendador Ermelino, Guaianases, Itaim Paulista, São Miguel Paulista—runs July 13, 15, 17, and 20, from 9:00 to 16:00, as part of a 6–20 July campaign. The Vacina 100 Dúvidas portal provides guidance.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹ワクチン接種の呼びかけを強化
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除国であるブラジルで少数（7例）の症例が確認されワクチン接種強化キャンペーンが実施されているが、重篤性や国際的拡大の情報はなく、現時点では注視レベル。
triage.notes: ブラジルは麻疹排除国とされていたため少数例でも公衆衛生上の関心が高い。ただし重症例・死亡・国際拡大の報告はなく、ワクチン接種キャンペーンという予防的対応が中心。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Тестват нова ваксина срещу ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Ebola vaccine is being tested.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University researchers are testing a new Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain, developed to curb the outbreak spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The study will assess safety and immune response in 50 healthy volunteers aged 18–55 in the United Kingdom. About 620,000 doses are stocked for potential future use, with roughly 4,000 doses allocated for research. Partners in Uganda will help prepare clinical trials in Africa. Volunteers will be monitored for one year as scientists seek rapid indications of protective immunity. Lead investigator Professor Teresa Lamb notes the ongoing Ebola epidemic is causing serious harm to affected communities, underscoring the urgent need for effective vaccines and treatments.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学がエボラ出血熱の新ワクチンを試験中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱流行を受けた新ワクチン臨床試験に関する報道であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な対応（英・ウガンダとの連携）が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はオックスフォード大学によるBundibugyo株対象の新エボラワクチン臨床試験であり、DRCでの流行が背景として言及されている。ウガンダは臨床試験準備の協力国として挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染者数・死亡者数などの具体的な疫学データは記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: ब्रेन मलेरिया से बचाव के लिए स्कूल में चला अवेयरनेस कैंप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Awareness camp held at school to prevent cerebral malaria.
article.articleSummary: Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, Potka block reports rising malaria and cerebral malaria cases. Anita Murmu, head of Sabarnagar panchayat, and Hiranyamay Das, a district council member, visited the Sabarnagar Bharat Sevashram Sangh School to promote prevention and sanitation. Bleaching powder was distributed on campus, and students, teachers, and locals were educated on malaria prevention. Murmu warned that infections are spreading rapidly in Potka and urged households to keep surroundings clean and avoid waterlogging. If fever, headache, or vomiting occurs, individuals should promptly get a blood test at a health center. They also pressed for road construction to Sabarnagar, 24-hour ambulance service for emergencies, and clean drinking water facilities at the school. Attendees included principal Aarsu Mahali, Lakshmi Devi Munda, Geeta Hembrom, Sarthi Majhi, and Alok Das Gupta.

triage.headline_ja: 脳マラリア予防のため学校で啓発キャンプが開催
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なマラリア（脳マラリア含む）症例増加が報告されているが、規模や重症度の詳細情報が不足しており、地域啓発活動レベルの内容であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: Jharkhand州Jamshedpur近郊Potkaブロックでのマラリア・脳マラリア症例増加に関する地方レベルの記事。感染規模・死亡者数等の詳細データはなく、国レベルでの重大な公衆衛生危機を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Why the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history is becoming more challenging
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending with the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date, caused by Bundibugyo virus and centered in Ituri province with suspected spread to Kisangani and other provinces, including the city of Goma. Nearly 2,000 cases have been confirmed, with 702 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines. Transmission occurs from wild animals and between people via bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pains, and sometimes bleeding. The outbreak has faced unrest as local responders protest unpaid work and distrust amid rebel activity and misinformation. A treatment study began, randomizing participants to standard care, remdesivir (Gilead) and MBP134 (Mapp Biopharmaceutical), or combinations. The trial, currently at one Ituri center, may require months and up to about 1,000 participants to show efficacy, with expansion planned when safe.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行が、なぜますます困難になっているのか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が発生し、約2000例・702人の死亡が確認されており、治安不安や医療従事者の不払い問題により対応が一層困難化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 感染はイトゥリ州を中心に、キサンガニやゴマなど複数州へ拡大が疑われている。承認済みワクチンがなく、治療薬（remdesivir、MBP134）の臨床試験が開始されているが、地域紛争や誤情報、医療従事者の未払い問題が対応を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: 15 दिन में 1 लाख से ज्यादा लोगों का टेस्ट, मिले 1895 मरीज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 100,000 people tested in 15 days; 1,895 patients detected.
article.articleSummary: East Singhbhum's Jamshedpur district mounted a 15-day malaria-control drive (June 29–July 12), screening 104,459 people across CHCs, Urban Health Centers, and Sadar Hospital. Malaria positivity was 1.96% (1,895 cases) from 96,478 rapid tests and 7,981 slide tests; breakdown: 1,491 cerebral malaria, 353 ordinary malaria, 51 mixed infections. Potka CHC accounted for the most testing (24,657) and 667 positives, followed by Dumuria (11,060; 427), Musabani (15,150; 344), and Ghatshila (12,121; 212). Sadar Hospital showed a high 14.36% positivity, reflecting referral-heavy caseload; Mango Urban Health Centre had zero positives, Birsa Nagar two. On Sunday, 11,184 tests yielded 69 positives (50 cerebral, 15 ordinary, 4 mixed), with Potka leading (33), then Ghatshila (13), Musabani (12), Dumuria (6), Patmada (4), Dhalbhumgarh (1). Insecticide spraying covered Dhalbhumgarh and two Potka villages. Authorities urge not to self-medicate, seek prompt testing, remove standing water, and use mosquito nets as East Singhbhum aims for malaria-free status.

triage.headline_ja: 15日間で10万人以上を検査、1895人の患者を発見
triage.triage_reason: インド・ジャールカンド州の流行地域における定期的なマラリア対策キャンペーンの報告であり新規性は低いが、脳性マラリアの割合が高く重症度の観点から注視が必要。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局による既存の防疫活動（殺虫剤散布、検査拡大）の一環としての報告であり、地域メディアのみの発信。脳性マラリアが陽性者の約79%を占める点は通常より高い比率であり、続報の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Pouca Gente Sabe, Mas Vacina Contra O Sarampo Ganha Reforço Urgente Em SP Após Confirmação De Novos Casos; Veja Quem Deve Tomar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not many people know, but the measles vaccine gains an urgent booster in São Paulo after confirmation of new cases; see who should take it.
article.articleSummary: Seven measles cases were confirmed in 2026 in São Paulo, prompting an urgent booster program. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat (SES-SP) issued an alert urging residents to update vaccination, with 6- to 11-month-old infants in the capital and Guarulhos offered an emergency 'dose zero' to curb transmission. The dose zero is not a substitute for the National Vaccination Calendar; routine vaccination remains: first measles-containing vaccine dose (MMR) at 12 months, second dose at 15 months (preferably tetraviral with varicella). Adults should align with vaccination schedules: 5–29 years and health workers require two doses; 30–59 years require one dose. A CPTM vaccination blitz in the eastern zone runs until July 20, providing clinics at Comendador Ermelino, Itaim Paulista, São Miguel Paulista (Line 12-Safira) and Guaianases (Line 11-Coral), operating 9:00–16:00 on July 13, 15, 17, and 20 to facilitate access.

triage.headline_ja: 多くの人は知らないが、新規感染確認を受けサンパウロで麻疹ワクチンの緊急追加接種が実施される；接種対象者を確認
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹7例確認による予防的なワクチン強化接種の実施であり、現時点で重症例や急速な拡大の報告はないが、麻疹はヒト-ヒト感染力が強く continued monitoring が必要。
triage.notes: 現時点では7例の確認と予防的な緊急接種プログラムの実施であり、重症度や死亡例の報告はない。麻疹はヒト-ヒト感染力が高く、ワクチン接種率低下地域での流行リスクがあるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ब्रेन मलेरिया से 26 साल के युवक की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a 26-year-old man due to cerebral malaria.
article.articleSummary: July 13, 2026: In Jamshedpur area, Ritik Singh, 26, died of cerebral malaria after treatment at private Galudih hospital and Sadar and MGM facilities; he died en route to Ranchi’s RIMS. His family, led by father Vijay Singh, a daily-wage laborer, faced financial strain; about 30,000 rupees spent on treatment. Funeral held in the village. In Potka block, six people have died of brain malaria, signaling a worsening outbreak in the Jharia-Jamshedpur region. Civil Surgeon Dr. Sahir Pal has deployed a medical team, but deaths continue. Potka CHC in-charge Rajnikant Mahakud suspended; Dr. Sukant Sit appointed as new in-charge. Authorities aim to curb mortality as the disease appears to have assumed an epidemic form in the area; onset symptoms observed since June 5.

triage.headline_ja: 脳マラリアにより26歳男性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド・ジャールカンド州ポトカ地区で脳マラリアによる死亡が複数(6名以上)確認され、流行的拡大の兆候があり、当局が医療責任者を交代させるなど対応を強化している。
triage.notes: マラリアは風土病だが、地域内で複数死亡と流行化の兆候があり、行政官交代など対応強化が報じられている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、地域公衆衛生上の懸念としてフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Kumar Sanu's son Jaan Kumar Sanu hospitalised after testing positive for COVID-19
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 case: Jaan Kumar Sanu, son of veteran playback singer Kumar Sanu and former Bigg Boss 14 contestant, has been hospitalised in Mumbai, Maharashtra, after testing positive for COVID-19. He was admitted to Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital, and posted a video from his hospital room joking about his situation, including captions referencing 'COVID from Wuhan' and 'China se aaya mera dost.' The report notes a single laboratory-confirmed case with no details on symptoms, severity, or treatment. Fans offered wishes for a speedy recovery on social media after the update. The article underscores ongoing public interest in COVID-19 among Indian celebrities but provides no information on exposure source or travel/imported/exported case status.

triage.headline_ja: クマール・サヌの息子ジャーン・クマール・サヌ、COVID-19陽性で入院
triage.triage_reason: 有名人個人の単発COVID-19感染例に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 武漢や中国への言及は本人のジョークであり、実際の感染地域や渡航歴とは無関係。単一の芸能人個人の感染例であり公衆衛生上の意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Κλινικές δοκιμές του νέου εμβολίου κατά του Έμπολα πρόκειται να ξεκινήσουν στη Βρετανία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clinical trials of the new Ebola vaccine are set to begin in Britain.
article.articleSummary: Britain begins a Phase I Ebola vaccine trial targeting the Bundibugyo strain, enrolling 50 healthy adults aged 18–55, with vaccinations to start in coming weeks pending regulatory approval. The candidate, ChAdOx1 BDBV, uses the same chimpanzee adenovirus vector as the Oxford/AstraZeneca Covid-19 vaccine, enabling potentially rapid development. WHO urged prioritization of Ebola vaccine development after the outbreak was declared on May 17. About 620,000 doses are stored for potential use, with 4,000 doses allocated for research for the Oxford trial. The study underscores global collaboration in rapid outbreak response. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Bundibugyo Ebola has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of Monday. The milestone comes 57 days after WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: 英国で新型エボラワクチンの臨床試験が開始される予定
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo株エボラのPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が宣言され、確定例1,926例・死亡702例に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は英国でのエボラワクチン臨床試験開始だが、背景としてDRCでのBundibugyo株エボラ流行（PHEIC宣言済み、死亡率高）が記載されており、こちらがイベントの実体である。英国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí chega a 11 mortes por dengue; vítimas vão de criança a idosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí reaches 11 dengue deaths; victims range from children to the elderly.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Piauí, Brazil: 11 deaths reported, with 8,300 confirmed cases and 405 dengue cases with warning signs; about 14,000 probable cases and 26 severe dengue cases this year. The most recent confirmed death is a two-year-old girl from Pio IX who died at Hospital Regional Justino Luz in Picos. Another death in Teresina is under investigation after initial tests did not confirm dengue, with final results pending. Dengue is an arbovirus transmitted by the Aedes aegypti mosquito; while most patients recover, older adults and individuals with chronic diseases have higher risk of severe disease. Vaccination includes Qdenga (Takeda); the Butantan vaccine was suspended. Common symptoms: high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, rashes, and bleeding. Prevention emphasizes window screens, repellents, removing standing water, sealing water tanks, clearing gutters, and participation in SUS prevention actions.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州でデング熱による死者11人に、被害者は子供から高齢者まで
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ピアウイ州で季節性デング熱の流行が継続し死者・重症例が発生しているが、例年見られる流行の範囲内であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで例年流行する疾患であり、季節性の地域アウトブレイクとみられる。国レベルのSUS（公的医療制度）による対応が進行中で、国際支援の必要性は現時点で示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Com quase 9 mil casos, Vale do Paraíba registra 15 mortes por dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With nearly 9,000 cases, Paraíba Valley records 15 dengue deaths.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in the Paraíba Valley region of São Paulo state reached 8,906 confirmed cases and 15 deaths in 2026, with Taubaté accounting for the majority of fatalities (10) and 3,777 confirmed cases. The regional death toll is: Taubaté 10, Jacareí 2, Tremembé 2, and São José dos Campos 1. The data come from the São Paulo state government monitoring panel. Health authorities urge residents to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites by removing standing water from containers and to seek medical care for fever, body pains, retro-orbital pain, and red skin spots, symptoms associated with dengue. The situation underscores ongoing transmission in Vale do Paraíba and the need for vector control and prompt clinical evaluation to reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: パライバ峠地域で約9,000件のデング熱症例、15人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州パライバ峠地域でデング熱の流行が継続し死者も出ているが、既知の風土病であり地域限定的な流行報告で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで季節性・地域的に流行する既知の疾患であり、州政府による監視・対応が行われている。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威というよりは地域の公衆衛生対応事案と判断。

article.articleHeadline: जमशेदपुर में 'कोरोना' की तर्ज पर मलेरिया की ट्रैकिंग: 14 दिनों में 1.4 लाख जांच; पोटका-डुमरिया बने नए हॉट स्पॉट - jamshedpur fights malaria 14 lakh tests new hotspots emerge
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria tracking in Jamshedpur on the lines of COVID-19: 140,000 tests in 14 days; Potka-Dumuria have become new hotspots.
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreak in Jamshedpur, East Singhbhum, Jharkhand, with 1,895 lab-confirmed cases and 6 deaths (4 cerebral malaria; 2 from mixed infections) reported during 29 June–12 July 2026. A total of 104,459 people were tested in this period, yielding a district positivity of 1.96%. Potka is the largest hotspot with 667 positives from 24,657 tests; Dumuria severely affected; Musabani and Ghatsila are high-alert or under surveillance. Sadar Hospital referrals show a 14.36% positivity rate. Urban Mango had no cases; Birsa Nagar recorded 2. Most cases are Plasmodium falciparum (1,491), with Plasmodium vivax (353) and 51 mixed infections. Authorities have launched COVID-era-style surveillance, 24-hour testing and treatment, and indoor residual spraying in hardest-hit areas; death audits are underway. Residents are urged to seek free testing for any fever at nearby health centers.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプルでコロナ流行時のようなマラリア追跡：14日間で14万件の検査；ポトカ・ドゥムリアが新たなホットスポットに
triage.triage_reason: インド・ジャールカンド州ジャムシェドプルで確定例1,895例・死亡6例のマラリア集団発生が続き、新規ホットスポットの拡大とCOVID並みの大規模サーベイランス対応が行われており、重症度・継続的曝露・流行しやすさの基準に該当し社会的・行政的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBangladesh・Chittagongが含まれているが、記事本文はインド・ジャールカンド州東シングブーム地区（ジャムシェドプル）のみに言及しており、バングラデシュの発生は確認できないため除外した。マラリアは既存の流行地域における季節的増加であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Why the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history is becoming more challenging
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo is described as the fastest-growing in history. Work has begun on a study of two urgently needed treatments for a form of Ebola that currently has none. A strike by unpaid workers at a central Ebola treatment center threatens to disrupt response in a remote region marked by fragile infrastructure, rebel threats, and misinformation that the virus is not real. The piece underscores how operational vulnerabilities—staffing gaps, limited facilities, and community distrust—complicate containment amid rapid transmission. The excerpt does not provide laboratory-confirmed case counts or deaths; instead it emphasizes outbreak dynamics, the pursuit of therapies, and the risk that interruptions in care could accelerate spread. The crisis is framed within broader public health challenges in eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行がさらに困難を極める理由
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行であり、医療従事者のストライキや脆弱な医療体制、コミュニティの不信感が拡大リスクを高めているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事には確定患者数・死亡者数の記載がないが、『史上最速拡大』との表現、医療従事者ストライキ、治療薬開発の緊急性、地域の不安定性など複数のリスク要因が指摘されており、フルRRAへの移行が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 Alert in Odisha: Ganjam on High Vigil as Cases Rise in Andhra Pradesh
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 alert issued in Odisha's Ganjam district after reports of new coronavirus cases in neighbouring Andhra Pradesh. Given Ganjam's proximity to Andhra Pradesh and frequent cross-border movement of people, the Chief District Medical and Public Health Officer directed all district hospitals and health centres to immediately strengthen surveillance and preparedness measures to prevent any possible spread of the virus. The notice cites rising cases in Andhra Pradesh but provides no local case counts or fatalities for Ganjam. The alert signals heightened vigilance across district health facilities as the situation develops, with actions focused on preventing cross-border transmission into Ganjam as of 13 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19警戒:オディシャ州ガンジャム地区、アンドラプラデシュ州での感染増加を受け高度警戒
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患であるCOVID-19の地域内での症例増加に対する予防的警戒であり、具体的な症例数・死亡数も不明で、深刻性や異常性を示す根拠がない。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局による予防的な警戒発令であり、具体的な感染者数・重症度データが記事に記載されていないため、続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Samar chikungunya cases spike past 250
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak reported in Samar province, Philippines, with 259 cases across Basey (159), Gandara (97), and Paranas (3) as of 11 July 2026. Most infections cluster in Barangay Mabini, Basey (128 cases), and Barangay Ngoso, Gandara (51 cases). No deaths have been reported. Monthly trends show a sharp rise: 9 cases in February, 6 in May, 190 in June, and 54 cases in the first 11 days of July, indicating ongoing transmission and a steep climb in recent weeks. The cases are described as mosquito-borne, concentrated within three municipalities, with no further details on laboratory confirmation or export/import considerations provided. The data are released by the Samar Provincial Health Office through 11 July.

triage.headline_ja: サマール州のチクングニア熱感染者数が250人を超えて急増

article.articleHeadline: सर्विस लेन का सीवर जाम: दो महीने से राधे कृष्ण अपार्टमेंट में भरा पानी, बीमारी के साए में जीने को मजबूर लोग - dwarka radhe krishna apartment sewer jam 2 months of overflow health risks
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sewer jam in the service lane: Water has flooded the Radhe Krishna Apartment for two months, people forced to live under the shadow of illness.
article.articleSummary: Two months of sewer blockage under the main service lane at Radhe Krishna Apartments, Dwarka Sector-3, West Delhi, have left residents living amid contaminated, stagnant water. The overflowing sewer line has spread foul-smelling water throughout the society, with improvised brick-and-stone bridges for access as walkways remain impassable. The stagnant water is breeding disease vectors, raising the risk of dengue, malaria, and chikungunya outbreaks in the area. Contact with polluted water has raised concerns of skin infections (eczema), typhoid, and gastroenteritis, particularly among children and the elderly. Decomposing water emits methane and hydrogen sulfide gases, causing respiratory discomfort. Residents blame Delhi Jal Board and civic bodies for inaction despite complaints and video evidence, and call for urgent sewer cleaning and lasting relief to end the health hazards.

article.articleHeadline: American tests positive for incurable Ebola strain as outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ituri province ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak: 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths reported by Africa CDC last week; 17th outbreak in the DRC, no vaccine or specific treatment, mortality 25-50%. WHO declared an international health emergency on May 17. An American humanitarian worker tested positive and was evacuated to Frankfurt University Hospital; a prior American doctor infected in the DRC recovered in Germany. France reported its first imported case linked to the outbreak; risk to Europe considered low. U.S. CDC maintains Level 3 travel advisory for the DRC and travel restrictions require travelers from DRC/Uganda/South Sudan to use specific U.S. airports for enhanced screening (JFK, IAH, IAD, ATL); travelers should monitor symptoms for 21 days after leaving the DRC. Transmission occurs via blood/body fluids, contaminated objects, and animal contact; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and bleeding. Ituri is the epicenter of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行拡大、米国人が感染確認

article.articleHeadline: US Aid Worker Tests Positive For Ebola As Congo Battles Fastest-Growing Outbreak
article.articleSummary: An American aid worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province (Bunia) tests positive for Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, marking the second U.S. citizen infected in the current outbreak. The patient is admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital in Germany and placed in isolation; he had been handling logistics in Bunia for about a month and was not directly treating patients. The outbreak, officially declared May 15, 2026, is described by Africa CDC as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in Africa, with 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths in Congo; Uganda has also reported cases. The CDC is coordinating with the NGO, U.S. agencies, and Congolese health officials to trace close contacts. Two Ebola treatment centers operate in Ituri. A plan to relocate exposed Americans to a Kenyan treatment facility is paused after a Kenyan court ruling.

article.articleHeadline: Нови огнища на ебола на фона на стачка в болница заради неплатени заплати
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola outbreaks amid a hospital strike over unpaid salaries.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak update: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo broadens as an Ituri hospital suspends operations after staff strike over months of unpaid salaries. Dozens at Rwampara Hospital left posts, including epidemiologists, drivers, and burial workers. Authorities confirm Ebola has spread to two additional eastern provinces, O-Uele and Chopo, bringing the total to five. As of the latest counts, 1,926 people have been infected and 702 have died. Security concerns, misinformation, distrust in health authorities, and traditional burial rites complicate containment, with armed groups controlling parts of the region. The WHO warns that urgent, coordinated action by local authorities and partners is needed. The Congolese health minister said salaries will be paid. Separately, a second American Ebola patient, about 60, was admitted to isolation at a Frankfurt university hospital; his condition is stable.

article.articleHeadline: Concern as district records five leptospirosis deaths in July
article.articleSummary: Ernakulam district in Kerala reported five leptospirosis deaths in the first 13 days of July, the highest statewide, with fatalities in Kalamassery, Kuttampuzha, Kadayiruppu, Pattimattom, and Udyogamandal. The district also logged influenza as the state’s highest burden, tallying 392 cases by July 13. Dengue remains significant with 536 suspected and 252 confirmed cases, across numerous localities including Aluva, Cheranalloor, Edappally, Kadavanthra, Kalamassery, Kaloor, Kothamangalam, Nedumbassery, Parakkadavu, Perumbavoor, Piravom, Eroor, Thrikkakara, and Thripunithura. Leptospirosis tallies stand at five suspected and 19 confirmed in the district. Across Kerala, deaths from leptospirosis include one each in Palakkad, Kollam, Alappuzha, Kozhikode, Thiruvananthapuram, and Kottayam. An epidemic prevention plan, Arogyabheri, launched a week ago targets rising communicable diseases; authorities distribute preventive medicines in Kalamassery after an 18-year-old migrant worker from Assam died and urge early medical attention among migrant workers.

article.articleHeadline: Reino Unido iniciará teste em humanos de vacina contra variante do ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Kingdom will begin human trials of a vaccine against an Ebola variant.
article.articleSummary: Oxford, United Kingdom, will launch the first human trial of a vaccine specifically targeting Ebola virus Bundibugyo (BDBV). The BD-Ebov study will assess safety and immunogenicity of the ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55, with vaccination expected to begin within weeks after regulatory approvals. No licensed vaccine exists for BDBV; vaccines for other Ebola species, such as Zaire ebolavirus, have not demonstrated protection against Bundibugyo. This phase aims to determine safety and immune response, not efficacy against infection; positive results could lead to larger, efficacy-focused trials. The WHO has prioritized BDBV vaccine development. Parallel to this UK effort, the WHO coordinates a Congo-based trial evaluating experimental treatments for disease caused by this variant. Bundibugyo Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever with high mortality, with recent outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Central Province Strengthens Fight Against Communicable Diseases
article.articleSummary: Central Province, Zambia, is intensifying the fight against communicable diseases, focusing on HIV and tuberculosis through strengthened prevention, early diagnosis, treatment and community awareness. Viral load suppression among people with HIV rose from 79% to 94.2%, while tuberculosis case notification climbed from 60% in 2024 to 68% in 2025; treatment success rates remain above the WHO benchmark of 90%. The province’s planning aligns with the five pillars of Zambia's National Health Compact 2026-2030, aimed at Universal Health Coverage and resilient health systems. Efforts will enhance access to quality, people-centered healthcare, strengthen primary health care, maternal and child health, referrals and hospital services to ensure no one is left behind, with better procurement of medicines, vaccines and supplies, and recruitment, training and retention of health workers, especially in underserved areas. Digital health technologies will bolster information management, service delivery, transparency and evidence-based decisions. Dr. Elijah Mutoloki emphasized gap identification and responses.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Varanasi News: A new COVID-19 case detected; a 27-year-old man admitted to BHU.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, a new COVID-19 case has been detected in Varanasi, India. A 27-year-old man from Ashapur developed shortness of breath and tested positive for SARS-CoV-2, and he has been admitted to Banaras Hindu University (BHU) for isolation in a dedicated room. BHU Director Prof. S.N. Sankhwar said the coronavirus persists, but population antibodies have reduced its ability to cause illness. Early in the pandemic, lack of antibodies allowed widespread infection; during the second wave vaccination boosted antibodies, making active infection less likely to cause severe disease. Those with weakened immunity may still become infected, but the risk is lower. The patient’s test originated from the Chest and TB Department. Family members have been advised to stay vigilant, and the patient is closely monitored. Experts urge vigilance and maintaining immunity to prevent future infections.

article.articleHeadline: Bairro de Curitiba se prepara para a chegada de mosquitos que combatem a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Curitiba neighborhood prepares for the arrival of dengue-fighting mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: Curitiba’s Sítio Cercado neighborhood will begin releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti (wolbitos) by the end of July to curb dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The initiative, led by the Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS) in partnership with Wolbito do Brasil (IBMP/Fiocruz Paraná), starts with community engagement and will roll out house-to-house, in schools, health units, social assistance centers, and local businesses. Wolbachia is non-harmful to people and the environment and reduces mosquitoes’ ability to transmit the three arboviruses. The program will deploy two release strategies—eggs and adult mosquitoes—to compare performance over an estimated 26 weeks. Past results show a 92% reduction in dengue in 2025 and a 94% reduction this year; Niterói (RJ) reported up to 89% dengue reductions. El Niño’s forecast of increased rains may raise disease circulation, prompting enhanced planning and pre-release public surveys to gauge understanding and support.

article.articleHeadline: UK: Oxford Begins Human Trial of New Ebola Vaccine
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 625 deaths among 1,792 laboratory-confirmed cases. In the United Kingdom, researchers at the University of Oxford will begin a first-in-human trial of a new vaccine against Bundibugyo, testing safety and immune response in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55. Development of the jab began eight weeks ago after the World Health Organization recommended prioritizing Ebola vaccine development following the outbreak declaration on May 17. This vaccine is the first of four under development to enter clinical trials. Volunteers are being recruited in the UK, with vaccinations set to start in the coming weeks after regulatory permission.

article.articleSummary: 69-year-old Brazilian actor Marcos Oliveira, famous as Beiçola in A Grande Família, was readmitted to the Intensive Care Unit at Hospital São Lucas in Rio de Janeiro on Saturday, July 11, after surgery to treat a perineal infection. He had been hospitalized since late June for removal of an abscess; initial improvement allowed transfer to a regular room, but the condition worsened, necessitating return to the ICU. He is currently on a zero-diet to aid postoperative monitoring and has difficulty feeding, with no discharge date. His friend and spokesperson Rose Scalco says he is afebrile and with stable blood pressure, awaiting a new evaluation by Dr. Hugo Fragozo. Oliveira remains conscious and responsive to visits, while supporters' prayers provide comfort. The actor has a history of health issues and past hospitalizations following the end of his Globo series.

article.articleHeadline: Oxford inicia teste em humanos de vacina contra nova variante do ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford begins human trials of a vaccine against a new Ebola variant.
article.articleSummary: Oxford begins human trials of BD-Ebov vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus amid the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda outbreak as of 13 July 2026. The outbreak has 625 deaths and 1,792 laboratory-confirmed cases, concentrated in the DRC where conflict and displacement complicate control. The Phase 1 trial will enroll 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 in Oxford, United Kingdom, with a one-year follow-up to assess safety and immunogenicity and to identify early signals of protective response. The vaccine uses a chimpanzee adenovirus vector carrying an Ebola Bundibugyo protein, the same platform used for the COVID-19 vaccine; preclinical work in mice and non-human primates supported progression. Serum Institute of India is manufacturing about 620,000 doses. Researchers plan to expand testing in Africa, including Uganda, to speed evaluation where the outbreak is most active. There is currently no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Disease: Mumbai tops the state in dengue cases; malaria also has 3,498 patients.
article.articleSummary: Mumbai records the highest dengue cases in Maharashtra during the monsoon, with malaria accounting for 3,498 patients. According to the state’s National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP) report, counts of dengue, malaria, and chikungunya have declined this year compared with the previous year, signaling an overall drop in vector-borne disease activity. Despite the reductions, the ongoing monsoon risk keeps vigilance essential across the state, and health authorities have urged residents to take preventive measures to curb mosquito breeding. The report highlights Mumbai as the focal point for dengue within Maharashtra, underscoring urban transmission risks and the need for intensified surveillance and public awareness in the city during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱:マハラシュトラ州で最もデング熱患者が多いのはムンバイ、マラリア患者も3,498人

triage.notes: モンスーン期の媒介蚊感染症に関する定例的な状況報告であり、前年比で患者数は減少している。持続的な監視は必要だが緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Second US citizen diagnosed with Ebola transferred to Germany for treatment: WHO - AOL
article.articleSummary: Second U.S. citizen diagnosed with Bundibugyo Ebola virus and transferred to Germany for treatment, according to WHO. The patient was admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital early Monday and is currently stable after early treatment in a dedicated isolation unit. The individual is a humanitarian worker who had been in Congo's Ituri province, specifically Bunia, working in logistics for Samaritan's Purse, which runs two Ebola Treatment Centers in Bunia and Nyankunde (40 beds each) to serve Ituri where about 90% of Ebola cases have occurred. Samaritan's Purse says the staffer has been with the group for 15 years and was not directly involved in patient care at the centers. The rescue and repatriation were coordinated with U.S. authorities. WHO emphasized protection of frontline responders; CDC declined to comment.

triage.headline_ja: 2人目の米国籍エボラ感染者、治療のためドイツへ搬送:WHO報道 - AOL
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクにおいて、2人目の米国籍感染者が確認され国際搬送された事例であり、国際的拡大・重大な公衆衛生上の懸念があるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 感染者は米国籍・独国搬送のため両国も発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外。実際の感染源・アウトブレイク発生国はDRC（イツリ州）。

article.articleHeadline: Al doilea cetățean american diagnosticat cu Ebola. Pacientul a fost transferat în Germania pentru tratament
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The second American citizen diagnosed with Ebola virus disease. The patient was transferred to Germany for treatment.
article.articleSummary: The second American citizen diagnosed with Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo was transferred to Germany for specialist care. The patient, identity withheld, is a humanitarian worker with Samaritan's Purse based in Bunia, Ituri Province, with 15 years in logistics rather than direct care at Ebola treatment centers. He is infected with the Bundibugyo strain; condition is stable after early treatment at University Hospital Frankfurt. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cautioned that frontline worker infections are not unusual in large outbreaks and stressed worker protection. Samaritan's Purse reports ongoing epidemiological investigations into contacts, collaborating with CDC, the U.S. State Department, and Congolese authorities; the organization operates two treatment centers in Ituri, accounting for about 90% of cases. U.S. health authorities maintain travel-related health restrictions for those who recently visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 2人目の米国人がエボラウイルス病と診断される。患者は治療のためドイツに搬送された
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）で継続中の大規模エボラ流行において、人道支援者である米国人が感染し国際搬送される事例が発生。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地はDRCイトゥリ州であり、ドイツ・米国は感染者の搬送・出身地であり発生地ではないため除外。WHO事務局長も前線スタッフの感染は大規模流行では珍しくないとコメントしており、流行の規模と継続性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Julho Verde reforça alerta para prevenção das hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Green July reinforces the alert for the prevention of viral hepatitis.
article.articleSummary: Green July (Julho Verde) campaign in Santa Catarina, Brazil, emphasizes prevention, early diagnosis, and treatment of viral hepatitis. The initiative aims to broaden public knowledge on how hepatitis viruses are transmitted, the precautions needed, and the importance of screening to detect infection early. Viral hepatitis can affect the liver and may progress to serious complications if not properly managed. During the awareness period, health professionals reinforce preventive habits and encourage seeking medical care. The mobilization also helps disseminate information to communities across Santa Catarina, supporting public health messaging about prevention and the value of routine testing to improve outcomes as of July 13, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 「グリーン・ジュライ」キャンペーンがウイルス性肝炎予防への注意喚起を強化
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生や異常事態の報告ではなく、ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州における恒常的な啓発キャンペーンに関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発キャンペーンの紹介であり、具体的な感染者数増加やアウトブレイクの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Hapur News: संचारी रोगों के प्रति स्टूडेंट्स को जागरूक किया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hapur News: Awareness raised among students about communicable diseases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue and malaria awareness drive in Hapur district as part of Communicable Disease Control Month. District Malaria Officer Satendra Kumar visited several government schools, including Tiala Government School, to educate students about communicable diseases and preventive measures, and to urge maintaining cleanliness around homes. The initiative began on July 1 and involves health teams conducting dengue and malaria prevention activities across areas. Chief Medical Officer Dr. Kishor Kumar Ahuja confirmed the campaign and highlighted ongoing preventive efforts during the month. The focus is on school-based outreach to curb dengue and malaria transmission in Hapur. As of July 13, 2026, the program continues with school visits and community awareness activities.

triage.headline_ja: ハプル新聞: 感染症について学生に啓発活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・マラリアに関する定例的な啓発・予防活動の報道であり、異常発生や症例増加を示す情報はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は例年実施される「感染症予防月間」の一環としての学校での啓発活動報告であり、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Oxford inicia teste em humanos de vacina contra ebola Bundibugyo | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford Begins Human Trials of Bundibugyo Ebola Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Oxford begins Phase I trial of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine (BD-Ebov) ChAdOx1 BDBV, assessing safety and immunogenicity in 50 healthy adults aged 18-55 in Oxford, England. The study, confirmed by Reuters, responds to ongoing Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. This first-in-human trial tests whether the vaccine elicits an immune response and is tolerable, aiming to accelerate countermeasures against Bundibugyo Ebola, for which no approved vaccines or therapies exist. Historically, vaccines exist for Ebola Zaire, but Bundibugyo poses distinct challenges, with humanitarian crises, population mobility, and informal health networks complicating control. Dr. Sumire Sakabe notes social instability and displacement hinder containment of this highly transmissible, lethal virus. With a global emergency declaration, the WHO will convene its Emergency Committee to issue temporary guidance.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォードがブンディブギョ・エボラワクチンのヒト臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は英国オックスフォードでの新規ワクチン(第I相)試験開始であり、新たな感染症発生シグナルではない。ただし背景としてDRC・ウガンダでの進行中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ)アウトブレイクに言及しており、その動向は要注視。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はワクチン臨床試験（英国オックスフォード）だが、DRCおよびウガンダでの進行中のブンディブギョ・エボラアウトブレイクへの対応として実施されている。ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCでの現地アウトブレイクの詳細情報（症例数・死亡数等）が不足しており、フルリスク評価には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uele : l'implication des chefs coutumiers dans la sensibilisation recommandée à Isiro (porte-parole du gouvernement provincial) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: involvement of customary chiefs in the recommended awareness-raising in Isiro (spokesperson for the provincial government) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Haut-Uele, Democratic Republic of Congo, prompts involvement of customary chiefs in awareness-raising in Isiro, the provincial capital, announced on 13 July 2026. During a response task-force meeting, Emmanuel Arama, provincial Minister of Communication and Media, said chiefs will relay barrier measures in local languages to communities. Xavier Mamboyi, provincial Minister of Customary Affairs, urged chiefs at all levels to strengthen outreach to curb Ebola. He called on chiefs, local leaders, civil society, mothers’ associations, taxi drivers, and others to act as community relays (RCO) and to counter misinformation, explaining the disease in dialects. He noted opposition to Ebola in some villages, stressing the disease is real and requires unified communication. Authorities requested broad outreach to ensure population understanding of the health measures.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：イジロにおける啓発活動への伝統的首長の関与が推奨される（州政府報道官）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国オー・ウエレ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱流行に関する記事で、地域社会での抵抗や誤情報への対応が必要とされており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクのある疾患であるためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行への地域社会啓発活動（伝統的首長・市民社会などの動員）に焦点を当てており、一部村落での疾病への抵抗（誤情報等）が指摘されている。感染者数や死亡者数などの具体的疫学データは本記事には記載されていないため、詳細はフルリスク評価で確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : inauguration d'un nouveau Centre de traitement à l'Hôpital général de référence de Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: inauguration of a new treatment center at Bunia General Referral Hospital.
article.articleSummary: On July 13, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo inaugurated a new Ebola Treatment Center at Bunia General Referral Hospital, boosting Bunia CT E capacity to 108 beds (56 added, up from 52). Additional centers are already operational at the Evangelical Medical Center in Rwampara and at Nizi, with two more planned at Lopa and Lita in the Bunia region, the outbreak epicenter. The project is a government–IMC partnership funded by the U.S. DOS initiative, aimed at strengthening Ebola response in the area. As of July 13, 2026, the Ministry of Health reports 1,873 confirmed Ebola cases, 672 deaths, and 306 recoveries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ブニア総合referral病院に新しい治療センターが開設
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（確定1,873例、死亡672例）に関する続報であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にルーマニア（Cluj）、ルワンダ（Kigali）が含まれているが、記事本文はDRC・ブニア地域のエボラ治療センター拡充に関するものであり、これらは無関係な位置情報と判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Grève des employés d'un centre de traitement d'Ebola en RDC | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strike by employees at an Ebola treatment center in the DRC
article.articleSummary: Dozens of staff at an Ebola treatment center in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, staged a strike over non-payment of salaries and bonuses since the outbreak began in May. Staff at Rwampara General Hospital—including epidemiologists, outbreak investigators, drivers, and mortuary workers—left their posts and blocked the road, closing the facility. Government officials say payroll lists are being audited to ensure payments reach the right personnel, after reports of mismatches. As of July 13, 2026, the DRC reports 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases and 702 deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. The government declared the outbreak on May 15 after weeks of undetected transmission. Separately, WHO Director-General Tedros announced a second American humanitarian worker infected in eastern DRC had been moved to Germany; the first American patient had been treated in DRC. Africa CDC warns of unprecedented spread on the continent.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療センターで職員がストライキ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例1,926人・死亡702人に達する大規模エボラ流行（ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株）が継続中で、国際的な患者移送（ドイツ）やAfrica CDCによる『前例のない拡大』警告があり、さらに治療施設のストライキが対応能力を損なう懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ドイツへの患者移送は国際的拡大の一例として言及されているが、発生国はDRCのみであり、ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。治療センターの人員問題（賃金未払いによるストライキ）は流行対応能力の低下を示す重要な運用リスクである。

article.articleHeadline: 3 പേർക്ക് ഷിഗെല്ല 48 പേർക്ക് കൂടി ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shigella in 3 people; dengue fever in 48 more people.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, Kerala reports 3 new Shigella infections across Malappuram, Kozhikode, and Kannur districts, confirmed by laboratory tests. Dengue fever is detected in 48 people, while 180 more with dengue-like symptoms are under treatment. Malaria has been laboratory-confirmed in 8 individuals, and elephantiasis (lymphatic filariasis) in 6. The update indicates simultaneous enteric and vector-borne disease activity in northern Kerala, with ongoing dengue surveillance and multiple laboratory-confirmed infections across the districts mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: シゲラ症3人、デング熱さらに48人確認
triage.triage_reason: インドケララ州で複数の媒介動物・水系感染症（デング熱、マラリア、シゲラ症、象皮病）が同時発生しているが、規模は限定的で国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、季節的な流行の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 地域ローカルニュースによるルーティンサーベイランス報告で、複数疾患（デング熱・マラリア・シゲラ症・象皮病）が同時報告されているが、いずれも重症度や規模の詳細は不明。継続的なモニタリングが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Porto União inicia borrifação contra mosquito da dengue em prédios públicos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto União begins spraying to combat the dengue-carrying mosquito in public buildings.
article.articleSummary: Porto União, Brazil, launches Residual Intradomiciliary Spraying (BRI) against Aedes aegypti in public buildings, including health units and Municipal Educational Centers. Coordinated by the Municipal Health Secretariat and Environmental Surveillance, spray points were selected using technical criteria that prioritize spaces with high foot traffic. In this initial phase, the intervention targets public spaces to reduce adult mosquitoes and extend protection in these sites. BRI entails applying insecticide to interior walls, with residual activity up to four months, killing adults upon contact. The measure is part of dengue prevention but does not replace routine household efforts. Residents should continue eliminating water-collecting containers to prevent Aedes aegypti breeding and minimize the risk of new dengue cases.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトゥニオン市、公共建築物でデング熱媒介蚊への殺虫剤噴霧を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの一地方自治体による通常のデング熱予防・蚊対策活動であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例の報告はなく、日常的な公衆衛生活動の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体による予防的な蚊媒介対策の実施報告であり、感染拡大や異常事態を示す情報は含まれていない。
