article.articleHeadline: Oxford inicia teste de vacina contra nova cepa do vírus Ebola - Portal Em Tempo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford begins vaccine trial against a new strain of the Ebola virus - Portal Em Tempo
article.articleSummary: Oxford begins phase I clinical trial of BD-Ebov, a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, amid an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The study will enroll 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 in Oxford to assess safety and immune response; doses are set to start in coming weeks pending regulators' approval. The vaccine uses the Oxford/AstraZeneca viral-vector platform. Serum Institute of India produced about 620,000 doses and provided 4,000 experimental doses for the trial. The WHO has prioritized evaluation of ChAdOx1 BDBV and the single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo candidate (IAVI). CEPI has committed up to $8.6 million to support development. Parallel studies are planned in Uganda with UVRI and the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine. If results are positive, CEPI will back advanced trials and potential regulatory authorization to ensure rapid, affordable supply to affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、新たなエボラウイルス株に対するワクチン試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン試験が主題だが、背景としてコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダでのブンディブジョ株エボラ出血熱の発生が言及されており、IHR基準（重大性・異常性）を満たすためフルRRAが必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はオックスフォードでのワクチン第I相試験であり、発生地域として記載されたUganda・India・UK等は出典または生産・試験実施国であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生国はDRC（および対象国リスト外のUganda）である。続報でDRC/Uganda間の感染拡大状況を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Eurofarma firma parceria internacional para trazer nova vacina contra chikungunya ao Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eurofarma signs international partnership to bring a new Chikungunya vaccine to Brazil.
article.articleSummary: On 13 July 2026, Brazilian pharmaceutical Eurofarma announced an international partnership with Bavarian Nordic to bring a new chikungunya vaccine to Brazil. The single-dose vaccine uses a virus-like particle (VLP) platform, lacks genetic material, and is designed to safely elicit neutralizing antibodies across ages. It has been approved from age 12+ in the European Union, United Kingdom, United States, and Canada under the brand VIMKUNYA. The submission to Brazil’s health regulator Anvisa seeks to expand access beyond traveler markets to regions where chikungunya poses a heavy public-health burden amid climate-driven arboviral spread. Chikungunya, transmitted by Aedes aegypti, has been notified in more than 100 countries, with nearly 500,000 cases annually worldwide and about 130,000 in Brazil. This would be the second chikungunya vaccine authorized in Brazil; the first, by Instituto Butantan, targets 18–59 years.

triage.headline_ja: Eurofarma社、チクングニア熱の新ワクチンをブラジルに導入するため国際提携を締結
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン承認・提携に関する製薬企業の商業的発表であり、新規の異常な公衆衛生事象や急性のアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はチクングニア熱ワクチンの新規承認・提携に関する商業ニュースであり、疫学的な異常事象の報告ではない。既存の流行状況（ブラジルで年間約13万例）についての言及はあるが、新規性・緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Second American diagnosed with Ebola in Congo outbreak
article.articleSummary: Second American aid worker diagnosed with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, Bunia, according to the World Health Organization. The patient, infected with the Bundibugyo strain, was sent to Germany for continued treatment. A previously diagnosed American doctor from the first week of the outbreak has also been flown to Germany. The outbreak is described by the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever recorded in Africa. Congo declared the outbreak on May 15 after the virus had been spreading undetected for weeks. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment; clinical trials for a potential treatment began last week.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行で2人目の米国人が感染診断
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がアフリカ史上最速の拡大を見せており、国際的な人員（米国人2名）が感染しドイツへ搬送されるなど国際的拡大の懸念があり、承認済みワクチン・治療法がない点で重症度・管理可能性も懸念される。
triage.notes: ドイツは治療搬送先であり発生国ではないため対象国から除外。Bundibugyo株は承認された治療法・ワクチンがなく、アフリカCDCが史上最速拡大と評価している点は重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola se extiende a nuevas provincias en República Democrática del Congo - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads to new provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - teleSUR
article.articleSummary: Ebola spreads to Tshopo and Haut-Uele in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, raising provinces to six since the World Health Organization declared the outbreak on May 15, 2026. The outbreak began in Ituri, then spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Investigations indicate cases in Tshopo and Haut-Uele originated in Nya Nya, Ituri. Official counts show 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths; four cases (two deaths) in Tshopo and one death in Haut-Uele. A WHO official warned the true scale may be larger, as four of five new cases lack a clear epidemiological link, signaling underreporting. The Bundibugyo strain has no targeted vaccine, and Ervebo is not recommended for this variant. Containment is hindered by the CRF rebel alliance and cross-border risks with South Sudan and the Central African Republic; Rwanda has sent six experts to Goma, with Kigali denying military support to rebels. UN agencies coordinate data exchange.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ民主共和国の新たな州へ拡大 - teleSUR
triage.triage_reason: WHOが宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行が6州に拡大し、死亡700名超・報告不足の懸念、ワクチン非対応株、国境を越えた拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内（Ituri, North/South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele）における流行拡大が主題。ルワンダ、南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国は国境リスク・支援に関する言及のみで、対象国リストに含まれないか主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン（Ervebo）の効果が限定的である点、報告不足の懸念が特に重要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito Density Soars, Mangalwari Worst Hit
article.articleSummary: June 2026 mosquito-density survey in Nagpur's Mangalwari records the city's highest Culex density (35.62 per collection) and Aedes density (3.75), signaling elevated risk of dengue, chikungunya and, via Culex, filariasis. Satranjipura (27.12), Gandhibagh (26.81), Laxmi Nagar (26.11) and Ashi Nagar (24.16) also show high Culex densities; Anopheles mosquitoes—malaria vectors—were detected in Gandhibagh (0.4). Mangalwari and Ashi Nagar placed under special surveillance due to dense housing, stagnant water, open drains, scrap yards, and narrow lanes fostering breeding. Additional high-risk localities include Patankar Chowk, Republican Nagar, Uppalwadi, Yashodharanagar, Mankapur, Zingabai Takli, Khamla, Sonegaon, Ramnagar, Gittikhadan, Mominpura and Kalamna. To curb breeding, 11 vehicle-mounted foggers, 51 hand foggers, 10 cold foggers and 126 spray pumps deployed; anti-larval emulsified oil spraying intensified. From July 1, 50 temporary health workers for three months; 100 breeding checkers for July-December. Public participation urged.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の密度が急増、マンガルワリ地区が最も深刻な被害
triage.triage_reason: 現時点では蚊の密度調査結果と予防的措置の報道であり、実際のデング熱・チクングニヤ熱の患者発生や重症例の報告は確認されないが、媒介蚊の高密度は流行リスクを示唆するため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は媒介蚊の密度調査結果と当局の予防対策（フォギング、監視強化等）に関する内容であり、実際の感染者数や症例に関する情報は含まれていない。デング熱・チクングニヤ熱・フィラリア症・マラリアの媒介蚊が高密度で検出されている点は今後の患者発生増加のリスク要因として注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura anuncia controle de roedores em Divinópolis e orienta população - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall Announces Rodent Control in Divinópolis and Advises the Public - Portal MPA
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis City Hall announced intensified rodent-control actions across multiple districts, including the Centro area, with technical criteria guiding monitoring of zones with higher incidence. Central-area cleaning and washing, waste removal, and public-space maintenance are being expanded by the Health and Urban Services secretariats. Regarding rodenticide use in the central area, Health Surveillance is evaluating the safest, most effective approach to widen this measure amid heavy foot traffic and the presence of stray dogs and cats. Public guidance calls for community participation: keep waste in sturdy bags and dispose only on collection days; do not discard waste on streets, vacant lots, or green spaces; store food and animal feed in sealed containers; eliminate potential rodent shelters; and maintain clean yards and sidewalks. The effort highlights shared responsibility to curb rodent proliferation and prevent rodent-borne diseases such as leptospirosis.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリス市庁がネズミ駆除対策を発表、住民に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症の予防的なネズミ駆除策の発表であり、実際の感染事例や流行の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の発生報告ではなく、行政による予防的なネズミ駆除・衛生対策の告知。レプトスピラ症の具体的な症例数や流行状況は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: पोर्टेबल एक्स-रे मशीन से 45 लोगों की हुई टीबी स्क्रीनिंग, 13 नमूने लिए
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB screening of 45 people using a portable X-ray machine; 13 samples taken.
article.articleSummary: On July 13, 2026, Pilibhit’s District Tuberculosis Center organized a TB screening camp at the Old Hospital PHC Mohalla Sheikhchand using a portable X-ray machine. Forty-five individuals were screened; 13 suspects had sputum samples collected and sent to the District TB Center for testing. ASHA workers from the hospital helped mobilize residents—especially diabetics, people aged 60 and above, and households with a prior TB patient—to attend the camp. Medical Officer Dr. Janmijay Singh conducted health assessments and educated attendees on TB prevention and the importance of timely testing. The event highlights a community-based approach to early TB detection and ensuring linkage to diagnostic services.

triage.headline_ja: ピリバイトでポータブルX線機器を用いたTB検診、45人検診・13検体採取
triage.triage_reason: 通常のTB検診・啓発活動に関する報道であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 通常の地域医療活動（TBスクリーニングキャンプ）の報道であり、アウトブレイクや異常事象の記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Expertos piden a México incorporar vacuna contra dengue ante riesgo de nuevas epidemias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts urge Mexico to include the dengue vaccine amid the risk of new epidemics.
article.articleSummary: Mexico’s dengue situation prompts vaccine inclusion in Universal Vaccination Program, per the Asociación Mexicana de Vacunología (AMV). In Ciudad de México and nationwide, Mexico recorded 24,998 probable dengue cases in 2026 with 2,421 lab-confirmed through epidemiological week 22. AMV cautions of hyperendemicity driven by climate change expanding the Aedes aegypti vector into new areas and urban growth increasing exposure; four dengue serotypes are circulating simultaneously, elevating risk of severe disease in previously infected individuals. The AMV delivered a proposal to President Claudia Sheinbaum urging addition of dengue vaccination to current vector-control measures, prioritizing high-incidence municipalities and targeting children and adolescents aged 6–11. A dengue vaccine obtained regulatory approval in late 2025 and could be deployed within months, alongside other vaccines under development. Vaccination could reduce hospitalizations, complications, deaths, and economic losses, and Brazil’s 2024 epidemic is cited as context. If not advanced, cycles of epidemics may recur.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、新たな流行リスクを前にメキシコにデング熱ワクチンの導入を求める
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の四血清型同時流行とヒトデング熱ワクチンの政策提言があり、行政（大統領府）への働きかけが確認されるため、WPRO基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）と社会的・政治的関心が満たされる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はメキシコにおけるデング熱流行とワクチン導入提言であり、対象国リストにメキシコは含まれない。ブラジルは2024年の流行事例として文脈的に言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Flood's health toll: Nearly 2,000 fall ill, skin infections lead
article.articleSummary: Flood-affected Surat reports rising illnesses at municipal health camps. Since July 11, 3,950 residents have been examined, with 1,930 diagnosed and treated. Skin infections are the most common, totaling 825 cases, concentrated in Kamru Nagar (Limbayat) 172; Sanjay Nagar (Udhna) 155; Azad Nagar (Bhatar) 147. Respiratory viral infections (cough/cold) number 402, and fever cases total 357. Malaria tests were conducted on 361 fever patients to rule out malaria. Gastrointestinal illness includes 264 diarrhoea cases and 82 with vomiting. Fourteen patients were referred for further evaluation as a precaution. Preventive measures included 2,020 multivitamin tablets and 3,988 ORS packets distributed. Officials report no evidence of a flood-related outbreak or disease cluster so far, but waterborne disease risk remains during the 4–5 day incubation period; camps will continue for several more days to screen residents.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水による健康被害：約2,000人が発病、皮膚感染症が最多
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の健康キャンプにおける通常の医療対応事例であり、マラリア検査は熱発患者の除外診断として実施されたのみで、実際のマラリア感染確定例やアウトブレイクの証拠は報告されていない。当局も「洪水関連の発生集積の証拠はない」と明言している。
triage.notes: 疾患名はMalariaと分類されているが、記事本文では361人の発熱患者に対しマラリアの除外検査を実施したとの記載のみで、確定感染例数は不明。主症状は皮膚感染症・呼吸器感染症・下痢であり、洪水後の一般的な公衆衛生対応事例と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak has now spread to two more provinces
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has expanded into two northeastern provinces, Tshopo (Kisangani) and Haut-Uele, in addition to prior foci in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. As of the July 11 update, the national tally is 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. In Tshopo, four confirmed cases have been reported, including two fatalities; Haut-Uele has one recorded death. Authorities consider the two new provinces as an epidemic zone, with investigations indicating most cases there are imported from Niania in Ituri. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC history, first declared May 15. Transmission remains via direct contact with bodily fluids, with symptoms such as high fever, vomiting, and bleeding. The World Health Organization cautions the true scale could be 2–4 times higher than reported, and four in five new cases lack known links to previous patients, highlighting cross-border risks with South Sudan and the Central African Republic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、さらに2つの州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が新たに2州へ拡大し、累計1,926例・702死亡と規模が拡大。WHOは実際の規模がさらに大きい可能性を指摘し、南スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国との国境を越える拡大リスクも明示されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事中の中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダンは越境リスクとして言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため対象国リストにも該当せず除外。DRC国内での多州拡大が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Why the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history is becoming more challenging
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy o ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Congo is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, with nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. Suspected cases have emerged in two more provinces, including Kisangani, one of Congo's largest cities, widening containment challenges. Laboratory confirmation lags because earlier testing targeted a more common Ebola type, and the outbreak's origin remains unknown. Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccines. Transmission occurs from wild animals to humans and between people via contact with bodily fluids (vomit, blood, semen) and contaminated surfaces; traditional funeral practices have been restricted to curb spread. An unpaid-workers strike at a treatment center underscores fragile infrastructure and misinformation claiming the virus is not real. Work has begun on studies of two treatments for this Ebola type. Infections and deaths are verified as of 13 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速のエボラ流行がさらに困難な状況に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのバンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱が史上最速の拡大を見せ、大都市キサンガニにも拡大しつつあり、ワクチン未承認・感染源不明という点でIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: バンディブギョ型エボラウイルスは稀な亜型でワクチン未承認、致死率・拡大速度ともに極めて高く、大都市への拡大や治療施設での労働者ストライキ等、対応体制の脆弱性も報告されている。フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lubero : plus de 6 000 déplacés vulnérables face au risque d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lubero: More than 6,000 vulnerable displaced people facing the risk of Ebola virus disease.
article.articleSummary: More than 6,256 displaced households in Lubero-Centre, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, live in severe precarity, lacking soap, handwashing kits, and other preventive tools, hindering adherence to Ebola prevention measures and increasing vulnerability to Ebola virus disease. Civil society leader Muhindo Tafuteni warns residents are unprotected against Ebola and urgently appeals to the government and humanitarian actors to intervene. The situation involves crowded living conditions and limited community prevention efforts, creating an elevated risk of Ebola transmission among displaced populations. No Ebola cases are reported in the article, but the risk is framed as a potential catastrophe if relief and preventive supplies are not delivered promptly. Urgent humanitarian support is deemed essential to avert a health crisis in Lubero-Centre.

triage.headline_ja: ルベロ:6,000人以上の脆弱な避難民がエボラウイルス病のリスクに直面
triage.triage_reason: エボラの確定症例は報告されていないが、北キブ州ルベロの避難民約6,256世帯が衛生用品不足の中で感染リスクに晒されており、市民社会指導者が政府・人道機関への緊急支援を要請している。WPRO基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に複数該当し、国際支援の必要性も明示されているためフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 現時点でエボラ確定症例の報告はなく、避難民の衛生状況悪化によるリスク警告記事。続報でのエボラ症例発生状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Exames laboratoriais permitem diagnosticar hepatites virais antes do surgimento dos sintomas.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Laboratory Tests Enable Diagnosis of Viral Hepatitis Before Symptom Onset.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces hepatitis awareness as the July Amarelo campaign highlights early laboratory diagnosis of viral hepatitis before symptoms appear. The 2025 Hepatitis Virales Epidemiological Bulletin notes reduced mortality from hepatitis B and C in the past decade due to vaccination and treatment, while hepatitis A rose after years of decline, underscoring prevention and early investigation. Diagnostic strategy relies on serology detecting markers for hepatitis A, B, and C, with liver-function tests (AST/ALT) and molecular tests that identify viral RNA/DNA weeks after infection for confirmation. Early identification reduces the risk of serious liver damage; hepatitis B and C can be asymptomatic for years but still cause damage, making early management crucial for control and cure. Vaccination protects A and B; C has curative treatment. Risk groups include healthcare workers, dialysis patients, people with HIV, transfusions prior to 1993, and exposure history. Grupo Meddi operates IHEF in Bahia, with presence in Salvador and over 30 Bahia cities.

triage.headline_ja: 検査によりウイルス性肝炎を症状発現前に診断可能に
triage.triage_reason: 啓発キャンペーンと診断技術に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、新規の異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 記事は7月の啓発キャンペーン(Julho Amarelo)に関連する診断技術・疫学的傾向の解説記事であり、アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 夏季流感高峰 新冠活躍增 醫學會籲高風險人士盡早接種疫苗 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer influenza season peaks as COVID-19 activity rises; Medical Association urges high-risk individuals to get vaccinated as early as possible | am730
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong faces a summer influenza peak as COVID-19 activity rises locally and in the Mainland. The Hong Kong Medical Association urges high‑risk individuals to vaccinate early. Dr. Zeng Qiyin, an Infectious Diseases and Clinical Microbiology specialist, reports private COVID-19 consultations up ~30% and, with waning population immunity, expects community transmission to worsen in 1–2 months. Targeted vaccination is recommended: young men and women should receive the HPV vaccine; pregnant women before 35 weeks gestation should get the pertussis vaccine; immunocompromised residents should receive the herpes zoster (shingles) vaccine; and pneumococcal vaccination should not be neglected, especially for the elderly and those with chronic illnesses, with subsidized options available. Dr. Cao Zhonghao, a respiratory specialist, notes pneumococcus can cause otitis media, severe pneumonia, and meningitis, underscoring the need for timely pneumococcal vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季インフルエンザが流行の高峰に、新型コロナ活動も増加 医学会が高リスク者に早期のワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザおよびCOVID-19の活動増加に関する通常の公衆衛生注意喚起であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれも明確な該当はなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性の感染症（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、肺炎球菌、百日咳）に関するワクチン接種推奨記事であり、新規または異常な感染症事象ではない。香港は中国(1814991)に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: أول تجربة لقاح ضد إيبولا على البشر.. سلالة نادرة - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First human trial of an Ebola vaccine... a rare strain - Al-Watan
article.articleSummary: As of 13 July 2026, Oxford University researchers plan to begin the first human trial of an Ebola vaccine targeting the rare Bundibugyo strain, testing in 50 volunteers in the United Kingdom. The study involves inoculating adults willing to be exposed to the deadly virus, eight weeks after development began. The Bundibugyo strain fuels an ongoing outbreak in Africa, primarily in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with about 645 deaths and roughly 1,800 confirmed cases, including one case reported in France. U.S. CDC data for the first week of July show around 100 deaths. There is currently no vaccine for Bundibugyo; four vaccines are in development as scientists rush to curb transmission, with the virus having reached parts of Europe.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチンの初のヒト試験…稀少株 - アル・ワタン
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダで進行中の稀少エボラ株（ブンディブジョ株）の流行が645人の死亡・約1800人の確定例に及び、フランスでの感染例も報告されるなど国際的拡大の兆候があるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、フランス、米国、英国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみが対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta: Como agir diante de morcegos suspeitos e prevenir a raiva humana em RO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert: How to act when faced with suspected bats and prevent human rabies in Rondônia.
article.articleSummary: Rondônia, Brazil – AGEVISA-RO issued an epidemiological alert after confirming rabies virus in bats. Since January 2026, 3 of 40 animal samples tested positive at LACEN-RO, with cases in Cacoal, Cacaulândia and Jaru. The virus continues circulating among bats, but control efforts have prevented spillover to people; the last human rabies case in Rondônia occurred in 2004 (Pimenta Bueno). Any bat species—frugivorous, insectivorous or hematophagous—can transmit if infected. Daytime activity, inability to fly, disorientation, or bats found on sidewalks or sleeping in sun should trigger suspicion. Emergency protocol: wash any contact area with water and soap, seek immediate medical care for vaccine and rabies serum. Do not touch the animal; isolate it with a bucket/box and call local zoonoses. Porto Velho Zoonoses: (69) 98473-6712. After a positive result, municipalities trigger focus vaccination of dogs and cats to block transmission; culling bats is prohibited given ecological importance.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：疑わしいコウモリに遭遇した際の対処法とロンドニア州における人の狂犬病予防について
triage.triage_reason: コウモリにおける狂犬病ウイルス検出は継続的なサーベイランス活動の一環であり、人への感染例は2004年以降発生していない。自治体による予防的対応（ワクチン接種等）が機能しており、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発情報であり、コウモリの狂犬病ウイルス保有は確認されているが人への感染例はなく、地元当局の対応で管理されている。継続的な動物サーベイランスの結果として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Distrito Federal registra alta em casos graves de influenza B
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal District reports a rise in severe influenza B cases.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-13, Fiocruz InfoGripe reports rising severe influenza B cases in the Federal District (Brasília), with SRAG incidence at alert/risk levels in Brasília, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro and Santa Catarina. Nationally, most states show stabilization or halted SRAG spread, but incidence remains high. Influenza B circulates mainly among humans; common symptoms include abrupt high fever, headache, myalgias, fatigue, dry cough and sore throat; children may have nausea or diarrhea. Severe warning signs include respiratory distress, tachypnea, chest pain, hypoxemia, confusion or poor intake. RSV remains the leading SRAG agent (55.9% of hospitalizations); influenza A accounts for 12.7% of cases and 33.1% of deaths, influenza B 8.4% of cases and 15.4% of deaths. Risk factors: comorbidities, pregnancy, young children, elderly. Seasonality (March–July) and low vaccination coverage in priority groups. Recommendations: influenza and COVID-19 vaccination; masks in health settings; oseltamivir within 48 hours for severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦直轄区、インフルエンザB重症例の増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル連邦直轄区を含む複数州でSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）の警戒レベルが上昇しているが、季節性インフルエンザ・RSVの通常の流行パターン内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザB、RSV、インフルエンザA）の国内サーベイランス報告。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、SRAG警戒レベルの動向は継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Chakradharpur News: मलेरिया से बचाव को किया जागरूक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chakradharpur News: Awareness Raised for Malaria Prevention.
article.articleSummary: Malaria awareness campaign organized in Chakradharpur, Goilkera area, with support from Goilkera Community Health Center and Ghoda Dubba School, led by Parimal Foundation's POCD, MPW. The malaria education drive explained causes, symptoms, transmission by mosquitoes, prevention steps, the importance of timely testing, and completing treatment. Emphasis was placed on regular use of mosquito nets, eliminating standing water, and maintaining cleanliness; villagers were urged to seek prompt testing at health centers if fever arises. During the campaign, fever screenings were conducted for residents, and free medicines were distributed as needed. Students and community members engaged in information sessions, enhancing awareness on vector control, early diagnosis, and treatment to reduce malaria transmission in the area.

triage.headline_ja: チャクラダルプル・ニュース:マラリア予防への意識向上活動が実施される
triage.triage_reason: アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、通常の予防啓発キャンペーンの記事であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア予防の地域啓発活動（意識向上キャンペーン）の実施報告であり、実際の感染拡大や異常な発生を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Reino Unido vai iniciar testes da vacina contra ebola em humanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Kingdom will begin testing the Ebola vaccine in humans.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University launched a first-in-human trial (BD-Ebov) of a Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The Phase I study in the United Kingdom will assess safety and immunogenicity in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55, with first doses expected in the UK within weeks and year-long follow-up. Outbreaks centered in the DRC have resulted in 625 deaths and 1,792 laboratory-confirmed cases as the virus persists in a conflict-affected, mobile population. Partnerships with Uganda aim to begin Africa-based testing. The vaccine uses a chimpanzee adenovirus vector platform shared with COVID-19 vaccines, expressing an Ebola glycoprotein to elicit immunity; it has prior animal testing and is manufactured by the Serum Institute of India, which has about 620,000 doses prepared.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、エボラワクチンのヒト臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模なエボラ流行（死亡625人、確定患者1,792人）を背景に、英国でワクチンのヒト初回投与試験が開始されるという内容であり、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は英国での臨床試験だが、根拠となる流行はDRC（および対象国リスト外のウガンダ）に集中している。インドはワクチン製造元（Serum Institute of India）としてのみ言及され、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists test first vaccine for lethal leishmaniasis threatening Oklahoma
article.articleSummary: Leishmaniasis vaccine enters first human trials after successful hamster testing. The first-ever vaccine targets both the mild cutaneous form, established in Oklahoma, Texas, and Arizona with 91 US cases reported in 2024 and two locally acquired in Oklahoma, and the deadly visceral form approaching the US from the south (Mexico reported two visceral cases in 2024). The trial concept echoes Bedouin leishmanization, using CRISPR to attenuate the parasite while preserving immunity. In hamster challenges, vaccination plus exposure to infected sandflies yielded 100% protection and survival. An international 13-country consortium led by Ohio State’s Abhay Satoskar, with collaborators including McGill, Nagasaki University, Ethiopia, and Kenya, seeks regulatory clearance; FDA granted IND status, NIH approval pending. Human trials will start later this year in Kenya and Brazil. If 50% efficacy is achieved within 7–8 years, eradication could be feasible; climate-driven vector shifts underscore urgency.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者たちがオクラホマ州を脅かす致死性リーシュマニア症の初のワクチンを試験
triage.triage_reason: 米国でのリーシュマニア症拡大とワクチン開発に関する科学ニュースであり、対象国での疾病発生自体を報じるものではないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国（オクラホマ・テキサス・アリゾナ）での皮膚リーシュマニア症拡大とワクチン開発。ブラジル・ケニアは臨床試験実施予定地として言及されているのみで、疾病発生国としての記述はないため対象国リストからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Aumentan a 1.873 los casos confirmados de ébola en RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases rise to 1,873 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, 13 July 2026 — The health authorities report 1,873 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 672 deaths, up from 1,830 cases and 648 deaths reported on Friday, according to an official Reuters-cited update. Officials say transmission began several months before the first officially announced cases on May 15, likely exposing many healthcare workers before detection. The update underscores ongoing outbreak dynamics and response challenges. Shortages of basic personal protective equipment, including gloves and masks, are hindering the response and increasing risk to medical staff, thereby complicating containment and patient care across affected areas in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確定患者数が1,873人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例1,873人・死亡672人（致死率約36%）に達し、PPE不足で医療従事者への感染拡大リスクも指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 5月15日の公式発表前から数か月にわたり感染が拡大していた可能性があり、医療従事者への未検知感染やPPE不足による対応の遅延が懸念される。致死率が高く、フルリスク評価への移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Beaver that's 'out for blood' terrorizes upstate NY swimmers as officials issue dire warning about rabid rodents
article.articleSummary: Two swimmers on Turtle Island, a small isle on Lake George in upstate New York, were bitten by a beaver on July 4 while trying to disengage from it. The incident prompted a New York DEC investigation; five days later, on July 9, a dead beaver tested rabid. It is unclear if it was the same animal, but officials warned the rabid beaver may have infected others in a nearby colony. Public advisories urge boaters and campers to avoid contact with beavers and to report unusual behavior around the water on Turtle Island. The case follows a May rabies incident in New Jersey, where an 8-year-old was attacked by a rabid beaver at Lake Henry in Continental Soldiers Park.

triage.headline_ja: 「血に飢えた」ビーバーがニューヨーク州北部の水泳客を襲い、当局が狂犬病ネズミ類に関する厳重warning を発令
triage.triage_reason: 米国ニューヨーク州における単発の狂犬病ビーバー咬傷事件であり、対象国（IHR加盟国リスト）に該当する地域での発生ではない。公衆衛生上の深刻な国際的影響は見られない。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与したフィリピン関連地域（Turtle Islands, ARMM等）は地名の同一性による誤検出であり、記事内容とは無関係。事件は米国ニューヨーク州・ニュージャージー州で発生しており、対象国リストに米国は含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Menina de dois anos morre vítima de dengue no Piauí; estado registra 11º óbito em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two-year-old girl dies from dengue in Piauí; state records 11th death in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Two-year-old girl dies of dengue in Picos, southern Piauí, raising the state's 2026 dengue fatalities to 11. The Painel de Arboviroses reports 14,413 probable dengue cases in Piauí, with 8,363 confirmed. The child, from Pio IX, died at Hospital Regional Justino Luz after initial treatment elsewhere; symptoms began July 6 and Lacen-confirmed dengue. Initial care in Pio IX led to discharge, then clinical deterioration; she had fever, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal swelling and weakness, and was transferred to Picos where she died. In Piauí, 26 cases progressed to severe dengue and 405 showed warning signs. One death in Teresina remains under investigation; early exams did not confirm dengue. Entre Rios Territory accounts for 7,284 probable cases, Serra da Capivara Territory for 2,404. Nationally, Brazil reports 247 confirmed dengue deaths, 197 under investigation, and over 415,000 probable cases in 2026. Prevention centers on eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州で2歳女児がデング熱で死亡、2026年州内11人目の死者
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ピアウイ州でデング熱による死亡例が続いており重症化例も報告されているが、毎年繰り返される季節性流行の範囲内であり、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行しており、本記事は州レベルの死者数更新報道。全国で415,000件超の疑い例、247人の確定死亡例が報告されているが、これは例年の季節性流行パターンと考えられる。国際的関心や渡航制限への言及はなし。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 'Brit scientists proving skill can save lives outside UK with new ebola vaccine'
article.articleSummary: Oxford University's Ebola vaccine was developed in eight weeks after a Bundibugyo-strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which killed 625 people and infected nearly 1,800. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. The vaccine uses technology behind the Oxford-AstraZeneca Covid jab, enabling rapid design while maintaining safety testing. The first safety trial will take place in Britain before trials in Africa. Supporters say the accelerated development shows British science at its best—fast, careful, and aimed at saving lives beyond the UK. The effort seeks to address the Congo outbreak with a vaccine that could provide protection against Bundibugyo Ebola, with testing conducted across the UK and Africa as part of the safety assessment.

triage.headline_ja: 英国の科学者が新型エボラワクチンで英国外の命も救えることを証明
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行（死者625人、感染者約1800人）という重大な公衆衛生イベントが背景にあり、承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しない状況のため、フルRRAでの状況確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は英国オックスフォード大学によるワクチン開発（治験は英国内で実施予定）であり、DRCでの流行自体は既知の過去情報として言及されている可能性がある。流行が現在進行中か終息済みかは記事から不明であり、続報確認が必要。UKは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: The DRC Ebola Outbreak Has Reached 1,792 Cases and 625 Deaths, and U.S. Airport Screening Expires in Eight Days
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reaches 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths as of July 9, 2026 (ECDC), with Ituri the epicenter (1,631/535 in 25 zones), North Kivu 158/89 in 11 zones, and South Kivu 3/1. Bundibugyo strain—not Zaire—drives the outbreak; there is no WHO-approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, and existing Zaire vaccines Ervebo and Mvabea/Zabdeno are not established as effective. Treatment is supportive. A U.S. entry restriction order remains in effect and is set to expire July 21, 2026; foreign nationals who were in DRC, South Sudan, or Uganda in the past 21 days are barred. U.S. citizens can enter via four airports with enhanced screening: IAD, ATL, IAH, JFK. One imported U.S. case—a missionary physician evacuated to Germany. A July 2 trial in DRC tests MBP134 and remdesivir with more than 1,200 doses. WHO has not declared stabilization; CDC assesses U.S. risk as low, renewal decision due by July 21.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ流行は1,792例・死者625人に達し、米国の空港検疫措置は8日後に期限切れへ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo株エボラが1,792例・625人死亡と大規模化し、ワクチン未確立・国際的な渡航制限措置(米国入国規制)も発動中であり、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは輸入症例および検疫措置関連の記載であり、発生国はDRCのみ。ウガンダ・南スーダンは入国制限対象国として言及されるが発生国としての記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Un segundo estadounidense infectado con ébola en el Congo fue evacuado a Alemania bajo vigilancia de la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A second American infected with Ebola in the Congo was evacuated to Germany under WHO surveillance.
article.articleSummary: A second American infected with Ebola from Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo was evacuated to Germany under WHO surveillance. The patient, a Samaritan’s Purse logistics worker in Bunia, tested positive and was confirmed by the organization after coordination with the US CDC, the State Department, and Congolese authorities. He has 15 years with disaster‑response teams but did not work directly with Ebola patients in the past month. Exposure occurred amid rapid transmission and weak health systems. The Congo outbreak, declared in May, has infected over 1,900 people and caused over 700 deaths, with most cases in Ituri Province. Bundibugyo has no approved treatments or vaccines, prompting clinical trials. WHO and CDC warn of inadequate PPE and attacks on facilities; challenges include mistrust, logistics, violence, and displacement. Earlier, a US physician, Dr. Peter Stafford, was infected and evacuated to Germany; authorities continue contact tracing to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラに感染した2人目の米国人がWHOの監視下でドイツに搬送された
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイクは既に1900人超感染・700人超死亡と深刻で、国際搬送・多国間対応が発生しており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは患者搬送先であり感染発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。DRCのイトゥリ州でのアウトブレイクが主題。Bundibugyo株には承認済み治療薬・ワクチンがなく、医療体制の脆弱性・暴力・不信感などが拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ghatsila News: स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने मलेरिया की रोकथाम को ले चलाया विशेष अभियान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ghatsila News: The Health Department has launched a special campaign for malaria prevention.
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, Anumandal Hospital, Ghatsila, formed a special health team to treat and prevent malaria and diarrhea in Mirgitod village, Bagudiya Panchayat. The team began outreach from schools to remote villages, providing health awareness and free medicines, and conducting malaria and diarrhea screenings. Medicines were distributed free of charge, and residents were urged to remain vigilant about health. Team members include Heera Murmu, Community Health Officer; ANM Savani Munda; BTM Vandana Maiti; Sahiya Sathi Sumitra Mardy; and Shashti Singh. The campaign emphasizes preventive education and accessible treatment to curb disease burden in Ghatsila’s area and to foster long-term health awareness among communities.

triage.headline_ja: ガーツシラ・ニュース：保健局がマラリア予防のための特別対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における通常のマラリア予防・啓発活動であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例の報告はなく、社会的関心の高まりも見られない。
triage.notes: 地方保健局による定例的なマラリア・下痢症予防キャンペーンの報道であり、感染拡大や異常事象を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 17ème épidémie de la maladie à virus d'Ebola en RDC : comme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak in the DRC: like.
article.articleSummary: Two months and two days after the current Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) was officially declared, the Bundibugyo strain has spread from its Ituri epicenter to five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele. The Centre for Public Health Emergency Operations in the DRC (COUSP RDC) reports more than 800 confirmed cases and over 600 deaths. In the last 48 hours, 43 new cases were detected in Ituri and North Kivu, with 42 in Ituri. The outbreak unfolds amid armed clashes in the Kivus, recurring population displacement, logistical challenges, and public mistrust; in Butembo, unknown individuals destroyed and looted hygiene and transmission-prevention materials. The response, led by COUSP RDC, aims to contain transmission and protect affected communities while navigating security and logistics hurdles.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国における第17次エボラウイルス病流行：現状
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認済み800例超・死亡600例超という高い致死率を伴うエボラ流行が5州に拡大しており、武力衝突や住民の不信感により対応が困難化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 本流行はブンディブギョ株によるもので、イトゥリ州を起点に北キブ州、南キブ州、ツショポ州、オートウエレ州の5州に拡大。武力衝突による治安悪化・住民避難・物流障害・公衆の不信（ブテンボでの衛生物資破壊等）が対応を阻害している。国境地帯（ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ブルンジ等）への越境拡大リスクにも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: the INRB is implementing a strict protocol to ensure safe laboratory diagnosis - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola diagnosis at Bunia's INRB applies strict biosafety: upon receipt of samples suspected of containing Ebola, preliminary inactivation destroys the virus before any handling. Dr Tony Wawina of INRB explains that this ensures staff safety and reliable results. After inactivation, samples are loaded into cartridges and run on the Radio One platform, yielding positive/negative Ebola results within 65 minutes. From receipt to result, turnaround is no more than 1 hour 15 minutes. Additional PCR platforms are available for rapid and accurate diagnosis. Safety continues post-testing through rigorous waste management: used cartridges are disinfected per procedures and incinerated for permanent destruction to prevent contamination. Results are immediately sent to medical teams at Ebola treatment centers to enable rapid management of confirmed cases and discharge of those testing negative. This follows the outbreak in Bunia, Ituri, in the north-east Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：INRBが安全な検査診断を確保するため厳格なプロトコルを実施
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ブニアで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する記事であり、致死率の高い疾患であるため深刻な公衆衛生影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ検査プロトコルの詳細に焦点を当てているが、ブニア（イトゥリ州）でのエボラアウトブレイクの継続を前提としている。感染者数・死亡者数などの疫学情報は本記事には含まれておらず、既存アウトブレイクの続報として注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Segundo americano infectado por ebola no Congo é levado para a Alemanha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second American infected with Ebola in the Congo is taken to Germany
article.articleSummary: Second American diagnosed with Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been evacuated to Germany and is hospitalized in a high-security isolation unit at University Hospital Frankfurt. The patient was transferred from the DRC to Germany by medical evacuation flight and arrived in the early hours of Monday, July 13, 2026, with the World Health Organization confirming the transfer. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the patient is responding well to treatment and thanked the governments of the DRC, Germany, and the United States for their cooperation. This marks the second American case associated with the Congo outbreak. The report provides no additional details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or the infection source beyond the evacuation and confinement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスに感染した2人目のアメリカ人がドイツへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱の発生に関連し、アメリカ人患者が国際医療搬送された事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当し社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCで感染しドイツへ医療搬送されたため、発生地域としてはDRCのみを検証対象とした。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Reino Unido inicia testes em humanos de vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: United Kingdom begins human trials of an Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University in the United Kingdom has launched the first-in-human trial of BD-Ebov, a vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus, in Oxford, UK. The outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 625 deaths and 1,792 laboratory-confirmed cases. The study will enroll 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 to assess safety and immunogenicity, with a one-year follow-up; researchers expect early signals of protective immune response and to monitor adverse effects. This vaccine is the first of four against this variant to reach human testing. The platform uses the same technology as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine: a chimpanzee adenovirus vector encoding an Ebola protein. Serum Institute of India is manufacturing about 620,000 doses, and future trials in Uganda are planned.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:英国がワクチンのヒト試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダで進行中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行（死亡625例、確認例1792例）を背景に英国でワクチン臨床試験が開始された。既存アウトブレイクの重症度・規模からIHR基準複数該当し、フルRRAでの継続評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は英国オックスフォードでのワクチン臨床試験開始だが、その背景としてDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行状況（死亡625例、確認例1792例）が言及されている。ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。インドはワクチン製造国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará registra aumento de 797 casos de dengue em uma semana e chega a 6.114 confirmações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará records an increase of 797 dengue cases in one week and reaches 6,114 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Ceará, Brazil, rose to 6,114 confirmed cases in 2026 as of the epidemiological week ended July 4, up 797 from the prior week (5,347). The surge pushes the year’s total beyond all of 2025 (4,892). Growth is concentrated in the North, Eastern Coast, and Jaguaribe Valley regions, with Tianguá leading at 660 cases. Dengue-related deaths reached 10 in 2026, compared with 3 in 2025. Laboratory-confirmed serotypes circulating include dengue types 1 (9 cases), 2 (11 cases), and 3 (1 case). Symptoms typically appear 4–10 days after the bite, and some patients may progress to severe dengue between days 3 and 7. Prevention focuses on eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites, proper water storage, disposing of containers, cleaning plant pots, and enabling vector-control inspections, including fumigation (fumacê) in high-incidence cities and health-system capacity-building. Community participation remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州、1週間でデング熱797件増加し6,114件の確定例に達する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州でデング熱の症例数が前年を上回るペースで増加し死亡例も増えているが、地域レベルの季節性流行であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、フルRRAより経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する既知の疾病であり、今回の増加は地域内医療体制で対応可能とみられる。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威としての新規性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: US continues to shun Ebola-infected citizens; second American sent to Germany
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) declared May 15; by July 12 reports 1,926 cases and 702 deaths, making it the third largest on record and still growing. A second American infected is a US citizen in his 60s working as a Samaritan’s Purse warehouse manager, not directly treating patients; he tested positive and was evacuated to Germany for care, arriving at Frankfurt University Hospital, in stable condition and in isolation after responding to treatment. The first American infected, Dr. Peter Stafford, directly treated patients and was evacuated to Berlin; he recovered and returned to the US with his family. A colleague exposed was sent to Prague for monitoring. The outbreak’s international response is hampered by US policies under the Trump administration, including travel restrictions and repatriation blocks, with WHO providing care before transfer and urging accelerated actions with Africa CDC to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ感染市民の受け入れを依然拒否——2人目の米国人がドイツへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブジョ株）が史上3番目の規模に拡大しており、国際的な人的移動（ドイツ・チェコへの患者搬送）や渡航制限を伴う深刻な公衆衛生イベントであるため。
triage.notes: 感染者のドイツ・チェコへの搬送は治療・観察目的の域外対応であり、発生地域はDRCのみ。ドイツ、チェコ、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Cidadão dos Estados Unidos com Ebola é internado na Alemanha | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American citizen with Ebola is hospitalized in Germany | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, an American citizen infected with Ebola, Bundibugyo variant, from the Democratic Republic of the Congo is hospitalized in Frankfurt, Germany, in stable condition. The patient arrived at the hospital’s isolation unit around 3:00 a.m. local time after contracting the Bundibugyo strain in Congo. The U.S. CDC stated on July 10 that a American humanitarian worker in Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola. The patient—a man in his 60s, a full-time warehouse manager for Samaritan’s Purse—received early treatment, and officials say there is no public risk due to complete isolation in a separate unit. Congo’s outbreak has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces. A June case involved an American treated in Berlin and discharged from Charité hospital.

triage.headline_ja: 米国籍のエボラ感染者、ドイツで入院
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）アウトブレイクが1,926例・702死亡に達し、感染者が国外（ドイツ）に運ばれるなど国際的拡大が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 感染者はコンゴ（ブンディブジョ株エボラ）で感染し、ドイツ・フランクフルトの隔離病棟で治療中。米国やドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。コンゴ国内の感染拡大（Haut-Uele州、Tshopo州）が主眼。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : la riposte se poursuit avec de nouvelles guérisons et un renforcement de la surveillance | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: the response continues with new recoveries and strengthened surveillance | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo shows regional variation. In Beni, North Kivu, three patients—an adult male, a female, and a child—were discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center on July 11 after recovery, underscoring the benefit of early, protocol-adherent care to curb transmission. In Kisangani, Tshopo province, four confirmed cases have been recorded, including two deaths, across Makiso-Kisangani, Mangobo and Lubunga health zones. Response teams are monitoring 129 contacts and investigating around 40 suspected cases, with intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and risk communication ongoing. In Maniema, the provincial government has declared an alert; health controls have been stepped up at ports, airports and border posts, and response committees have been reactivated in seven territories. No confirmed Maniema cases yet, but authorities urge adherence to prevention measures and prompt reporting of suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：治癒者増加とサーベイランス強化を伴う対応継続
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の複数州（北キブ、チョポ、マニエマ）における継続的な感染・死亡例が報告され、国際的拡大防止のための渡航・貿易制限的措置（国境検疫強化）も取られているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 北キブ州ベニでは回復例が報告される一方、チョポ州キサンガニでは4例確認（死亡2例）、129人の接触者と約40人の疑い例を調査中。マニエマ州では確定例なしだが州政府が警戒を宣言し、港湾・空港・国境検問所での検疫を強化。複数州にわたる継続的流行状況であり、既知のエボラ流行対応の一部として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ante la posible llegada de El Niño, Posadas refuerza la prevención para reducir el riesgo de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In view of the possible arrival of El Niño, Posadas reinforces prevention to reduce the risk of dengue
article.articleSummary: Posadas, Argentina intensifies dengue prevention ahead of El Niño, with forecasts of more frequent rains and higher temperatures boosting Aedes aegypti transmission of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. Municipal health officials stress that removing water-holding containers from homes is critical, as the main driver remains domestic receptacles. Winter is identified as the best time to eliminate breeding sites to reduce next season’s outbreaks. The city is in an inter-epidemic period with historically few transmissions, though first cases typically appear from early to mid-December as temperatures rise. Regional spread depends on movement between Misiones, Corrientes, Paraguay and Brazil. A May LIRAa survey found 12.8% of homes with at least one breeding site, and 17 vector-containing containers per 100 houses, highest in Dolores Norte and Dolores Sur. Access for inspections remains variable, with 12–15% refusing and 40–50% allowing.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョの到来可能性を受け、ポサーダス市はデング熱リスク低減のため予防策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 現時点で実際の感染拡大や症例増加は報告されておらず、季節前の予防的取り組みに関する記事であり、対象国（ブラジル）は主題ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチン・ポサーダス市（ミシオネス州）における予防活動であり、対象国リストに含まれる国（ブラジル等）は地域移動の文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : un nouveau patient américain soigné en Allemagne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: a new American patient treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Mi-mai declared the 17th Ebola outbreak in its history, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no licensed vaccine or treatment. As of July 9, 2026, the outbreak had 1,792 infections and 625 deaths. On July 13, Germany admitted a new imported case: an American infected in the DRC, arriving in Frankfurt and hospitalized at the University Hospital in Frankfurt. The health ministry provided limited details on the patient and said there is no danger to the general population or other hospital patients, and that the risk of an Ebola-infected traveler entering Germany remains very low. Earlier, at end-May, another American infected with Ebola and his family were quarantined at Berlin’s Charité; the man recovered after two weeks. The United States requested Germany’s medical expertise and shorter flight times from the DRC to aid in response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行：新たなアメリカ人患者がドイツで治療される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（17回目、1792例・625死亡）が進行中であり、既に複数の輸入例がドイツに発生していることから国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ドイツ・米国での輸入例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、DRCでの流行拡大が主要な公衆衛生上の懸念事項である。

article.articleHeadline: Papua Selatan Mulai Serius Obati Penyakit Kusta dan TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Papua Starts Serious Treatment for Leprosy and Tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: South Papua Province, Indonesia, is intensifying efforts to eliminate leprosy (Hansen’s disease) and tuberculosis, alongside HIV/AIDS, malaria, and maternal–child health improvements. Dinkes PPKB Chief Benedicta Herlina Rahangiar said a cross‑sector commitment will be signed on 14 July 2026 with regional leaders, health officials, TNI and Polri, legislators, academics, professional bodies, development partners, and community and religious figures to accelerate leprosy elimination and strengthen TB control. 2025 data show leprosy prevalence at 8.13 per 10,000, up 1.76 points from the previous year and well above the national target of under 1 per 10,000. In 2025, 221 new leprosy cases were detected (180 adults, 41 children), with a Case Detection Rate of 40.21 per 100,000—far above the national target of 5 per 100,000. Each detected case is treated under standard health services, though occasional central‑level drug distribution delays were noted. Public health campaigns promote the Free Health Check Program for early detection of leprosy and other diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 南パプアが結核とハンセン病治療への取り組みを本格化
triage.triage_reason: 既知のエンデミック疾患（ハンセン病・結核）への行政的対応を報じる定例的な公衆衛生プログラム記事であり、急性の異常事象や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ハンセン病の有病率が国家目標を大幅に超えているが、これは慢性的なエンデミック状況であり、急性の公衆衛生危機とは異なる。地方政府による多部門連携の対策強化を報じる内容。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: Eurofarma anuncia parceria para trazer vacina contra chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regional Newspaper: Eurofarma announces partnership to bring chikungunya vaccine.
article.articleSummary: On July 13, 2026, Brazilian pharmaceutical company Eurofarma announced a partnership with Danish laboratory Bavarian Nordic to bring a chikungunya vaccine to Brazil. The candidate vaccine, CHIKV VLP, targets chikungunya, a disease transmitted by the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Eurofarma has already submitted a registration request to Anvisa in June, initiating the regulatory approval process for this single-dose vaccine. CHIKV VLP uses virus-like particle technology, presenting the external structure of the pathogen without its genetic material, preventing replication and infection. If approved, the vaccine would move forward under Brazil’s regulatory framework, with the current report focusing on the partnership, the vaccine’s design, and the ongoing submission to Anvisa.

triage.headline_ja: 地方紙フォーリャ・ダ・レジオン:エウロファルマがチクングニアワクチン導入のための提携を発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン開発・承認手続きに関するビジネス提携の発表であり、実際の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: デンマークはワクチン開発企業（バイオリノルディック）の所在地であり、チクングニア発生国ではないため除外。記事は疫学的イベントではなくワクチン開発・提携ニュース。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Eurofarma faz parceria para trazer vacina contra chikungunya ao Brasil | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eurofarma forms a partnership to bring a Chikungunya vaccine to Brazil | A TARDE
article.articleSummary: On July 13, 2026, Brazilian company Eurofarma announced a partnership with Danish Bavarian Nordic to bring a chikungunya vaccine to Brazil, submitting registration to Anvisa in June for CHIKV VLP. The single-dose vaccine uses virus-like particles (non-replicating) and has shown neutralizing antibody responses across age groups; it is already approved in the US, EU, UK, Switzerland, and Canada as Vimkunya. If approved in Brazil, it would be the second chikungunya vaccine licensed in the country; the first, from Butantan and Valneva, was approved by Anvisa in April 2025, with production authorized in May 2026. The Butantan vaccine is a live-attenuated formulation for ages 18–59, contraindicated in pregnancy and immunosuppressed individuals. Globally, WHO reports >500,000 chikungunya cases and ~186 deaths in 2025; Brazil records ~130,000 cases and ~120 deaths. PAHO/WHO warn of rising transmission into early 2026, including resurgence in central-west and southeast Brazil, with spread in >110 countries; climate warming may boost Aedes aegypti–borne transmission, causing acute fever and potential chronic arthralgia.

triage.headline_ja: Eurofarma社がチキングニアワクチンをブラジルに導入するため提携 | A TARDE
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン導入・製薬提携に関する内容が主であり新規の異常発生報告ではないが、ブラジルでのチクングニア熱の流行拡大・再燃に関する言及があるため継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はワクチン供与・製薬提携に関するニュースであり、感染症発生そのものの警報ではない。ただしブラジルでのチクングニア熱流行拡大（中西部・南東部での再燃）についての言及があり、疫学的動向の観察は継続すべき。米国・スイス・英国・デンマーク・カナダは製品承認国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Pig germs build drug resistance
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis, a bacterium carried by pigs in Thailand, shows antibiotic resistance and may drive rising human infections. Researchers at Biotec and Kasetsart University collected S. suis strains from patients and injected them into mice; Serotype 2 sub-strains ST233 and ST104 caused 80–100% mortality within 48 hours due to septicaemia, while Serotype 14 showed similar virulence and Serotype 31 intermediate after 42 hours. Since 1987 Bangkok reported the first human case, with a 2000 Lamphun cluster of 10 fatalities; overall 1,798 infections and about 0.97 per 100,000 population. Serotype 2 dominates human disease (93.4%), followed by Serotype 4 (5.2%). ST1, ST104, ST233, and ST1688 relate to meningitis, sepsis, and infective endocarditis. Penicillin and ceftriaxone resistance linked to CC233 and CC1688. Heat destroys the bacteria; raw pork consumption is the main exposure. Calls for improved farming hygiene to curb transmission and awareness.

triage.headline_ja: 豚由来細菌が薬剤耐性を強める
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるStreptococcus suis感染の薬剤耐性に関する研究報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではないが、豚肉消費を介した継続的な感染リスクと重症化(敗血症・髄膜炎)の可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の疫学・微生物学的研究データ（1987年以降の症例集計含む）に基づく報告であり、急性の発生事象ではない。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、主な感染経路は生豚肉の摂取であるため、養豚衛生管理と加熱調理の啓発が対策の中心となる。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Qué es el ébola? Lo que debes saber sobre esta enfermedad viral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Ebola? What you need to know about this viral disease.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is caused by the Orthoebolavirus group, first identified in 1976 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. These viruses circulate mainly in sub-Saharan Africa and can cause a severe illness with an untreated case fatality rate of about 80–90% (CDC). Four species cause human disease: Zaire ebolavirus, Sudan ebolavirus, Taï Forest ebolavirus, and Bundibugyo ebolavirus; Reston and Bombali have not caused human illness to date. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of a symptomatic or deceased person; rare animal-to-human transmission from bats or some primates may occur. Ebola is not airborne and cannot be spread by merely sharing a space with an infected person. In the United States, ERVEBO®, a vaccine for high-risk exposure to Zaire ebolavirus, is approved. Diagnosis relies on laboratory tests, principally PCR; suspected cases should be isolated pending confirmation to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱とは？このウイルス性疾患について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントではなく、エボラ出血熱に関する一般的な解説記事であり、具体的な発生や症例数の報告がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ出血熱の疫学・症状・予防に関する一般的な教育記事であり、DRCや米国での具体的な発生事例を報じたものではない。発生地域として付与されたDRC・米国はいずれも解説文脈上の言及に過ぎず、実際のイベント発生を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: No evidence of highly virulent COVID-19 variant in T.N., says Health department
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu's Health Department says there is no evidence of a highly virulent COVID-19 variant circulating in the state, and infections are lower than in previous years. A Directorate of Public Health press release cites routine Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme monitoring and pre-operative testing. In Andhra Pradesh, two deaths are reported: a 52-year-old man transferred to Vellore with COVID-19 and Klebsiella pneumoniae who died June 28, and a 68-year-old man treated in Vellore for colon cancer who died with COVID-19 as an incidental finding. A separate Kadapa district case, a 46-year-old man dying while undergoing treatment for COVID-19 in AP, is under medical review. Tamil Nadu’s totals: 990 cases in 2024, 1,250 in 2025, and 335 so far in 2026 (total 2,575) detected via routine surveillance with mostly mild symptoms; no outbreak. NIV Pune WGS links circulating variant to mild illness and low transmission. Public urged to maintain hygiene and follow official guidance; no alarm.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナドゥ州で高毒性COVID-19変異株の証拠なし、保健局が発表
triage.triage_reason: 保健当局が高毒性変異株の証拠なしと明言し、感染者数は過去より減少、大半が軽症で流行の兆候もないため、シグナルとして扱う根拠が乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事にNipahウイルスに関する記載はなく、疾患タグの付与は誤りと考えられる。報告された死亡例も基礎疾患やCOVID-19が偶発的所見であるケースが中心で、直接的な重症例増加を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí confirma 11 mortes por dengue em 2026 e ultrapassa 14 mil casos prováveis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí confirms 11 dengue deaths in 2026 and surpasses 14,000 probable cases.
article.articleSummary: Piauí, Brazil, reported 11 dengue deaths in 2026, with one case under investigation, according to the Epidemiological Arboviruses Panel updated on July 13, 2026. Since January, the state has 14,476 probable dengue cases, of which 8,400 have been laboratory- or clinically confirmed. The overall fatality rate among probable cases is 0.08%, but the rate rises sharply in severe dengue to 2.55% for those with complications. There are 26 confirmed cases of severe dengue and 405 confirmed dengue with warning signs. Regional distribution shows Meio Norte as the most affected macroregion with 7,796 probable cases; Cerrado 3,981; Semiárido 1,808. Among health regions, Entre Rios leads with 7,305 probable cases, followed by Serra da Capivara with 2,410. Women account for the majority of cases (7,890 vs 6,560 men). Cumulative incidence stands at 440.13 per 100,000 inhabitants.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州、2026年のデング熱死者11人を確認、確定・疑い症例1万4千件を超える
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内のデング熱流行で死者・症例数は多いが、ブラジルでは毎年季節的に発生する既知の疾患であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため継続観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する既知の疾患であり、州レベルの統計報告。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威としての新規性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи в Конго став найшвидшим в історії та продовжує набирати обертів
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has become the fastest in history and continues to gain momentum.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak is the fastest-growing in recorded history, with nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccine exists, and initial spread went unrecognized due to testing for a different Ebola strain. New suspected cases have emerged in two provinces, including Kisangani, one of the country's largest cities. Security remains volatile in eastern Congo; healthcare workers face threats from armed groups, mistrust of the virus among residents, and a strike by Ebola treatment center staff in Ituri Province over prolonged salary delays. Despite challenges, researchers have begun clinical trials of two treatments: remdesivir and MBP134, an antibody-based therapy designed to target multiple Ebola strains, including Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行は史上最速となり、依然として拡大を続けている
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で史上最速のエボラ流行（約2000例、702死亡）が拡大中で、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる被害拡大とIHR複数基準への該当が確認されるため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で承認ワクチンが存在せず、初期に別株として検査されたため拡大を許した経緯がある。治安不安、医療従事者への脅威、賃金未払いによるストライキなど対応能力に懸念があり、外部支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Advierten que la peste no es una enfermedad erradicada y sigue matando, incluso en EE.UU.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They warn that the plague has not been eradicated and continues to kill, even in the United States.
article.articleSummary: Plague remains endemic in Madagascar and persists in parts of the United States, notably Oregon. Yersinia pestis causes three forms: bubonic (fleas transmitting from infected rodents; painful lymph node swelling), septicemic (bloodstream infection), and pneumonic (airborne, person-to-person transmission). Globally, up to 3,000 cases are reported annually; Madagascar experiences 250–500 cases per year, with the DRC and Uganda also affected. A 2014 Oregon case shows how non-specific early symptoms can lead to misdiagnosis as cat-scratch disease after a bite from a sick cat. Diagnosis is critical and often delayed; antibiotics can be lifesaving. Efforts to strengthen laboratory networks include Madagascar’s Laboratory for Medical Analyses and the Robert Koch Institute in Germany, led by Holger Scholz. Europe has been plague-free since 1945; last Corsican cases. Ancient DNA shows Y. pestis dates back more than 5,500 years.

triage.headline_ja: ペストは根絶された病気ではなく、米国でも今なお人命を奪い続けていると専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、ペストが根絶されていないことを解説する一般教育的な記事であり、緊急のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はペスト（Yersinia pestis）の歴史・疫学・診断に関する解説記事であり、新規の発生や急性イベントを報じるものではない。マダガスカルが主要な流行地域として言及され、DRC・ウガンダも影響地域として触れられているが、いずれも既知の恒常的流行状況の説明に過ぎない。マダガスカル・米国・フランス・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Município registra novo caso de dengue em 10 dias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipality records a new dengue case in 10 days.
article.articleSummary: Barretos, Brazil, recorded one new dengue case between July 3 and July 13, bringing total confirmed dengue cases to 233 among 2,046 notifications. By July 13, 1,774 cases had been discarded and 39 were under investigation; no dengue deaths have occurred this year. Despite the single-case increase, the Municipal Health Secretariat continues Aedes aegypti control efforts with fieldwork across neighborhoods, household visits, elimination of breeding sites, and resident guidance to prevent transmission. These figures suggest stable transmission with limited growth, reinforcing continued vector control and community outreach.

triage.headline_ja: 自治体、10日間で新たなデング熱1例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バレトス市における単発のデング熱新規1例で、死亡なく感染拡大も限定的であり、既存のベクター対策が継続されているのみで異常性・国際的懸念はない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルの対象国リストに含まれるが、記事は地方自治体レベルの日常的なサーベイランス報告であり、症例数も233例中1例の増加に過ぎず死亡例もないため、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 6月新增新冠确诊环比增近3倍 病例数显著上升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: June sees a nearly threefold month-on-month increase in new confirmed COVID-19 cases; case numbers rise significantly.
article.articleSummary: June 2026 saw 79,000 new confirmed COVID-19 cases in China (June 1–30) across 31 provinces and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, with 130 severe cases and 1 death in a patient with underlying disease. This is a 3.61-fold month-on-month rise from May’s ~21,900 cases, yet still far below June 2025’s 333,000. Genomic surveillance reported 3,741 local SARS-CoV-2 genomes, all Omicron variants, dominated by NB.1.8.1 and sublineages; no evidence of new high-risk variants. Experts attribute the increase to waning population immunity (antibodies protecting 4–6 months), summer travel, and indoor, poorly ventilated environments; overall severity and mortality have not risen, indicating a temporary fluctuation rather than a pandemic. Shanghai’s Hu Yang and Peng Jie emphasize protection for immunocompromised individuals and those with underlying conditions. China CDC notes activity among influenza, rhinovirus, enteroviruses, parainfluenza, metapneumovirus, and SARS-CoV-2, and recommends masks, hygiene, and vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 6月の新型コロナ新規確定診断数、前月比約3倍増 症例数が顕著に上昇
triage.triage_reason: 中国全土の定例COVID-19サーベイランス報告であり、前月比では増加したが前年同月比では大幅減、新規高リスク変異株なし、重症度・死亡率上昇もなく、専門家も一時的変動でパンデミックではないと明言している。
triage.notes: 既知のOmicron系統（NB.1.8.1など）が主体で新規高リスク変異株の報告なし。中国CDCによる定例季節性呼吸器感染症サーベイランスの一環であり、パンデミックリスクとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: MSF Ebola training in Kenya prepares doctors for 'intense' job
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surged since May, becoming the fastest-spreading on record with thousands of cases and deaths reported. International response is fragmented by political stances and funding shifts, threatening containment. Authorities and partners press for cross-border surveillance, rapid isolation protocols, and expanded training for frontline workers. MSF is expanding training and local engagement in Kenya to bolster frontline readiness amid the regional crisis. The WHO and Africa CDC coordinate cross-border efforts, while the United States has imposed stringent travel restrictions and reduced direct outbreak responses, complicating international aid. The report contrasts political action with on-the-ground preparation, noting questions about current hotspots, community reception of MSF training in Kenya, and changes in U.S. policy affecting outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、ケニアでエボラ対応訓練を実施し医師らを『過酷な』任務に備える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で記録的な速さで拡大しているエボラ出血熱の流行があり、国際対応の分断や渡航制限も生じているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケニアはMSFの訓練実施国であり感染発生国ではないため除外。米国は渡航制限を課している国であり発生国ではないため除外。実際のエボラ流行はDRCで発生している。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat Reports 7 Chandipura Virus Cases, 3 Deaths; Health Department Intensifies Surveillance
article.articleSummary: Gujarat reports seven confirmed Chandipura virus (CHPV) cases in the last few weeks, with three deaths among patients under 10 years old; four are under medical treatment. Health Minister Praful Pansheriya chaired a high-level meeting in Gandhinagar to review the outbreak. Eight suspected patients’ blood samples are awaiting results; overall, 27 suspected samples have been tested previously, with seven positives and 12 negatives. CHPV causes fever with flu-like symptoms and acute encephalitis. The virus belongs to Vesiculovirus genus in the Rhabdoviridae family and is transmitted by vectors such as mosquitoes, ticks and sandflies. Surveillance and control efforts continue across Gujarat.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルスが7例確認、3人死亡；保健当局が監視強化
triage.triage_reason: 小児における死亡例を伴う急性脳炎（チャンディプラウイルス）の集団発生であり、公衆衛生への影響が深刻かつ稀な疾患であるためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはグジャラート州で季節的に発生する既知の媒介動物媒介性疾患。小児における高い死亡率と急性脳炎症状が特徴であり、州保健当局が高レベル会議を開き監視を強化している。

article.articleHeadline: Expertos piden a México incorporar vacuna contra dengue ante riesgo de nuevas epidemias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts urge Mexico to adopt a dengue vaccine amid the risk of new epidemics.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Mexico faces a hyperendemic scenario, warns the Asociación Mexicana de Vacunología (AMV). In a proposal to President Claudia Sheinbaum, AMV urges adding dengue vaccination to existing vector-control measures, not replacing them. Climate change has expanded the Aedes aegypti mosquito into new regions, while urban growth increases exposure; the 2024 epidemic was the largest on record in Mexico and worldwide. All four dengue serotypes are circulating, raising the risk of severe dengue in previously infected individuals. About 70% of Mexican territory is endemic, indicating widespread prior exposure. The plan targets high-incidence municipalities, prioritizing children 6–11 years old, alongside current breeding-site elimination and insecticide use. A dengue vaccine was licensed in late 2025 and could be available soon; Brazil started vaccination in 2024. If not accelerated, Mexico risks recurrent epidemics, with another major dengue outbreak anticipated. In 2026, 24,998 probable and 2,421 confirmed cases through week 22.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、新たな流行のリスクを前にメキシコにデングワクチン導入を要請
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はメキシコにおけるデング熱ワクチン導入の専門家提言であり、対象国リストに該当する国（ブラジル等）が発生地域として主題化されていないため見送りと判定。
triage.notes: 記事はメキシコにおけるデング熱の流行状況とワクチン導入提言が主題。ブラジルは2024年からのワクチン接種開始事例として言及されているのみで、ブラジル国内での発生自体は主題ではないため対象外とした。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: علماء أكسفورد يطورون لقاحاً واعداً لمواجهة أخطر سلالة من "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford scientists are developing a promising vaccine to confront the deadliest strain of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Oxford researchers have launched the first-in-human trial of a vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, in response to one of Africa’s deadliest outbreaks. The UK MHRA approved a Phase I study of 50 healthy adults (18–55) to assess safety and immunogenicity, with one-year follow-up. The vaccine uses a chimpanzee adenovirus vector delivering Bundibugyo genetic code, a platform based on the technology behind the Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Development occurred in 57 days after the WHO declared the Congo outbreak a public health emergency. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 625 deaths and 1,792 infections mark it as the third-largest Ebola outbreak. Serum Institute of India has produced about 620,000 doses; a second efficacy study is planned in Uganda. Prof. Teresa Lamb and Alex Sampson note rapid progress; preclinical tests in mice and macaques were promising. Rare adverse events like blood clots are acknowledged; safety remains a priority.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学の科学者たちが、エボラ最凶株に対抗する有望なワクチンを開発中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で625人死亡・1792人感染の大規模エボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行がWHOにより公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言されており、深刻性・異常性・国際的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はオックスフォードによるワクチン開発（第I相試験）だが、背景として言及されているコンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行（WHOがPHEIC宣言済み）自体が重大なイベントであるため、その観点からPICKUPと判定した。ウガンダ・インドはワクチン試験・製造拠点として言及されているが、当該国での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: American cu Ebola, tratat în Germania: Costuri și riscuri mutate
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American with Ebola, Treated in Germany: Costs and Risks Shifted.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) totals 1,926 cases and 702 deaths as of 12 July. The second American patient infected in this outbreak was transferred to Frankfurt University Hospital in Germany after Samaritan’s Purse shifted care from the DRC; the first American, Dr. Peter Stafford, had already been evacuated to Berlin with care coordinated by the WHO. The shift away from domestic repatriation to European treatment centers redefines response timelines, logistics, and exposure risk, elevating dependence on external capacity. The move carries material implications for employers and donors in terms of costs, staffing, and mission continuity. WHO and Africa CDC call for accelerated, multi-country mobilization. The RDC outbreak, declared 15 May, is described as the third largest on record.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の米国人患者、ドイツで治療:費用とリスクの移転
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）は史上3番目に大きい規模（1,926例・702死亡）で、患者の国際移送や多国間動員要請が発生しており、公衆衛生上・国際的関心ともに高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにドイツ（フランクフルト、ベルリン）が含まれるが、これは患者の治療のための移送先であり、実際の発生国はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱のワクチン治験開始　コンゴ流行株で初、英大学
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccine trial begins; first against the Congo outbreak strain, UK university.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University announced on July 13 the world's first clinical trial of a vaccine against Ebola virus disease focused on the Bundibugyo strain circulating in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (formerly Zaire). The study will enroll 50 participants aged 18–55, with vaccination expected within weeks. Developed by Oxford researchers and manufactured by an Indian institute, the vaccine will be evaluated for safety and immune response. The trial has UK regulatory approval and will be conducted in the United Kingdom, with preparations under way to conduct parts of the study in Africa. The Democratic Republic of the Congo Ministry of Health reported on July 12 that 1,926 infections and 702 deaths have occurred in the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱のワクチン治験開始　コンゴ流行株で初、英大学
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行は1,926感染・702死亡に達し深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的なワクチン治験開始という社会的関心・国際支援の動きも見られるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はUK・インドが関与するワクチン治験だが、実際の疾病発生国はDRCのみ。UK・Indiaは治験実施・製造国であり発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの流行は既知のアウトブレイクの続報だが、死亡者数・感染者数の規模から深刻度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue despencam 98% em São Carlos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases plummet 98% in São Carlos.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in São Carlos show a markedly positive trend as of July 13, 2026. The Epidemiological Surveillance bulletin reports 393 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases in 2026 to date, with zero deaths. This represents a 98% decline from 19,254 cases during the same period in 2025. General notifications (confirmed, suspected, and discarded) fell from 25,119 in 2025 to 3,078 in 2026, an 88% decrease. Regarding other arboviruses, 165 suspected chikungunya cases were discarded and 154 zika virus notifications were discarded; there have been no suspected or confirmed yellow fever cases so far. Health authorities reiterate that combating Aedes aegypti remains a priority, emphasizing removal of breeding sites, prevention of standing water, and population awareness to sustain progress and prevent new outbreaks later in the year.

triage.headline_ja: サンカルロスでデング熱症例が98%減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例は前年比98%減少し、死亡者もゼロという明確な改善傾向を示す内容で、公衆衛生上の懸念や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのサンカルロス市におけるデング熱症例数の大幅な減少を報じるポジティブな内容であり、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、内容が減少傾向の報告であるため、リスクイベントとしては該当しないと判断し、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí registra 11 mortes por dengue e mais de 8,3 mil casos confirmados em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí records 11 dengue deaths and more than 8,300 confirmed cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026, Piauí, Brazil, has recorded 11 dengue deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases, with about 14,000 probable cases, 405 records showing warning signs, and 26 cases classified as severe dengue, per Sesapi epidemiological panel. The most recent confirmed case is a two-year-old girl from Pio IX who died at Hospital Regional Justino Luz in Picos. Dengue is transmitted by female Aedes aegypti and presents with high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, nausea, fatigue, joint pain, and a red rash; warning signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, dizziness, breathing difficulty, bleeding, irritability. Vulnerable groups include the elderly and patients with chronic diseases. Brazil currently has the Qdenga vaccine (Takeda); a Butantan vaccine was suspended by the Health Ministry last month during studies. Prevention focuses on eliminating mosquito breeding sites and using screens, repellents, and SUS public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州、2026年にデング熱で11人死亡、確定患者8,300人超を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ピアウイ州における季節性デング熱の流行で死者・重症例が報告されているが、ブラジルでは毎年発生する地域流行であり、国際的な異常性や渡航・貿易制限の兆候はないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ブラジルでは毎年デング熱の季節的流行が発生しており、今回の報告も地域内の通常の疫学監視データに基づくもの。国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限の兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Oxford Begins World's First Human Trial of Bundibugyo Ebola Vaccine as Congo Outbreak Continues
article.articleSummary: Oxford begins the world's first human trial of a vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, as a Congo outbreak in central Africa continues and has killed more than 700 people. The early-stage study will enroll 50 healthy adults to assess safety and tolerability; efficacy data are not yet available. This milestone marks the first clinical testing of a Bundibugyo-strain Ebola vaccine and signals intensified efforts to curb transmission in the Congo region as of 2026-07-14. The excerpt focuses on safety assessment and provides no details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or imported/exported cases.

article.articleHeadline: Clinical trials offer hope as Ebola outbreak accelerates
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths reported as of Sunday across 37 health zones in three provinces, 94% of cases in Ituri Province. Uganda has 20 mostly imported cases and has contained transmission through surveillance and contact tracing. No approved vaccines or targeted treatments exist for the Bundibugyo strain, but DR Congo launched clinical trials this month testing remdesivir, monoclonal antibodies, and combination therapies. An additional study enrolling about 800 high‑risk contacts to assess preventive therapies will begin this week. WHO and Africa CDC emphasize cautious optimism amid rapid spread, with an estimated reproduction number of 1.4 and roughly 1,600 cases in the first six weeks—far above the West Africa 2014–2016 pace.

triage.notes: ウガンダは輸入例のみで対象国リスト外。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが記事サマリー上で言及がなく、主題ではないため除外した。
